jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, India
jobs.description:
Who We Are
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.
About the Role:
Notion is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer focused on migrations to join our growing team in India. You will help deliver complex, production-grade data migrations, integrations, and automations for customers across APAC.
This is initially an internally focused, hands-on engineering role. You will partner closely with regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who own customer discovery, solution architecture, stakeholder communication, risk management, and final customer validation. You will own the behind-the-scenes technical execution layer from feasibility assessment and implementation through testing, production rollout, QA, reconciliation, reporting, and operational handoff.
You will work across multiple customer environments and source systems, often with incomplete requirements, imperfect data, and real-world constraints. Success requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound judgment, careful validation, and the ability to turn one-off delivery work into reusable tools and repeatable playbooks.
As a founding engineer in India, you will help build a new regional engineering capability from the ground up. You will create migration infrastructure, standards, and reusable tooling used by FDEs across APAC, while establishing practices that can scale globally. The role offers an opportunity to become a technical authority for production migration delivery, shaping how Notion approaches reliability, validation, and operational quality across complex customer environments. As the team grows, the role may also expand toward customer-facing FDE work, technical leadership, or a deeper engineering path, depending on business needs and demonstrated capability.
What You'll Achieve:
Own the technical execution layer after customer requirements, scope, and solution architecture have been established with the regional FDE. Contribute to feasibility assessment, estimation, implementation planning, and risk identification while the regional FDE remains accountable for customer discovery, scope, architecture, stakeholder communication, and final acceptance.
Apply a repeatable migration lifecycle covering source inventory and sampling, scope and pruning decisions, compatibility and degradation assessment, transformation design, pilot or dry run, user acceptance testing, production cutover, reconciliation, remediation, hypercare, and documented handoff.
Translate approved customer and regional FDE requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, test strategies, runbooks, and delivery estimates.
Build production-quality migration utilities, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, and automations using Python, SQL, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
Investigate source-system behavior, data quality issues, permissions, rate limits, authentication constraints, and edge cases, then recommend practical solutions.
Design and validate permissions, ownership, and inheritance mappings against the approved migration plan. Make unsupported or ambiguous access requirements explicit, obtain the required decision or approval, and preserve evidence of validation.
Design migrations for reliability, scale, security, observability, idempotency, failure recovery, and safe reruns.
Execute migrations only through approved environments, devices, accounts, and tooling. Follow least-privilege access, customer-specific security and data-residency requirements, and approved handling procedures. Do not store customer data in unmanaged local or external systems, and escalate privacy, security, or sovereignty concerns before execution.
Build validation and reconciliation frameworks that provide clear evidence of migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions.
Debug failures across application code, infrastructure, customer data, third-party systems, and the Notion platform, then drive issues through resolution.
Manage multiple implementation workstreams, dependencies, and priorities while communicating scope, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly.
Surface scope changes, unsupported requirements, timeline risks, and material effort increases early. Document assumptions and trade-offs, and escalate with options and a recommended path rather than silently absorbing additional work.
Maintain an auditable record of scope, decisions, risks, approvals, validation evidence, and customer acceptance criteria in the agreed shared workspace or channel.
Convert repeated delivery patterns into reusable components, automation, documentation, and playbooks that improve speed, quality, and cost over time.
Bring field learnings back to Notion's Product and Engineering teams as actionable platform feedback and technical requirements.
Skills You'll Need to Bring:
3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in backend engineering, data engineering, integration engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role.
Strong hands-on Python development experience.
Working experience with Node.js, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and data transformation.
Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, webhooks, and system integrations.
Experience owning a production migration, integration, or technical implementation through mapping, transformation, testing, rollout, validation, and handoff.
Experience taking a technical problem from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production operation.
Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, release practices, and production deployment.
Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills across code, data, infrastructure, and external systems.
Evidence of working on production systems, not only prototypes or proof-of-concept projects.
Clear written and verbal English communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions, constraints, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
High agency and ownership. You are comfortable making progress with incomplete information, challenging assumptions, and escalating with options and a recommendation.
Nice to Haves:
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, job orchestration, or infrastructure automation.
Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Familiarity with message queues, event-driven systems, distributed-system patterns, retries, concurrency, and rate limits.
Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, or other observability tools.
Experience with enterprise SaaS applications, professional services, or large-scale customer implementations.
Experience migrating large volumes of content or structured data between enterprise platforms.
Experience with AI or LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, or agentic workflows.
Familiarity with MCP, tool calling, Notion Workers, Custom Agents, or similar extensibility platforms.
Experience working with distributed global or APAC teams.
What success looks like:
In your first 90 days, you will:
Learn Notion's migration and implementation ecosystem, engineering standards, and APAC delivery model.
Establish a productive working rhythm with regional FDE partners.
Contribute to at least one migration or integration workstream through production delivery.
Leave behind clear technical documentation, validation evidence, and an operational runbook.
Within your first six months, you will:
Independently own production migration or integration workstreams from technical design through rollout and handoff.
Deliver measurable improvements in migration turnaround time, validation quality, delivery cost, or regional FDE execution hours through reusable engineering.
Help establish repeatable quality controls, code review practices, runbooks, and observability patterns for the India team.
Demonstrate effective prioritization and communication across multiple concurrent APAC engagements.
Turn at least one repeated delivery pattern into a reusable tool, component, or playbook that is adopted by a subsequent engagement.
Location:
This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our Anchor Days, because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We're looking for someone who's excited to work alongside the team during those days.

Your future team
As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Atlassian, you’ll be at the forefront of applied AI, working directly with customers and cross-functional teams to deliver innovative, AI-powered solutions. The FDE team partners with top organizations across industries, helping them leverage Atlassian’s AI capabilities to solve complex, real-world problems. You’ll collaborate with product, engineering, and design, rapidly growing your technical and domain expertise while making a tangible impact on business outcomes. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for those who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and are passionate about shaping the future of AI-powered teamwork.
To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/fdeatlassian.
What you’ll do
As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:
Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI/ML-powered solutions tailored to customer needs.
Architect and implement robust application integrations using Python, JavaScript, or similar languages, with a focus on APIs, microservices, and enterprise-scale systems.
Drive data-driven solution development by analyzing complex datasets to extract insights and inform product direction.
Champion the adoption of AI-augmented workflow automation within customer environments, maximizing business value and operational efficiency.
Oversee the end-to-end deployment of AI solutions into production, ensuring continuous evaluation, monitoring, and improvement.
Navigate risk and compliance requirements, including AI risk assessment, data privacy (GDPR), and regulatory frameworks.
Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, creating concise artifacts for peers, partners, and leadership.
Align technical solutions with business objectives, setting a clear vision for technological progress and measurable results.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

10+ years of experience in backend software development.
5+ years of experience delivering impactful AI/ML solutions in production environments, including experience as a founding or forward-deployed engineer in 0-to-1 product development.
Deep expertise in applied AI/ML, including generative AI, LLMs, and agent-based frameworks.
Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages, and experience with APIs, microservices, and enterprise integration.
Demonstrated ability to solve complex, ambiguous problems and thrive in rapidly changing environments.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing cross-functional teams without formal authority.
Experience with AI risk assessment, data privacy, and compliance (e.g., GDPR).
Strategic and innovative thinking, with a track record of aligning technical solutions to business goals.
It's great, but not required, if you have:
Experience with Atlassian Intelligence, Rovo AI, or AI-powered Atlassian features.
Familiarity with regulated industries (e.g., finance, healthcare).
Experience deploying AI solutions to complex production systems at scale.
Prior experience mentoring or leading engineering teams.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Trusted Data Platform
jobs.description:
Job Details | Atlassian
Principal Software Engineer - Trusted Data Platform
Engineering | Bengaluru, India | Remote, Remote | Full-Time
Apply for this job
Working at Atlassian
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company.
Our office is in Bellevue, WA, but we offer flexibility for eligible candidates to work remotely across the West US. Whatever your preference - working from home, an office, or in between - you can choose the place that's best for your work and your lifestyle. We call this TEAM anywhere.
As a Principal Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader and hands-on contributor, designing and optimizing high-scale, distributed storage systems built on AWS storage technologies. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the architecture, performance, and reliability of backend storage solutions that power critical applications at scale.
Your primary responsibilities will include designing, implementing, and optimizing backend storage services that support high throughput, low latency, and fault tolerance. You will work closely with senior engineers, architects, and cross-functional teams to drive scalability, availability, and efficiency improvements in large-scale storage solutions. You will also lead technical deep dives, architecture reviews, and root cause analyses to resolve complex production issues related to storage performance, consistency, and durability.
As a thought leader, you will drive best practices in distributed system design, security, and cloud cost optimization. You will also mentor senior engineers, contribute to technical roadmaps, and help shape the long-term storage strategy. Your expertise in storage consistency models, data partitioning, indexing, and caching strategies will be instrumental in improving system performance and reliability.
Additionally, you will collaborate with Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) to implement observability, monitoring, and disaster recovery strategies, ensuring high availability and compliance with industry standards. You will advocate for automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), and DevOps best practices, leveraging tools like Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Kubernetes (EKS), and CI/CD pipelines to enable scalable deployments and operational excellence.
Basic Requirements
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
8+ years of experience in backend software development, focusing on distributed systems and storage solutions.
5+ years of experience working with AWS storage services (S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, Glacier).
Strong expertise in system design, architecture, and scalability for large-scale storage solutions.
Proficiency in at least one major backend programming language (Kotlin, Java, Go, Rust, or Python).
Experience designing and implementing highly available, fault-tolerant, and cost-efficient storage architectures.
Deep understanding of distributed systems, replication strategies, sharding, and caching.
Knowledge of data security, encryption best practices, and compliance requirements (SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA).
Experience leading engineering teams, mentoring senior engineers, and driving technical roadmaps.
Proficiency with observability tools, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting at scale.
Core Requirements
Expertise in Large-Scale Storage Systems
Deep knowledge of AWS storage services (S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, Glacier) and their performance characteristics.
Experience designing and optimizing object storage, block storage, and file storage solutions at scale.
Strong understanding of storage durability, consistency models, replication, and erasure coding for fault tolerance.
Experience implementing tiered storage solutions and cost-optimized data retention strategies.
Distributed Systems & Scalability
Deep understanding of distributed storage architectures, CAP theorem, and consistency models.
Expertise in partitioning, sharding, and replication strategies for low-latency, high-throughput storage.
Experience designing and implementing highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems using consensus algorithms (Raft, Paxos, Gossip Protocol).
Hands-on experience with high-performance NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, Cassandra, RocksDB).
High-Performance Backend Engineering
Strong programming skills in Kotlin, Java, Go, Rust, or Python for backend storage development.
Experience building event-driven, microservices-based architectures using gRPC, REST, or WebSockets.
Expertise in data serialization formats (Parquet, Avro, ORC) for optimized storage access.
Experience implementing data compression, deduplication, and indexing strategies to improve storage efficiency.
Cloud-Native & Infrastructure Automation
Strong hands-on experience with AWS Well-Architected Framework and cloud storage best practices.
Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.
Experience with Kubernetes (EKS), serverless architectures (Lambda, Fargate), and containerized storage workloads.
Expertise in CI/CD automation for storage services, leveraging GitHub Actions, CodePipeline, Jenkins, or ArgoCD.
Performance Optimization & Observability
Experience with benchmarking, profiling, and optimizing storage workloads.
Proficiency in performance monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana) for storage systems.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills for latency bottlenecks, memory leaks, and concurrency issues.
Experience designing observability strategies (tracing, metrics, structured logging) for large-scale storage systems.
Security, Compliance, and Data Protection
Deep knowledge of data security, encryption at rest/in transit, and IAM policies in AWS.
Experience implementing fine-grained access controls (IAM, KMS, STS, VPC Security Groups) for multi-tenant storage solutions.
Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP) and best practices for secure data storage.
Expertise in disaster recovery, backup strategies, and multi-region failover solutions.
Leadership & Architectural Strategy
Proven ability to design, document, and drive large-scale storage architectures from concept to production.
Experience leading technical design reviews, architecture discussions, and engineering best practices.
Strong ability to mentor senior and mid-level engineers, fostering growth in distributed storage expertise.
Ability to influence technical roadmaps, long-term vision, and cost optimization strategies for backend storage.

Extract compact models for advanced semiconductor devices (HBT/BJT, RF CMOS, RF Passives, GaN)

Automate modeling infrastructure to accelerate technology development

Ph.D./Masters in Electrical Engineering or related field
5+ years in compact (SPICE) RF modeling for HBT/BJT and CMOS

jobs.title: Sr. Network Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments is seeking an Sr. Network Security Engineer responsible for designing, implementing, and operating highly resilient Enterprise, Manufacturing (OT/Fab), and Data Center network security solutions. You will protect TI's global infrastructure, hybrid cloud environments, remote users, and business-critical applications. This role requires a seasoned engineer with deep expertise in Palo Alto Networks and Fortinet technologies, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and secure enterprise architecture. You will define and implement network security strategies that support global business growth, safeguard intellectual property, and minimize operational risk across our global footprint.
Experience & Core Requirements
Total Experience: 8+ years of experience in enterprise network engineering and information security environments.
Palo Alto Expertise: 4+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and managing Palo Alto Networks Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) and Panorama.
Advanced SASE/Cloud Experience: Proven track record working with Palo Alto Strata Cloud Manager (SCM) and Prisma Access for global secure access service edge deployment
Key Responsibilities
Security Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain global enterprise network security architectures, ensuring alignment with TI’s security frameworks and engineering standards.
Firewall & Perimeter Management: Lead the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of Palo Alto NGFW, Panorama, Fortinet firewalls, SCM, Prisma Access, and advanced threat prevention modules (WildFire, URL Filtering, DNS Security).
Zero Trust & Segmentation: Develop and execute Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), network segmentation, and micro-segmentation strategies to isolate critical manufacturing (OT) environments from IT networks.
Data & IP Protection: Design and implement enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions and data protection controls to safeguard high-value semiconductor designs and intellectual property.
Hybrid Cloud Security: Secure multi-cloud connectivity (AWS, Azure) and hybrid environments using cloud-native security controls and virtual appliances.
Operations & Incident Response: Provide Tier-3/4 engineering support for complex network security issues and collaborate with the global SOC during major security incidents.
Automation & DevSecOps: Drive security automation initiatives using Python, Ansible, and Terraform to deploy Network Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and streamline policy management via APIs.
Collaboration & Leadership: Partner closely with global Infrastructure, IT Cloud, IAM, and manufacturing automation teams while mentoring junior engineers in the India design center.
Leadership & Strategic Planning
Roadmap Development: Evaluate emerging security technologies and help define TI's future-state network security roadmap.
Cross-Functional Influence: Act as a trusted technical advisor, presenting architectural recommendations clearly to cross-functional global stakeholders and leadership.
Standards & Governance: Author and maintain technical design documents, security standards, and operational governance procedures.
Preferred Certifications
Palo Alto: PCNSE / PCCSE (Highly Preferred)
Cisco: CCNP Security / CCIE Security
Industry Standard: CISSP / Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
Cloud: AWS Certified Security – Specialty / Azure Security Engineer Associate

Minimum requirements:
Required Degrees:B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech in Computer Science (CSE), Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), or a related engineering discipline from a recognized Indian university.
Alternative Qualifications:MCA (Master of Computer Applications) or an M.Sc. in Computer Science/Information Security combined with relevant, deep technical field experience.
Preferred qualifications:
Core Technology Expertise: Deep technical mastery of Palo Alto NGFW, Panorama, Fortinet, SCM, Prisma Access, GlobalProtect, and associated cloud security suites.
Network & Traffic Management: Hands-on experience with core network services, specifically Infoblox (DNS/DHCP/IPAM) and A10 or F5 Load Balancers.
Segmentation & Remote Access: Deep knowledge of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Network Access Control (NAC/802.1X), and secure remote access for global engineering teams.
Cloud & SASE: Practical experience with SASE/SSE architectures, hybrid networking, and securing cloud infrastructures (AWS, Azure).
Security Automation: Strong automation and scripting skills using Python, Ansible, Terraform, REST APIs, and Git version control.
Monitoring & Analytics: Experience integrating network security platforms with SIEM systems (e.g., Splunk) and network monitoring tools for proactive threat visibility.

jobs.title: Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Position/Role: Sr Test Engineer for Power Path Protection Devices (4+ years exp).
Location: Bangalore, India
Description
Linear Power team is looking for bright engineers to drive our next generation of cutting-edge power products across Automotive, Industrial, Data Center, and Personal Electronics markets. As traditional power architecture rapidly transitions toward higher power, higher voltage, and functionally safe systems, our team is actively developing highly differentiated solutions by pushing the boundaries of silicon process, advanced packaging, IP design, and test engineering. We believe in acquiring deep end-equipment knowledge, solving complex high-voltage challenges to achieve the best performance for the application. Our teams define, design, verify, validate, and take products to high-volume manufacturing through deep involvement with customers and a thorough understanding of the market - across a broad portfolio of Power Path Protection, High-Side Switches, Precision References, Power Monitoring Solutions, and best-in-class LDOs. Join this team if you want to be at the forefront of power design and shape the future of semiconductors.
Sr Test Engineer
Summary
This role owns test solution for new product development of power path protection devices. Engineer will work with cross functional team during system definition, DFT planning, project plan, product release and support solving post production issues. The engineer leads root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and cross-functional problem solving across design, quality, and operations teams.
What You Will Do
As Test lead for your device, you will own quality and test cost entitlement for your product (test solution including hardware and software releases) and leading cross functional team to make decision, resolving critical manufacturing, test, yield, and reliability issues with urgency while eliminating recurring problems through rigorous root-cause and permanent corrective action and meet customer demand requirements. You will also be responsible to drive other projects and lead young engineers.
You will develop and execute strategies to continuously improve yield and reduce test cost across the product portfolio, working directly with factory teams to implement solutions and sustain gains on the production floor. You will partner closely with Test, Product, Design, Quality, Manufacturing, and Operations teams to close complex issues and build a structured feedback loop that transfers sustaining learnings into development to improve future designs and test strategies.
What We Are Looking For
We are looking for 4+ years experienced engineer with hands-on ATE test experience - including expertise in hardware and software (ETS or V98K tester platforms (software and hardware)). Ideal candidate combines deep technical judgment, strong analog fundamental skills and pcb design experience with cross-functional leadership - able to work across design, quality, factory, and operations teams, influence without direct authority, and build systems and processes that scale
Qualifications
Minimum requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
4+ years of relevant experience
ATE experience on Teradyne Eagle or equivalent analog ATE (iFlex, LTX, VLCT), although Eagle experience is preferred and is a differentiator
Characterization test program and hardware development experience.
Production test program and hardware development experience
Strong technical knowledge of electronic devices and circuits, and Analog test techniques
Data analysis skills.
Experience with product engineering activities such as yield improvement and test time reduction
Strong understanding of the analog electronics, IC product development process, from concept to volume production
Preferred qualifications:
Analog/Mixed signal test techniques and experience
Experienced with test program and hardware offload to TI offshore manufacturing sites
Demonstrated strong analytical and problem solving skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery
Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment
Ability to take the initiative and drive for results

jobs.title: Applications Engineer
jobs.description:
Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. And it doesn't stop there. We're developing breakthrough technology to power the world's future innovations as well. TI is committed to building a better future — from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities. Put your talent to work with us.
Our business has very high growth in TI and is in a segment where the market is fast growing. We're searching for applications engineer who have the passion and excitement to grow, innovative, take an active role in product definition, execute the characterization until ramp, and provide post ramp application support to customers.
Why DLP is exciting and differentiated
TI DLP® Products gives Applications engineers a uniquely broad and hands-on space to work in, spanning complex systems that combine optics, illumination, mechanics, MEMS-based DMDs, controllers, image-processing firmware, power management, and motor/actuator interfaces. DLP® technology is an Academy Award®-winning innovation that powers leading display solutions across digital cinema, lifestyle projection, laser TV, automotive, industrial, machine vision, 3D printing, and spectroscopy. For an engineer who enjoys working across disciplines and solving real system-level challenges, DLP offers an opportunity to contribute to technology that is both technically deep and widely used across fast-growing applications.
What this specific role in India will do
In this role, the engineer will work within the TI India DLP® Products Group to develop, validate, debug, and support DLP-based applications for high-resolution and high-brightness display systems, automotive display and lighting, and industrial use cases. The role involves working closely with customers and internal cross-functional teams to solve technical issues, improve product quality, support system bring-up and release readiness, and create technical deliverables that help scale support. This is a strong fit for someone who is self-driven, comfortable working across both hardware and software, and motivated to take ownership of complex application engineering problems from development through customer enablement.

Key Responsibilities
Contribute to new product development through application use-case definition, requirements analysis, and system-level performance evaluation
Support system bring-up, feature validation, and board-level debug across hardware, firmware, and overall application behavior
Work closely with customers, sales, marketing, program management, and engineering teams to support product launches and drive issue resolution
Provide ongoing customer support through schematic reviews, technical troubleshooting, training, and on-site bring-up support when needed
Create technical collateral such as user guides, application notes, technical briefs, and reusable debug documentation
Improve team efficiency through scripting, automation, reusable debug methods, and better documentation practices
Support proof-of-concept demonstrations, technical seminars, and field training on TI DLP® solution offerings
Contribute to silicon bring-up and application-level testing to help ensure product robustness and release readiness
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics or Electrical Engineering
2–5 years of relevant experience in embedded systems, applications engineering, system validation, or technical product support
Good working knowledge of Embedded C, RTOS, and embedded system debug
Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters, and general lab-based debugging
Experience working with hardware boards in a lab, validation, or bring-up environment
Basic understanding of schematics, board-level interfaces, board bring-up, and debug
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work across teams and manage multiple priorities effectively
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in display, projection, industrial, automotive, or other embedded system applications is a plus
Understanding of video interfaces and protocols such as USB, SPI, UART, and I2C
Familiarity with signal integrity, power integrity, or EMI/EMC considerations in board-level design and debug
Ability to create clear, high-quality technical documentation
Strong time management skills and the ability to drive work to closure in a dynamic environment
What We’re Looking For
We’re looking for an engineer who is curious, hands-on, and comfortable working across software, systems, and lab debug. The right candidate should be able to learn quickly, communicate clearly, and take ownership of solving customer and product challenges with urgency and sound engineering judgment.
Success in This Role Looks Like
Taking ownership of assigned tasks and driving them to closure
Debugging and validating application flows on supported systems
Supporting customer issues with clear communication and structured problem-solving
Building reusable knowledge, documentation, and tools that help the broader team scale

jobs.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.
Key Responsibilities
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.
–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.
–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.
–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
–Implements performance and load testing.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.
–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.
–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.
–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.
–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.
–Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
–Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues.
–Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.
Compliance & Security:
–Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.
–Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security.
–Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date
Automation & Change Management:
–Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure.
–Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications.
Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:
–Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements.
–Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance
Collaboration & Partnership:
–Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.
Problem Solving:
–Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices
Continuous Learning:
–Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members..
Continuous Improvement:
–Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.
As part of Oracle’s onboarding process and consistent with applicable law, India-based employees are required to complete identity verification, which involves the collection and processing of their biometric information. Accommodations to this requirement may be granted following an individualized assessment.

Working closely with project management, design, procurement, commissioning, operations teams, and delivery partners, the role will oversee construction execution across civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, controls, security, and life-safety systems.
The position is accountable for maintaining safe site operations, monitoring quality and progress, managing contractor performance, coordinating interfaces, and resolving construction issues in a timely manner. The Construction Manager will ensure work is delivered in accordance with approved designs, specifications, local regulatory requirements, and project schedules, while supporting a smooth transition through testing, commissioning, and handover.
Construction Manager AI Data Center Infrastructure Hyderabad India
Location: Hyderabad, India (site-based role)
Travel: As required for project delivery
Experience: 7+ years in data center or mission-critical construction delivery
The Role
We are hiring a Construction Manager to lead on-site execution of AI data center infrastructure construction in Hyderabad, India. The role is based at the project site and is responsible for safe, compliant, high-quality delivery across multiple contractors and specialist vendors. It focuses on disciplined control of site works, construction processes, quality, commissioning readiness, and handover in live or new-build data center environments.
What you will do
Lead on-site construction delivery for AI and high-density infrastructure, including base build and fit-out readiness, power, cooling, containment, and enabling works.
Manage contractors and vendors across CSA, MEP, controls and BMS, fire, security, and specialist packages.
Drive construction workflows including RFIs, submittals, ITPs, inspections, NCRs, punch lists, progressive turnover, and closeout.
Coordinate sequencing and interfaces across trades to protect milestones and remove site constraints quickly.
Own site readiness and logistics, including access control, permits, RAMS, workface planning, and cleanliness or controlled-environment requirements.
Drive commissioning readiness with commissioning and operations teams, including test readiness, evidence packs, redlines and as-builts, and turnover requirements.
Maintain a strong daily and weekly reporting cadence covering progress, look-aheads, constraints, risks, and escalation items.
What we are looking for
Proven experience delivering data center construction and/or mission-critical infrastructure in a site leadership role.
Strong understanding of MEP and critical-systems construction, including construction-to-commissioning handover.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple contractors in high-pressure, high-dependency environments.
Strong QA and QC discipline, including documentation capability for ITPs, inspections, NCRs, and closeout.
Competency with project and document-control platforms such as Aconex, Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, SharePoint, or similar, plus solid MS Office skills.
Ability to work full-time from the Hyderabad project site and travel domestically as required.
Preferred
Experience supporting high-density or AI-ready data center infrastructure, including tight power and cooling constraints, accelerated fit-outs, and compressed commissioning windows.
Relevant construction or engineering qualification and safety leadership credentials.

jobs.title: Principal Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Firmware connects hardware capability to cloud reliability. At OCI, you will work where those layers meet—investigating challenging failures, developing lasting fixes, and improving how firmware is tested, deployed, and operated across our infrastructure.
As a Principal Systems Firmware Engineer, you will design, develop, and improve BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI and the tools that support its deployment across OCI’s server and GPU infrastructure. You will own complex engineering problems across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, delivering changes that improve platform reliability, diagnosability, security, and recovery.
Your initial focus will be engineering improvements for platforms already operating in our fleet. You will use production findings to identify design weaknesses, develop and validate firmware fixes, extend automated testing, and eliminate recurring failure modes. Success means delivering durable improvements that reduce failures and the need for manual intervention.
You will also participate in an India daytime on-call rotation, complementing US engineering teams. This responsibility connects your engineering work directly to how platforms behave in production and includes incident investigation, mitigation, and coordinated handoffs.
As the team grows, its scope is expected to expand into new server and GPU platform development, with opportunities to work alongside silicon suppliers and ODM/JDM partners on firmware integration, platform bring-up, and validation.
This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team’s engineering practices while remaining deeply involved in design, code, and complex technical investigations.
Key Responsibilities
Own firmware development and integration. Design, develop, debug, and maintain BMC or BIOS/UEFI components and supporting systems software. Define clear interfaces across firmware, hardware, operating systems, and fleet management services.
Resolve complex fleet issues. Lead investigations into boot failures, management controller faults, firmware update problems, hardware initialization failures, and other platform reliability issues. Develop mitigations, establish root cause, and deliver durable fixes.
Provide operational support. Participate in the India daytime on-call rotation, coordinate investigations and handoffs with US teams, and communicate impact, progress, and resolution clearly.
Build automation and preventive controls. Develop tools for firmware provisioning, updates, diagnostics, recovery, and validation. Improve telemetry, logging, and failure analysis to reduce recurring incidents and manual intervention.
Drive software quality and security. Write maintainable code, lead design and code reviews, and develop functional, regression, negative, and recovery tests. Apply secure development practices and support firmware vulnerability remediation.
Contribute to platform bring-up. Diagnose interactions across firmware, hardware, bootloaders, and operating systems. Use platform logs and appropriate hardware debugging tools to isolate faults and validate end-to-end behavior.
Collaborate with engineering and vendor partners. Work with hardware, silicon, operating system, validation, and fleet operations teams. As product development scope grows, work with ODM/JDM partners on requirements, defect resolution, firmware releases, and platform readiness.
Provide technical leadership. Own delivery of complex engineering work, identify dependencies and risks, document designs and debugging methods, mentor engineers, and contribute to hiring and continuous improvement.
Required qualifications
Meet one of the following education and software development experience combinations:
11 years of software development experience; or
A bachelor’s degree/B.Tech in a relevant engineering, computing, information technology, mathematics, physics, or related field, with 7 years of software development experience; or
A master’s degree/M.Tech in one of these fields, with 5 years of software development experience; or
A doctorate in one of these fields, with 3 years of software development experience.
At least 6 years of experience using programming and scripting languages, with strong C/C++ skills and the ability to build diagnostic and automation tools.
Substantial hands-on development and debugging experience in BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI, with the ability to investigate interactions across the broader server platform.
Strong understanding of server architecture, embedded systems, hardware/software interfaces, and Linux fundamentals.
Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex issues across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, using evidence to distinguish symptoms from root causes.
Experience owning software components through design, implementation, code review, testing, release, and ongoing support.
Experience developing automated tests, diagnostics, or operational tooling and improving reliability, observability, or performance.
Ability to lead technical investigations, mentor colleagues, and communicate effectively across engineering teams and external partners.
Willingness to participate in the India daytime on-call rotation.
Preferred qualifications
Experience with OpenBMC or other server BMC stacks, or with server BIOS/UEFI implementations such as EDK II or commercial firmware platforms.
Familiarity with relevant platform interfaces and protocols, such as Redfish, IPMI, PLDM/MCTP, SMBus/I²C, SPI, PCIe, or ACPI.
Experience with server or GPU platform bring-up, hardware initialization, power and thermal management, or reliability, availability, and serviceability (RAS) features.
Experience using JTAG, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, or emulators, and interpreting schematics and board documentation.
Experience with secure boot, firmware signing, update and recovery mechanisms, or firmware security remediation.
Experience supporting production infrastructure at cloud or hyperscale environments, including controlled firmware rollouts and incident response.
Experience collaborating with silicon suppliers, BIOS/BMC vendors, or ODM/JDM engineering teams.

We are building a systems firmware team in Bengaluru and are looking for a Principal Engineer with deep, hands-on expertise in server BIOS/UEFI. You will own complex engineering problems across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, delivering changes that improve platform initialization, reliability, performance, security, and recovery.
Your initial focus will be engineering improvements for platforms already operating in our fleet. You will use production findings to identify design weaknesses, develop and validate firmware fixes, extend automated testing, and eliminate recurring failure modes. Success means delivering durable improvements that reduce failures and the need for manual intervention.
You will also participate in an India daytime on-call rotation, complementing US engineering teams. This responsibility connects your engineering work directly to how platforms behave in production and includes incident investigation, mitigation, and coordinated handoffs.
As the team grows, its scope is expected to expand into new server and GPU platform development. You will have opportunities to collaborate with silicon suppliers, BIOS vendors, and ODM/JDM partners, including Taiwan-based manufacturers, on firmware integration, platform bring-up, validation, and production readiness.
This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team’s engineering practices while remaining deeply involved in design, code, and complex technical investigations.
Key Responsibilities
Responsibilities
Own BIOS/UEFI development and integration. Design, develop, debug, and maintain server firmware components supporting platform initialization, hardware configuration, boot, and operating system interfaces.
Solve complex platform problems. Investigate boot failures, initialization errors, PCIe device enumeration issues, memory configuration problems, and firmware/OS interactions. Establish root cause and implement durable fixes.
Improve reliability and performance. Develop firmware enhancements that improve boot behavior, error handling, recovery, diagnosability, and platform performance. Translate fleet findings into engineering improvements and regression coverage.
Build validation and automation. Develop tools and automated tests for BIOS configuration, firmware updates, boot validation, diagnostics, and recovery. Validate firmware changes across supported hardware configurations and operating environments.
Drive software quality and security. Write maintainable code, lead design and code reviews, document technical decisions, and apply secure development practices. Support firmware vulnerability investigation and remediation.
Contribute to platform bring-up. Debug interactions across BIOS/UEFI, silicon initialization code, hardware, bootloaders, and operating systems. Use firmware traces, hardware debugging tools, and platform documentation to isolate faults.
Work with engineering and vendor partners. Collaborate with hardware, BMC, operating system, validation, and fleet engineering teams. Work with silicon suppliers, BIOS vendors, and ODM/JDM partners to resolve defects and validate firmware releases.
Own firmware reliability in production. Participate in the India daytime on-call rotation, coordinate investigations and handoffs with US teams, and turn incident findings into fixes, tests, and preventive controls.
Provide technical leadership. Own delivery of complex engineering work, identify dependencies and risks, mentor engineers, and contribute to hiring and continuous improvement.
Required qualifications
Meet one of the following education and software development experience combinations:
11 years of software development experience; or
A bachelor’s degree/B.Tech in a relevant engineering, computing, information technology, mathematics, physics, or related field, with 7 years of software development experience; or
A master’s degree/M.Tech in one of these fields, with 5 years of software development experience; or
A doctorate in one of these fields, with 3 years of software development experience.
At least 6 years of experience using programming and/or scripting languages, including strong C programming skills.
Substantial hands-on experience developing and debugging server BIOS/UEFI firmware, including implementing firmware changes and resolving defects at the source-code level.
Strong understanding of UEFI architecture and the server boot flow, with development experience in firmware phases or components such as PEI, DXE, SMM, or UEFI drivers.
Strong understanding of x86 server architecture on Intel or AMD platforms, including processor and memory initialization, PCIe enumeration and resource allocation, and firmware/OS interfaces such as ACPI and SMBIOS.
Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex issues across BIOS/UEFI, hardware, bootloaders, and Linux using firmware logs, traces, and appropriate debugging tools.
Experience owning firmware components through design, implementation, code review, testing, release, and ongoing maintenance.
Ability to build diagnostic or automation tools, lead technical investigations, and communicate effectively across engineering teams and external partners.

Experience with server reliability, availability, and serviceability (RAS), including hardware error reporting and firmware/OS coordination.

jobs.title: Senior Release Engineer, Patching
jobs.description:
Oracle’s Automated Patching Framework (APF) builds and delivers software updates for Oracle Database, Exadata, Fleet Patching and Provisioning (FPP), Real Application Clusters (RAC), Oracle GoldenGate (OGG), Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA), and Autonomous Health Framework (AHF), across on-premises and cloud environments. APF is a business-critical platform that helps Oracle deliver patches to customers on schedule and improves the efficiency of development teams across the company.
The framework includes services and tools built with Python, Java, Perl, PL/SQL, and Ant. Our team develops and operates these systems in a large-scale production environment. Engineers contribute across the full software lifecycle, from design and implementation to troubleshooting, performance tuning, and production support.
We’re looking for strong hands-on software engineers who enjoy solving complex automation problems and working across technologies and teams.
Design, develop, troubleshoot, and debug software for Oracle’s automated patching framework. You’ll build and maintain tools and services using technologies such as Python, Java, Perl, Linux shell scripting, and PL/SQL. The role also includes providing internal production support, investigating and triaging issues, and improving the reliability and performance of the patching infrastructure.
As a member of the software engineering team, you’ll help define and implement software solutions, make changes to existing architecture as needs evolve, and contribute to technical direction across shared projects. The work is varied and often complex, requiring sound judgment and the ability to work independently. You may also lead projects or provide technical guidance to other developers.
Design, develop, and maintain APF (Automation Patching Framework) services, tools, and automation.
Provide production support and investigate issues reported by internal customers.
Lead or contribute to cross-functional technical discussions and shared projects.
Improve the framework’s architecture, code quality, reliability, and support processes using AI tools where appropriate.
Take ownership of software throughout its lifecycle, including operation in a 24/7 production environment.
Provide technical guidance to other developers and, where appropriate, lead projects.

jobs.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.
Key Responsibilities
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.
–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.
–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.
–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
–Implements performance and load testing.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.
–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.
–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.
–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.
–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.
–Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
–Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues.
–Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.
Compliance & Security:
–Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.
–Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security.
–Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date
Automation & Change Management:
–Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure.
–Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications.
Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:
–Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements.
–Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance
Collaboration & Partnership:
–Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.
Problem Solving:
–Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices
Continuous Learning:
–Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members..
Continuous Improvement:
–Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

The Senior Site Reliability Engineer will support the reliability, scalability, performance, and operational lifecycle of Autonomous Database Serverless (ADBS) infrastructure and services. The role requires deep expertise in Oracle RAC, Exadata, OCI, database/infrastructure upgrades and patching, incident response, automation, capacity management, and production troubleshooting, including the ability to troubleshoot across the Exadata and OS layers.

Design, operate, and continuously improve highly reliable and scalable infrastructure supporting Autonomous Database Serverless (ADBS).
Administer and optimize high-availability Oracle database environments using Oracle RAC and ASM, with responsibility for service health, performance, capacity, and operational reliability.
Execute end-to-end Exadata lifecycle management, including infrastructure upgrades, storage expansion, quarterly patching/QFSDP activities, and related maintenance across Exadata generations.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues across Exadata hardware, database, network, and OS layers, including incident response, root cause analysis, and post-mortem activities.
Use Exadata capabilities and database performance techniques, including SQL tuning, Smart Scans, Storage Indexes, and Hybrid Columnar Compression (HCC), to improve performance and resource efficiency.
Develop and maintain automation using Shell scripting, Python, or Ansible for infrastructure provisioning, database operations, monitoring, remediation, and recurring maintenance.
Partner with software development and cross-functional teams to assess infrastructure changes, capacity requirements, deployments, reliability risks, and operational impact.

Strong hands-on experience with Oracle RAC and ASM in production environments.
Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Oracle databases on Exadata physical infrastructure.
Proven experience with Exadata infrastructure upgrades and patching, including end-to-end lifecycle activities across multiple Exadata generations.
Practical experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI); exact OCI services to be confirmed.
Ability to troubleshoot issues across the Exadata and operating-system layers.
Experience with production incident response, technical troubleshooting, RCA, post-mortems, and on-call support.

jobs.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Core Infrastructure Engineer, you will design and deliver major features while leveraging AI to improve engineering productivity, operational excellence, and business outcomes. You will build secure, scalable, and maintainable systems, lead feature and subsystem design, and ensure operational readiness through automation, observability, and AI-assisted workflows.
You will work independently on complex projects, collaborate across teams, drive root cause analysis, and identify opportunities to use AI for improving development, testing, troubleshooting, operational efficiency, and customer experience. A key expectation of the role is to use AI-driven insights and automation to reduce operational overhead, improve service reliability, accelerate delivery, and minimize technical debt while delivering scalable, customer-focused solutions.
The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) team can provide you the opportunity to build and operate a suite of massive scale, integrated cloud services in a broadly distributed, multi-tenant cloud environment. OCI is committed to providing the best in cloud products that meet the needs of our customers who are tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges.
We offer unique opportunities for smart, hands-on engineers with the expertise and passion to solve difficult problems in distributed highly available services and virtualized infrastructure. At every level, our engineers have a significant technical and business impact designing and building innovative new systems to power our customer’s business critical applications.
Who are we looking for?
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building next-generation cloud security and compliance solutions, and we’re looking for skilled Software Engineers to join our Cloud Guard / Assurance Service team. Be part of our mission to create the most secure cloud environment. In this pivotal, hands-on engineering role, you will architect and develop scalable, innovative solutions that ensure OCI resources start secure and remain secure. You’ll also build automated mechanisms for compliance reporting, control deployment, and exception management. You’ll work closely with top engineers, product managers, and security teams to deliver features that strengthen OCI’s security posture and provide a unified, single-pane-of-glass experience for both detective and preventive controls.
We are looking for engineers with distributed systems experience. You should have experience with the design of major features and launching them into production. You’ve operated high-scale services and understand how to make them more resilient. You work on most projects and tasks independently. You have experience working with services that require data to travel long distances, but have to abide by compliance and regulations.
The ideal candidate will own the software design and development for major components of Oracle’s Cloud Infrastructure. You should be both a rock-solid coder and a distributed systems generalist, able to dive deep into any part of the stack and low-level systems, as well as design broad distributed system interactions. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn.
What are the biggest challenges for the team?
The biggest challenges for the team are reliability, performance and keep up in cybersecurity space. The dynamic and fast growth of the business is driving us to improve the ability of our systems to scale out and handle traffic patterns with full coverage that are several orders of magnitude greater than what we can support today.
We understand that software is living and needs investment. The challenge is making the right tradeoffs, communicating those decisions effectively, and crisp execution.
We need engineers who can build services that can reliably protect our customer cloud environment. We need engineers who can figure out how we can keep up our solution in a fast pace to securely protect our customers. We need engineers who can build services that enable us to offer even more options to customers and contribute to the overall growth of Oracle Cloud.
Required Qualifications
• 4+ years distributed service engineering experience in a software development environment
• Experience driving feature design reviews, documentation, UX reviews, and working with Product Managers through the entire launch process
• Strong development experience in Java, C++, C#, or similar OO languages
• Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems fundamentals
• Working familiarity with networking protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP) and standard network architectures
• Good understanding of databases, SQL, NoSQL systems, storage and distributed persistence technologies
• Experience building multi-tenant, virtualized infrastructure a strong plus
Preferred Qualifications
• Hands-on experience developing services on a public cloud platform (e.g., AWS, Azure, Oracle)
• Building continuous integration/deployment pipelines with robust testing and deployment schedules
• Expertise in applying threat modeling or other risk identification techniques to develop security solutions
• Experience and understanding of Cryptograph, DDoS, CVE, CIS, SAST, DAST, or similar security and compliance knowledge

We Are

You Are
You have spent years drawing layouts that actually work at multi-gigabit speeds, not just pass DRC. You understand that a transmitter layout is not just about matching the schematic, it is about controlling skew to picoseconds, managing substrate noise, and making sure the signal integrity holds when that design goes into a 2.5D package with micro bumps and an interposer underneath. You know the difference between a layout that closes verification and one that closes verification and actually performs in silicon.
High-speed differential routing is second nature to you. You think about return paths, shield placement, and length matching before you start drawing, not after LVS fails. When a circuit designer hands you a schematic for a DLL or equalizer, you see the layout challenges immediately and you know which tradeoffs matter and which ones do not.
You have worked through enough tapeouts to know that the hard part is not the individual block, it is how everything integrates at the top level, how the bump map affects your floor plan, how the package stackup changes your routing strategy, and how to close EM/IR without redesigning half the layout two weeks before signoff. jobs.title: Standard Cell Library Characterization Engineer
jobs.description:
Alternate Job Titles
Standard Cell Library Characterization Engineer
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent enough time in library characterization to know that a Liberty model is only as good as the corner cases you tested and the correlations you actually validated. You understand that when a designer's STA run fails because of a timing model mismatch, it is not just a data issue, it is hours of someone's schedule gone, and you take that seriously.
You are comfortable moving between SPICE simulations, Liberty file generation, and debugging why a CCS noise model behaves differently than expected across PVT corners. When a correlation gap shows up between characterization and static timing analysis, you do not just log it, you dig in, reproduce it, and figure out what assumption broke down.
You know the difference between running a characterization flow and owning it. Running it means you execute scripts. Owning it means you catch the issue before QA does, you spot the pattern in regression failures, and you know when a model needs another pass even if it technically meets spec.
At Synopsys, you will work on standard cell libraries that power advanced node designs across the semiconductor industry. The libraries you characterize will be used in real tapeouts, and the quality bar is not negotiable.
What You'll Be Doing
Characterize and model standard cell libraries for advanced technology nodes, generating Liberty files including NLDM, NLPM, CCS timing, CCS noise, ECSM, LVF, AOCV, POCV, spatial OCV, aging, and EM models
Handle characterization across a wide range of cell types: combinational, sequential, clock gating, synchronizers, retention, level shifters, power gating, always-on, filler, and decap cells
Debug and resolve correlation issues between characterization results, static timing analysis, and SPICE simulations, working across tool flows to identify root causes
Execute QA checks, regression analysis, and release validation to ensure library deliverables meet quality and accuracy standards before they ship
Drive methodology improvements and automation initiatives that make characterization flows faster, more reliable, and easier to maintain across multiple projects
Coordinate project execution timelines, manage deliverables, and communicate status across cross-functional teams including design, verification, and product engineering
Support library releases by validating models against design rule checks, performing sanity testing, and ensuring documentation is complete and accurate
The Impact You Will Have
Enable accurate timing closure for advanced node designs by delivering high-quality Liberty models that designers and STA tools depend on
Reduce correlation gaps between characterization and silicon behavior, improving predictability and reducing costly respins for customers
Accelerate library development cycles by building automation and improving characterization flows that scale across multiple technology nodes
Increase library quality and reliability through rigorous QA, regression testing, and validation processes that catch issues before release
Support successful tapeouts by ensuring standard cell libraries meet performance, power, and area targets across all operating conditions
Contribute to methodology evolution by identifying gaps, proposing solutions, and implementing improvements that benefit the entire characterization team
Help Synopsys maintain its leadership in library IP by delivering models that meet the precision and robustness requirements of cutting-edge semiconductor designs
What You'll Need
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, VLSI, Microelectronics, or a related technical field
2+ years of hands-on experience in standard cell library characterization and Liberty modeling
Strong understanding of Liberty file formats including NLDM, CCS, ECSM, and advanced modeling constructs like AOCV, POCV, and aging models
Experience characterizing multiple cell types: combinational, sequential, clock gating, level shifters, retention, or power management cells
Solid grasp of SPICE simulation, timing analysis concepts, and correlation methodologies between characterization tools and STA flows
Proficiency in scripting languages like Python, Tcl, or Perl for automation, data analysis, and flow development
Experience with industry-standard characterization tools and STA platforms is a strong plus
Who You Are
You can look at a Liberty file and spot when a timing arc does not make sense or a capacitance value looks off, and you know how to trace it back to the characterization setup
When a correlation issue appears, you do not wait for someone else to debug it, you pull the SPICE deck, compare waveforms, and figure out where the model diverged
You are organized enough to manage multiple library releases in parallel without losing track of which models are validated, which are in QA, and which need another pass
You can explain a complex characterization issue to a design engineer or a project lead in a way that makes sense without dumbing it down or losing the technical detail
You push back when a release timeline does not leave enough room for proper validation, because you know that shipping a bad model costs more than delaying a release by a few days
You treat automation as part of the job, not extra credit, and you are always looking for repetitive tasks that should be scripted instead of done manually
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will join the Library Characterization team at Synopsys, a group responsible for characterization, validation, QA, release management, and methodology support for advanced standard cell libraries across multiple technology nodes. Your recruiter will share more about the team structure, current projects, and how the team collaborates with design, product engineering, and customer-facing groups during the interview process.
Rewards and Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.
