Independent delivery: Delivers complex platform capabilities with high engineering quality and predictable execution.
End-to-end accountability: Owns outcomes beyond implementation, including testing, deployment, production support, and maintainability.
Sound technical judgment: Produces robust designs and contributes effectively to cross-component architecture decisions.
Measurable platform improvements: Improves reliability, performance, security, observability, and operational efficiency.
Reusable engineering: Builds sustainable abstractions and shared solutions rather than unnecessary one-off implementations.
Technical leadership: Raises engineering standards through mentoring, design reviews, and knowledge sharing.
Architectural growth: Demonstrates the ability to reason about system-wide implications, technical trade-offs, and the long-term evolution of the platform.

jobs.title: Principal Data Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Build the next generation of Oracle data protection software, helping fortune 500 enterprises protect and recover their business-critical Oracle databases. Work on software where data integrity, recoverability, cyber resilience, and performance at scale directly affect customers’ most important operations.
Join our growing engineering team in Bengaluru and collaborate with experienced engineers in India and the US. You will contribute to shared product priorities, deliver new features and projects, and help evolve an enterprise data protection platform. This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team while building deep product expertise within an established global engineering organization.
The work spans Oracle database kernel development and systems programming, primarily in C and PL/SQL on Linux. You will tackle engineering problems involving buffers and caches, memory management, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, concurrency, and distributed systems. Strong algorithms, thoughtful design, and an understanding of how these components interact will be central to delivering correct, efficient, and maintainable software.
You will participate throughout the development lifecycle: understanding problems, exploring the codebase, identifying root causes, designing solutions, implementing changes, writing tests, and validating results. The work combines new development and enhancements with complex defect resolution, including issues encountered in customer environments. As your product knowledge grows, you will take increasing technical ownership of assigned features and components, contributing to design decisions, code reviews, ongoing maintenance, and knowledge sharing.
We value engineers who investigate problems systematically, use documentation and diagnostic tools resourcefully, communicate clearly, and help colleagues succeed. You will use modern engineering tools, including LLMs and AI coding agents, to accelerate code exploration, development, and testing while applying independent judgment and rigorous validation to the resulting designs and code.
We welcome experienced developers with strong C, Linux, system programming skills and practical knowledge of database internals, storage, distributed systems, or other demanding enterprise software. Prior Oracle Database, RMAN, PL/SQL, or backup and recovery product experience is an advantage. Strong systems fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to translate complex requirements into reliable production software are essential.
This position is based in Bengaluru, India.
• Design, implement, and maintain RMAN features and enhancements in C and PL/SQL on Linux, contributing to Oracle database kernel and systems software development.
• Translate requirements and technical problems into clear designs, manageable tasks, and deliverable milestones. Evaluate alternatives and document trade-offs involving correctness, performance, scalability, compatibility, and maintainability.
• Apply appropriate algorithms and data structures to build efficient, reliable software. Reason about memory use, concurrency, synchronization, and behavior under demanding workloads.
• Develop and improve assigned components involving buffers, caches, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, and distributed processing, with careful attention to data integrity and recovery behavior.
• Build product expertise through code exploration, technical documentation, collaboration, and delivery of fixes and enhancements. Progress toward ownership of assigned features and projects, including subsequent development, maintenance, and defect resolution.

Maintain technical documentation, project summaries and customer handover guides.

Use Oracle-approved AI tools and reusable components across delivery, including code review and documentation, while retaining accountability for quality and validation.
Mentor colleagues and contribute reusable scripts, technical guidance and delivery improvements.

Sound understanding of the Millennium data model and clinical or operational workflows.

Experience with version control, code reviews, testing and controlled deployments.
Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Oracle-approved ChatGPT and Codex.

Experience

Atlassian’s Trusted Data Platform (TDP) provides secure, reliable, and scalable data capabilities used by Atlassian product and platform teams. Clear communication skills appropriate for engineers, executives, product partners, and customer-facing stakeholders.

jobs.title: Research Scientist - Nemotron India
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!
We are looking for Research Scientists passionate about large generative models! We are searching for world-class researchers in deep learning and natural language processing (NLP) to join our applied deep learning research team which pioneered the Megatron, MT-NLG, and DLSS projects at NVIDIA. Our team is pushing the boundaries of generative AI by building state-of-the-art large language and multi-modal foundation models and applying them to solve real-world problems. If you are passionate about the latest research and technologies revolutionizing generative AI and want to explore creative new paradigms for applied foundation models such as software assistants and customized multi-modal agents, this team will be a great fit for you. After building prototypes that demonstrate the promise of your research, you will collaborate with product teams to apply your ideas into industry-leading real-world applications.

jobs.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.
The Opportunity
Nutanix AHV builds on top of the open-source x86-KVM stack, with an emphasis on performance, scale, and reliability. The hyperconverged nature of our stack provides the phenomenal potential for optimizations cutting across various parts of our stack -- right from the kernel, and ranging up to, but not limited by, the management layer.
We are looking for original thinkers who won't hesitate to demand conventional thought in arriving at out-of-the-box solutions.
We aim to work as closely aligned with the open-source community as possible. Our engineers are highly encouraged to participate in open-source community development. Any work you do will be preserved as open-source commit(s) for posterity!
A day in the life of an AHV Hypervisor Engineer:
Problems you’ll solve:
We’ve always believed in demanding the status quo and disrupting ourselves to provide the best in-class customer experience. A case in point: Nutanix is well known for providing a zero-touch upgrade experience for our customers. Within the hypervisor team, we are focussing on various ways to make this faster and more reliable -- by pushing the limits of VM live migrations towards speed and predictability, or rethinking why a hypervisor upgrade should need a reboot at all.
About the Team
At Nutanix, you will have the opportunity to be part of the Hypervisor team, a dynamic group that is spread out geographically. Despite being in different locations, the team collaborates effectively and maintains a strong sense of camaraderie. Working with the Hypervisor team means being surrounded by talented people who are supportive, making it a great team to work with. This setup also provides exciting exposure to diverse perspectives and opportunities for personal and professional growth.
You will report to a Senior Manager who is committed to supporting your development and ensuring your success within the organization.This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager. As for travel requirements, there are none, allowing you to focus on your projects without the need for frequent travel.
Your Role
You’ll be working with a team of extremely talented engineers across a spectrum of geographies and experience. The most successful candidate for this role will be someone who can:
Constantly look for ways to improve the product, learning from customer questions and not limited to existing technologies.
Devise solutions and back them up with solid research and numbers to prove their efficacy.
Have the ability to convey ideas to a geographically diverse audience using excellent communication/writing skills.
Participate in design discussions, often outside one’s known comfort zone -- learning on the go.
Proactively mentor junior members of the team, finding ways to fuel their intelligent curiosity and leverage their unique strengths.
Not hesitate to help out with occasional customer escalations: Nutanix believes in putting customers first. While we have a huge, dedicated team to assist customers with any issues, there might be situations where engineering help might be sought to bail out a rare, unfortunate outage.
Take pride in working with open-source communities to fold product improvements back into community projects.
What You Will Bring
The must-haves:
Rock-solid OS/systems fundamentals drive design and implementation.
Low-level coding, debugging experience with at least one hardware architecture, preferably x86.
The ability to write and maintain enterprise-quality code.
Deep reasoning and detailed skills, which provide top-down thinking to break down abstract concepts into actionable pieces.
Proven feature delivery experience: should have 8+ years of hands-on experience of what it means to ship enterprise-quality code to customers.
The good-to-haves:
Knowledge of x86 virtualization and the KVM stack.
Code contributions to the Linux kernel/virtualization stack is an added plus.
Desired qualification & experience:
Bachelors/Master’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
8+ years of experience building enterprise-grade software, preferably some with guide experience.

● Work with the SAP Business AI Platform and modern data / AI platforms (Databricks, MLflow) and LLM frameworks.

● Awareness of responsible AI, data privacy, and compliance(PII / GDPR), and of feature engineering and model-evaluation fundamentals.

● Hands-on experience with the SAP Business AI Platform(SAP AI Core, Generative AI Hub, SAP HANA Cloud) and platforms such as Databricks, SAP Datasphere, or a major cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).

jobs.title: Senior RTL IP Qualification Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Overview
Join Arm’s third-party IP qualification team to help prepare IP for integration into systems-on-chip (SoCs) for Cloud AI, Physical AI and Edge AI. Based in Bengaluru, you’ll collaborate with teams across Arm and work with colleagues in India, France and the USA.
You’ll qualify a range of IP, including standard-cell libraries, GPIOs, SRAM and ROM memories, PLLs, sensors, and interfaces such as LPDDR, UCIe, Ethernet and PCIe PHYs.
Responsibilities
Check that third-party IP RTL designs and electronic design automation (EDA) models are compatible with the tools and methodologies used in Arm SoC design flows.
Verify that IP design and modelling methodologies meet SoC flow requirements.
Use, improve and develop Python and Tcl scripts to run qualification checks, including RTL linting, elaboration, CDC/RDC, functional verification and low-power verification.
Run supplied verification testbenches to check the correctness and consistency of delivered RTL designs.
Install third-party IP and check that the required EDA views and models for soft and hardened IP are complete and consistent.
Analyse deviations, share results with SoC design teams and report issues to IP providers for resolution where needed.
Improve automation to make qualification flows easier to set up, deploy and maintain across different IP types.
Required Skills and Experience
Relevant industry experience in RTL linting, elaboration and CDC/RDC verification, supported by a master’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Experience automating tasks using Bash, Tcl, Python or similar languages.
Ability to collaborate with others and take initiative when working with different IP types and SoC design flows.
Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience
Experience with continuous integration workflows using Git or Gerrit and CloudBees or Jenkins.
Knowledge of UVM verification environments and gate-level functional verification using SystemVerilog.
Knowledge of static low-power verification using UPF (IEEE 1801).
Knowledge of design for test (DFT) and static timing analysis (STA), including SDC constraints.
In Return
You’ll have the opportunity to work across a broad range of IP and learn about SoC design flows while collaborating with teams across Arm. You can also help improve the automation used to qualify IP.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - AI Platforms
jobs.description:
Job Overview
As the Senior Engineering Manager for AI Compute, you will lead teams building and operating Arm’s central platform for AI training, evaluation, model serving, and CPU and accelerator fleet management. The work spans Kubernetes infrastructure, workload scheduling, control-plane services, APIs, observability, security, capacity, and developer tooling.
This role combines people leadership, technical direction, and operational ownership. You will develop senior engineers, guide architecture and execution, and partner with global teams to deliver reliable and scalable AI compute capabilities.
Responsibilities
Lead and grow platform, infrastructure, and reliability engineering teams.
Recruit, coach, and develop engineers while managing performance, career growth, succession, and team health.
Define the technical strategy and roadmap for the AI compute platform with global engineering and product leaders.
Guide architecture and delivery across training and serving workflows, Kubernetes controllers, scheduling, multi-tenancy, developer tools, and fleet management.
Own production readiness, reliability, security, capacity planning, incident management, observability, and sustainable on-call practices.
Partner with AI researchers, hardware teams, infrastructure, security, and internal users to prioritize work and remove delivery barriers.
Required Skills and Experience
12+ years of experience building distributed systems, cloud platforms, ML infrastructure, HPC systems, or large-scale backend services.
5+ years of people-management experience leading infrastructure, platform, SRE, or distributed-systems teams.
A record of hiring, mentoring, and developing senior and staff engineers across multiple technical workstreams.
Deep technical knowledge of Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and production operations.
Experience supporting AI training or inference workloads and CPU, GPU, or other accelerator infrastructure.
Ability to define strategy, evaluate architectural trade-offs, and deliver complex cross-functional programs.
Clear communication and the ability to influence engineers, partner organizations, and senior leadership across locations.
Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience
Experience with workload scheduling, topology-aware placement, resource management, accelerator enablement, and fleet health.
Familiarity with NVIDIA or other accelerator software stacks, AWS EKS, infrastructure as code, GitOps, and observability.
Knowledge of Go, Python, RPC services, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.
Familiarity with distributed AI frameworks and serving systems such as PyTorch, Ray, vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM.
Experience evolving an internal platform from early capabilities into a reliable managed service.
In Return
You will lead an engineering organization with broad responsibility across AI software, cloud infrastructure, and accelerated computing. The role offers the opportunity to shape the platform’s technical direction, build strong teams, and improve how AI workloads are developed and operated across Arm.
Lead engineering teams and guide Kubernetes infrastructure and platform strategy to deliver reliable AI training, model serving and accelerator fleet management.

jobs.title: Layout Engineer
jobs.description:
Role Summary
Our Solutions Engineering Physical IP team comprises some of the industry’s leading experts in deep submicron circuit design. This position is a wonderful opportunity for you to work with our custom standard cell design engineering team on innovative technologies. Your work will have a significant lasting impact as the designs will be used in Solutions Engineering products servicing the infrastructure, client, automotive, and IoT market segments.
In this role, you will be responsible for the layout development of Arm custom standard cells in the latest, sub-3nm process technology nodes. The ideal candidate will be an expert in standard cell layout, physical verification, and automation techniques. You will work in close collaboration with the circuit design team to provide optimally tuned layout, and validate them through QA flows that use a variety of tools. This role is crucial in delivering high-performance, area-optimized, and DRC-clean logic libraries for next-generation SoCs and custom digital IPs.
Key Responsibilities
Independently develop transistor-level physical layouts from circuit schematics.
Create and interpret stick diagrams and determine efficient transistor placement and routing strategies.
Optimize device placement, diffusion sharing, routing and pin accessibility to achieve compact and robust layouts.
Perform DRC, LVS and physical-verification debugging and independently resolve routine violations.
Understand and apply requirements from technology Design Rule Manuals (DRMs) and established layout guidelines.
Perform layout modifications resulting from schematic, design-rule or methodology changes.
Understand parasitic resistance and capacitance introduced by physical implementation and their effect on circuit behaviour.
Apply established layout techniques to improve power, performance and area (PPA).
Consider reliability requirements such as current density, electromigration and routing robustness during implementation.
Perform layout quality checks and participate in peer reviews.
Review straightforward layout work produced by other engineers where required.
Work with circuit designers to identify practical solutions to layout-related implementation challenges.
Manage assigned workload, communicate progress and identify potential technical or schedule risks.
Support development of less-experienced engineers through knowledge sharing and occasional on-the-job guidance.
Contribute to continuous improvement of layout practices and team workflows.
Technical Skills / Expertise
CMOS transistor-level circuit layout
Schematic interpretation
Stick-diagram development
Transistor placement and diffusion optimization
DRC and LVS
Physical-verification debugging
Design Rule Manual interpretation
Parasitic resistance and capacitance
Basic EM/current-density considerations
Layout-dependent effects
PPA-aware physical implementation
Semiconductor manufacturing/process fundamentals
Practical AI-tool proficiency is required. Candidates should be able to use approved AI assistants to accelerate technical investigation, generate and refine Python/Tcl/SKILL scripting ideas, analyze logs and verification results, improve documentation and automate repetitive engineering tasks, while independently validating AI-generated outputs for technical correctness and complying with data-security and responsible-AI requirements.
Experience with industry-standard custom-layout and physical-verification environments such as Cadence Virtuoso, Synopsys Custom Compiler, Siemens Calibre or equivalent tools is desirable/expected depending on seniority.
What We Are Looking For
Complete straightforward layout assignments with minimal or no supervision.
Take ownership of assigned layouts from initial implementation through physical-verification closure.
Make sound engineering decisions using established methodology and previous experience.
Independently troubleshoot common layout and verification problems.
Recognize when a problem requires specialist or senior-level input.
Balance layout quality, area, performance and schedule requirements.
Communicate technical information clearly within the engineering team.
Work effectively with circuit designers and related engineering teams.
Provide constructive peer-review feedback.
Consistently deliver accurate, high-quality work within agreed schedules.
Use AI tools as a normal engineering productivity aid while retaining ownership of technical decisions, verification and final deliverables.
Education / Experience :
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, VLSI, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Engineering or equivalent practical experience. Professional experience in custom IC, standard-cell, memory, analog or related transistor-level layout design is preferred.
“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience :
Exposure to physical design implementation flow

jobs.title: Software Engineer – AI
jobs.description:
Join us as Software Engineer - AI at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
To be successful as a Software Engineer - AI, you should have experience with:
This is a hands-on Software Engineer role responsible for designing, developing and testing features across web UI, mobile and API-based applications.
The role will work with developers, product colleagues and other engineering teams to understand requirements, design maintainable solutions, review code, investigate defects and support reliable software releases.
A typical day may include developing responsive React user interfaces, Java and Spring Boot services and REST APIs; reviewing designs and code; creating and executing automated tests; analysing failures; supporting CI/CD execution; and contributing to engineering and release-readiness discussions.
The role is not directly customer-facing, but it supports the performance, reliability, security and usability of customer-facing digital services.
Working across varied applications, technologies and delivery teams; building accessible, responsive and maintainable user experiences and secure, testable backend services; diagnosing complex UI, API and environment-related failures; applying asynchronous and concurrent programming safely; implementing effective observability; learning new tools quickly; and balancing hands-on technical delivery with stakeholder communication, risk management and release deadlines.
The role offers opportunities to modernise customer-facing web applications and Java services, strengthen UI, API and engineering standards, improve automated coverage and CI/CD quality gates, enhance observability and performance, and apply AI-assisted engineering practices.
The successful colleague will use Claude or an equivalent enterprise-approved AI tool to support tasks such as solution design, code generation and review, test design and automation, failure analysis, documentation and productivity improvement, while following Barclays security, privacy and responsible-AI controls.
Mandatory skills include:
Strong hands-on React engineering skills, with a sound understanding of JavaScript, JSX, reusable components, state management and React Hooks.
Strong command of JavaScript concepts including closures, promises, async/await and array methods.
Proficiency in semantic HTML, modern CSS, CSS Grid, responsive web design and cross-browser compatibility.
Strong hands-on Core Java engineering skills, with a sound understanding of object-oriented programming principles, collections, exception handling and modern Java development practices.
Practical experience with Spring and Spring Boot, including inversion of control, dependency injection, transactions, Spring Data JPA and Spring MVC.
Experience designing, developing and consuming RESTful APIs, with an understanding of API architecture, contracts, versioning, error handling, security and API gateway patterns.
Experience with Gradle or Maven for dependency management, build automation and integration with delivery pipelines.
Practical experience with testing frameworks and tools such as Mockito, EasyMock, Pact and Karate, including unit, component, contract and API testing.
Hands-on experience with multithreading and concurrent programming, including ExecutorService, CompletableFuture and thread-safety techniques.
Experience implementing application observability using tools such as the ELK Stack, Splunk or AppDynamics, including logging, monitoring, tracing and production-failure analysis.
Working knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts.
Experience integrating build, test and deployment activities with CI/CD pipelines and source-control workflows using Jenkins or GitLab.
Preferred skills include:
Exposure to React Native and mobile UX engineering.
Exposure to performance tuning and cloud services on AWS or Microsoft Azure.
Experience with automated UI and mobile testing using tools such as Jest, Appium or Detox.
Practical experience using Claude or an equivalent enterprise-approved AI assistant for software engineering tasks, alongside clear communication, problem solving and stakeholder collaboration.
You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in the role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
The role is based out of Pune.
Purpose of the role
To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
Accountabilities
Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.
Assistant Vice President Expectations
To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Job Summary
As a Sr Technical Marketing Engineer (TME) for Remote Browser Isolation (RBI), you will serve as the senior technical authority and strategic driver for our browser isolation and secure web access portfolio across Prisma SASE. Operating at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and go-to-market (GTM), you will define how our RBI capabilities are architected, positioned, and adopted in the enterprise market.
You will lead the technical marketing strategy for zero-trust web browsing, isolated cloud execution, and clientless/agent-based session isolation—protecting organizations against zero-day web exploits, phishing, ransomware, and unauthorized data exfiltration without degrading user experience. This is a highly visible, customer-facing role where your technical depth will directly accelerate revenue by translating complex browser-level rendering and isolation architectures into high-velocity sales tools.

Drive Technical GTM Strategy: Work with GTM team to execute the technical go-to-market strategy for Remote Browser Isolation, secure web access, and unmanaged/BYOD contractor access across Prisma SASE.

Competitive Intelligence & R&D Feedback: Track key RBI and enterprise browser competitors, evaluate emerging isolation architectures, and translate field friction and technical gaps into actionable requirements for R&D.

Executive Evangelism: Represent Palo Alto Networks as a subject matter expert at Executive Briefing Center (EBC) sessions, industry conferences, analyst briefings, and strategic customer engagements.
Technical Mentorship: Guide and mentor fellow Technical Marketing Engineers, establishing rigorous standards for architectural accuracy, benchmark integrity, and storytelling.

Deep RBI & Web Security Expertise: Proven architectural mastery of Remote Browser Isolation technologies—including DOM reconstruction, Document Object Model (DOM) mirroring, vector/stream rendering, pixel streaming, and Content Disarm and Reconstruction (CDR).
Networking & SASE Foundations: Strong understanding of Secure Web Gateways (SWG), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), HTTP/2 & HTTP/3, TLS decryption, WebSockets, WebRTC, and cloud-delivered SASE architectures.

Familiarity with enterprise browser architectures, Chromium internals, JavaScript engines (V8), and browser extension security models.
Experience integrating RBI with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and AI Access Security controls (e.g., preventing copy/paste, upload/download, and prompt injection in GenAI web apps).
Prior experience supporting Tier-1 industry analyst evaluations (e.g., Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave) and leading technical briefings.
Background as a Field SE or Field CTO working with highly regulated enterprises (Financial Services, Healthcare, Government/Public Sector).
Hands-on experience integrating browser and web security telemetry with SIEM, SOAR, or XDR platforms such as Cortex XSIAM.

Job Description
ERP Architect – Tieto CIO Office
Do you have a strong background in Oracle ERP architecture, complex data models, integrations and technology planning, and want to join one of the largest tech companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you!
We are looking for an ERP Architect who would be part of our technology and architecture community in Tieto CIO Office. Tieto Group Functions’ focus is to bring together core capabilities to enable and accelerate business performance. We play a vital part in the implementation of Tieto’s strategy and supporting the distinct success paths of our end-to-end businesses, through delivering high-quality services at scale and fostering an exceptional culture.
When joining Tieto CIO Office as an ERP Architect
You join a skilled team working with a highly customised Oracle ERP landscape, covering Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Database 19c, Oracle APEX, WebADI and business-facing web applications developed with Groovy on Grails and Ruby on Rails as well as the large integration network. You will collaborate with Enterprise Architects, business owners, application teams, integration specialists, database specialists and external providers to shape the future ERP architecture and roadmap.
Own current-state, target and transition architecture for Oracle EBS and surrounding applications.
Lead ERP development and evolution planning together with Head of ERP, Application manager of ERP, Enterprise Architects, Service Delivery Managers and business stakeholders.
Design and govern integrations, business logic implementation, customisations, automation and connected web applications.
Define architecture principles, standards, approved patterns, lifecycle plans and technical guardrails.
Drive security, performance, resilience, maintainability, upgrade readiness and reduction of technical debt with Application manager of ERP.
Who we are looking for
Extensive experience in ERP, solution, application or data architecture in complex enterprise environments.
Strong expertise in Oracle E-Business Suite R12.2, Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL and highly customised ERP landscapes.
Experience with complex data models, master data management, high-volume transactions, integrations and operationally critical systems.
Understanding of Oracle APEX, WebADI and enterprise web applications, with working knowledge of Groovy on Grails and Ruby on Rails frameworks.
Strong documentation, stakeholder management, communication and technical-leadership skills, with fluent English both verbally and in writing.
As an individual, we expect you to be a team player who takes responsibility for task organization and problem-solving. Working in Group Functions gives you the opportunity to have a direct influence on our company's efficiency and growth. Good communication skills and a service-oriented mindset are essential in our roles. Tieto operates in a fast-paced industry, and we value your commitment to ongoing learning and adaptability.
We also believe you have
Experience with different Oracle eBS modules.
Knowledge of Oracle eBS customisation compatibility, Microsoft Entra ID integration, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
Experience of ERP modularisation, application rationalization and modernisation, data archiving, re-hosting and platforming, enterprise integration platforms, API management, DevSecOps or automated testing.
Ability to develop target architectures, transition roadmaps and modernisation plans together with Enterprise Architects.
Typically, more than ten years of relevant ERP, application, data or solution-architecture experience.
We offer
We offer you a broad range of professional experiences, meaningful projects and collaborations within Tieto Group Functions. You will have the opportunity to be part of creating the future of the growing and fast-developing tech sector. We have an open culture, and we offer you responsibility and flexibility from the start. We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge.
Did we get you inspired?
We look forward to your application!
Please attach your CV or LinkedIn profile and we will reach out to you. Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager.
Hope to hear from you soon!
Location: Latvia, India / hybrid
We perform background checks on all final candidates.

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.title: Principal Data Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Build the next generation of Oracle data protection software, helping fortune 500 enterprises protect and recover their business-critical Oracle databases. Work on software where data integrity, recoverability, cyber resilience, and performance at scale directly affect customers’ most important operations.
Join our growing engineering team in Bengaluru and collaborate with experienced engineers in India and the US. You will contribute to shared product priorities, deliver new features and projects, and help evolve an enterprise data protection platform. This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team while building deep product expertise within an established global engineering organization.
The work spans Oracle database kernel development and systems programming, primarily in C and PL/SQL on Linux. You will tackle engineering problems involving buffers and caches, memory management, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, concurrency, and distributed systems. Strong algorithms, thoughtful design, and an understanding of how these components interact will be central to delivering correct, efficient, and maintainable software.
You will participate throughout the development lifecycle: understanding problems, exploring the codebase, identifying root causes, designing solutions, implementing changes, writing tests, and validating results. The work combines new development and enhancements with complex defect resolution, including issues encountered in customer environments. As your product knowledge grows, you will take increasing technical ownership of assigned features and components, contributing to design decisions, code reviews, ongoing maintenance, and knowledge sharing.
We value engineers who investigate problems systematically, use documentation and diagnostic tools resourcefully, communicate clearly, and help colleagues succeed. You will use modern engineering tools, including LLMs and AI coding agents, to accelerate code exploration, development, and testing while applying independent judgment and rigorous validation to the resulting designs and code.
We welcome experienced developers with strong C, Linux, system programming skills and practical knowledge of database internals, storage, distributed systems, or other demanding enterprise software. Prior Oracle Database, RMAN, PL/SQL, or backup and recovery product experience is an advantage. Strong systems fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to translate complex requirements into reliable production software are essential.
This position is based in Bengaluru, India.
• Design, implement, and maintain RMAN features and enhancements in C and PL/SQL on Linux, contributing to Oracle database kernel and systems software development.
• Translate requirements and technical problems into clear designs, manageable tasks, and deliverable milestones. Evaluate alternatives and document trade-offs involving correctness, performance, scalability, compatibility, and maintainability.
• Apply appropriate algorithms and data structures to build efficient, reliable software. Reason about memory use, concurrency, synchronization, and behavior under demanding workloads.
• Develop and improve assigned components involving buffers, caches, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, and distributed processing, with careful attention to data integrity and recovery behavior.
• Build product expertise through code exploration, technical documentation, collaboration, and delivery of fixes and enhancements. Progress toward ownership of assigned features and projects, including subsequent development, maintenance, and defect resolution.

OverviewAs a Principal Security Engineer, Cloud Security at Atlassian, you will be the technical architect and engineer driving the architecture and technical vision across our cloud platforms, infrastructure, and software supply chain. You will partner closely with engineering leadership, platform teams, and principal architects to define secure-by-default standards, architect scalable guardrails, and lead cross - organisational initiatives that protect Atlassian’s cloud environments at global scale.
In this role, you will operate at the intersection of deep technical leadership and strategic influence - diving hands-on into complex architectural designs, critical codebases, and high-severity escalations, while steering long-term security roadmaps and mentoring senior engineers across the organization. You will systematically identify systemic risks, design resilient mitigations, and ensure our cloud platforms deliver world-class security, reliability, and trust for over 300,000+ customers.
As a Principal Product Security Engineer, Cloud Security, you will be the technical architect and engineer driving the architecture and and strategic SME driving cloud security architecture, automation, and secure-by-default platforms across Atlassian's global footprint. You will define the technical vision, establish architectural standards, and lead cross-organizational initiatives that equip engineering teams with state-of-the-art tools, patterns, and guardrails to build secure products by default. Partnering closely with security leadership, principal architects, and platform engineering teams, you will champion strategic programs that uplift and scale our security posture across multi-cloud environments. Some of your key responsibilities will include:
Strategic Architecture & Secure Design: Define and steer the overarching security architecture for multi-cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), setting company-wide secure-by-default standards, architectural patterns, and guardrails for cloud-native services and core platforms.
Complex Threat Modeling & High-Impact Assessments: Drive advanced threat modeling and deep-dive security assessments across critical, complex systems, distributed microservices, and high-assurance environments (such as Isolated, Private, and Regulated/FedRAMP offerings).
Platform Automation & Guardrails at Scale: Architect, champion, and scale automated security controls, detection capabilities, and self-healing guardrails embedded directly into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (IaC), systematically eliminating classes of vulnerabilities.
Continuous Posture Optimization & CSPM Strategy: Set the technical direction for Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and posture analytics, driving continuous compliance, maturing security baselines, and providing leadership visibility into systemic risk.
Operational & Architectural Excellence: Establish company-wide reusable security frameworks, engineering guidelines, and operational standards that improve resilience, reliability, and security performance across Atlassian products.
Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a technical sponsor and mentor for security and software engineers across the organization, fostering an inclusive culture of engineering excellence, security advocacy, and cross-team capability uplift.
Critical Incident Advisory & Architectural Remediation: Act as the principal cloud security authority during high-severity security incidents, partnering with Incident Response to conduct root-cause investigations, formulate long-term architectural mitigations, and prevent recurrence.
Executive & Stakeholder Influence: Translate complex cloud security risks and technical roadmaps into strategic priorities for executive and non-technical stakeholders, driving consensus and cross-functional alignment on mission-critical security initiatives.

Exceptional technical communication and executive influence, with a demonstrated ability to align diverse engineering teams, architects, and senior leadership around strategic security goals.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Baseboard Management Controller
jobs.description:
The Software (CE-SW) group is responsible for developing and improving the software ecosystem around Arm's next generation architectures and systems. This means working with processors and other hardware technology not yet available to the public. You will join a team of Software Engineers who share a passion for leaving their mark on the future of computing.
We are looking for highly capable software engineers with practical experience of programming the Baseboard Management Controller (BMC). The successful candidate will be working with vibrant software and hardware teams across multiple geographies on ground breaking products and will be presented with opportunities to vastly grow their technical understanding.
If you are similarly passionate about innovative technologies, then we would love to hear from you!
Responsibilities
We are seeking those who will perform both software development and actively participate in the OpenBMC community.
Your day-to-day role will involve develop, enhance, and maintain the OpenBMC firmware stack for Arm-based server platforms, ensuring robust and reliable system management capabilities.
BMC firmware bring-up and platform enablement activities for new Arm-based server boards, including hardware integration, driver configuration, debugging, and validation.
Develop and port BMC functionalities across multiple Arm-based server platforms, promoting software reuse, scalability, and consistency across platforms.
Working closely with colleagues who develop SoC firmware to ensure that the BMC operates correctly within the complete system.
Contribute to the upstream OpenBMC community to ensure that common server manageability features and Arm-specific platform requirements are well supported, maintained, and aligned with industry standards.
Required Skills and Experience
We need the following experience and skills from our candidates:
5+ years of strong proficiency in C/C++ programming and Linux shell scripting for embedded firmware development, debugging, and automation.
Hands-on experience with U-Boot, Linux kernel development, and device driver integration for hardware interfaces such as GPIO, I2C, I3C, SPI, PCIe, and Ethernet.
Good understanding of OpenBMC architecture, system management services, D-Bus communication, and systemd service management, with experience in developing, integrating, and debugging OpenBMC components.
Good Linux debugging skills.
Familiarity with Git.
Strong interpersonal skills; excellent written and spoken English.
“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience
We would look favourably at the following:
Knowledge of DMTF specifications and protocols, including PLDM, MCTP, and SPDM, with an understanding of their application in server management and platform security.
Familiarity with OCP specifications and standards related to server manageability, including DC-SCM and other relevant platform management requirements.
Experience contributing to upstream open-source projects, particularly OpenBMC, including patch submission, code reviews, and collaboration with the open-source community.
Hands-on experience with BMC SoCs from vendors such as ASPEED or Nuvoton, including platform bring-up, peripheral integration, and firmware development.
Ability to read and interpret hardware schematics, understand board-level interfaces, and collaborate with hardware teams to debug platform integration issues.

jobs.title: Sr Serviceability Engineer - Life Cycle Manager (LCM)
jobs.description:
About Nutanix
Nutanix is building a world where infrastructure is invisible, and organizations can focus on the work that matters. Our hybrid multicloud platform helps customers run applications and manage data across private, public, and distributed clouds with simplicity and control.
About the Team
The Serviceability Engineer role is part of the Service Strategy & Enablement team at Nutanix, based in Bangalore. The team is made up of engineers who improve product serviceability, diagnostics, reliability, and the overall customer experience.
Serving as a critical bridge between Support and Engineering, the team ensures that serviceability and usability are considered throughout the product lifecycle. By analyzing customer issues, monitoring field performance, validating releases, and incorporating customer feedback, the team drives improvements that make Nutanix products easier to deploy, upgrade, troubleshoot, and operate.
You will report to the Manager, Service Strategy & Enablement. The team works in a hybrid environment that encourages collaboration, technical learning, and ownership.
Your Role
As a Senior Serviceability Engineer for Life Cycle Manager (LCM), you will help make upgrades predictable, diagnosable, and safe across Nutanix software and hardware environments. You will work closely with Engineering, Product Management, Quality Assurance, Release Management, and Support to improve the serviceability of LCM from product definition through release and post-deployment adoption.
LCM provides a cluster-aware framework for inventorying and updating software and firmware across a Nutanix environment. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys understanding complex distributed systems, investigating customer-impacting failures, improving product diagnostics, and influencing teams to prevent recurring issues.
The role involves performing duties requiring the application of professional expertise and the exercise of independent judgment/discretion, creativity, problem-solving, and decision-making in carrying out responsibilities, as applicable to the position. The specific responsibilities of the role may vary based on business needs and role requirements. Employees can refer to the applicable guidelines and career frameworks for additional information regarding role expectations and responsibilities.
What You’ll Do
Define and maintain serviceability requirements for LCM features, upgrade workflows, inventory, prechecks, compatibility validation, recovery, and diagnostics.
Partner with Product Management and Engineering during product planning and development to ensure customer troubleshooting and operational needs are addressed early.
Lead serviceability validation for LCM releases, including upgrade-path testing, upgrade and inventory workflows, precheck coverage, failure and recovery scenarios, interoperability, scale, and upgrade resiliency.
Build and maintain representative test matrices across Nutanix software, hypervisors, server platforms, firmware components, cluster configurations, and supported deployment models.
Review field issues, support cases, telemetry, and diagnostic data to identify trends, customer impact, recurring failure modes, and opportunities for product improvement.
Investigate complex LCM failures by correlating application logs, task and workflow data, cluster state, system events, network behavior, and firmware or hardware-management responses.
Work with Engineering to isolate root causes, reproduce issues, define corrective actions, and drive critical and deferred defects to closure.
Review precheck and compatibility behavior to ensure that failures are actionable, accurately classified, and supported by clear remediation guidance.
Evaluate upgrade rollback, recovery, and partial-failure scenarios and help define safe customer outcomes when an upgrade does not complete as expected.
Collaborate with Quality Assurance and test automation teams to improve coverage for upgrade paths, dependency conflicts, hardware variants, network conditions, disconnected or restricted environments, and negative scenarios.
Partner with Release Management and Documentation teams on release readiness, known issues, upgrade guidance, troubleshooting content, and Support enablement.
Translate complex technical findings into clear requirements, defect reports, troubleshooting guides, executive summaries, and customer-safe recommendations.
Represent the customer and Support perspective in design reviews, technical discussions, defect triage, and release decisions.
Mentor engineers and promote serviceability practices that reduce customer effort, support case volume, time to resolution, and avoidable upgrade risk.
What You’ll Bring
5+ years of experience in enterprise software, platform engineering, systems engineering, quality engineering, technical support, or serviceability.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
Experience working with complex infrastructure products, distributed systems, virtualization platforms, cloud infrastructure, or data-center operations.
Strong experience troubleshooting customer-impacting issues across multiple layers of a technology stack and converting investigation findings into durable product improvements.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and Support without relying solely on formal authority.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, technical support teams, product leaders, and executive stakeholders.
Technical Requirements
Life Cycle Management and Upgrade Workflows
Strong understanding of software and firmware lifecycle management, including inventory, repositories, package or bundle management, prechecks, dependencies, compatibility, upgrade sequencing, and post-upgrade validation.
Experience testing or troubleshooting upgrade workflows involving failure handling, partial completion, recovery, retry, and resumption scenarios.
Understanding of the operational risks associated with infrastructure upgrades and the importance of clear customer-facing diagnostics and remediation guidance.
Virtualization and Nutanix Technologies
Hands-on experience with one or more virtualization or hypervisor technologies, such as Nutanix AHV/KVM or VMware ESXi.
Familiarity with enterprise infrastructure concepts such as clusters, controllers, virtual machines, storage, networking, high availability, and rolling maintenance.
Experience with Nutanix technologies such as AOS, Prism, AHV, or LCM is a plus.
Systems and Infrastructure Troubleshooting
Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, including process, service, filesystem, permissions, networking, and system-resource analysis.
Ability to analyze logs, task histories, service states, configuration files, alerts, and diagnostic bundles to identify failure patterns.
Familiarity with server hardware, firmware, boot processes, out-of-band management, and hardware-management interfaces such as Redfish or IPMI is preferred.
Understanding of network fundamentals relevant to infrastructure upgrades, including DNS, routing, firewalls, proxies, TLS certificates, repositories, and connectivity validation.
Automation, APIs, and Diagnostics
Proficiency in Python, Shell, or another scripting language for test automation, log analysis, data extraction, and operational tooling.
Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, error handling, and API-driven infrastructure workflows.
Familiarity with observability, telemetry, log collection, diagnostic bundles, and metrics used to detect and troubleshoot product issues.
Experience building or improving automated validation for upgrade, compatibility, failure-injection, or recovery scenarios.
Serviceability and Quality Engineering
Experience defining test strategies, test plans, acceptance criteria, release gates, and validation metrics for complex products.
Proven ability to review and prioritize defects using customer impact, frequency, severity, reproducibility, and business risk.
Ability to create high-quality defect reports with clear symptoms, impact, reproduction steps, evidence, suspected scope, and validation criteria.
Experience using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or equivalent systems for defect tracking, documentation, and cross-functional execution.
Experience using AI to automate workflows, build task-oriented agents, or analyze defects, bugs, and diagnostic data.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with infrastructure lifecycle management, firmware orchestration, server vendors, or data-center management platforms.
Experience supporting or validating air-gapped, dark-site, proxy-based, or restricted-network environments.
Knowledge of upgrade compatibility models, dependency graphs, release branches, backward compatibility, and interoperability testing.
Experience with CI/CD, test frameworks, continuous validation, or quality dashboards.
Background in technical support, escalation engineering, site reliability engineering, or customer-facing engineering for enterprise infrastructure products.
Experience creating technical documentation, knowledge base content, troubleshooting guides, or Support readiness material.
Why This Role Matters
Infrastructure upgrades are high-trust operations for customers. In this role, you will help ensure that LCM does more than execute an upgrade: it should explain what is happening, identify risks early, recover safely when conditions change, and give customers and Support a clear path to resolution.
If you enjoy solving difficult infrastructure problems, working across product boundaries, and turning field experience into better engineering outcomes, this is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the reliability and usability of Nutanix products.
Nutanix is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Job Details | Atlassian
Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Responsible AI
Engineering | Bengaluru, India | Remote, Remote
Apply for this job
Working at Atlassian
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. This is a remote position. To help our teams work together effectively, this role requires you to be located in India.
We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team, dedicated to developing innovative solutions to make AI services responsible (Responsible AI).
You will join the Responsible AI (RAI) & AI Safety engineering team. We are responsible for building, operating, and advancing the centralized AI safety, content moderation, and guardrail platforms powering Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo.
Our systems run inline and asynchronously across high-throughput production workloads, detecting and mitigating jailbreaks, prompt injection, harmful content, bias, and policy violations while preserving latency and user experience. We partner closely with Product Engineering, Central AI Platform, AI Gateway, Legal, and Trust teams to deliver safety systems that scale globally.
We have teams in the USA, Australia, New Zealand, and this will be our expansion to India. This team is responsible for building solutions and operating mature platforms to improve the entire company's security and trust & safety posture.If you are passionate about improving security, trust & safety, and combating abuse, this role presents a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact!
At Atlassian, a Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) is responsible for building, training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models into production systems at scale. The role sits at the intersection of software engineering and data science, requiring production-grade code to turn research prototypes into real-world systems like search ranking, recommendations, and GenAI platforms.
What You’ll Do
Design & Productionize Safety Models: Architect, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM-based guardrail and moderation models (text, multi-modal, and code) to safeguard user inputs and model outputs across Atlassian products.
Build Robust Evaluation & Benchmarking: Design offline and online evaluation frameworks, adversarial test suites (red-teaming), and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to measure precision, recall, false-positive rates, and robustness against model drift.

We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. You Are
You have spent years designing circuits that sit at the foundation of every chip that ships, the standard cells that have to work flawlessly across voltage corners, temperature swings, and process variations because millions of instances of your design will be stitched into real silicon. You know that a poorly designed flip-flop does not just fail in simulation, it shows up as yield loss six months later, and you have learned to think three steps ahead to prevent that.
You understand CMOS physics deeply enough to know why a circuit behaves differently at 7nm than it did at 28nm, and you can trace a leakage path or an EM violation back to a transistor-level decision without needing someone to walk you through it. You have debugged post-layout netlists at 2am and come out the other side with a fix that actually holds.
You are comfortable working in the space between circuit design, layout, characterization, and physical design. You do not wait for perfect specs, you collaborate with layout engineers to understand what is buildable, with characterization teams to ensure your cells can actually be modeled, and with product teams to understand what the end customer needs. You have opinions about how a library should be architected, and you can defend them with data.
At Synopsys, you will design standard cell libraries that power the semiconductor industry's most advanced chips, and the work you do will directly affect performance, power, and area outcomes for customers building everything from AI accelerators to mobile SoCs.
What You'll Be Doing
Design and optimize high-performance and low-power standard cells for advanced technology nodes, including flip-flops, latches, multi-bit flip-flops, level shifters, isolation cells, retention cells, power-gating cells, clock buffers, inverters, and clock gates
Perform transistor-level circuit design, simulation, and analysis using HSPICE, PrimeSim XA, Custom Compiler, or Virtuoso to meet PPA targets across PVT corners
Support characterization teams by developing verification environments, analyzing post-layout extracted netlists using StarRC, and ensuring timing, power, and noise models are accurate
Collaborate with layout teams to define cell architecture, matching strategies, and parasitic-aware design techniques that account for layout-dependent effects and manufacturability constraints
Drive circuit-level optimization using statistical and variation-aware methodologies including Monte Carlo analysis, OCV, and advanced variation modeling
Develop and maintain automation scripts in Python, Shell, or Tcl to streamline design flows, extraction, analysis, and verification tasks
Work cross-functionally with CAD, methodology, physical design, and product engineering teams to ensure library quality, reliability, and performance meet customer requirements
The Impact You Will Have
Your standard cell designs will be instantiated millions of times in customer chips, directly affecting the performance, power, and area of AI, mobile, automotive, and high-performance computing products
You will enable Synopsys customers to achieve aggressive PPA targets at advanced nodes by delivering optimized, reliable, and manufacturable standard cell libraries
Your collaboration with characterization and layout teams will reduce library development cycle time and improve model accuracy, enabling faster customer tape-outs
You will contribute to the development of next-generation library architectures that address emerging challenges in leakage, reliability, electromigration, and IR drop at sub-7nm nodes
Your automation and scripting work will increase design productivity across the team and establish reusable flows that scale across multiple technology nodes
You will mentor junior engineers and help build technical depth across the circuit design organization
Your expertise in variation-aware design and AI/ML-assisted EDA tools will position the team to adopt cutting-edge methodologies that improve design quality and efficiency
What You'll Need
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
8+ years of hands-on experience in standard cell library circuit design for advanced technology nodes
Deep expertise in designing and optimizing flip-flops, latches, multi-bit flip-flops, voltage level shifters, power optimization cells, clock cells, and complex custom digital circuits
Strong knowledge of CMOS device physics, transistor behavior, leakage mechanisms, reliability concerns, and advanced node effects including layout-dependent effects
Proven experience with circuit simulation, characterization support, post-layout verification, and extraction using tools like HSPICE, PrimeSim XA, StarRC, Custom Compiler, Virtuoso, SiliconSmart, or Liberty NCX
Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Shell, or Tcl; experience with IC Validator coding or custom flow development is a strong plus
Experience with statistical and variation-aware design methodologies including PVT analysis, OCV, and Monte Carlo simulation; exposure to AI/ML-assisted EDA tools is highly desirable
Who You Are
You can look at a post-layout netlist with 500 parasitics and quickly identify the coupling path that is causing a setup violation without needing someone to point it out
You push back when a spec does not account for real-world variation or when a layout approach will create an EM risk three years down the line, and you can explain why in a way that gets the decision changed
You are comfortable presenting circuit-level tradeoffs to senior engineers or product teams and defending your design choices with simulation data, not intuition
You work well across teams, you do not throw designs over the wall to layout or characterization, you sit with them, understand their constraints, and iterate until the solution works for everyone
You stay current on advanced node challenges, whether that is new leakage mechanisms, reliability models, or EDA tool capabilities, and you bring that knowledge back to improve how the team works
You can mentor a junior engineer through their first standard cell design, helping them understand not just what to do but why it matters and what will break if they get it wrong

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent the last few years building verification environments that actually close coverage, not just pass tests. Protocols like PCIe, UCIe, or DDR are not abstract specs to you, they are state machines with edge cases you have debugged at the transaction level in Verdi. You write UVM code that other engineers can extend without breaking, and you know the difference between a scoreboard that checks transactions and one that catches the bugs that matter.
You think in coverage models and assertions, not just directed tests. When documentation is incomplete or a design decision is still being debated, you ask the right questions and build test plans that close the gaps. At Synopsys, you will work on high-speed interconnect IP that ships in real silicon, and the verification you own keeps bugs out of the lab.
What You'll Be Doing
Own verification planning and execution for UCIe, PCIe, or DDR IP blocks, translating protocol specs into test plans, checkers, and SystemVerilog Assertions.
Build and extend UVM testbenches including agents, sequencers, scoreboards, factories, and coverage models that other engineers will use and maintain.
Write constrained-random and directed tests in SystemVerilog, debug failing regressions, and close functional and code coverage using VCS and URG.
Perform root-cause analysis on RTL bugs, protocol compliance failures, and testbench issues using Synopsys Verdi for waveform, transaction-level, and protocol debug.
Contribute to regression infrastructure, coverage closure strategies, and first-silicon readiness activities.
The Impact You Will Have
Your verification catches silicon-impacting bugs before tape-out, saving months of respins and lab debug time.
The UVM environments you build become reusable across product generations, accelerating time-to-market for future IP releases.
Your coverage models and assertions close gaps that design reviews and code inspection miss, improving overall IP quality.
The test plans you write become the blueprint for regression suites that run thousands of times across multiple projects.
Your debug skills reduce mean-time-to-resolution on critical bugs, unblocking design teams and keeping schedules on track.
The protocol expertise you bring strengthens the team's ability to tackle next-generation interconnect standards and customer requirements.
What You'll Need
B-Tech or M.Tech in Electronics, VLSI, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
2+ years of hands-on ASIC or SoC verification experience with ownership of IP block or subsystem-level verification.
Strong working knowledge of at least one high-speed protocol: PCIe, UCIe, or DDR, including link training, state machines, and compliance requirements.
Solid UVM methodology experience building agents, sequencers, scoreboards, coverage models, and constrained-random stimulus in SystemVerilog.
Proven debug skills using Synopsys Verdi for waveform analysis, transaction-level debug, and protocol-specific investigation.
Experience with industry simulators like VCS, Xcelium, or Questa, and familiarity with regression and coverage tools such as URG.
Direct experience verifying UCIe PHY, PCIe controllers, or DDR memory controllers is a strong plus, as is familiarity with VIP integration or formal verification.
Who You Are
You can look at a failing regression, open Verdi, and find the root cause without needing someone to point you to the right signal.
You write UVM code that other engineers can read and extend six months later without asking you how it works.
You push back when a test plan is too vague or a coverage hole is being ignored, and you do it in a way that moves the conversation forward.
You communicate debug findings clearly in writing and in meetings, whether you are talking to a junior engineer or a principal architect.
You stay organized across multiple test plans, coverage reports, and bug tracking without losing track of what actually needs to close before tape-out.
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will join the Synopsys IP Verification team in Hyderabad, working on high-speed interconnect IP including UCIe, PCIe, and DDR that ships in production silicon. The team collaborates closely with design, architecture, and silicon validation engineers to ensure protocol compliance and functional correctness. You will work alongside verification engineers with deep protocol expertise, contribute to shared UVM infrastructure, and participate in tape-out readiness reviews that directly impact customer schedules.
Rewards and Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

Knowledge of RF architecture and blocks such as transceivers front-end , VCOs, LNA, and up/down converters
Hands-on in analog design , simulation and signoff methodology , critical layout reviews and driving parasitic optimization

Join our High-Performance Computing (HPC) Enterprise analog/mixed-signal Serdes team involved in cutting-edge High Speed PHYSICAL Interface Development.
You will work with experienced teams locally and with colleagues from various sites across the globe, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment.
