jobs.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
The Security Central team builds and operates services that help OCI teams understand their security posture, identify risks, and drive remediation across cloud infrastructure. The Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer designs, implements, and optimizes distributed system components, backend services, data pipelines, and integrations with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability.
The role includes owning features and service components from design through production, delivering load and performance tests, and using data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing. Responsibilities include building fault-tolerant paths through redundancy, replication, synchronization, and automatic failover; applying recovery-oriented design principles; and implementing retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts.
Operational ownership includes proactively detecting and mitigating issues through tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authoring runbooks; and participating in incident response and root cause analysis. The role also involves developing automation and Infrastructure as Code for deployment, troubleshooting, and maintenance, and implementing security controls for encryption, access management, and remediation while meeting change management, compliance, and documentation standards.
Close collaboration with security and engineering teams is essential to translate requirements into practical solutions. Contributions include technical design reviews, peer implementation reviews for scalability and reliability, and ongoing improvements to engineering and operational practices.
This role is ideal for an engineer with strong software development fundamentals, experience with distributed systems, and an interest in building secure, reliable cloud services.
Key Responsibilities
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.
–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.
–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.
–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
–Implements performance and load testing.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.
–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.
–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.
–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.
–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.
–Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
–Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues.
–Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.
Compliance & Security:
–Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.
–Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security.
–Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date
Automation & Change Management:
–Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure.
–Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications.
Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:
–Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements.
–Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance
Collaboration & Partnership:
–Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. The LRT group is responsible for the language layer and relational execution engine powering YugabyteDB. We care deeply about correctness, performance, and usability of the system we are building. We are always looking for innovative solutions to these challenges, be it from other industry applications, academic research or original contributions, as our team’s work powers a broad range of components. The team's work areas include query planning and optimization, consistent online schema changes, as well as a broad set of SQL features including stored procedures, triggers, geo-partitioned tables, or GIN indexes for text search.
Roles and Responsibilities
Lead the design, implementation, and evolution of the distributed SQL query execution engine in YugabyteDB, ensuring correctness, efficiency, and horizontal scalability.
Own and enhance execution-layer components including distributed scans, joins, aggregations, sorting, batching, parallel execution, RPC coordination, and runtime memory management.
Optimize distributed execution paths by minimizing cross-node communication, reducing data movement, improving pushdown to storage layer, and enhancing execution pipelining.
Improve runtime observability by enhancing execution metrics, tracing, profiling, and debugging capabilities to support production-grade workloads.
Mentor engineers on distributed systems design principles, execution-engine architecture, and performance engineering best practices.
Write high-quality C/C++ code with comprehensive unit, integration, and performance test coverage; actively participate in and drive high-quality code and design reviews.
Collaborate cross-functionally with storage, transaction, and infrastructure teams to ensure execution-layer scalability as cluster sizes and transactional throughput grow.
Contribute strategically to the roadmap and technical direction of YugabyteDB’s distributed SQL execution subsystem and the broader ecosystem.
Required Experience
5-8 years experience with compiled languages, e.g. C/C++.
BS/MS/PhD in CS (or related field) or equivalent experience.
Systems engineering fundamentals (e.g.: distributed systems, operating systems, databases) is a must.
Experience with compiled languages, e.g. C/C++ (preferred), Java, Go, Rust.
Knowledge of database internals, compilers, query planning/optimization is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
A hands-on Technical Lead / Senior Data Platform Engineer responsible for designing, building, and operating ISDP — Ford's cloud-native, event-driven data ingestion and identity-resolution platform. ISDP ingests vehicle engineering, manufacturing, service, PLM (3DX), supply chain, and quality data from multiple enterprise source systems (IVS, FEDE Workbench, DVP, 3DX, Ascent, SIMPSN) through a 5-layer architecture — GCS ingestion, Cloud Function event triggers, Airflow/Astronomer orchestration, Apache Beam/Dataflow processing, and BigQuery/AlloyDB storage — with full identity resolution (deterministic UUID v5), schema-contract data quality validation, observability, and downstream graph/analytics layers.
Responsibilities
Pipeline & Platform Engineering
Design, build, and enhance the ISDP ingestion and identity-resolution engine using Apache Beam and Google Cloud Dataflow (Flex Templates, Java 21) to process PLM, manufacturing, service, and quality data into a BigQuery domain event store.
Implement pluggable file-reader strategies for JSON, JSONL, and XML payloads (XPath/JSONPath-based field extraction, namespace handling) and support 3 processing strategies: flat_records, tree_flatten, and tree_relationships.
Implement the YAML-driven Mapping Engine: field mappings, transforms (upper/lower/strip/split/replace/regex_filter/compose_from), deterministic UUID v5 primary-key minting, and cross-domain foreign-key resolution via a frozen namespace_id registry.
Own the Schema Contract Validation layer — required fields, allowed values, regex patterns, min/max length checks — routing failing records to a BigQuery Dead Letter Queue (domain_event_store_dlq.identity_quality_events) prior to canonical mapping.
Design and implement streaming pipelines (e.g., the ODS AlloyDB job) that subscribe to canonical-record Pub/Sub topics (isdp-canonical-records) and upsert transformed records into AlloyDB as an Operational Data Store for low-latency API serving.
Build and maintain the downstream Graph Layer — a config-driven, entity-agnostic property graph (BigQuery) that projects domain_event_store events into graph_nodes/graph_edges via registry-driven, watermark-based incremental refresh procedures.
Domain / Data Source Onboarding
Onboard new business domains and source systems (IVS Manufacturing/Service, FEDE Workbench, DVP, 3DX PLM, Ascent Supplier Commit/Survey, SIMPSN Quality, Part Return) by authoring per-domain YAML configs (sources, key_rules, mappings, foreign_keys, schema_contract), BigQuery JSON schemas, and Terraform table definitions.
Register new domains in domains_index.yaml, assigning immutable, rename-stable namespace_id values that seed the UUID v5 namespace for each domain.
Run the ISDP data-source onboarding process end-to-end: profile source files, propose domains/PKs/FKs/data-quality rules, build and iterate YAML contracts with the source team, validate in Dev then Pre-Prod, and finalize go-live plans.
Author and maintain validation test cases (unit tests for MappingEngine, SchemaContractValidationFn; Cucumber BDD integration tests) to certify each onboarded domain end-to-end against a local SQLite/PostgreSQL sink without requiring live GCP infrastructure.
Orchestration, Infrastructure & CI/CD
Maintain the Cloud Function event trigger (Gen2, Python) that detects GCS object-finalize events and launches the Airflow DAG (isdp_processing_engine) via the Astronomer/Airflow REST API, including duplicate-run prevention.
Maintain the Airflow DAG orchestration logic (list_and_move, trigger_dataflow, archive, check_requeue tasks) governing the file lifecycle (new/ → processing/ → archive/ or invalid/) across all source buckets.
Own Terraform infrastructure-as-code (github-60318-isdp-tf) provisioning BigQuery datasets/tables, GCS buckets, Cloud Functions, Workload Identity Federation bindings, IAM, and Secret Manager entries across Dev, Pre-Prod, and Prod GCP projects.

Support local development workflows — Gradle/Java 21 builds, DirectRunner local pipeline execution, portable local PostgreSQL (AlloyDB-equivalent) provisioning, and Pub/Sub sample message replay for ODS streaming testing.
Operations, Quality & Observability
Monitor and maintain the six-pillar observability suite (freshness, volume/anomaly, quality, schema drift, lineage, DLQ analysis) backed by BigQuery observability tables and MS Teams alerting (MsTeamsAlertFn).
Perform production support: health checks across Cloud Function, Airflow DAG, and Dataflow job status; BigQuery write-recency verification; DLQ triage and root-cause investigation; incident response for stuck/failed jobs.
Own release coordination, security remediation (dependency CVE patching via Gradle constraints, FOSSA/SonarQube gates), QA validation, and post-production support across Dev, Pre-Prod, and Prod environments.
Perform detailed requirement analysis, solution design, development, code review, unit/integration testing, and defect resolution across the full ISDP delivery lifecycle.

NCR Atleos is a global leader in self-service financial access and ATM solutions, providing technology and services to financial institutions and retailers. The company supports ATM deployment, maintenance, managed services, cash management, transaction processing infrastructure, and end-to-end ATM operations.
For the PNB Dispute Management Executive position, the role contributes to operational accuracy and customer service by supporting transaction verification, ATM reconciliation, excess cash investigation, CIT coordination, CCTV verification, and timely closure of GL, suspense, and sundry differences.
Position Summary
The Dispute Management Executive will be responsible for the day-to-day reconciliation, and closure of ATM transaction disputes and related operational differences for the PNB process. The role requires timely investigation of failed transactions, excess cash cases, reconciliation differences, and suspense/sundry items while coordinating with relevant internal and external stakeholders for resolution.

Perform daily verification of failed ATM transactions.
Investigate transaction discrepancies and ensure timely resolution of identified exceptions.

Investigate mismatches and coordinate for timely resolution of reconciliation differences.

Ensure open reconciliation items are appropriately investigated, documented, and closed within defined timelines.

Follow up on outstanding entries and ensure timely closure of pending items with appropriate supporting documentation.

Practical knowledge of C3R, EJ, Switch, GL, suspense, and sundry reconciliation.

Good written and verbal communication skills.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer
jobs.description:
Yugabyte is the company behind YugabyteDB, the AI-ready, multi-modal, distributed PostgreSQL database for cloud-native apps. Trusted by industry leaders including Shopify, Paramount+, GM, Kroger, Fiserv, and NPCI, YugabyteDB has been deployed in over 100 countries and powers more than 5 million clusters worldwide.
Together, our hard-working team of experts and our industry-leading technology are uniquely positioned to meet the demands of modern workloads: geo-distributed, ultra-resilient, and built to scale without limits.
Our Yugabeings (distributed, like our database) span 12+ countries and multiple time zones, sharing expertise from diverse backgrounds and industries.
Staff Engineer – Distributed Storage & Transactions (DST)
About Yugabyte
At Yugabyte, we are on a mission to become the default transactional database for enterprises building cloud-native applications. YugabyteDB is our PostgreSQL compatible distributed database for cloud-native apps. Resilient, scalable, and flexible, it runs on any cloud and enables developers to become instantly productive using well-known APIs.We are looking for talented and driven people to join us on our ambitious mission and help us build a lasting and impactful company.The transactional database market is estimated to grow to $150B by 2030. YugabyteDB is cloud-native by design, has on-demand horizontal scalability, and supports geographical distribution of data using built-in replication. This means that we are well-positioned to meet market demand for geo-distributed, high-scale, high-performance workloads.
Yugabyte offers a culture of innovation, ownership, and technical excellence, with opportunities to impact a cutting-edge distributed SQL database used by global enterprises. As a member of the DST team, you’ll help meet growing demand for high-scale, high-performance, globally distributed transactional workloads — instrumental to our product’s success.
Role Overview
As a Staff Engineer on the Distributed Storage & Transactions (DST) team, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling the core distributed storage, replication, and transaction foundations of YugabyteDB.
You will work on some of the most challenging problems in distributed systems — including consistency, durability, fault tolerance, performance, and scalability — while collaborating closely with query layer, platform, and cloud teams. This role is ideal for engineers who thrive in low-level systems work and want to shape the future of a globally distributed database.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, development, testing, and delivery of core storage and replication features in YugabyteDB.
Write high-quality C/C++ code with comprehensive automated tests; actively participate in design discussions and code reviews.
Troubleshoot and resolve correctness, stability, and performance issues in complex distributed storage and transactional subsystems.
Improve database scalability and throughput as cluster sizes, data volumes, and transaction rates continue to grow.
Build and streamline database management operations, including:
Horizontal cluster scale-out
Incremental and point-in-time backups
Online schema and index operations
Rolling upgrades and blue-green deployments
Identify and implement performance improvements across the storage engine, transaction processing, and replication layers.
Contribute to the open-source YugabyteDB project, helping evolve its storage architecture and operational reliability.
Mentor and technically influence other engineers in distributed systems design, performance engineering, and systems-level debugging.
Required Qualifications
8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong foundation in systems programming using C/C++.
Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science (or related field), or equivalent practical experience.
Deep understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including:
Replication and consensus
Transactions and consistency models
Fault tolerance and recovery
Experience working on storage engines, databases, or other infrastructure-level systems.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in a collaborative, distributed team environment
Preferred Skills
Hands-on experience with distributed storage systems, transactional engines, or consensus protocols.
Familiarity with LSM-tree based storage engines, WALs, snapshots, or compaction strategies.
Experience with PostgreSQL internals or other relational database engines is a strong plus.
Prior contributions to open-source systems or database projects.

Monitor excess, obsolete, and slow-moving inventory and recommend corrective actions.

Enterprise Account Executive - North & East India
Join us at Zendesk, where we're on a mission to power exceptional service for every person on the planet. We're accelerating our ambition by building products rooted in the belief that behind every interaction is an opportunity to make a human connection.
To achieve this, we're in search of a successful Enterprise Account Executive with a proven track record in B2B sales and a passion for driving growth within the SaaS space. Manage and nurture key customer relationships to ensure maximum satisfaction and retention, fostering long-term strategic partnerships.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description
At Zendesk, we’re revolutionizing what’s possible in Customer Experience (CX) and Employee Services (ES). Our rapid innovation and Agentic AI leadership have earned the trust of thousands of forward-thinking businesses.
We are seeking aSenior Sales Engineer to sit at the intersection of enterprise software strategy, hands-on systems architecture, and advanced AI automation. This is not a traditional generalist presales role. This is a role built for highly technical builders who are deeply curious about how autonomous agents, security, analytics, and deep integrations fundamentally transform how enterprise work gets done. You will own the technical strategy for our global customer engagements, acting as a strategic advisor to both the C-suite and engineering leadership.
Why This Role? Why Now?
Drive the AI Revolution: Step into an elite presales environment where you will directly architect the deployment of modern Agentic AI workflows and Large Language Models (LLMs) for top global enterprises.
Strategic Scope: Evolve your career by expanding your enterprise influence by presenting technical value narratives directly to economic buyers and C-level stakeholders.
Innovative Culture: Work within an ecosystem designed to optimize human potential through advanced digital tools, where continuous learning, curiosity, and experimentation are hardwired into our daily performance.
Who We're Looking For
We are looking for a highly technical Individual Contributor who operates with considerable judgment and initiative. You understand the complex operational and financial implications of architecture choices and can confidently design customized enterprise-grade solutions. You have a passion for clean system configurations, combined with a sharp commercial mindset that links technical capabilities directly to business metrics, ROI, and organizational transformation.
What You'll Be Doing
Architect Agentic AI & Integration Workflows: Design, build, and operationalize advanced, agentic AI-driven customer workflows leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), deep prompt engineering, and modern automation frameworks.
Lead Technical Architecture Discovery: Conduct rigorous, deep-dive technical discovery and AI readiness assessments. Translate complex system requirements into scalable pilots and proofs-of-concept (POCs) and enterprise-grade pilots that demonstrate clear business value.
Build Scalable Accelerators: Proactively develop production-ready, reusable technical accelerators, middleware templates, and open-source-aligned API components that allow regional teams and Systems Integrators (SIs) to deploy Zendesk solutions at scale.
Own the Technical Sales Lifecycle: Serve as the absolute technical authority from qualification through execution. Architect secure, scalable topologies leveraging Zendesk APIs, webhook frameworks, and leading cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

jobs.title: LEAD, MSI Warehouse
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
As a Warehouse Lead, you will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of inbound and internal warehouse operations, including receiving of materials, storage, inventory management, cycle counting and on-time fulfilment of manufacturing floor requirements. You will lead a team of warehouse associates on the shop floor, ensuring that every material is received, stored, issued and accounted for accurately in the system, and that production lines never stop due to material unavailability.
You will drive a culture of 6S, safety, discipline and continuous improvement in the warehouse, and act as the first point of contact for Production, Planning, Quality, Procurement and Finance teams on material-related matters during your shift.
1. Receiving of Materials
Plan and manage inbound dock schedule, vehicle unloading and material receipt as per PO, ASN, invoice and packing list
Ensure physical verification of quantity, part number, lot/batch, date code and packaging condition before acceptance
Ensure timely GRN / goods receipt posting in ERP/WMS (e.g., SAP) within defined TAT
Coordinate with Incoming Quality (IQC) for inspection, and segregate quarantine, hold, rejected and damaged material
Handle receiving discrepancies (shortage, excess, damage, wrong part) and raise them with Procurement, Supplier and Logistics teams
Ensure correct handling of ESD-sensitive, moisture-sensitive, temperature-controlled, shelf-life and hazardous materials as per SOP
Ensure labelling and barcode identification of all received material before put-away
2. Storage and Location Management
Ensure system-directed put-away of material to correct bin/location within defined TAT
Maintain bin location master and optimise space utilisation (racking, slotting, fast/slow movers)
Ensure storage conditions are met (temperature, humidity, ESD, dry cabinets, segregation of hazardous material)
Enforce FIFO / FEFO and monitor shelf-life and expiry of materials
Ensure safe stacking, material handling equipment usage and load-bearing limits
Identify and report slow-moving, non-moving, obsolete and expired stock for disposition
3. Inventory Management and Cycle Count
Maintain 100% system-to-physical inventory accuracy for all materials under warehouse custody
Plan and execute daily/weekly cycle counts based on ABC classification and the approved cycle count calendar
Investigate count variances, perform root cause analysis and drive corrective actions
Process inventory adjustments with proper approval and documentation as per Finance and audit requirements
Support periodic wall-to-wall physical inventory, internal audits and external/statutory audits
Monitor stock levels and raise alerts for shortages, critical parts and excess inventory to Planning and Procurement
Ensure all inventory transactions (receipt, transfer, issue, return, scrap) are recorded accurately and on time
4. Fulfilment of Manufacturing Floor Requirements
Ensure on-time and accurate issue of materials to the production floor as per work order, material requisition, kitting list and production plan
Plan picking, kitting and line-feeding / replenishment (Kanban, min-max) to ensure zero line stoppage due to material
Coordinate with Production and Planning on daily build plan, priority changes and urgent requirements
Manage return of unused, excess and rejected material from the floor with proper system transactions
Track and escalate material shortages, and follow up with Planning, Procurement and Suppliers for closure
Ensure traceability of issued material (lot/batch/reel ID) to work orders
5. 6S, Safety and Housekeeping
Implement and sustain 6S (Sort, Set in Order, Shine, Standardise, Sustain, Safety) across the warehouse
Conduct daily 6S walks and periodic 6S audits; track and close observations
Ensure visual management – floor marking, location labels, signage and display boards
Ensure compliance with EHS requirements, PPE usage, MHE (forklift, stacker, pallet jack) safety and safe material handling
Report near-misses, unsafe acts and unsafe conditions, and drive corrective actions
Ensure ESD compliance in material storage and handling areas
6. Team Leadership
Lead, allocate and monitor daily work of warehouse associates and material handlers in the shift
Conduct shift start meetings / Tier-1 huddles covering safety, priorities, KPIs and issues
Train team members on SOPs, system transactions, safety, ESD and 6S; maintain skill matrix and training records
Monitor attendance, productivity and discipline; provide feedback, coaching and recognition
Support the Supervisor in manpower planning, shift handover and performance reviews
Drive teamwork, ownership and a "right first time" culture
7. Systems, Compliance and Continuous Improvement
Follow and maintain warehouse SOPs, work instructions and documentation; support SOP updates
Ensure compliance with quality, customs/bonded warehouse (where applicable), audit and statutory requirements
Prepare and publish daily/weekly warehouse reports and KPI dashboards
Identify process gaps and lead Kaizen, Lean and error-proofing (Poka-Yoke) improvements
Support RCA and CAPA for warehouse-related incidents, customer/internal complaints and audit findings
Support system enhancements, barcode/scanner usage and digital tools (WMS, Power BI, Copilot) for efficiency
Using Artificial Intelligence
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) :
Inventory record accuracy (system vs. physical)
Cycle count plan adherence and variance closure
GRN / receiving TAT and put-away TAT
On-time, in-full material issue to production (zero line stoppage due to material)
Picking / issue accuracy
6S audit score
Safety – zero lost-time incidents; near-miss reporting and closure
Audit findings – zero major non-conformance
Team training completion and skill-matrix coverage
Education Desired :
Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, Commerce or related field
Certification in Lean, 6S, Inventory Management or Warehouse Operations is an advantage
Experience Desired :
4–7 years of experience in warehouse / stores operations in a manufacturing environment (semiconductor, electronics, automotive or similar preferred)
Minimum 2 years in a team lead / shift lead role
Hands-on experience in receiving, inventory control, cycle counting and production line feeding
Skills and Competencies :
Working knowledge of ERP/WMS (SAP MM/WM/EWM preferred), barcode and RF scanning systems
Good understanding of inventory control principles – FIFO/FEFO, ABC analysis, min-max, Kanban
Knowledge of 6S, Lean, Kaizen and basic problem-solving tools (5 Why, Fishbone, 8D)
Knowledge of ESD, MSL and safe material handling practices; MHE operation awareness
Proficiency in MS Excel and reporting; exposure to Power BI / digital tools is a plus
Strong leadership, communication and people management skills
High attention to detail, ownership and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
Willingness to work in shifts

AI Powered Tech Talent. Data & RAG oEstablish data contracts and retrieval patterns (chunking, indexing, hybrid search, citations/grounding, freshness). Design guardrails to minimize hallucinations and enforce factuality. Platforms & Integration oDefine integration strategies with enterprise systems, event streams, APIs/gateways, and CI/CD ensure alignment with SDLC and release governance. Quality & Responsible AI oSet evaluation frameworks (offline/online), E2E telemetry, failure modes/mitigations, and safety policies for content, access, and action boundaries. Leadership oGuide squads of developers contribute to internal enablement (playbooks, training tracks, coding standards). Support interviewer panels for AI native hiring. Must Have Qualifications (AI Native archetype) Strong CS and software engineering fundamentals. Hands on experience with LLMs, RAG, vector DBs, and AI APIs. Proven ability to build end to end applications and integrate AI into systems. Visible portfolio of AI projects demonstrating experimentation and speed. Fast learner with a bias for rapid prototyping and iteration. Able to translate business problems into practical AI solutions with clear communication. Ecosystem familiarity: LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel vector DBs (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus) messaging (Kafka/JMS) API gateways cloud SDKs (Azure/AWS/GCP). Preferred Skills & Experience Designing multi agent systems (planner/executor roles, collaboration protocols, tool abstraction) experience with agent frameworks or custom orchestration. Production grade RAG (retrieval evaluators, re ranking, freshness pipelines), vector DBs, and hybrid search. LLMOps/ModelOps: prompt/versioning, eval harnesses, feature flags, canarying, A/B testing, safety gateways. Cloud native architecture (containers, serverless, events), secrets management, policy as code, and cost governance for AI workloads. Enterprise integration: API gateways, event buses, messaging (JMS/Kafka), and contract testing. Additional Information: - The candidate should have minimum 15 years of experience in Java Full Stack Development. - This position is based at our Bengaluru office. - A 15 years full time education is required. Qualification 15 years full time education

jobs.description:
Experience range: 2-5 Yrs
Project Role : Custom Software Engineer Project Role Description : Design, build and configure applications to meet business process and application requirements. Must have skills : SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll, Generative AI Good to have skills: NA Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification: 15 years full time education Summary AI Powered Tech Talent You will design, configure, and enhance SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll (ECP) solutions while utilizing AI assisted development tools and copilots to accelerate requirement analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, and issue resolution. The role focuses on delivering accurate, compliant, and efficient payroll operations, integrating pre built AI services where beneficial, and improving delivery productivity-without requiring deep AI model engineering, RAG systems, or agentic AI development. Key Responsibilities Payroll Functional & Technical Delivery Configure and optimize Employee Central Payroll including pay components, off cycle processes, gross to net calculations, retroactivity, schemas, and rules. Use AI copilots to rapidly generate functional specifications, configuration notes, testing scenarios, and payroll validation logic documentation. Support the full delivery cycle from requirements gathering and solution design to UAT, deployment, and post go live stabilization. Ensure seamless integration between Employee Central (EC), Time Management, HRIS Sync, BIB, and payroll relevant third party systems. Perform payroll simulations, validations, reconciliations, and error diagnostics with AI assisted accelerators. AI Assisted Productivity Use AI copilots for: oImpact and configuration analysis oTest script automation oDefect analysis and guided troubleshooting oDocumentation creation and updates Integrate pre built AI services into payroll operations (e.g., automated anomaly detection on payroll variances, automated summarization of payroll runs, intelligent categorization of payroll tickets). Apply AI enabled tools to accelerate compliance checks, payroll audits, and batch run reviews. Governance, Compliance & Collaboration Ensure strict compliance with local and global payroll regulations, audit requirements, data privacy laws, and security standards. Participate in workshops, payroll parallel runs, root cause analysis, and optimization discussions-enhanced with AI supported insights. Collaborate closely with HR operations, finance, technical integration teams, and external providers. Contribute to reusable payroll templates, configuration patterns, checklists, SOPs, and best practices incorporating AI assisted workflows. Required Skills & Experience SAP Payroll Expertise Strong hands on experience in Employee Central Payroll (ECP) and/or SAP HCM Payroll fundamentals including: oPCRs, schemas, wage types oRetrocalculations and payroll calendars oOff cycle and special payroll runs oIntegration with EC, Time Off, Time Sheet, Benefits Understanding of payroll posting to finance (FI/CO) and payroll reconciliation practices. AI Ready Skills Practical experience using AI copilots and LLM based tools for analysis, documentation, test generation, and troubleshooting. Ability to integrate pre built AI capabilities such as automated validations, anomaly detection, and summarization. Understanding of responsible AI usage and the limits of AI tools in regulated HR/payroll contexts. General Professional Skills Strong analytical and problem solving skills, especially in data driven payroll scenarios. Ability to translate business rules into accurate payroll configuration. Excellent communication and collaboration skills across HR, payroll, and technical teams. Continuous learning mindset with comfort adopting AI enabled development and support workflows. Good to Have SAP SuccessFactors EC/ECP Certification. Experience with payroll parallel testing and country specific payroll localization. Exposure to CPI/Boomi integrations or cloud based payroll analytics. Familiarity with automated testing environments. Outcome Expectations Deliver accurate, reliable, and compliant payroll solutions using AI enabled productivity accelerators. Improve cycle times, testing efficiency, and payroll accuracy through AI assisted workflows. Act as a connector between payroll teams, SAP engineering teams, and AI native teams when deeper AI capabilities are required. Additional Information A 15 years full time education is required. Qualification 15 years full time education

jobs.title: Staff, AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
Experience range: 18-23 Yrs
Job Summary As the Staff, AI Product Manager, you will be the day-to-day strategic partner for forward deployed engineering (FDE) pods working on a set of high-impact engagements. This is an individual contributor role for someone who can take a complex business problem, structure it, size the value, prototype hands-on, and turn it into something a forward deployed engineer can build against. You won't manage engineers - you will be in the room with them, the business sponsor, and the data, translating between all three and keeping each engagement focused on the most valuable outcome. Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. In this role, you will make sure the engineers we deploy are working on the right things by: Sizing value, structuring problems, building concept prototypes, and writing the business cases that fund engagements. Acting as the day-to-day strategic counterpart to FDE pods in active deployments. Bringing opportunity signals from business sponsors back into the portfolio. Key Responsibilities Opportunity identification and value sizing Surface and size AI opportunities across your assigned engagements and adjacent business units, producing one-page opportunity briefs that are easy to compare and prioritise. Build credible value cases with finance-grade reasoning behind cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, or cost avoided. Develop hands-on domain knowledge of your engagement areas - workflows, data, decisions, and the people who own them. Strategic prioritisation and portfolio shaping Recommend what to start, continue, and stop across your engagements based on evidence, not enthusiasm. Sequence work for impact, helping engineering leads decide what is in scope this sprint, what comes next, and what is out. Engineering partnership and enablement Be the day-to-day strategic partner to FDE pods, converting business ambiguity into crisp problem statements, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can act on. Run engagement structure end-to-end - scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways - drafted, agreed, and revisited. Spot reusable patterns that should become platform capabilities instead of point solutions. Stakeholder alignment and communication Work confidently with Director-level business and scientific stakeholders, running working sessions that move things forward and produce decisions, not just notes. Maintain sponsor confidence with concise updates, honest risk calls, and clear asks. Measurement, learning, and iteration Track value realisation on each engagement against the business case written up front. Capture lessons rigorously and feed them back into how the team scopes the next engagement. Required Skills 18+ years of professional experience with Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent qualification. Candidates with the combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML products, product management, or strategy roles in technology-led organisations are preferred. A track record of taking complex, ambiguous business problems and turning them into structured, sized opportunities with defensible business cases. Strong working knowledge of at least one area of the pharma value chain (such as R&D, supply chain, or commercial), including how decisions actually get made on the ground. Technical fluency in modern AI/ML - enough to design realistic engagements with engineers and avoid hype-driven choices. Strong individual contributor instincts - you produce quality artefacts, not status updates. Preferred Skills Experience in Global Supply Chain (GSC), particularly Quality and Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT). Working knowledge of large language models (LLMs), agentic systems, the ML lifecycle, and evaluation patterns, with the ability to assess data readiness (availability, quality, access constraints, and labelling) before engineering starts. Understanding of how GxP, regulatory, and data-governance requirements shape AI deployments in pharma - and how to factor them into scoping without over-constraining engineering. Experience producing value cases with clear assumptions and sensitivity ranges, and maintaining an opportunity portfolio with clear rationale for what is in flight, queued, or de-prioritised. Product intuition: a clear understanding of the difference between an MVP, a product, and a platform, and the ability to spot patterns that should become shared capabilities. An AI-native way of working - codifying product management and user research best practices into reusable skills, plugins, and markdown files, and using the command line to automate everyday tasks. Ability to lead through influence and write crisp, outcome-focused communications that connect progress to the value case. Experience running honest retrospectives that distinguish execution failures from selection failures. Skills AI Platforms Artificial Intelligence Change Management Data Analysis Feature Prioritization Machine Learning (ML) Machine Learning Model Management ML Platforms Model Evaluation Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. We are looking for experienced AI/ML Engineers who can build and productionize enterprise-grade Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions. Copilot Studio - Job Descriptions Copilot Studio Senior Developer Role Summary We are looking for a Copilot Studio Senior Developer to build and ship custom AI agents (copilots) that plug into our clients' Microsoft 365 and Power Platform estates. This is a hands-on role. You will design conversation flows, wire agents to enterprise data and actions, and take them through to production with the right grounding, testing, and guardrails. You should be comfortable owning an agent end to end and mentoring less experienced developers on the team. Key Responsibilities Design and build custom agents in Copilot Studio, including topics, trigger phrases, conversation flows, and generative answers grounded on enterprise knowledge sources. Configure knowledge sources (SharePoint, Dataverse, public and internal websites, files) and tune grounding so agents give accurate, in-scope responses. Build actions that let agents do real work by connecting to Power Automate flows, connectors, Microsoft Graph, and custom or REST APIs. ¢ Implement authentication and secure data access for agents, using Entra ID and appropriate permission scopes. ¢ Handle agent lifecycle: environment strategy, solution packaging, testing, and publishing across channels such as Teams, M365 Copilot, and websites. ¢ Apply prompt design and generative orchestration to balance scripted control with generative flexibility, and test for accuracy, safety, and unwanted behaviour. ¢ Support and troubleshoot agents in production, including analytics review, fixing failed actions, and improving grounding based on usage. ¢ Mentor developers and contribute reusable patterns, prompts, and components back to the team. Must-Have Skills ¢ Strong hands-on Copilot Studio experience: topics, generative answers, knowledge sources, actions, and publishing. ¢ Solid Power Platform grounding, especially Power Automate and connectors, and working knowledge of Dataverse. ¢ Experience connecting agents to data and actions via Microsoft Graph, connectors, and REST APIs. ¢ Understanding of Entra ID, authentication, and permission/consent models for secure agent access. ¢ Practical prompt engineering and an understanding of generative AI behaviour, grounding, and limitations. ¢ Ability to test, monitor, and iterate on agents using the built-in analytics. Good-to-Have Skills ¢ Understanding of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) concepts and how grounding, chunking, and retrieval quality affect answer accuracy. ¢ Some scripting ability (Python or PowerShell) for custom connectors and Azure Functions. ¢ SPFx or Power Apps development for surfacing or embedding agents in custom experiences. ¢ Azure services (Functions, Logic Apps, AI services) for extending agents beyond low-code. ¢ Exposure to pro-code agent frameworks (Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Foundry) for hybrid low-code plus pro-code scenarios. ¢ Awareness of responsible AI, data governance, and DLP considerations. ¢ SharePoint Online knowledge for grounding and content-source design. Experience & Qualifications Experience: Typically 5 to 8 years across Power Platform / M365 development, with real Copilot Studio delivery experience. Certifications: PL-400, PL-600, or the Copilot/agent-focused credentials are an advantage. Soft Skills ¢ Comfortable explaining what an agent can and cannot reliably do, and setting expectations with stakeholders. ¢ Clear communicator who can turn a business ask into a workable agent design.

Job Description At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. Were committed to fostering an environment for every teammate thats welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us. Overview As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeings team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the companys core values of safety, quality and integrity. Technology for today and tomorrow The Boeing India Engineering Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge RD, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace. People-driven culture At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected.No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping peoples careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing. With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace. The Boeing AI India team is seeking a Principal AI Engineer (NLP GenAI) to join its team in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. The selected individual will co-lead a team that innovates, develops implements next generation AI/ML and engineering analytics for aerospace applications. The successful candidate will lead and participate in projects to develop solutions that help improve aircraft performance, increase the operational efficiency of aircraft fleet operators, improve/optimize the productivity of Boeing engineering, operations manufacturing and simulate aircraft lifecycle scenarios for potential customers. In addition, the candidate will support senior members of the team in developing future vision and direction of Boeings technology development in the field of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, NLP, and GenAI and their application to diverse areas relevant to Boeing. Position Responsibilities: Lead the architecture, design, and production delivery of scalable Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Generative AI (GenAI) systems. Drive technical strategy, mentor senior and mid-level engineers, and partner with product, data, and business leaders to turn complex language and reasoning challenges into high-impact products. Architect end-to-end LLM applications, RAG pipelines, and multi agentic workflows with the right guardrails. Design fine-tune transformer and NLP models alongside frontier and open-weight LLMs. Establish rigorous benchmarking, evaluation suites, latency/cost optimization, and production observability to measure accuracy, grounding, safety, and reliability. Own high-quality codebases, reusable AI libraries/APIs, CI/CD, AIOps and cloud deployments across multi-cloud platforms. Set engineering standards, conduct architecture reviews, evaluate emerging AI research and tooling, and align technical roadmaps with business goals. Work closely collaboratively with an international team comprising software development and research engineers. Develop and maintain relationships / partnerships with customers, stakeholders, peers, and partners to develop collaborative plans and execute on projects. The selected candidate will undergo the Fellowship selection process for Associate Technical Fellow (ATF). Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience): Bachelors Degree. 17+ years of overall work experience in core engineering/manufacturing organizations with 7+ years in software development, AI, data analytics with proven leadership taking GenAI/NLP products from prototype to production at scale. Hands-on experience with end-to-end ML lifecycle: data pipelines, training, deployment, monitoring, and optimization. Excellent presentation communication skills: Demonstrate strong written, oral, presentation and interpersonal communication skills. Strong research background in innovating developing technologies solutions thru data science analytics. Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience): Masters degree in computer science, Computer Engineering or related discipline from a reputed academic institution. PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience). Deep expertise in Python, PyTorch, transformer architectures, embeddings, vector databases, hybrid/semantic retrieval, and LLM orchestration/agent frameworks. Strong hands-on experience with distributed systems, APIs, containers, MLOps, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), balancing performance, security, and token/compute costs. Track record in performing and leading research development of highly innovative AI-driven solutions for difficult problems. Expertise in building and productizing Machine Learning/Deep Learning models. Experience with containerization, model deployment, data management, and monitoring. ML experience with synthetic data generation / domain adaptation / self-supervised learning. Solid software engineering practices: unit/integration testing, CI/CD, version control, and traceability to requirements. Be a self-starter who is not afraid to pro-actively seek information and direction to successfully complete the statement of work. Be self-motivated and able to work independently with a positive attitude and highest ethics. Must be willing to work flexible hours (early or late as needed) to interface with Boeing teams around the world. Typical Education Experience: Education and experience typically acquired through a masters degree and at least 18 years of related work experience, or a PhD and at least 17 years of related work experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Relocation: This position does offer relocation within INDIA. jobs.description:

Additional Information: - The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Large Language Models (LLMs). - This position is based at our BDC11 - SEZ office. - A 15 years full time education is required. Qualification 15 years full time education

jobs.title: Senior Developer - Python/LLMs/RAG/AI Agents (7-12 years)
jobs.description: We help the world run better At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. What You'll Bring You have deep experience in distributed systems and scalable application design, with strong hands-on skills in LLMs, advanced RAG patterns, and agentic workflows. Experience building agentic workflows on SAP AI Core and integrating LLM-based features into CAP Java applications is expected. Proficiency in system design for scale, resiliency, and fault tolerance is required. Strong experience in performance optimization, cost management, and troubleshooting complex production systems is essential. A solid understanding of SRE principles, observability (logs, metrics, tracing), and incident management is expected — including Open Telemetry instrumentation and SAP Cloud Logging dashboards. Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI systems, validating model behavior, and applying agentic engineering patterns is critical. You use Claude-style tools to generate code and ideas, but you read and challenge their output — you know when the AI is making the wrong call in both code and design. Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architecture on SAP BTP (MTX, service-manager, IAS/AMS) is a strong advantage. Four Values Matter At Every Level Learning agility (non-negotiable, and the most important value) — you rapidly pick up new models, frameworks, SAP Technologies, ontologies, and industry processes. You enjoy updating your mental model as the landscape shifts, which it will, frequently. Bias for action — you move quickly from ambiguity to a working prototype and learn through execution. Critical thinking — you ask the right questions, so we stay focused on the objective instead of just managing the day. End-to-end ownership — you own the outcome from problem definition through build, deployment, and evaluation. What You'll Build You'll independently design and architect scalable, AI-native application systems and components, including advanced RAG pipelines and multi-agent workflows. You'll design and build AI agents integrated into GHRA's revenue accounting domain — including formula explanation, disposition computation assistance, and production volume analysis — using SAP AI Core and Python as primary programming language, CAP in Java will be secondary programming language. You'll contribute to the design of ontology-grounded agents for the domain, encoding accounting rules, formula structures, and ownership relationships as structured knowledge that agents can reason over reliably, rather than relying on prompt-only approaches. Evaluation and benchmarking frameworks to measure AI system quality, reliability, and performance are things you'll build and own. This includes domain-specific test harnesses that validate LLM outputs against known good formula results and accounting rules — and the honest memo that explains why an idea shouldn't ship. You'll optimize latency, throughput, and cost efficiency across systems — including HANA Cloud query optimization and AI Core inference cost management. Observability and SRE practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root cause analysis, are areas you'll implement and improve — specifically enabling OTEL tracing across the CAP microservice fleet and building Cloud Logging dashboards for cross-service visibility. You'll partner with platform, data, and AI teams to design robust, production-ready solutions and improve system integration. System scalability, resilience, and maintainability are areas you'll continuously work to strengthen. Where you belong If you need stable, well-defined requirements before you can start, this role will be uncomfortable. If you'd rather supervise an AI than trust it blindly, and you want to be the technical bridge between a complex accounting domain and an AI platform, keep reading. You'll take end-to-end technical ownership of critical systems and contribute to engineering excellence across the team. You'll be the technical bridge between GHRA's domain logic (royalty, production volumes, ownership allocation) and the AI platform layer — translating accounting business rules into context that agents can reason over reliably. Mentoring less-experienced engineers, guiding design and code quality, and building strong technical capabilities within the team are all part of the role. The team operates across global, cross-functional groups in a culture that values continuous improvement, operational excellence, and knowledge sharing. Bring out your best SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best. We win with inclusion SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world. SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. jobs.description: About This Role Your team BlackRock Data Office (BDO) is powering the next stage of enterprise innovation with artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML). The team combines industry-leading data standards with advanced intelligence capabilities to transform how BlackRock operates and to help define what is possible with technology at enterprise scale. BDO takes a full-stack approach, bringing together engineers, data scientists, data analysts, and domain specialists to address challenges ranging from core computing infrastructure to end-user applications. The team is globally distributed and partners with stakeholders across BlackRock to deliver both near-term solutions and long-term transformation. Your role and impact As an AI/ML Engineer within BDO AI, you will design, build, and deploy production-grade AI and ML systems that address complex business challenges. You will combine hands-on software engineering with emerging AI capabilities, working across the technology stack to take ideas from early exploration through reliable production deployment. You will collaborate with domain experts, data analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate business processes into technical solutions. You will evaluate emerging AI and ML capabilities, communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and help build consensus around forward-looking solutions that can operate at enterprise scale. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: Pioneer and evaluate novel AI/ML capabilities, applying emerging technologies to solve specific business problems and build forward-looking solutions. Make frequent, high-quality code contributions to existing and greenfield projects. Model and demonstrate emerging solutions using first-principles problem solving, building stakeholder understanding and consensus around proposed approaches. Deploy reliable services to development and production environments while maintaining enterprise software development lifecycle standards. Communicate granular technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Your Experience Undergraduate degree in a relevant technical or scientific field, such as Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, Software Engineering, Physics, or Chemistry; a postgraduate degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred. 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience designing, building, and deploying production-grade systems. 2+ years of generative AI/ML engineering experience, including designing, developing, and deploying production-grade AI/ML systems. Demonstrated systems-level problem-solving abilities, including experience deploying containerized services to production environments without reliance on managed cloud services. Strong communication skills in both technical and non-technical forums. Our Benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. Our hybrid work model BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer
jobs.description: About the Role: GSK’s Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. The Forward Deployed Engineer is the engineer GSK sends in to find out whether an AI idea will work — embedded with business unit teams, proving ideas through PoCs, PoVs, and MVPs at a days-to-weeks cadence, then handing the proven solution off to the Sr. Solutions Engineer for scale-up. The pattern is proven by AI-native companies — Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI — and this role brings that model to GSK. This senior engineer role embeds directly with business unit teams — product owners, engineering leads, and the wider BU — to understand the problem and execute. Most prototyping work is AI-augmented: AI coding assistants and multi-agent workflows handle the bulk of routine coding, freeing the FDE to focus on framing, judgement, and validation. The role works directly inside the customer’s business and emerges with working software and a defensible value hypothesis — not slideware. The FDE does not carry use cases through to long-term operations — clean handoff to the Sr. Solutions Engineer is part of the role. Why This Role Exists: Enterprise AI’s impact depends on engineers who can close the gap between what AI can do and what the business needs — fast, embedded, and without requiring the business to specify everything upfront. The FDE is that engineer. Proves AI ideas fast — shipping working prototypes at days-to-weeks cadence before significant investment is committed. Works directly inside the business — not at arm’s length — building the trust and domain understanding that separate useful AI from academic AI. Builds the organisation’s reusable AI engineering assets — every engagement distilled into patterns, agents, and reference architectures the whole team benefits from. Key Responsibilities: PoC / PoV / MVP Delivery: Take ownership of high-priority BU use cases from problem framing through to a working prototype, at days-to-weeks cadence, and form a defensible view on whether each should progress. Ship first production versions directly for use cases where the path is clear — before the Sr. Solutions Engineer takes them forward to scale. AI-Native Engineering: Operate AI agent workflows (planning, coding, testing, review, documentation) for autonomous prototype delivery — selecting the right level of automation for each engagement. Use AI coding assistants as the default mode of building; provide judgement, course-correction, and validation. Customer Embedding & Handoff: Embed with BU teams — attend standups, understand the domain, prototype against real data and real workflows. Package proven use cases cleanly for the Sr. Solutions Engineer — working code, architecture rationale, open risks, and scaling concerns. Governance, Standards & Coaching: Begin Code Orange, Responsible AI, and Accountability Report conversations during prototyping — so the productionisation team does not inherit governance debt. Contribute reusable agents, prompt templates, and reference architectures to the organisation’s pattern library after each engagement. Form and defend kill/continue recommendations at the end of each engagement — presenting clearly to BU and Enterprise AI leadership. Coach BU engineers on AI-augmented ways of working while embedded, building BU capability alongside delivery outcomes. Required Functional Experience: Overall 15+years of full-stack or AI/ML engineering experience, including production deployments. Demonstrated ability to take ideas from sketch to working software at speed — startup, lab, or innovation-team background is ideal. Strong proficiency in Python and at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or similar. Hands-on experience with GenAI patterns: agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, prompt engineering, and evaluation. Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Databricks AI Assistant) as the primary mode of development. Preferred Experience: Prior experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer at an AI-native company (Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI, or similar), or as a Customer Engineer / Solutions Architect at a hyperscaler. Experience in regulated industries (pharma, healthcare, financial services) and familiarity with GxP, GDPR, and SOX. Working knowledge of fine-tuning fundamentals and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. Track record of contributing reusable engineering patterns back to a broader team. Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree/ Ph D in Mathematics, statistics, computer science or related field is advantageous. Skills Artificial Intelligence (AI), Artificial Intelligence Ethics, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Classification Models, Deep Learning, Intelligent Automation (IA), Machine Learning (ML), Model Evaluation, Model Validation, Predictive Modeling, Probabilistic Modeling, Python (Programming Language), Test Documentation Why GSK? Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. This is a hands-on build role: you will own features end to end from database schema through backend services and distributed systems to the user interface and bring practical, hands-on experience building or integrating AI agents, tool-calling workflows along with the right AI evals or LLM-powered features into production systems that our business stakeholders rely on. The ideal candidate combines strong full-stack engineering fundamentals with a systems mindset for reliability and scale, and has spent meaningful hands-on time (1–2 years) building AI-agentified applications not just experimenting with AI tools, but shipping agentic features in production. We are targeting 8+ years of overall software engineering experience; this is flexible for candidates who demonstrate strong depth across full-stack, distributed systems, and applied AI engineering skills during technical evaluation. What You'll Do Key Responsibilities: Build and productionize agentic workflows, LLM-powered automation, and AI-assisted tooling having hands-on experience with these systems. Design and build end-to-end agent evaluation frameworks that measure correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate, including synthetic test environments that stress-test agents built on Google ADK and Google AI/ML services (Vertex AI, Gemini) under diverse real-world conditions. Curate golden datasets and test harnesses for our Rubrik enterprise use cases and contribute to an eval-as-a-service platform that IT teams can self-serve against standard and custom benchmarks. Automate regression and drift detection with CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployments Architect for distributed systems concerns: scalability, fault tolerance, data consistency, and service boundaries across backend and data layers. Build full-stack web applications and own features end to end be it database schema, backend services, APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and webhooks), and frontend (React/Next.js) user interface Design and build APIs and services that are consumed by applications, internal tools, and AI agents/LLMs, including tool-calling interfaces Apply reliability engineering practices — observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, incident response, and post-incident reviews — to keep production systems healthy. Clarify requirements upfront, surface blockers early, and communicate progress proactively without being asked. Collaborate openly with internal Business stakeholders, Product, QA, DevOps, and UX or designer teams; avoid working in silos. Experience You'll Need Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. 5-7 years of Salesforce experience. Strong knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud (or Pardot), Channel/Partner Portals, and Salesforce Admin functionalities. Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud and Case Management is a plus. Proficiency in troubleshooting complex issues involving Apex, Flows, Workflows, Process Builder, Validation Rules, Reports & Dashboards. Familiarity with Salesforce integration tools (e.g., MuleSoft, Zapier, Marketing Automation Platforms). Salesforce Administrator certification is required; additional certifications (e.g., Platform App Builder, Marketing Cloud Administrator, Marketing Cloud Email Specialist) are a plus. Required Qualification Education & Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience across full-stack engineering (flexible based on demonstrated strength in technical evaluation). 1–2 years of hands-on experience building, integrating and operating AI Agent powered applications (agentic workflows, tool-calling, RAG, LLM-powered features) in production.. Demonstrated experience owning systems designed for scale and reliability, not just feature delivery. Technical Skills — Applied AI Engineering 1–2 years of hands-on experience building AI applications, using agent frameworks (e.g., Claude Agent SDK, Google ADK, LangGraph, or equivalent). Practical understanding of latency, cost, rate limiting, and safety/guardrails when exposing systems for AI consumption. Experience with coding agents, Spec Driven and Eval Driven Development Deep hands-on experience with LLM evaluation — familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval, LLM as a Judge, Promptfoo, RAGAS, Hugging Face evaluation tooling, custom eval harnesses Strong understanding of agentic AI patterns — Supervisor Multi-Agent, ReAct/Plan-Execute reasoning chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) Technical Skills — Full Stack Software Engineering Frontend: Strong JavaScript fundamentals; hands-on experience with React and Next.js for building modern, production-grade web applications (hooks, state management, component architecture, routing, server-side rendering). Backend: Proficient in Python, writing production-grade code; hands-on experience with FastAPI or Flask (or equivalent frameworks) for building REST APIs. Database: Experience with relational and non-relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, or equivalent); solid understanding of schema design, joins, indexing, and query optimization. APIs: Secure API design, API Gateway expertise with platforms such as Kong / Apigee / AWS API Gateway / Azure APIM / MuleSoft API Gateway for routing, rate limiting, and policy enforcement. Technical Skills — Distributed Systems & Reliability Engineering Working knowledge of distributed systems concepts: service decomposition, consistency models, caching, queuing/messaging, and failure handling. Reliability engineering fundamentals: observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, error budgets, and operational runbooks. Ability to reason about system design trade-offs and build scalable, resilient solutions under ambiguity. Soft Skills Proactive communication — shares updates without being asked and flags blockers early. Asks the right questions — clarifies requirements upfront before jumping into implementation. Ownership mindset — treats the project as their own rather than just completing tickets. Transparency — speaks up when something is unclear instead of making assumptions. Strong analytical mindset to break down complex or ambiguous problems. Preferred Qualifications Experience with agentic frameworks (ADK, LangGraph, or similar) beyond individual projects — production deployment experience preferred. Familiarity with API documentation standards (Swagger/OpenAPI). Basic DevOps awareness (Docker, CI/CD) and Git/version-control best practices. Testing experience across unit and integration levels. Experience with modern web app tooling — component libraries (e.g., Tailwind, MUI) and state management (e.g., Redux, Zustand). Exposure to cloud-native development (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containers and infrastructure as code. Deep Learning/NLP Knowledge: Fundamental understanding of how LLMs work, including concepts like RAG, prompting, and the technical challenges related to alignment Data Analysis: Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Pandas, SQL) for analyzing evaluation and safety results Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential. Your potential is limitless here. Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries. Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
