jobs.description: Job Description Be an integral part of an agile team that's constantly pushing the envelope to enhance, build, and deliver top-notch technology products. As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Asset & Wealth Management, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives. At JPMorgan Chase, we are reimagining software engineering itself – by building an AI-Native SDLC Agent Fabric, a next generated ecosystem of autonomous, collaborative agents that transform every phase of the software delivery lifecycle. We are forming a foundational engineering team to architect, design, and build this intelligent SDLC framework levering multi-agent systems, AI toolchains, LLM Orchestration (A2A, MCP) and innovative automation solutions. If you're passionate about shaping the future of engineering—not just building better tools, but developing a dynamic, self-optimizing ecosystem—this is the place for you. Job Responsibilities Works closely with software engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to define requirements and deliver robust solutions. Designs and Implement LLM-driven agent services for design, code generation, documentation, test creation and observability on AWS Develops orchestration and communication layers between agents using frameworks like A2A SDK, LangGraph, or Auto Gen Integrates AI agents with toolchains such as Jira, Bitbucket, Github, Terraform and monitoring platforms Collaborates on system design, SDK development and data pipelines supporting agent intelligence Provides technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers and team members. Drives adoption and governance of approved AI-assisted engineering practices across teams to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test acceleration, release readiness, incident/root-cause analysis), while establishing measurable validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of proven patterns and automation within the SDLC/TLM toolchain. Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including approved AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation at scale. Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience. Experience in Software engineering using AI Technologies Strong hands-on skills in Python, Pydantic, FastAPI, LangGraph, and Vector Databases for building RAG based AI agent solutions integrating with multi-agent orchestration frameworks and deploying end-to-end pipelines on AWS (EKS, Lambda, S3, Terraform) Experience with LLMs integration, prompt/context engineering, AI Agent frameworks like Langchain/LangGraph, Autogen, MCPs, A2A. Solid understanding of CI/CD, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker and APIs Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset. Demonstrated experience leading effective use of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching senior engineers/leads on compliant usage patterns and controls. Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills Experience with Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Familiarity with MLOps practices, including CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, automated deployment, and ML pipelines. ABOUT US

jobs.description: When you join Verizon You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. The Principal Full Stack AI - Base Management is a hands-on technical leader responsible for architecting, building, and shipping end-to-end, production-grade AI solutions. You will solve complex business problems using the right mix of AI paradigms—spanning Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent workflows, multimodal processing, and predictive/applied ML—wrapped in resilient, intuitive full-stack applications. Alongside direct solution delivery, you own the technical health and capability growth of our core delivery base, setting the architectural standards and production rigor that enable full-stack squads to consistently ship high-impact AI products. Key Responsibilities End-to-End Full-Stack & AI Solutioning Complete Production Application Delivery: Architect and build full-stack AI applications end-to-end—owning responsive frontends, backend services, data pipelines, and model integration from initial design through live production scale. Pragmatic AI Architecture: Evaluate business problems and select the right technical approach—combining LLM reasoning, RAG pipelines, multi-step agentic workflows, fine-tuned task models, or classical predictive ML services rather than forcing a one-size-fits-all pattern. Data, Retrieval & Context Engineering: Design high-precision data ingestion, chunking, hybrid search (vector + keyword), reranking, and structured feature pipelines across enterprise databases and unstructured knowledge sources. Adaptive & Human-in-the-Loop UX: Build responsive web interfaces engineered for real-time token streaming (SSE/WebSockets), dynamic UI rendering, source citation traceability, confidence indicators, and human-in-the-loop review workflows. Production Hardening, Evaluation & FinOps Enterprise-Grade Reliability: Transition AI solutions from proof-of-concept to hardened production systems with deterministic guardrails, graceful model fallbacks, strict latency budgets, rate limiting, and PII/security compliance. Automated Evaluation & Quality Gates: Implement continuous evaluation harnesses that benchmark task accuracy, groundedness, hallucination rates, model drift, and regression safety prior to every production release. Inference & Cost Optimization: Instrument end-to-end tracing and implement intelligent model routing, semantic/prompt caching, and context optimization to maximize responsiveness and minimize cost per transaction. Base Management & Technical Governance Solution Architecture & Code Governance: Lead architecture reviews, define production-readiness checklists, and enforce clean code, testing, and API standards across the delivery base. Capability Building & Mentorship: Coach senior and mid-level full-stack specialists in end-to-end AI solutioning through hands-on pair architecture, design critiques, and internal technical workshops. Delivery Readiness & Hiring: Partner with technical and delivery leaders to assess skill gaps across the talent pool, structure onboarding ramp-up plans, and calibrate hiring rubrics. Required Qualifications Experience: 10+ years of software development experience, including 4+ years leading full-stack production architecture and 3+ years shipping live AI/ML and Generative AI solutions at scale. Frontend Mastery: Deep expertise in React, Next.js, and TypeScript, with strong command of asynchronous state management, real-time streaming protocols (SSE/WebSockets), and designing intuitive UX for probabilistic AI outputs. Backend & AI Solutioning: Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI, AsyncIO) and/or Node.js/TypeScript, with hands-on experience across LLM integration, RAG pipelines, agentic orchestration (e.g., LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom state machines), and serving predictive ML or multimodal models in production. Data & Search Systems: Production experience with PostgreSQL, vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, or Weaviate), hybrid retrieval, and scalable ETL/data-ingestion pipelines. Cloud & Production Operations: Hands-on experience deploying containerized workloads on AWS, GCP, or Azure (Kubernetes/ECS), CI/CD automation, and AI observability/evaluation suites (e.g., Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize, OpenTelemetry). Leadership: Proven track record of owning complex technical deliverables end-to-end, resolving production bottlenecks, and elevating execution across multiple full-stack squads. Where you’ll be working In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager. Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Equal Employment Opportunity Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description: Company Overview We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next. Overview General Mills, Digital and Technology India, is seeking an ML Engineer(Agentic) to join the D&T Global Artificial Intelligence and Automation (AIA) Organization as part of the overall AIA Engineering group. This team builds enterprise-level scalable and sustainable AI solution pipelines and Agentic workflows to serve the AI and Agentic needs of business-impacting problem statements, maintains cloud and agentic platforms, and explores new complementary tooling for AI and Intelligent automation requirements. In this role, you are a critical member of the AIA team focused on leading efforts dedicated to enabling, optimizing, and scaling our next-generation agentic AI platforms. The candidate will be instrumental in designing and implementing robust custom connectors, ensuring seamless and secure API integrations, and orchestrating complex agent behaviors to unlock new business capabilities. We are looking for an individual with a strong background in Generative AI and Agentic AI, coupled with a passion for developing, maintaining, and continuously enhancing intelligent systems that deliver significant business value and drive innovation across the enterprise. Key Accountabilities Advanced Agentic Platform Enablement: Lead the technical enablement, integration, and continuous enhancement of advanced agentic AI platforms, ensuring they adhere to stringent performance, scalability, reliability, and security standards. This includes evaluating new agentic-first platforms, tools and frameworks. Custom Connector & Integration Development: Architect, design, develop, and implement robust custom connectors and integration solutions to seamlessly connect diverse data sources, enterprise applications, and external services with our agentic platforms. API Design, Testing & Integration: Drive the design, development, and rigorous testing of APIs, ensuring secure, reliable, and efficient integration with both internal and external systems to support agentic workflows. Agent Orchestration & Workflow Management: Develop, implement, and optimize sophisticated strategies for orchestrating complex agent workflows, managing inter-agent communication, and enhancing decision-making processes within the platform to achieve desired business outcomes. Monitoring, Observability & Reliability Engineering: Overall understanding to collaborate with other engineering teams to establish, implement and support comprehensive monitoring and observability capabilities for Agentic workflows Platform Optimization & Lifecycle Management: Conduct ongoing optimization, performance tuning, and lifecycle management of agentic platforms and their underlying capabilities, including bug fixes, security patches, and capacity planning. Expert-Level Troubleshooting & Support: Provide advanced technical support and expert-level troubleshooting for complex issues related to agentic platform functionality, integrations, and performance, performing root cause analysis and implementing preventative measures. Technical Documentation & Best Practices: Create and maintain comprehensive, high-quality technical documentation for platform architecture, custom connectors, API specifications, operational procedures, and best practices to ensure knowledge transfer and system maintainability. Security & Compliance: Ensure all platform development and integrations adhere to enterprise security policies, data privacy regulations, and compliance standards. Embrace learning mindset: Continually invest in your own knowledge and skillset through formal training, reading, and attending conferences and meetups MINIMUM QUALIFCATIONS Experience & Education Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a closely related technical field. 5-7 years of progressive experience in software engineering, platform development, or a related technical field, with a strong focus on building scalable and resilient systems. Minimum of 1-2 years of hands-on, in-depth experience specifically with Generative AI (Gen AI) and Agentic AI technologies, platforms, and frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, Glean, etc.). Proven track record of designing, developing, and deploying complex integrations and custom connectors for enterprise-level applications. Technical Skills Expert-level proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Go) with a strong emphasis on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code. Deep understanding and extensive experience with API design principles, development, and rigorous testing (RESTful APIs, GraphQL, gRPC). Demonstrated expertise in building custom connectors and integrating diverse systems, including enterprise applications (e.g., Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow) and various data sources. Good understanding/Working experience of agent orchestration frameworks, multi-agent systems, and techniques for managing complex agent interactions and decision flows. Extensive experience with major cloud platforms (Google Cloud Platform is preferred) and their AI/ML services (Vertex AI is preferred). Proficiency in establishing and utilizing monitoring, logging, and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, Datadog, Splunk) to ensure platform health and performance. Working knowledge of MCP connections, RAG, Vectors, Embeddings and Indexing, Knowledge graph and Oauth Flows. Soft Skills Exceptional problem-solving and analytical capabilities, with a keen eye for detail and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving complex technical challenges. Superior communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, working both independently and as a key contributor within cross-functional teams. Passion for learning new technologies and solving challenging problems. Preferred Qualifications Background in building, maintaining, and supporting traditional ML pipelines in a GCP environment. Understanding of the Consumer-Packaged Goods (CPG) industry. Familiarity with AI/ML lifecycle stages and MLOps concepts. Strong understanding and practical experience with MLOps principles and practices, including CI/CD for AI/ML workflows, model versioning, and deployment strategies. Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and orchestration platforms. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) is a plus. Ability to collaborate cross functional teams and provide tech mentorship to other stakeholders Strong leadership potential with the ability to mentor junior engineers and drive best practices ELIGIBILITY Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

jobs.title: Senior Applied Data Scientist, Context Intelligence & Autonomous Systems
jobs.description: Our Company At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. What You Will Do At Teradata, we are building the next generation of enterprise AI systems that understand, reason over, and act on complex business data. Our Context Intelligence team sits at the heart of the Knowledge & Autonomous Platform organization , creating the intelligence layer that enables AI agents to understand enterprise data, metadata, business meaning, and operational context at scale ( Tera Context Engine ). We are looking for an exceptional Senior Data Scientist with a startup mindset: someone who obsessively focuses on customer outcomes, moves fast without sacrificing quality, challenges conventional approaches, and thrives in ambiguity. This is not a traditional analytics role. You will invent, experiment, build, validate, and ship production-grade AI capabilities that become core components of the Teradata's Context Engine platform. Most data science roles optimize existing systems. This role invents the future. You'll operate at the intersection of AI research, enterprise-scale data systems, agentic architectures, and real-world product delivery. You'll have the freedom to experiment, the responsibility to own outcomes, and the opportunity to build technology that powers the next generation of intelligent enterprise platforms. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will partner closely with AI engineers, architects, product leaders, and platform teams to solve some of the hardest problems in enterprise AI. You will: Build New Capabilities Design and develop novel approaches for context understanding, knowledge representation, semantic reasoning, and agent intelligence. Apply machine learning, deep learning, graph techniques, LLMs, agent frameworks, and statistical methods to solve previously unsolved customer problems. Transform ambiguous ideas into measurable experiments and production-ready solutions. Rapidly prototype new concepts and determine viability within days, not months. jobs.description: Meet the Team The Cisco Cloudx team is a dynamic group of developers, Solutions Architects, and data engineers dedicated to supporting Cisco’s public cloud infrastructure and operations. As part of the Cloud Management and Operations (CMO) team within Cisco IT, we build the platforms and automations that enable governance, operational efficiency, cost management, and security guardrails across Cisco’s public cloud environments. Your Impact As an AI Engineer, you will contribute to the design, development, and deployment of intelligent cloud platforms and automation tools. You will work closely with senior engineers to implement AI-driven solutions that improve visibility into our multi-cloud environment. You will play a hands-on role in shaping the future of Cisco’s cloud operations by delivering features that directly impact cost efficiency, security, and operational performance. You will: Design, build, and deploy AI agents and agentic workflows that automate cloud resource monitoring, governance, and operations. Build and maintain Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tool integrations that give AI agents secure, governed access to cloud platforms, internal APIs, and data sources. Apply large language models (LLMs) using prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and evaluation techniques to improve drift detection, cost anomaly identification, and resource forecasting. Develop and maintain robust ETL pipelines using Python, PySpark, and Apache Airflow to ingest multi-cloud data into Snowflake. Collaborate with multi functional teams to integrate AI-driven insights into existing cloud management tools. Use AWS Athena and SQL for data analysis and interactive querying of cloud usage data. Contribute to code reviews and participate in team discussions to ensure high-quality software development. Stay updated on emerging AI technologies (LLMs, agent frameworks, MCP) and cloud-native services to suggest process improvements. Support the development of front-end and back-end interfaces (using Python/Flask) to surface AI insights to internal teams Minimum Qualifications 3 years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications or AI agents in a production environment. Proficiency in Python and experience with LLM and agent frameworks or SDKs (e.g., LangChain/LangGraph, Amazon Bedrock, or OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs). Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure, or OCI) and data management tools like Snowflake. Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience building MCP servers or integrating tools with AI agents, and familiarity with RAG and vector databases. Experience with full-stack development (e.g., Flask/Django for back-end, Angular or React for front-end). Solid understanding of cloud-native ETL/ELT patterns and distributed computing (PySpark). Comfortable working in an Agile environment and using CI/CD tools (e.g., GitLab, GitHub Actions, Jenkins). Experience working with streaming data, REST APIs, and telemetry/logging systems. Strong analytical skills with a passion for solving complex, data-heavy problems in a cloud-first environment. Effective communicator capable of explaining AI and agent-based solutions to both technical and non-technical members. Why Cisco? We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Department: System Management​ Company: Novo Global Business Services (GBS) Your impact begins here As AI Engineer, you will build the AI applications and agent workflows that help People & Organisation (P&O) become a Tech + AI first function. You will turn approved designs into working, secure and reliable tools, from retrieval grounded in P&O content to integrations with HR platforms. Your work will help colleagues get accurate answers and complete HR tasks faster, with the right controls and approvals in place. What you’ll bring A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, AI or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 8+ years of hands-on Python development, including API integration, debugging and automated testing. 2+ years of hands-on AI engineering with ChatGPT Enterprise and Databricks-based data retrieval, building secure, scalable AI applications that meet business needs and enterprise standards. Working knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), document processing, embeddings and vector or hybrid search. Experience creating agent evaluation test cases, running automated tests and analysing results to improve quality and reliability. Working knowledge of authentication, authorisation, secrets management and secure handling of sensitive data. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deploying applications in cloud environments. The ability to use logs, traces and monitoring tools to investigate incidents and diagnose technical issues. Clear communication, structured problem-solving and the ability to work independently on assigned tasks while escalating at the right time. Useful, but not essential: Experience with HR transformation, People Services or Talent Acquisition. Delivery experience with SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Joule or ServiceNow. Up-to-date knowledge of existing and emerging HR platforms, enterprise technologies and cloud technologies. What you’ll do You will work within defined architecture and engineering standards, under the technical guidance of the Lead AI Engineer or AI Solution Architect, to take AI applications from build to reliable day-to-day operation. Build agent workflows: develop and configure agent instructions, tool integrations, workflow logic and human approval steps against approved technical designs. Implement retrieval and HR system integrations: build document ingestion, indexing, search and source attribution so responses are grounded in approved P&O content, and develop and maintain the APIs and connectors that let agents retrieve information and carry out authorised actions across HR platforms. Test and secure what you build: create test cases and run automated evaluations covering response accuracy, task completion, tool use and adherence to access and approval controls. Apply authentication, authorisation and data-handling requirements so retrieval and agent actions respect source-system permissions. Release and monitor: prepare and deploy changes through established CI/CD pipelines, complete release checks and support rollback when needed. Review dashboards, logs, traces and alerts to spot failures, quality issues, latency and unexpected usage or cost. Resolve incidents and improve reliability: diagnose application, retrieval, integration and workflow issues, implement fixes and escalate complex problems to the Lead AI Engineer or platform teams. Turn evaluation results, incidents and user feedback into enhancements and reusable code. Keep operations clear: maintain technical documentation, configurations, test evidence and support runbooks so the solutions you build can run reliably and be handed over with confidence. Who you’ll work with You will join the AI & Workforce Transformation team within People, Organisation & Corporate Affairs, where colleagues help create an engaging, inclusive workplace and attract and develop the talent needed to support Novo’s purpose. Your closest partner will be the Lead AI Engineer or AI Solution Architect, who provides technical guidance and sets the architecture and engineering standards you work within. You will also work with platform teams and with P&O colleagues who use the tools you build, so feedback reaches you quickly and you can turn it into improvements. What you can expect here You will work at the forefront of AI and technology, building tools that P&O colleagues use in real working routines. scale, with ownership of platform capabilities through deployment, upgrades, and production operations. • Hands-on developing Kubernetes Operators, Admission Controllers, or other platform extensions technical strategy through architectural design reviews, technical proposals, and cross-functional collaboration. • Good to have: • Experience with container networking (CNI) and/or service mesh. • declarative infrastructure tooling. • Experience designing or tuning distributed data or compute workloads on Kubernetes. Good to Have •Large scale manufacturing expertise, including understanding of manufacturing processes, quality, testing, and production constraints. •Experience applying AI/ML within industrial, manufacturing, or energy environments. •Knowledge of transformer condition monitoring and predictive maintenance. •Experience with digital twins, simulation, optimization, or physics-informed AI/ML. •Understanding of industrial IoT, sensor technologies, and data acquisition. Educational Preferences •Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, power systems, or a closely related engineering discipline. •Advanced qualifications or professional expertise demonstrated in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, or Computational Engineering is preferred. •PhD in relevant engineering or AI-related specialization would be an advantage. Soft Skills •Ability to bridge deep engineering expertise and emerging AI technologies. •Ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines, cultures, and geographies. •Innovative mindset with a strong focus on practical implementation and measurable engineering value. •Ability to challenge conventional approaches while maintaining engineering rigor. •Continuous-learning mindset and curiosity for emerging technologies. You will gain exposure to challenging engineering problems, emerging digital and AI technologies, and opportunities for continuous professional and technical development. This role offers an environment to grow as a technical expert while helping shape how advanced AI is applied to the future of energy technology.

jobs.title: ServiceNow ITOM Architect
jobs.description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: The ServiceNow ITOM Architect owns the architecture of PayPal’s ServiceNow IT Operations Management platform, with a focus on AIOps. The role designs how the platform discovers the estate, correlates events, and acts on them, moving IT from detecting problems to resolving them automatically, with human supervision and audit built in. This individual contributor sets ITOM and AIOps standards, owns third-level escalation, and directs the contingent-worker and vendor engineers who build. Scope spans Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and orchestration, plus the AIOps layer: alert correlation, AI agents, and observability integrations, on a CSDM-aligned CMDB. The role leads work from proof of concept to production, sets approaches other teams adopt, and judges trade-offs such as alert noise and when automation is safe. It defines the guardrails for autonomous action: what agents may do alone, what needs approval, and how every action is logged, reversible, and audit-ready. Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Acts as a project or system leader, coordinating the activities of other engineers on the project or within the system Determines the technical tasks that other engineers will follow Actions result in the achievement of customer, operational, program or service objectives Proactively improves existing structures & processes Exercises judgement in reconciling diverse and competing priorities (time, quality, complexity risk) to identify optimal solutions to problems Notices patterns and condenses repetition into densely meaningful generalized solutions Collaborates with management to set/improve standards for engineering rigor Trusted to represent PayPal, Inc to the outside world via interactions with partners, customers, or industry organizations Minimum Qualifications: 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : Your way to impact You will move PayPal's IT operations from detect-and-ticket to detect-and-fix. The architecture you set will determine how quickly issues are found, how much alert noise reaches people, and how many problems resolve without human touch, measured in mean time to detect (MTTD), mean time to resolve (MTTR), and touchless resolution. You will also define the guardrails that let AI agents act safely in production, so that automation meets PayPal's change-management, security, and audit standards, and you will set the approaches that other engineers and teams adopt. Your day to day In your day to day role you will: • AIOps target architecture — Define the target-state AIOps architecture on ServiceNow: event sources and ingest, normalization, deduplication, correlation, and the hand-off from alert to incident, change, and automated remediation. • Event Management from proof of concept to production — Take ServiceNow Event Management from proof of concept to production, including connector design for observability platforms (e.g., Datadog), event rules, alert thresholds, and operational runbooks. • Alert correlation & noise reduction — Design rules-based and machine-learning correlation and grouping that reduce alert noise and surface probable cause, and measure their accuracy over time. • AI agents for triage & remediation — Design AI agents and automated workflows that triage, enrich, and resolve alerts, defining when an agent acts on its own, when it asks a human, and how it escalates. • Supervision, audit & safe automation — Build in human-in-the-loop controls, action logging, rollback, and change-management integration so that every automated action is traceable and meets security and audit requirements. • CMDB & CSDM service context — Partner with the existing ITOM architect and engineers so that configuration items (CIs), relationships, and business-service maps give AIOps the context it needs, and contribute to the CSDM-aligned CMDB re-build design. • Integration architecture — Design integrations between ServiceNow and monitoring, logging, cloud, and collaboration tools using IntegrationHub, REST, and streaming patterns, with the performance and resilience that enterprise scale requires. • Engineering standards & technical direction — Set design patterns, coding standards, and definitions of done for AIOps work, and review the designs and code produced by contingent-worker and vendor engineers. • Third-level (L3) technical ownership — Own L3 escalation for AIOps capabilities, and lead root-cause analysis when automation or correlation behaves unexpectedly. • Operational outcome measurement — Define and report outcomes such as alert-to-incident ratio, noise reduction, mean time to detect (MTTD), mean time to resolve (MTTR), and the share of alerts resolved without human touch. • Technology evaluation — Evaluate ServiceNow roadmap capabilities and third-party AIOps options, run proofs of concept, and recommend best practices and build-versus-buy decisions to Autonomous Operations leadership. • Mentoring & knowledge sharing — Mentor engineers and administrators on ITOM, event management, and AI-agent design, and document the architecture for business, leadership, and technical audiences. What do you need to bring- • 5+ years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree OR any equivalent combination of education and experience • Hands-on experience designing and implementing ServiceNow ITOM at enterprise scale, including Event Management, Discovery or Service Mapping • Experience integrating ServiceNow with observability and monitoring platforms (e.g., Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace, or cloud-native monitoring) • Working knowledge of the CMDB and the Common Service Data Model, including CI classes, relationships, identification and reconciliation, and service maps • Experience designing alert correlation, deduplication, or noise-reduction approaches and measuring their effectiveness • Experience building automation and AI-assisted workflows on ServiceNow (e.g., Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Now Assist, or AI Agents) or a comparable platform • Proficiency in JavaScript (ServiceNow scripting), experience using PowerShell or Bash over Secure Shell (SSH) for orchestration and discovery, plus REST API design • Experience defining controls for automated actions, such as approval gates, logging, rollback, and change-management integration • Experience documenting technical architecture for business stakeholders, leadership, and engineers • Ability to work effectively in a global team and to influence engineers and vendors without formal reporting authority Preferred qualifications • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in Event Management, Discovery, or Service Mapping; ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in Data Foundations; ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) • Experience with dedicated AIOps platforms (e.g., ServiceNow Health Log Analytics, BigPanda, or Moogsoft) • Experience applying large language models (LLMs) or agentic AI to IT operations, including tool design, evaluation, and guardrails • Cloud or reliability credentials, such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure certifications • Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) 4 Foundation or higher **We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Applied ML
jobs.description: Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you’ll find your place here.  We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.  About the Role DigitalOcean's Agentic AI organization provides a powerful inference cloud, Managed Agents, and robust Agent Learning Services that enable customers to run AI inference confidently at scale. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to serve as a technical leader within our Agent Learning Services team, driving the Applied ML strategy to build a robust Continuous Learning Loop for our customers. This is a high-impact leadership role where you will define the machine learning architectures that allow AI agents to learn from historical data, simulate synthetic data, and continuously self-improve. You will partner closely with our Infrastructure and product teams to translate complex ML concepts into scalable, production-ready continuous learning platforms. What You’ll Be Doing Continuous Learning Architecture: Designing and implementing the core Applied ML pipelines for a Continuous Learning Loop, enabling AI agents to autonomously evaluate, learn, and adapt based on user interactions and synthetic data. Agent Optimization & Fine-Tuning: Developing the machine learning models and methodologies behind the Agent Optimizer, leveraging techniques like Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning from Human/AI Feedback (RLHF/RLAIF), and targeted optimization strategies to improve agent performance. Evaluations & Simulations: Building robust ML frameworks for Simulations and Evaluations, creating deterministic and non-deterministic scoring mechanisms, reward models, and objective metrics to benchmark agent behavior in complex multi-turn scenarios. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Senior AI Engineer Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. In this hands-on role, you'll design, build, and ship production-grade agentic AI systems. These include agents that make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs, handle complex multi-step workflows, and deliver secure, scalable, reliable results. You'll work across agent orchestration, tool calling, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps, help set the engineering standard for Gen AI development, and mentor other engineers on the team. Much of this work is strong backend engineering. If you bring deep experience building production services and have started building with LLMs, we'd love to Roles & Responsibilities • Architect and build the tool-calling layer that powers our agents: wrap internal services, data platforms, and external APIs as well-defined tools with clear schemas, contracts, and permissions. • Engineer reliable tool execution at scale, including parallel and chained tool calls, timeouts, retries, idempotency, error recovery, and graceful handling of tool failures or bad model outputs. • Develop high-performance Python backend services for LLM orchestration, covering async job handling, streaming responses, caching, rate limiting, and distributed workflows supporting high-throughput Gen AI operations. • Engineer state, memory, and context management subsystems so agents can maintain session continuity across long, multi-step, tool-heavy interactions. • Architect multi-agent and skills-based agent systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar, enabling autonomous reasoning, tool use, inter-agent coordination, and adaptive decision-making at enterprise scale. • Build observability for agent behavior, including end-to-end tracing of tool calls, measuring tool-selection accuracy, and debugging multi-step agent runs in production. • Build retrieval systems (RAG and Graph-RAG) where agents need grounded knowledge, using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune). • Establish LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS), covering MLflow, prompt and agent evaluation, model lineage tracking, CI/CD, and monitoring. • Design multimodal generative AI pipelines that unify text, image, tabular, and graph data using modern transformer-based and foundation models. • Guide fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and alignment strategies (e.g., PEFT, LoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF) to adapt foundation models for specialized enterprise use cases, working closely with ML specialists. • Implement Responsible AI practices, including hallucination mitigation, bias detection, output safety guardrails, explainability, and compliance with data ethics standards. • Evaluate and productionize advances in agentic AI, multimodal models, and frontier foundation models, benchmarking them against enterprise performance and safety requirements. • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, and set the engineering standard for Gen AI development across the program. All About You • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. • A strong track record of building and operating production backend systems at scale, including distributed services, APIs, async processing, data stores, and observability. • Strong API design and integration experience: you know how to build services that other systems, and now LLMs, can call safely and reliably. • Excellent Python engineering skills, including async programming, API development (FastAPI or similar), and microservices, plus SQL proficiency. • Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM-powered application to production that uses tool/function calling, such as agents that call APIs, query databases, or trigger workflows. This can be with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models. • A working understanding of Gen AI engineering patterns, such as prompt design, embeddings, semantic search, and agent memory, or a demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on new technical domains. • Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome). • Experience leading or mentoring engineers, plus strong communication and stakeholder management skills. You should be able to translate technical work into business value. • Nice to have: experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building tool servers and connectors for LLM agents. • Nice to have: experience evaluating agent performance, such as tool-selection accuracy, task completion rates, or multi-step reasoning reliability. • Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, knowledge graphs, or MLOps tooling like MLflow, Weights & Biases, SageMaker, or Bedrock. • Coming from a backend background? We value engineers who take AI from prototype to production as much as those who train the models. If you've built high-throughput systems and started applying those skills to LLM-powered products, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't worked with every tool listed here Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: Under summary section Zettle India, part of PayPal's Payment Services and Crypto organization, is hiring a Software Engineer in Test (SDET). Our POS platform moves real money for merchants every day across mobile apps, cloud services, and card readers. In this hands-on role, you'll turn designs into written risk models before code exists, build automated checks that gate real merges, and encode how the payments domain behaves so the knowledge outlives any one person. You'll help shape how test engineering works on a platform where quality is built in, not bolted on. If you'd rather build the thing than maintain it, read on — the best is yet to come! Card payments, card readers and hardware variance, acquiring, payments SDKs, ledger and financial flows, onboarding and checkout across web and mobile. As a Test Engineer here, you won't hand down verdicts after the fact; you'll build the capability that lets verification happen without you in the room. The engineering discipline bar is the same as any software role: version control, review in both directions, CI, design before implementation, and root-cause debugging by the owner. The Test Engineer will be integral part of the team and takes pride in advocating for the quality of the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS, along with the backend and web services behind it. Meet our team: Zettle is PayPal's point-of-sale and payments product for small businesses. Zettle India is part of the Payment Services and Crypto organization, and our test engineering team supports the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS and the services behind it. We are a centralized Test and Quality Engineering function actively moving to an automation-first, shift-left culture. You will be joining a growing team and help shape its test strategy, automation framework, and quality standards. You will partner closely with developers and product managers, and mentor engineers in the team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with three days a week onsite. Your way to impact: As a Test Engineer, you will help make sure that merchants can take payments without problems on any device. You will own testing for the features you work on, from test planning to release, and you will help move our testing from manual to automated over time. Your work will reduce production defects, speed up releases, and improve the experience of small businesses that use Zettle every day. You will grow toward a Senior Test Engineer role as you build your technical depth and ownership. Run tests on BrowserStack and in CI/CD pipelines (Harness) and analyze failures to find the root cause. AI Research Scientist - Algorithm We are a passionate, cross-functional team at the forefront of applying cutting-edge AI and machine learning to accelerate scientific and materials innovation. Our mission is to create domain-specific, product-centric algorithmic solutions that drive real impact for our customers. We thrive in a collaborative environment that encourages out-of-the-box thinking and values diverse perspectives. Here, creativity flourishes—groundbreaking ideas are born from the synergy of technical expertise and open-minded teamwork. We believe the best solutions emerge when everyone is empowered to share their unique insights and challenge conventional boundaries. Our team leverages state-of-the-art generative AI and large language models to tackle complex problems in materials science, scientific discovery, and hardware design. We work closely with scientists, engineers, and product leaders to translate frontier research into practical, high-value applications. Ideal candidates bring a strong research background, technical leadership, and a passion for learning new technologies. If you are excited to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and help shape the future of science with AI, join us on our journey to make possible a better future through intelligent discovery. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Develop, pretrain, fine-tune, and align LLMs and generative models tailored for scientific and materials science data, literature, and workflows. Innovate post-training methods, alignment, and evaluation for domain-specific LLMs, ensuring models are robust, accurate, and trustworthy for scientific use cases. Design and implement generative approaches to accelerate materials discovery, hypothesis generation, and hardware design. Collaborate with scientists, engineers, and cross-functional teams to identify impactful applications of generative AI in materials science. Build and curate scientific datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols for model validation and continuous improvement. Stay current with advances in AI, machine learning, and materials science, and publish original research in top venues. Mentor junior team members and contribute to a collaborative, inclusive research culture. TECHNICAL SKILLS: Strong background in machine learning, deep learning, NLP, and generative AI, with a focus on scientific or technical domains. Hands-on experience with LLM pretraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), post-training alignment (e.g., RLHF), and rigorous model evaluation. Proficiency in Python and frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Experience working with structured and unstructured scientific data (e.g., literature, experimental results, simulation outputs) and developing domain-specific models. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across disciplines and present complex ideas to diverse audiences. jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and RAG-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions. Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)). Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation). Knowledge of "LLM-native" metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing. About the job As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an "innovator-builder," moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap. It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours. Responsibilities Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, model context protocol (MCP) servers) that drive measurable return on investment (ROI). Architect and code the "connective tissue" between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team. Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency. Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams. Co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption. jobs.title: AI Performance Modeling Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. Responsibilities: The Role We're building GPUs to run the most demanding AI in the world — Transformers, LLMs, and large vision models — and we need an experienced hands-on engineer who can tell us how fast those workloads will run before the silicon exists . This is an AI performance projection/modeling role: your job is to model AI workloads on our GPU architecture, predict their performance with confidence, and use those projections to shape the hardware we build. You'll work across the full modeling spectrum — analytical models for fast architectural what-ifs, and architectural and cycle-accurate simulators for precision — choosing the right level of fidelity for the question at hand. Because these workloads live on the GPU, you'll need real GPU architecture depth to do it. If you think in rooflines, arithmetic intensity, tensor/pipeline/data parallelism, and KV-cache bandwidth budgets — and you want your models to change the microarchitecture, not just describe it — this is the role. What You'll Do Project AI workload performance (your core mission) Build and use models — analytical, architectural, and cycle-accurate — to project the performance of generative AI and LLM workloads (attention, GEMMs, collectives, training and inference, vision models etc) on our GPU architecture. Choose the right fidelity for the question: analytical bounds and rooflines for rapid trade-off exploration, architectural and cycle-accurate simulation for precise answers. Find where performance will be won or lost — compute-engine occupancy, L1/L2 hierarchy, memory bandwidth, SoC fabric — and quantify the impact of each. Characterize workloads & shape the hardware Characterize AI workloads end to end — trace and profile execution, extract structural footprints, and translate them into microarchitectural bottlenecks and performance bounding boxes. Run architecture experiments to evaluate GPU configurations, scaling limits, and trade-offs against real AI workloads, backing every recommendation with sensitivity analysis and data. Extend and maintain the cycle-accurate / cycle-approximate simulators for the GPU subsystems AI workloads depend on — compute engines, cache hierarchies, memory subsystems, interconnects. Prove it on silicon (post-silicon) Run AI workloads on early silicon, capture telemetry, and correlate results back to your pre-silicon models to sharpen fidelity. Root-cause AI performance mismatches on physical silicon using low-level performance counters, register dumps, and Linux tracing. Collaborate across the stack Partner with compiler, runtime, and framework teams to turn model insights into optimizations, and to ground your projections in how workloads actually execute. Act as the bridge between architecture/RTL and software, translating AI workload requirements into concrete architectural constraints. What You'll Bring AI workload expertise: Deep, hands-on understanding of LLM and Transformer performance — scaling techniques, parallel training/inference strategies (tensor, pipeline, data parallelism), kernel execution graphs — and how they map to hardware. Performance modeling breadth: Hands-on experience with analytical performance models and execution-driven / architectural / cycle-accurate simulators, and sound judgment about which to reach for. Track record of turning models into decisions. GPU architecture depth: Strong command of GPU execution pipelines, SIMD/SIMT models, cache hierarchy, memory technologies, and high-bandwidth interconnects (PCIe, custom fabrics). Engineering craft: Expert modern C++ and production-grade Python. Execution: Excellent structured problem-solving; able to turn noisy simulation data into crisp, actionable findings for engineering stakeholders. Nice to have: Experience with NPU / AI-accelerator architecture, or modeling AI workloads on dedicated inference/training accelerators. #LI-AA1 Qualifications: Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. jobs.title: LLM & Agentic AI Performance Engineer
jobs.description: Job Details: Job Description: The Role and Impact: Join Intel's Data Center AI organization and help shape how LLM and Agentic AI workloads perform on Intel platforms. Our team operates at a unique intersection of core performance optimization, AI frameworks, and customer-facing AI solutions. We bridge the gap between teams that deeply understand silicon and benchmarking and teams building real-world AI solutions, turning performance insights into software optimizations that developers and customers can use. In this role, you will own end-to-end performance characterization and optimization of LLM and Agentic AI workloads, from Python-level frameworks and inference runtimes down to Linux, system architecture, and hardware performance counters. This is not simply a benchmarking role. Benchmarking tells us what the number is. Your job is to understand why the number is what it is, identify the hardware or software bottleneck, and determine what needs to change to remove it. Your work will translate into code contributions, framework optimizations, best-known configurations (BKCs), customer-ready solutions, and insights that help influence future Intel hardware and software. If you enjoy working across the complete AI stack, from agent frameworks and LLM serving engines to NUMA, memory bandwidth, cache behavior, and silicon counters, this role provides an opportunity to work at that intersection. About the Team: The AI Solutions and Toolkit Engineering team is part of Intel's Data Center organization, focused on enabling modern AI workloads and solutions on Intel platforms. We work across the AI ecosystem, collaborating with AI framework and runtime developers, performance and optimization teams, hardware architects, open-source communities, and solution engineering teams. Our goal is to take deep platform capabilities and performance insights and translate them into practical, optimized AI solutions that developers and customers can deploy. The team works across areas including LLM inference, Agentic AI, AI frameworks and runtimes, workload optimization, open-source software, and datacenter AI systems. Key Responsibilities: Characterize and optimize LLM and Agentic AI workloads across the complete software and hardware stack. Identify performance bottlenecks across AI frameworks, inference runtimes, operating systems, memory, compute, and platform architecture. Design and develop hardware-aware and hardware-agnostic optimizations for AI frameworks and runtimes. Optimize LLM inference techniques including KV-cache management, attention, continuous batching, and quantization. Work hands-on with serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, or equivalent technologies. Analyze host and accelerator performance using tools such as VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, and roofline modeling. Debug complex performance issues spanning Python frameworks, native code, Linux, runtime libraries, and hardware. Convert performance findings into software changes, upstream contributions, BKCs, and reusable optimization guidance. Collaborate with open-source communities to upstream and integrate performance improvements. Translate silicon-level findings into actionable recommendations for framework developers, while bringing application and framework insights back to Intel platform and silicon teams. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications: BE +10 years / M.Tech +8 years in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. Significant hands-on experience in performance engineering, systems optimization, or workload characterization on server-class platforms. Demonstrated ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and deliver measurable performance improvements. Strong programming skills in Python and C++, or equivalent systems programming experience in C/Rust. Strong understanding of server architecture including cache hierarchy, memory bandwidth, NUMA, interconnects, and system-level performance behavior. Hands-on experience with Linux performance and system technologies such as affinity, huge pages, cgroups, eBPF, ftrace, perf, or equivalent tools. Preferred Qualifications: Deep understanding of LLM inference, including KV-cache, paged attention, continuous batching and quantization such as INT8, INT4, or FP8. Hands-on experience modifying or optimizing AI serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, OpenVINO, or equivalent. Experience building, profiling, or optimizing Agentic AI systems using technologies such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MCP-based frameworks, or similar platforms. Experience with hardware counter-level performance analysis using VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, or roofline modeling. Contributions to significant open-source projects, including upstream code contributions. Ability to communicate across abstraction layers, translating silicon-level findings for software developers and application-level requirements for hardware architects. Why Join This Team? This role gives you the opportunity to work across boundaries that few engineering positions span: Agentic AI & LLMs AI frameworks inference runtimes Linux server architecture silicon You won't be limited to measuring performance or optimizing an isolated component. You'll help connect the entire stack, identify where the real bottlenecks are, implement improvements, and make those optimizations available to developers and customers. The result is tangible: better AI performance today, stronger software solutions for customers, and insights that can influence tomorrow's Intel platforms. The Digital Engagement Tech@Lilly team builds solutions and capabilities for Marketing, Corporate Affairs and Medical organizations globally, and owns the consumer platforms and the governance around them. This role exists because the hardest problems in our space are not solved from a ticket queue. RAG and semantic search solutions over enterprise content and data, including embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking and Text2SQL where it fits. Production AI services and APIs that integrate with enterprise data platforms, content systems and downstream product workflows. Turn what you learn in the field into reusable components, templates, and reference implementations for cross-functional teams. Set and uphold coding standards, review practices and engineering patterns across teams. Work with quality, compliance and risk partners, so solutions meet regulatory and enterprise requirements, including content review processes. Maintain clear architecture, design, and support documentation for everything you put into production. Mentoring and influence Provide hands-on technical guidance to developers and engineers, review designs and code, and raise the bar through practical examples. Working proficiency in Python and SQL, and experience with frameworks such as LangChain, DSPy or Hugging Face. Strong experience with unit and integration testing frameworks such as Jest, Mocha, Chai or Jasmine. Experience designing, deploying and operating services on a major cloud (AWS preferred), with CI/CD, containers and monitoring. Strong system design and architecture fundamentals: version control (GitHub), code reviews, and secure, maintainable, observable code. Experience working in Agile teams, including scoping, estimation and backlog ownership. Proven ability to turn ambiguous business problems into scalable solutions with measurable value, and to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences. Preferred Qualifications Pharmaceutical, healthcare or other regulated-industry experience, including working within content review, privacy and compliance processes. jobs.title: Senior / Lead Platform Forward Deployed Engineer - Cogentiq I2C
jobs.description: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing! We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. About Cogentiq I2C Cogentiq I2C is Fractal's agentic AI platform for invoice-to-cash operations, spanning Collections, Cash Application, Deductions, Credit Risk, and Invoice Management. The platform runs on a four-tier architecture: a Next.js application layer, FastAPI services, the Cogentiq APA agentic orchestration layer, and a data estate built on Azure Databricks and PostgreSQL. Deployments land in client Azure tenancies against live ERP data (Dynamics 365, SAP), which means deployment engineering is a first-class discipline, not an afterthought to development. Why this role, now The platform has crossed from being built to being deployed. Collections is entering pilot with enterprise clients, and the deployment machinery is real: Databricks Asset Bundles with one-click, script-based deployment; auto-loader ingestion running historical and incremental loads into a common data model; versioned bundles and wheel-file packages delivered through Git and Azure Artifactory; and a quick-start standard under which a newcomer must be able to stand up the full data platform by running one setup script. This role carries that machinery into client environments and makes it hold under client governance, client data, and client timelines. It owns everything between our release artefacts and a running, observable, correctly governed installation; candidates who want to work on agent behaviour and LLM integration should apply to the AI FDE track instead. What you will do Own the deployment architecture of client installations from environment readiness through hypercare: bundle strategy, environment topology (Dev, QA, production; per-client catalogs), release sequencing, and sign-off that the installation meets the validation standard. Navigate Unity Catalog and platform governance Client and internal IT control catalog and metastore provisioning, storage decisions, and access models. You will assess what their governance model means for our setup scripts, negotiate provisioning paths, and know when a shared-infrastructure convenience creates an SOW, NDA, or data-isolation problem that must be escalated rather than worked around. Set and enforce the platform engineering standards: idempotent, rerunnable deployments; fail-fast error handling with no silent except-and-continue paths; environment-variable-driven parameterisation with a single point of change per client value; and configuration conventions that hold across Databricks today and Fabric tomorrow. Own the shared utilities architecture: interface-function contracts and factory-pattern abstractions across Databricks, Fabric, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and storage back ends, packaged as versioned wheel files through Azure Artifactory, so swapping a client's platform is a configuration change, not a rewrite. Make the hard ingestion calls: auto-loader versus custom conflict-driven ingestion when the client will not provision Databricks, checkpoint and reprocessing strategy, retry and alerting design per pipeline, and writeback reliability to the application database. Run incident command during deployment and hypercare. When a deployment breaks in a client environment, you run the incident: triage across the data estate, the application database, and upstream ERP feeds; communicate honestly with the client; and land the fix and the post-incident correction to the playbook. Own the deployment playbook as a product. The quick-start guides, validation suites, and synthetic data configurations you leave behind must make the next deployment cheaper. The bar is that a newcomer deploys the platform from your playbook with one setup script. Coach junior Platform FDEs, reviewing their work against the standards you set and growing them toward deployment ownership. What You need 6 or more years in data platform or deployment engineering, with at least two years deploying into environments you did not control (client tenancies, regulated environments, or equivalent). Deep Azure Databricks: Asset Bundles, workflows, Unity Catalog and metastore governance, cluster and library management, service-principal automation, and the CLI. Strong Python and SQL, with the judgement to review pipeline code for idempotency, failure behaviour, and configuration hygiene, not just correctness. PostgreSQL in production: schema evolution, write reliability, connection behaviour under load. CI/CD for data platforms: Git-based release flows, semantic versioning, artefact repositories, and backward compatibility across component versions. Domain literacy in order-to-cash and accounts receivable data: invoices, receipts, remittances, customer masters, and ERP AR structures in Dynamics 365 or SAP. You cannot validate a deployment whose data you do not understand. Client-facing composure: you will be the technical face of the deployment to client IT and finance stakeholders. Nice to have: Microsoft Fabric, observability design (OpenTelemetry, Application Insights), and experience taking a data product through pilots at multiple clients in parallel. Success in the first year Two client deployments taken from environment readiness through hypercare, each validated against the standard suite and signed off on schedule. A deployment playbook that demonstrably reduced the cost of the deployment that followed it, measured in elapsed time from access granted to validated installation. Platform standards (idempotency, fail-fast, parameterisation) adopted across the data engineering codebase, evidenced in review practice, not just documentation. At least one governance or infrastructure negotiation with client IT resolved without escalation to leadership. If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us! Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking Introduce Yourself in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!
