jobs.description: Job Summary We are seeking a talented, technically passionate Generative AI Engineer with 3+ years of professional software engineering and applied AI/ML experience to design, build, and deploy production-grade LLM applications. In this hands-on engineering role, you will turn the latest advancements in generative artificial intelligence into resilient, scalable business solutions. You will specialize in constructing Advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, engineering autonomous agents with deterministic tool-calling capabilities, optimizing prompt workflows, experimenting with parameter-efficient model adaptation (LoRA/QLoRA), and serving high-performance inference APIs via containerized microservices hosted on AWS or Microsoft Azure. Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities & Core Engineering Mandates A. RAG Architecture & Vector Search Engineering RAG Pipeline Development: Design and implement end-to-end RAG pipelines incorporating multi-modal document parsing, recursive text splitting, and semantic chunking. Vector Store Management: Integrate, optimize, and benchmark vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector, Azure AI Search) for sub-second similarity search. Hybrid Search & Re-ranking: Implement hybrid retrieval combining dense vector embeddings with sparse lexical keyword matching (BM25) and cross-encoder re-ranking models (Cohere Rerank, BGE). Context Optimization: Engineer contextual compression, parent-document retrieval, and metadata filtering schemas to eliminate context noise and hallucinations. B. Agentic Workflows & Multi-Tool Integration Agentic Frameworks: Build stateful multi-agent workflows and autonomous task execution loops using LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or AutoGen. Tool Calling & Action APIs: Develop robust, type-safe function-calling and tool-use interfaces connecting LLMs to external REST APIs, relational databases, and enterprise systems. Loop Safeguards & Routing: Implement plan-and-solve agent patterns, multi-step reflection loops, and fallback error-handling to prevent infinite agent recursion. C. Prompt Engineering, Output Validation & Fine-Tuning Prompt Engineering: Design and test systematic prompt templates utilizing Chain-of-Thought (CoT), Few-Shot prompting, ReAct patterns, and directional stimulus prompting. Structured Output Parsing: Enforce deterministic, validated output structures using Pydantic, Instructor, Guidance, or Outlines to guarantee reliable downstream ingestion. Model Adaptation: Conduct Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA) on open-weights models (Llama 3, Mistral, Phi-3/4) for domain-specific tasks. D. Backend API & Inference Microservices Inference APIs (FastAPI): Develop high-throughput asynchronous backend microservices using Python (FastAPI), managing connection pooling, concurrency, and rate limiting. Streaming Latency: Implement low-latency streaming inference pipelines utilizing Server-Sent Events (SSE) and WebSockets for conversational user interfaces. Inference Engines: Optimize inference throughput utilizing modern serving engines like vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or Ollama, minimizing Time-to-First-Token (TTFT). Containerized Deployment: Containerize applications with Docker and configure deployment manifests for Kubernetes, AWS ECS/EKS, or Azure Container Apps. E. Evaluation, Guardrails & LLMOps Observability Automated Model Evaluation: Establish automated evaluation benchmarks utilizing synthetic test datasets and evaluation harnesses (Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) to quantify faithfulness and recall. AI Guardrails & Safety: Implement enterprise guardrails (NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard, Azure Content Safety) to proactively mitigate prompt injection, jailbreaks, and toxicity. Observability & Tracing: Integrate comprehensive LLM tracing, prompt versioning, and cost monitoring using tools like Langfuse, Phoenix, or Weights & Biases Skill Requirements Total Experience: Minimum 3+ years of professional software engineering / data science experience, with at least 1.5+ years of dedicated hands-on GenAI / LLM development. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or equivalent technical field. Python & ML Foundations: Advanced Python programming skills (asyncio, type hints, Pydantic, pytest) and deep familiarity with PyTorch or Hugging Face Transformers. GenAI Frameworks: Extensive hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and commercial/open foundation model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock). Vector Search & RAG: Proven track record building and deploying production RAG architectures using vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Qdrant, pgvector). Backend & Containers: Hands-on proficiency developing asynchronous REST APIs using FastAPI, Docker containerization, and Git-based collaborative workflows. Core Competencies: Strong analytical problem-solving skills, solid understanding of transformer architecture mechanics, and proactive technical curiosity. 4. Preferred Qualifications & Industry Certifications Inference Optimization: Hands-on experience with model quantization (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ) and high-throughput inference serving engines (vLLM, TGI, TensorRT-LLM). Cloud Certifications: Cloud AI certifications: AWS Certified AI Practitioner / ML Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), or Azure AI Fundamentals. Open Source & Portfolio: Demonstrated contributions to open-source GenAI projects, LangChain/LlamaIndex community plugins, or active technical blog/GitHub repository. Agile Collaboration: Experience working in Agile/Scrum sprint environments collaborating with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Frontend Developers. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Success Benchmarks Success and engineering performance in this role will be measured against the following technical benchmarks: 1. Retrieval Accuracy: RAG Faithfulness & Retrieval Relevance: Achieving 90% ground-truth accuracy and minimal hallucination scores on benchmark evaluation datasets. 2. Low Latency: Inference Latency SLAs: Maintaining p95 streaming Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) < 800ms and total request latency within defined application budgets. 3. Security & Safety: System Robustness & Guardrails: Zero critical prompt injection bypasses or unauthorized data leakage incidents in production environments. 4. Engineering Quality: Code Quality & Test Coverage: Delivering modular, well-documented code with 80% automated unit/integration test coverage across API endpoints. 5. Delivery Velocity: Sprint Execution Velocity: Consistently completing committed sprint stories and technical spikes on schedule with minimal defect slippage Must Have Skill Advanced Business Analysis - Gen AI Good to Have Skill Other Requirements

Must have skills : Snowflake Data Warehouse Good to have skills : AI Agents & Workflow Integration Minimum 12 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Role Summary / Description AI Powered Tech Talent As a Senior Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture for Snowflake, you will own significant portions of the end-to-end architecture and engineering of optimized data and AI infrastructure for production machine learning and AI-enabled applications. You will design scalable warehouses, Snowpark workloads, AI-ready data/feature pipelines, model-enablement patterns, automation and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, platform modernization, regulated data workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust Snowflake-based AI infrastructure solutions. Key Responsibilities Own end-to-end architecture and design of optimized Snowflake data and AI infrastructure, including warehouses, Snowpark workloads, secure data architecture, AI-ready feature/data pipelines, model integration and AI application enablement. Design and tune scalable Snowflake warehouses, tasks, streams, Snowpark services, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streamlit applications and cloud integrations, including compute sizing, query optimization, governance, access controls and high-throughput data access design. Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Snowflake, applying deep knowledge of Snowflake Data Cloud capabilities, data/AI application patterns, governance, security and cost levers. Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity. Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions. Drive architecture decision-making by documenting rationale, trade-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards. Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities. Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production. Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization. Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards. Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards. Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field. Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large-scale engineering solutions. Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads. Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages. Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform-native workflow tooling. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced engineering or client delivery environment. Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills. Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large-scale solutions. Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives. Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns. Required Skills/ Experience Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake warehouses, databases, schemas, secure data sharing/access controls, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Streamlit and cloud ecosystem integrations. Experience architecting scalable data and feature pipelines, AI application integrations, model-enablement patterns, governance, query/warehouse optimization and secure data access. Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python, dbt/Terraform, CI/CD, DataOps, MLOps/AI enablement patterns, observability and incident response practices. Ability to optimize Snowflake AI infrastructure for performance, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance. Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable platform patterns. Good to Have Skills Snowflake certifications such as SnowPro Advanced Architect, SnowPro Advanced Data Engineer or related AI/data platform credentials. Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail/e-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments where data/AI platforms must meet compliance, security, reliability and cost-control requirements. Exposure to Snowpark, Cortex/AI features, vector search, retrieval pipelines, feature engineering, model enablement and AI application architecture. Knowledge of Snowflake governance, secure data sharing, FinOps, infrastructure partner/vendor collaboration and production support operating models. 15 years full time education

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Administrator (AWS Data Engineer)
jobs.description: : ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS. : What You’ll Do : As a Senior Cloud Administrator at ZS you will combine strong data engineering skills with practical cloud infrastructure knowledge. The role is primarily responsible for designing, developing, supporting, and optimizing scalable data pipelines and distributed data-processing workloads. The successful candidate will work across Spark, Hadoop, SQL, Python and Linux, while supporting analytics services and the underlying AWS environment required to run them reliably, securely and cost-effectively. This is a hands-on role for a data engineer who can own complex transformations, tune jobs, troubleshoot production issues, automate recurring operational work, and collaborate with product, engineering, operations and architecture teams. The role also contributes to emerging AI-enabled data workflows through an understanding of Large Language Models, Amazon Bedrock, Agentic AI and Model Context Protocol (MCP). Design, develop, maintain and support robust data pipelines that ingest, transform and deliver data for analytics, reporting, machine learning and AI use cases. Write and review production-grade Python, PySpark and SQL for complex, high-volume data transformations. Optimize Spark and SQL workloads for performance, scalability and cost by analyzing execution plans, partitioning, skew, caching, memory pressure and I/O patterns. Build reusable ingestion and transformation components, common utilities and automation frameworks that reduce manual intervention and improve delivery consistency. Monitor scheduled pipelines and distributed jobs, investigate failures, restore services, and improve observability, alerting, and operational runbooks. Perform hands-on troubleshooting across the data-processing layer and supporting cloud infrastructure, including Linux hosts, storage, access, networking and service configuration. Conduct root cause analysis for recurring or high-impact incidents and implement long-term remediation to prevent recurrence. Apply data-engineering standards for reliability, maintainability, data quality, security and governance throughout the development lifecycle. Partner with data producers, consumers, architects, product teams and cloud operations teams to translate requirements into practical technical solutions. Contribute to technical design reviews, code reviews, release validation, capacity planning and productionreadiness assessments. Support proofs of concept involving LLMs, Amazon Bedrock, Agentic AI and MCP-based integrations where they intersect with enterprise data platforms. Work with AWS or other technology vendors and subject matter experts for advanced troubleshooting when required. What You'll Bring: 4+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, including Apache Spark, Hadoop ecosystems and Data Warehousing. Strong expertise in designing, building, testing, and supporting scalable batch or ETL/ELT data pipelines. Hands-on expertise in Spark or PySpark development, including distributed processing concepts and job optimization. Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, aggregations, query tuning and data validation. Strong Python skills for data processing, reusable frameworks, automation and operational tooling. In-depth hands-on experience with Linux, shell utilities, logs, processes, file systems and troubleshooting. Proven ability to implement complex data transformations, including cleansing, deduplication, enrichment, aggregation and slowly changing dimension patterns. Sound understanding of data warehousing, data lakes, partitioning, file formats, schema evolution and data quality controls. Experience diagnosing and optimizing pipeline performance, including parallelism, partition sizing, data skew, memory usage, shuffle behavior and inefficient SQL patterns. Ability to troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions. Understanding of cloud infrastructure fundamentals relevant to analytics workloads, including compute, storage, identity and access, networking, monitoring and cost management. Understanding of Large Language Models, Amazon Bedrock, Agentic AI patterns and Model Context Protocol (MCP) concepts. Ability to collaborate with cross-functional and globally distributed teams and communicate technical findings clearly to stakeholders. Hands-on experience with AWS analytics services such as Amazon EMR, AWS Glue, Amazon Athena, Amazon SageMaker, etc. Experience with Amazon S3-based data lakes and related security, cataloging, partitioning and performance considerations. Exposure to workflow orchestration or scheduling tools and CI/CD practices for data pipelines. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code or cloud automation tools used to provision and manage analytics environments. Knowledge of streaming data, open table formats, data governance, or metadata and catalog solutions. Experience supporting secure, regulated or mission-critical analytics platforms. Associate-level or higher AWS certification, or relevant data engineering certification Fluency in English Client-first mentality Intense work ethic Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach : How you’ll grow: Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions Perks & Benefits: At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations | Where we work | ZS. Hybrid working model: We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections. Travel: Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures. Considering applying? At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive. If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply. ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law. To complete your application: Candidates must possess or be able to obtain work authorization for their intended country of employment. An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered. NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE. Find Out More At: www.zs.com

jobs.title: Production Engineer (SRE/Dev - Python)
jobs.description: Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform. We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. Role We are looking for a Production Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Manager, Site Reliability Engineering in the Cloud Infrastructure & Operations department. Join Zscaler to be a force multiplier for the reliability of a global platform protecting over 15 million users, providing the technical vision and hands-on execution to drive an automation-first culture across the company. By maturing our observability and architectural standards, you will directly reduce our Mean Time to Mitigate (MTTM) and shape the scalability of our globally distributed, multi-cloud infrastructure. What you'll do (Role Expectations) Design and implement highly available, scalable infrastructure across AWS, Azure, GCP, and bare-metal environments Drive an "automation-first" culture by writing code (Python/Go) to eliminate manual toil and build self-healing systems Implement and maintain sophisticated observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), define SLIs/SLOs, and establish error budgets Act as a lead Incident Commander (TDO on-call), develop response playbooks, and conduct deep-dive post-incident analyses Partner with Engineering and partner teams to conduct operability reviews Who You Are (Success Profile) Comfortable navigating ambiguity and dynamic environments, viewing uncertainty not as a hindrance but as an opportunity to build meaningful solutions. Driven by a strong sense of ownership and bias for action, operating with integrity while seamlessly balancing high-level strategy with hands-on technical execution. Laser-focused problem solver who proactively runs toward complex engineering challenges to deliver high-impact results. High-trust collaborator committed to team success, actively giving and receiving transparent feedback with clarity and respect. Purpose-driven learner with an active growth mindset, continuously seeking feedback to grow as a teammate and engineering partner. What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications) Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain 2 to 3 years of experience managing reliability, scalability, and availability for large-scale production services with deep expertise in programming (e.g., Python, Go, or C/C++) Strong background in networking protocols, Linux/FreeBSD systems, and distributed architecture Experience in high-stakes incident management and participation in a 24/7 on-call rotation Proficiency in leveraging ITIL frameworks and incident data to drive service maturity through systematic problem management and technical operability reviews What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications) Proven ability to leverage AI technologies, workflows, and AIOps tools to drive measurable operational efficiency, including implementing machine learning models for anomaly detection and predictive capacity planning to automate incident response Extensive experience with public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Infrastructure-as-Code (Ansible, Terraform), and chaos engineering or disaster recovery planning at scale Expertise in global routing (BGP), traffic tunneling (GRE, IPSec), L7 proxy architectures (HAProxy), DNS at scale, and OS networking stack internals #LI-SK3 #LI-HYBRID At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure. Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including: Various health plans Time off plans for vacation and sick time Parental leave options Retirement options Education reimbursement In-office perks, and more! Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here. By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines. Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Pay Transparency Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules. This role bridges deep cloud infrastructure mechanics with data engineering, algorithm design, and business economics. You will architect automated reporting pipelines, develop unit-cost metrics, govern procurement and operational policies, introduce FinOps practices for AI workloads, and partner closely with engineering squads, platform teams, and finance leaders to foster a culture of cost-aware engineering. Key Responsibilities 1. Cloud Cost Visibility, Data Analytics & Anomaly Detection Manage, curate, and normalize end-to-end cloud cost and usage datasets, ensuring high data fidelity, consistency, and standardized governance across multi-cloud environments. Define, build, and maintain automated cost, usage, and efficiency dashboards using Apache Superset, supported by SQL and data extraction pipelines. Design and deploy automated anomaly detection algorithms, statistical models, and alerting mechanisms to detect spending spikes, runaway workloads, and unexpected cost regressions in near real time. Benchmark, track, and report on cloud consumption, forecast variance, unit economics, and realized savings to engineering teams and leadership. Implement and refine tagging governance, business cost-allocation models, and unit economics metrics, such as cost per customer, cost per query, or cost per pipeline run. 2. Architecture, Automation & Spend Optimization Own and optimize cloud financial management platforms for reporting, cost optimization, and performance measurement. Our environment includes Cloudability, PointFive, ProsperOps, and Larridin; experience with comparable platforms is welcome. Design, build, and maintain automation workflows and scripts to identify and reclaim idle, underutilized, or orphaned resources, including compute instances, unattached volumes/IPs, outdated snapshots, and development/test environments. Lead enterprise-wide commitment strategies across AWS, Azure, and GCP, managing portfolio coverage, risk, and utilization for Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, and applicable provider-specific commitments. Partner with software, platform, and SRE teams to analyze utilization telemetry, implement rightsizing recommendations, and optimize compute and storage resources. 3. FinOps for AI & Emerging Technologies Introduce and establish FinOps frameworks tailored to AI, ML training pipelines, and LLM inference workloads. Establish Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and Return on Investment (ROI) models for AI infrastructure, including GPU clusters, vector databases, model hosting endpoints, and third-party AI APIs. Collaborate with AI/ML engineering teams to evaluate model inference performance against operational costs, improving token efficiency and hardware utilization. 4. Governance, Procurement & Cross-Functional Alignment Establish and enforce cloud cost and operational policies across accounts, subscriptions, regions, and resource configurations. Participate in architectural design and cloud capacity planning for new projects, services, and major infrastructure changes. Oversee third-party cloud marketplace software procurement, ensuring spending aligns with enterprise budgets and cloud discount commitments. Review production release schedules from a cost-impact perspective, incorporating pre-production load-testing analysis and cost guardrails. Partner with Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) and engineering leaders to track monthly variance, improve forecasting models, and translate technical decisions into business impact. Collaborate with engineering, platform, and finance teams across India and the United States. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions, develop technical documentation, and promote FinOps best practices across engineering teams. Advanced SQL skills and experience building automated data workflows, metrics engines, and dashboards using BI tools such as Apache Superset. Experience creating or configuring automated alerting rules, statistical anomaly detection, or threshold-based algorithms for infrastructure telemetry. Direct experience managing cloud commitment portfolios, including Savings Plans and Reserved Instances, and optimizing effective savings rates. Strong scripting or coding skills in Python, Bash, or Go to build automated resource reclamation, API integrations, and policy enforcement tools. Strong communication skills and demonstrated ability to contribute to architectural planning, implement governance policies, and explain trade-offs between cost, performance, reliability, and delivery speed. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. Job Title: Senior Applied AI Engineer Experience: 6-12 yrs Category: IT Main location: Hyderabad Position ID: J1126-0807 Employment Type: Full Time Job Description Summary You will design, build and operate production grade AI agents that talk to real customers. Working on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore Runtime, you will own the reasoning, retrieval, tooling and guardrails behind services handling millions of conversations. This is applied AI engineering, taking systems from prototype to reliable, evaluated, governed production, not research. Client , Technology is a core driver of how we deliver our strategy. You'll join a team modernising our platforms, strengthening cyber and operational resilience, and advancing a product led way of working that brings engineers, data specialists and business experts together to deliver meaningful outcomes at pace. We're scaling automation and AI from proof of concept into real, end to end change, improving customer journeys, reducing cost to serve, accelerating delivery, and building the digital foundations that underpin everything from energy trading and risk to field operations and critical infrastructure. If you want to work on complex, high impact problems using modern engineering practices, and help build reusable platforms that will shape how Client operates over the next decade, this is the place to do it. An opportunity to play your part. You will join the Channel Platforms team, which owns Client 's customer conversation estate across voice, chat and email. Our agents are already live: a pay as you go voice assistant built on a real time speech to speech model, a multi channel customer facing agent spanning voice, chat and WhatsApp, and a standalone agentic webchat service running on AgentCore Runtime. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer you will own the intelligence layer of these products. That means the agent's reasoning and orchestration, the tools it can call, the knowledge it retrieves, the guardrails that constrain it, and the evaluation that proves it works. You will decide what good looks like and then build the measurement to show whether we are hitting it. This is a role for someone who has taken generative AI past the demo stage. Our problems are the hard ones that show up after launch: grounding answers in the right source, keeping voice latency low enough to feel natural, handing off to a human at the right moment, and proving to a governance board that the system behaves safely at scale. You do not need a contact centre background. If you are a strong engineer who has built real agentic systems on Bedrock or a comparable platform, we will teach you the domain. Location: UK based hybrid role, occasional travel to site. Day to day . Design and build agentic services on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore Runtime, including multi step orchestration, state and memory management, and graceful handling of failure and ambiguity. . Build and own the tool layer that agents act through, exposing business capability such as account lookup, billing and identity as reliable, well described actions with sensible error semantics. . Build retrieval augmented generation over Bedrock Knowledge Bases, taking ownership of content preparation, chunking, embedding strategy, retrieval quality and answer grounding. . Treat prompts as engineering artefacts. Version them, test them, and understand precisely what changed when behaviour shifts. . Build the evaluation harness. Define what accuracy, containment and safe behaviour mean for each product, assemble regression sets, and make it possible to ship a prompt or model change with evidence rather than optimism. . Implement guardrails and safety controls, including PII handling, out of scope refusal, jailbreak resistance and clean escalation to a human advisor. . Engineer for latency and cost. Streaming, model selection and routing, caching and token budgets all matter, and in voice they matter in real time where a pause of a few hundred milliseconds is felt by the customer. . Instrument agent behaviour end to end so that tool failures, retrieval misses and abandoned conversations are visible in Datadog and QuickSight, not discovered through complaints. . jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. Department Tech@Lilly Location: Eli Lilly, Bengaluru Position Type Full-Time Level R2-3 Are you passionate about designing and building AI-powered applications that bring together large language models, agentic workflows, and full stack engineering to solve real business problems? Do you thrive working across the stack — AI/LLM integration, backend services, modern frontend frameworks, and cloud deployment — while staying curious about what GenAI can unlock next? If so, Tech@Lilly is looking for an AI Full Stack Engineer to design, build, and scale AI-powered applications and full stack solutions across the enterprise. As an AI Full Stack Engineer, you will design and develop AI-powered applications using Large Language Models, build Agentic AI workflows leveraging tools, reasoning, memory, and orchestration patterns, and develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using enterprise knowledge sources. You will work across the full stack — building responsive frontend applications, scalable backend services and APIs, and cloud-native deployments on AWS — while integrating AI services with business applications and ensuring systems are secure, reliable, and production-ready. What You’ll Be Doing Design and build AI-powered applications using Large Language Models, agentic AI workflows, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions built on enterprise knowledge sources. Integrate AI services with business applications and external systems, and continuously evaluate, optimize, and monitor AI application performance and quality. Build responsive, modern frontend applications and scalable backend services and APIs, using reusable components and clean, maintainable code. Deploy and manage applications on cloud platforms (preferably AWS), building CI/CD pipelines, containerizing with Docker, and orchestrating workloads with Kubernetes. Design and manage SQL and NoSQL databases, integrate enterprise systems and third-party services, and ensure secure, compliant handling of data. Collaborate closely with product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions, and implement monitoring, logging, and observability best practices. What You Will Bring Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, and Agentic AI concepts, with hands-on experience using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex. Experience integrating AI models through OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent services, along with working knowledge of vector databases and semantic search. Strong proficiency in Python, with experience building APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks, and a solid understanding of microservices architecture and API design. Practical experience with React and TypeScript, building modern, responsive user interfaces with strong attention to frontend performance and usability. Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes, and CI/CD implementation using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab, or similar tools, along with infrastructure deployment and environment management experience. Strong knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server, with experience in NoSQL and vector databases preferred. How You Will Succeed Delivers production-ready AI applications with high quality and reliability. Independently drives features from design through deployment. Builds reusable and scalable solutions that can support multiple business teams. Improves developer productivity through automation and engineering best practices. Continuously explores and adopts emerging AI capabilities to solve business problems. Basic Qualifications 6-8 years of software engineering experience. At least 1-2 years of practical Generative AI experience. Strong Python + React + Cloud background. Proven deployments to production. Ability to work across the full technology stack independently. Preferred Skills Experience building enterprise AI copilots or intelligent assistants. Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and AI tool integrations. Experience integrating with collaboration platforms such as Microsoft Teams, Jira, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise tools. Familiarity with AI observability, evaluations, and monitoring frameworks. jobs.description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. Forward Deployed Engineer, Frontier Engineering Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential – and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology – and careers – to the next level. Where Data Does More. Join the Snowflake team. At Snowflake, we are building a high-impact team to help the world's most innovative companies unlock the power of AI. As a Forward Deployed Engineer on our Frontier Engineering team, you will be a hands-on builder and a key technical partner to our most strategic customers, placing you at the forefront of the enterprise AI revolution. You won't just work with cutting-edge technology – you'll deploy it to solve real-world business problems at scale, building production-grade AI systems using Snowpark, Cortex, and our native LLM capabilities. IN THIS ROLE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL: Build Customer Solutions : Architect, build, and deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions, including sophisticated AI agents. Own the end-to-end lifecycle of your workstreams – from prototype to production – directly solving customers' most complex business challenges. Own the Quality of What You Ship : Define what "good" means for the systems you build. Translate ambiguous customer goals into measurable quality metrics, evaluation frameworks, and golden datasets – then run systematic eval loops to hill-climb on agent quality, catch regressions before customers do, and continuously raise the bar on accuracy, faithfulness, and safety. Treat measurement as a first-class part of building, not an afterthought. Deliver with Velocity : Rapidly design, iterate, and ship high-quality code and pipelines. Translate ambiguous business objectives into robust, scalable, and performant solutions using Python and SQL. Productionize AI at Scale : Own the full implementation lifecycle for your solutions – from prototype through deployment, monitoring, and optimization in secure, large-scale production environments. Build the safety guardrails, observability, and human-review workflows that keep AI applications reliable and trustworthy, and close the loop from production traces and user feedback back into your evals so quality compounds over time. Be a Technical Partner : Partner directly with customer data science and engineering teams as a hands-on technical resource and trusted advisor on how to best leverage AI for their business challenges. Collaborate to Innovate : Work cross-functionally with Snowflake's Product and Engineering teams, sharing real-world feedback from the field to directly influence the future of Snowflake's AI platform. Have the opportunity to travel : Spend at least 25% of your time onsite, working closely with Snowflake's most strategic customers. WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO HAVE: Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years of professional software engineering experience. Willingness to travel. Proven experience building applications using LLMs, especially with technologies like RAG and agentic workflows. Hands-on experience defining quality metrics and running evaluations for LLM or agent systems, and using evals to systematically improve quality. Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with an ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders. Comfort with ambiguity and a desire to thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing Generative AI environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience building eval sets from production traces and synthetic data, and running structured experimentation (A/B tests, ablations, offline evals) to compare prompts, models, or agent architectures. Familiarity with eval and observability tooling (e.g., Braintrust, LangSmith, Arize, Weave, Promptfoo) or experience building custom eval harnesses. Experience with failure-mode analysis on agent or RAG systems – categorizing errors (hallucination, retrieval miss, planning failure, tool misuse) and driving each down with targeted evals. Hands-on experience with the MLOps lifecycle, including model deployment, monitoring, and evaluation in a cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Familiarity with core data science libraries and tools (e.g., pandas, numpy, Snowpark). Experience in a customer-facing technical role (e.g., solutions architect, sales engineer, or professional services). Startup experience. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? jobs.description: Overview Working at Atlassian Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. This is a remote position. To help our teams work together effectively, this role requires you to be located in India. We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team, dedicated to developing innovative solutions to make AI services responsible (Responsible AI). You will join the Responsible AI (RAI) & AI Safety engineering team. We are responsible for building, operating, and advancing the centralized AI safety, content moderation, and guardrail platforms powering Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo. Our systems run inline and asynchronously across high-throughput production workloads, detecting and mitigating jailbreaks, prompt injection, harmful content, bias, and policy violations while preserving latency and user experience. We partner closely with Product Engineering, Central AI Platform, AI Gateway, Legal, and Trust teams to deliver safety systems that scale globally. We have teams in the USA, Australia, New Zealand, and this will be our expansion to India. This team is responsible for building solutions and operating mature platforms to improve the entire company's security and trust & safety posture. If you are passionate about improving security, trust & safety, and combating abuse, this role presents a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact! Responsibilities At Atlassian, a Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) is responsible for building, training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models into production systems at scale. The role sits at the intersection of software engineering and data science, requiring production-grade code to turn research prototypes into real-world systems like search ranking, recommendations, and GenAI platforms. What You’ll Do Design & Productionize Safety Models: Architect, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM-based guardrail and moderation models (text, multi-modal, and code) to safeguard user inputs and model outputs across Atlassian products. Build Robust Evaluation & Benchmarking: Design offline and online evaluation frameworks, adversarial test suites (red-teaming), and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to measure precision, recall, false-positive rates, and robustness against model drift. Optimize for Real-Time Serving: Work at the intersection of model accuracy and low latency (P50/P99 targets) to deliver cost-effective, high-throughput safety filtering integrated with our central AI Gateway and inference layers. Combat Emerging Threats: Research and build defenses against adversarial prompts, jailbreaks, data leakage, hallucinations, and unauthorized tool-calling behaviors in agentic systems. Drive Global Compliance & Governance: Support technical readiness for enterprise standards and emerging AI regulations (e.g., EU AI Act, ISO 42001 / AIMS, FedRAMP) through verifiable safety controls, audit logging, and watermarking capabilities. Collaborate & Mentor: Partner with engineering managers, staff engineers, data scientists, and product managers to steer technical strategy; provide code/design reviews and mentor junior engineers across the team. Compensation At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range. This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity. Qualifications Your background Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, with 7+ years of industry experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production. Deep hands-on experience with modern NLP and LLM techniques, transformer architectures, prompt engineering, fine-tuning (e.g., PEFT/LoRA), and model alignment. Proficiency in Python (and familiarity with Kotlin, Java, or Go) with a track record of writing clean, testable, and performant production-grade code. Proven experience constructing rigorous evaluation pipelines, benchmarking datasets, and managing precision/recall trade-offs for high-consequence classification or safety systems. Expertise at telling stories with data and familiarity with at least one visualization tool (e.g. Tableau, R-Shiny, Microstrategy, SAP Business Objects, Looker, etc.) Experience deploying and scaling ML services in cloud environments (AWS / GCP) using containerized platforms (Kubernetes/Docker) and distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, SQL). Strong analytical problem-solving skills, ability to navigate ambiguity, and clear communication skills to articulate ML trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. An agile development mindset focused on constant iteration, solving problems from first principles, and navigating ambiguity. It's great, but not required, if you have Experience specifically in Trust & Safety, Content Moderation, or AI Red-Teaming / Adversarial Robustness. Hands-on experience optimizing inference engines (e.g., Triton Inference Server, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM) or model quantization techniques for low-latency serving. Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, content provenance/watermarking, or regulatory compliance standards (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001). Experience with large-scale streaming pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis) or graph-based entity systems. Benefits & Perks Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits . About Atlassian At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them. To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh . jobs.title: Associate, AI Data Scientist- Private Markets
jobs.description: About This Role Build efficient, trusted agentic AI for private-markets intelligence Research, build and scale advanced agentic systems and fit-for-purpose language models that turn complex information into dependable data, research and decision intelligence. Your team You will join a multidisciplinary AI and data science team focused on applying advanced AI to high-value challenges in private markets. The team brings together data science, engineering, product and domain expertise, and works closely with users to develop practical capabilities that improve how information is acquired, researched and managed. You will work in an environment where applied research is expected to become dependable production capability. We value intellectual curiosity, rigorous experimentation, strong engineering and responsible AI, with quality, security and appropriate human oversight designed in from the start. Your role & impact As an Associate, AI Data Scientist, you will be a hands-on technical contributor responsible for researching, building and scaling enterprise-grade agentic AI capabilities. Working directly with users and senior technical leaders, you will translate complex private-markets workflows into well-evaluated systems that move from experimentation to governed production and sustained adoption. Your core mandate is to advance multi-agent LLM systems through effective agent design patterns, rigorous evaluation and disciplined model engineering. You will develop workflows that plan, retrieve, reason, use tools, verify and escalate appropriately, while selecting the simplest architecture and model that can meet the required quality, latency, cost and control objectives. You will also help establish the lifecycle for open-source small language models and LLMs, from model discovery and benchmarking through training, adaptation, fine-tuning, deployment, monitoring and retirement. Your impact will be visible in stronger data quality, faster research, scalable automation and reusable AI capabilities that help BlackRock Preqin remain at the forefront of private-markets data and technology. Your responsibilities Work forward-deployed with researchers, data specialists and product teams to understand workflows, frame ambiguous problems, define measurable outcomes and iterate rapidly from evidence to production. Research, design and deliver agentic workflows spanning planning, retrieval, tool use, structured extraction, reasoning, verification, exception handling and human escalation, using single-agent or multi-agent patterns where each is demonstrably appropriate. Engineer advanced agent patterns, including bounded iterative loops, reflection and critique, planner-executor and evaluator-optimizer patterns, with explicit stop conditions, budgets and safeguards that prevent unproductive or uncontrolled execution. Build agent and model harnesses that standardise tool interfaces, context assembly, state and memory handling, policy enforcement, tracing, replay and failure recovery. Determine when an agentic architecture, retrieval workflow, specialised model or deterministic service is the best fit, and validate the decision against representative tasks and simpler baselines. Design safe caching and reuse across retrieval, prompts, model responses, tool results and intermediate agent state, with clear cache keys, invalidation, freshness, access-control and provenance requirements. jobs.description: Job Description We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Specialist, Full-Stack Engineer to join our DATA SOLUTIONS AND SVCS PLATFORM team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain full stack applications that support applied AI solutions, enterprise platform capabilities, and AI-enabled product flows. The Vice President, Full Stack AI Developer will work closely with product managers, product owners, engineering leads, data scientists, platform teams, and governance partners to translate product needs into high-quality technical solutions. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, practical AI fluency, disciplined execution, and the ability to contribute across solution delivery, integration, testing, deployment, production readiness, and ongoing platform support. Support applied AI solution delivery by integrating AI/ML capabilities, model outputs, prompts, automation workflows, data services, APIs, and enterprise systems into reliable product experiences. Provide platform support for AI capabilities, including enhancements, defect resolution, release support, troubleshooting, performance improvements, and maintainability. Support AI product enhancement across platforms by improving existing workflows, adding new capabilities, integrating reusable components, and ensuring solutions scale across business and technology environments. Partner with product owners, product managers, data scientists, and engineering teams to translate requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, and working software. Develop well-designed, testable, efficient, and maintainable code to solve business and technology problems. Participate in solution design, code reviews, technical documentation, testing, release planning, deployment activities, and production readiness. Support application quality through automated testing, software verification, debugging, performance tuning, and secure coding practices. Troubleshoot, debug, upgrade, and enhance existing systems while managing technical debt and improving software maintainability. Ensure software solutions are aligned to enterprise architecture, security, privacy, resiliency, observability, and change management standards. Leverage existing products, reusable components, and platform capabilities to improve engineering efficiency and avoid duplication. Collaborate across product, engineering, data science, platform, operations, risk, and governance teams to deliver high-quality AI-enabled capabilities. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Preferred 5+ years of experience in software development, full stack engineering, application development, platform support, or related technology roles. Experience developing, supporting, and enhancing enterprise applications using modern application, API, integration, and platform technologies. Strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices, Agile delivery, CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, release management, and production support. Experience building secure, scalable, testable, and maintainable software in complex enterprise environments. Familiarity with AI-enabled applications, automation platforms, data-driven products, model integrations, prompt-based workflows, or AI/ML-enabled software solutions. Strong troubleshooting skills, including debugging application behavior, reviewing logs, resolving defects, and improving application reliability. Understanding of security, privacy, performance, resiliency, and maintainability considerations in enterprise software development. Ability to work effectively with product, engineering, data science, platform, operations, risk, and governance teams. Strong communication, problem-solving, ownership, and collaboration skills. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required. Experience in financial services, enterprise technology, or another highly regulated environment. Exposure to generative AI, large language models, retrieval systems, agentic workflows, AI-assisted development, or enterprise AI platforms. Experience with cloud platforms, containerization, microservices, DevOps tooling, observability, APIs, data integrations, and production support practices. Experience with Python, Java, JavaScript / TypeScript, React, Node.js, SQL / NoSQL databases, APIs, and modern engineering toolchains. Familiarity with AI observability, workflow automation, prompt orchestration, model lifecycle tooling, or data pipeline integration is a plus. jobs.title: Sr Machine Learning Engineer, Fraud (Crypto & Debit Card)
jobs.description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: This job will design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms to detect and prevent fraud across our Crypto and Debit Card portfolios. You will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, fraud strategy, risk operations, and product teams to protect customers and reduce losses through AI/ML solutions. Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Develop and optimize machine learning models for various applications. Preprocess and analyze large datasets to extract meaningful insights. Deploy ML solutions into production environments using appropriate tools and frameworks. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into products and services. Monitor and evaluate the performance of deployed models. Minimum Qualifications: 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Experience with ML frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and tools for data processing and model deployment. Several years of experience in designing, implementing, and deploying machine learning models. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications: Responsibilities: Develop and optimize ML models to detect fraud across debit card transactions (card-present and card-not-present), crypto buy/sell/transfer activity, account takeover, and scams. Deploy and maintain ML solutions in production, including feature pipelines, model serving, and champion/challenger testing. Collaborate with fraud strategy, risk operations, product, and engineering teams to integrate models into decisioning systems. Monitor and evaluate the performance of deployed models (fraud capture, false positive and decline rates, drift), making necessary adjustments and supporting retraining cycles. Produce model documentation that meets model risk management and governance standards. Contribute to team best practices through code reviews and knowledge sharing, and support the growth of junior engineers. Preferred Qualifications: Experience building fraud detection or risk models in payments, card issuing, banking, or crypto. Proficiency with gradient-boosted models (XGBoost, LightGBM); familiarity with deep learning approaches such as sequence models or graph-based methods is a plus. Understanding of card payment flows (authorizations, chargebacks, disputes) or crypto transaction and wallet risk. Familiarity with model explainability and governance in a regulated financial services environment. Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field. Subsidiary: PayPal Travel Percent: 0 PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us. jobs.description: About The Role Adobe is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Adobe Genuine Engineering team. This group protects Adobe's ecosystem from fraud, abuse, and misuse using intelligent systems worldwide. In this position, you will build and develop machine learning models from scratch, including custom transformer-based frameworks, to identify fraudulent actions, stop account sharing, and protect the experience of hundreds of millions of users. jobs.title: Senior Python Engineer Systems and Edge Computing
jobs.description: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Join Thermo Fisher Scientific to develop software platforms that support advanced scientific instruments and engineering workflows. Work with global product, hardware and software teams to deliver reliable systems used in semiconductor, life sciences and materials research. How Will You Make An Impact We are seeking a Senior Python Engineer with 6–10 years of software engineering experience and substantial hands-on Python development. You will build backend services, system automation and device-management capabilities connecting scientific instruments, IoT gateways and edge devices. The role combines software design with practical Linux systems engineering, secure deployment, diagnostics and operational ownership across device, network and application layers. What Will You Do Design, develop and maintain modular Python services, APIs, command-line tools and automation libraries for device orchestration, process execution, configuration and data handling. Manage IoT and edge-device lifecycles, including discovery, secure onboarding, provisioning, inventory, configuration, health monitoring and controlled decommissioning. Integrate instruments, sensors and gateways through vendor SDKs, REST or gRPC APIs and messaging protocols such as MQTT; validate commands, telemetry and device state. Automate deployment and version tracking of applications and containers on Linux edge systems; support-controlled software and firmware updates with compatibility checks, staged rollout and rollback or recovery. Troubleshoot failures across Python code, operating-system services, networking, containers and hardware interfaces; implement structured logging, metrics, alerts and diagnostic collection. Develop unit, integration and system tests using pytest, mocks, simulators and physical devices; integrate validation and deployment workflows into CI/CD. Apply secure engineering practices, including device authentication, certificate and secret management, least-privilege access, dependency scanning and auditable change records. Collaborate with firmware, hardware, QA, DevOps and product teams on requirements, interfaces and release readiness; mentor engineers and maintain deployment guides, runbooks and onboarding documentation. Work effectively within an Agile Scrum / SAFe framework, participating in backlog refinement, sprint planning, technical estimation, PI planning, reviews, retrospectives, and cross-team coordination to support predictable and high-quality delivery. Required Skills Strong production Python development with object-oriented design, reusable modules, exception handling, concurrency, API integration, file operations and structured data such as JSON, YAML and CSV. Familiarity on development experience in C/C++ integration, PowerShell, BDD/Robot Framework, hardware-in-the-loop testing or scientific and regulated product environments. Hands-on systems engineering on Linux, including processes, services, permissions, resource usage, shell scripting and network diagnostics; ability to support Windows integration where needed. Practical experience deploying, configuring, monitoring and troubleshooting physical IoT devices, industrial gateways or edge-computing systems, beyond cloud-only application development. Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, MQTT and HTTP-based communication, with an understanding of device connectivity, authentication and offline recovery. Experience building Python backend services with FastAPI, Flask or equivalent, and integrating databases or local persistence for configuration, telemetry and operational state. Hands-on Git and CI/CD experience, plus automated testing, mocking and dependency/environment management for reproducible execution across development and deployed systems. Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, technical documentation and cross-functional communication; ability to own implementation through deployment and operational support. Desirable Skills Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi, industrial PCs or comparable ARM/x86 edge platforms; familiarity with device drivers, BSPs and hardware/software compatibility. Exposure to Azure IoT or AWS IoT services, Kubernetes/k3s, Ansible or equivalent device and deployment orchestration tools. Experience deploying AI inference workloads at the edge, or integrating LLM services for diagnostics and automation with validation and appropriate human controls. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience delivering connected products or engineering platforms through the full development lifecycle in an Agile, globally distributed team.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer 3
jobs.description: About The Role Adobe is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Adobe Genuine Engineering team. This group protects Adobe's ecosystem from fraud, abuse, and misuse using intelligent systems worldwide. In this position, you will build and develop machine learning models from scratch, including custom transformer-based frameworks, to identify fraudulent actions, stop account sharing, and protect the experience of hundreds of millions of users. You will manage the entire model lifecycle: raw behavioral data and feature engineering, architecture development, large-scale GPU training, deployment, and monitoring. The team is actively building in-house behavioral foundation models that learn identity-preserving representations from long sequences of user activity. This is a role for an engineer who wants to own deep learning systems end-to-end — not consume pre-built ones. Key Responsibilities Build and train deep learning models from scratch, including custom transformer and attention-based architectures for long behavioral event sequences. Own the full training stack: event tokenization, temporal and positional embeddings, self-supervised pretraining (e.g., masked modeling, contrastive learning), and downstream fine-tuning. Train large models efficiently on GPU infrastructure using mixed-precision training, gradient accumulation/checkpointing, efficient attention, and distributed strategies (DDP, FSDP, or equivalent). Build and optimize feature pipelines on Databricks and Spark, transforming raw behavioral events into high-quality model inputs. Translate prototypes into production ML systems — scalable, reliable, and observable — and drive inference performance through architectural and serving-side optimization. Contribute to MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, automated retraining, and production monitoring. Collaborate cross-functionally with data science, product, and platform teams; mentor junior engineers on experimentation rigor, deployment process, and responsible AI. Stay current with advances in ML/AI and bring relevant innovations into Adobe's products. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field. 5+ years of professional experience building and deploying ML solutions at scale. Strong programming expertise in Python, with hands-on experience in PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks. Deep understanding of the end-to-end ML lifecycle—from data collection to deployment and monitoring. Strong grasp of model optimization, inference efficiency, and production system integration. Desired Qualifications: Experience integrating applications with enterprise platforms and APIs such as Microsoft Graph, Teams, ServiceNow, monitoring tools, security platforms, infrastructure services, cloud services, and operational data sources. jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer
jobs.description: The LRT group is responsible for the language layer and relational execution engine powering YugabyteDB. We care deeply about correctness, performance, and usability of the system we are building. We are always looking for innovative solutions to these challenges, be it from other industry applications, academic research or original contributions, as our team’s work powers a broad range of components. The team's work areas include query planning and optimization, consistent online schema changes, as well as a broad set of SQL features including stored procedures, triggers, geo-partitioned tables, or GIN indexes for text search. Roles and Responsibilities- Lead the design, implementation, and evolution of the distributed SQL query execution engine in YugabyteDB, ensuring correctness, efficiency, and horizontal scalability. Own and enhance execution-layer components including distributed scans, joins, aggregations, sorting, batching, parallel execution, RPC coordination, and runtime memory management. Optimize distributed execution paths by minimizing cross-node communication, reducing data movement, improving pushdown to storage layer, and enhancing execution pipelining. Improve runtime observability by enhancing execution metrics, tracing, profiling, and debugging capabilities to support production-grade workloads. Mentor engineers on distributed systems design principles, execution-engine architecture, and performance engineering best practices. Write high-quality C/C++ code with comprehensive unit, integration, and performance test coverage; actively participate in and drive high-quality code and design reviews. Collaborate cross-functionally with storage, transaction, and infrastructure teams to ensure execution-layer scalability as cluster sizes and transactional throughput grow. Contribute strategically to the roadmap and technical direction of YugabyteDB’s distributed SQL execution subsystem and the broader ecosystem. Required Experience- 5-8 years experience with compiled languages, e.g. C/C++. BS/MS/PhD in CS (or related field) or equivalent experience. Systems engineering fundamentals (e.g.: distributed systems, operating systems, databases) is a must. Experience with compiled languages, e.g. C/C++ (preferred), Java, Go, Rust. Knowledge of database internals, compilers, query planning/optimization is a plus.
