jobs.description: Job Description We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical leader for this team. In this role, you’ll define and drive the architecture, execution strategy, and long-term technical roadmap. You’ll lead the development of a feature-rich system that helps company admins onboard, adopt, and manage Zendesk products with ease, while also empowering internal teams to integrate their solutions efficiently. If you’re passionate about building meaningful experiences, driving platform excellence, and creating extensible systems that serve both customers and internal teams, we’d love to have you on this journey. Our ideal candidate is someone who takes the lead on anything they work on and is a self-starter with projects that has the initiative to drive a project from start to finish. This role is based in Pune and requires you to work from office at least 3 days a week What You’ll Get To Do Each Day Contribute to the code at the core of Zendesk’s support product - what you write will reach millions of people each day! Break complex features into granular pieces of work, to facilitate incremental feedback cycles. Take ownership of features and collaborate with the Tech Leaders to design and implement complete solutions. Contribute to technical discussions and decision-making with other teams and partners across the global engineering organisation. Prioritise and estimate work balancing feature delivery with the management of tech debt. Participate in and lead activities such as pairing sessions and code reviews to facilitate continuous self-improvement for the whole team. Work closely with our designers and product managers to help define the future of the product. Triage customer issues in partnership with Product Managers. Provide operational support for our services in Production. Actively look for ways to improve the observability, performance, reliability and security of our services. Show strategic forward-thinking and provide technical leadership to drive near-to-mid-term success (1-2 years). What You Bring To The Role 9+ years of experience in full-stack software engineering, with expertise in building enterprise-scale SaaS or large web applications. Strong proficiency in any of the programming languages - Java, Ruby on Rails, GoLang, Scala, Typescript, NodeJs or any other object oriented language. 9+ years of experience working with JavaScript and TypeScript, as well as frameworks like React and Redux. Solid experience with MySQL or similar. A knack for writing efficient queries and optimizing performance in high-traffic environments. Good to have - experience/knowledge of front end technologies A track record of delivering large-scale, high quality, and resilient web systems. Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills in English - you’ll collaborate with our other product teams around the globe. The ability to understand and communicate sophisticated concepts in a relevant and considerate manner. Explain and reason your technical decisions clearly and effectively to engineers of different levels and non-technical partners. Experience solving difficult problems across multiple systems. Our services are deployed to Kubernetes using Docker via Spinnaker, running on AWS. We don’t require previous experience with these specific technologies; we’re confident you can learn as we go. Correlate network and infrastructure signals to assess customer impact and enable safe automated responses. Identify performance bottlenecks and optimize capacity, resource utilization, routing convergence, and behavior under heavy load. Architect and build highly available, fault-tolerant systems with reliable state management, replication, automated failover, and recovery. Define service-level objectives, operational KPIs, telemetry, monitoring, and alerting for service health and routing outcomes. Establish simulation, scale testing, phased migrations, in-service upgrades, verification, and rollback practices. Lead production troubleshooting, incident response, and root-cause analysis; establish runbooks and drive reliability improvements. Integrate security controls, auditability, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment, patching, and lifecycle management. Contribute production-quality code, review designs and implementations, and maintain architecture and operational documentation. Partner with cross-functional engineering, product, and business stakeholders to define technical strategy and deliver high-impact initiatives. Mentor senior engineers, influence architectural direction, and promote engineering excellence through technical leadership, hiring, and knowledge sharing. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 10+ years of relevant experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, network control planes, or network automation platforms. Strong Linux systems and networking knowledge, including containers, process and memory behavior, network namespaces, resource isolation, and packet-level troubleshooting. Experience designing highly available distributed services with reliable state management, observability, overload protection, and failure recovery. Demonstrated ability to lead architecture and delivery across teams, resolve ambiguous requirements, communicate technical trade-offs, and mentor senior engineers. Deep knowledge of L2/L3 networking, routing and switching, software-defined networking, traffic engineering, and WAN technologies. Strong expertise in BGP and MP-BGP, IPv4/IPv6, route reflection, routing policy, and VPN address families, including practical experience with convergence and reachability troubleshooting. Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java, or C++, with experience in API design, concurrency, automated testing, and production debugging. Experience with NETCONF, Junos XML APIs, gRPC, OpenConfig, and model-driven network automation. Experience tuning containerized networking workloads, including cgroups, socket buffers, veth, and SR-IOV. Experience with infrastructure as code, automated lifecycle orchestration, and rolling upgrades for stateful services. Understanding of Clos fabrics, overlay/underlay integration, ECMP behavior, and backbone transit. Experience building distributed active measurement and telemetry systems. Experience with simulation, failure injection, or formal methods to validate complex distributed-system behavior. Experience applying traffic prediction, machine learning, or AI techniques to network optimization, anomaly detection, or operational intelligence.

jobs.description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: The ServiceNow ITOM Architect owns the architecture of PayPal’s ServiceNow IT Operations Management platform, with a focus on AIOps. The role designs how the platform discovers the estate, correlates events, and acts on them, moving IT from detecting problems to resolving them automatically, with human supervision and audit built in. This individual contributor sets ITOM and AIOps standards, owns third-level escalation, and directs the contingent-worker and vendor engineers who build. Scope spans Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and orchestration, plus the AIOps layer: alert correlation, AI agents, and observability integrations, on a CSDM-aligned CMDB. The role leads work from proof of concept to production, sets approaches other teams adopt, and judges trade-offs such as alert noise and when automation is safe. It defines the guardrails for autonomous action: what agents may do alone, what needs approval, and how every action is logged, reversible, and audit-ready. Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Acts as a project or system leader, coordinating the activities of other engineers on the project or within the system Determines the technical tasks that other engineers will follow Actions result in the achievement of customer, operational, program or service objectives Proactively improves existing structures & processes Exercises judgement in reconciling diverse and competing priorities (time, quality, complexity risk) to identify optimal solutions to problems Notices patterns and condenses repetition into densely meaningful generalized solutions Collaborates with management to set/improve standards for engineering rigor Trusted to represent PayPal, Inc to the outside world via interactions with partners, customers, or industry organizations Minimum Qualifications: 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : Your way to impact You will move PayPal's IT operations from detect-and-ticket to detect-and-fix. The architecture you set will determine how quickly issues are found, how much alert noise reaches people, and how many problems resolve without human touch, measured in mean time to detect (MTTD), mean time to resolve (MTTR), and touchless resolution. You will also define the guardrails that let AI agents act safely in production, so that automation meets PayPal's change-management, security, and audit standards, and you will set the approaches that other engineers and teams adopt. Your day to day In your day to day role you will: AIOps target architecture — Define the target-state AIOps architecture on ServiceNow: event sources and ingest, normalization, deduplication, correlation, and the hand-off from alert to incident, change, and automated remediation. Event Management from proof of concept to production — Take ServiceNow Event Management from proof of concept to production, including connector design for observability platforms (e.g., Datadog), event rules, alert thresholds, and operational runbooks. Alert correlation & noise reduction — Design rules-based and machine-learning correlation and grouping that reduce alert noise and surface probable cause, and measure their accuracy over time. AI agents for triage & remediation — Design AI agents and automated workflows that triage, enrich, and resolve alerts, defining when an agent acts on its own, when it asks a human, and how it escalates. Supervision, audit & safe automation — Build in human-in-the-loop controls, action logging, rollback, and change-management integration so that every automated action is traceable and meets security and audit requirements. CMDB & CSDM service context — Partner with the existing ITOM architect and engineers so that configuration items (CIs), relationships, and business-service maps give AIOps the context it needs, and contribute to the CSDM-aligned CMDB re-build design. Integration architecture — Design integrations between ServiceNow and monitoring, logging, cloud, and collaboration tools using IntegrationHub, REST, and streaming patterns, with the performance and resilience that enterprise scale requires. Engineering standards & technical direction — Set design patterns, coding standards, and definitions of done for AIOps work, and review the designs and code produced by contingent-worker and vendor engineers. Third-level (L3) technical ownership — Own L3 escalation for AIOps capabilities, and lead root-cause analysis when automation or correlation behaves unexpectedly. Operational outcome measurement — Define and report outcomes such as alert-to-incident ratio, noise reduction, mean time to detect (MTTD), mean time to resolve (MTTR), and the share of alerts resolved without human touch. Technology evaluation — Evaluate ServiceNow roadmap capabilities and third-party AIOps options, run proofs of concept, and recommend best practices and build-versus-buy decisions to Autonomous Operations leadership. Mentoring & knowledge sharing — Mentor engineers and administrators on ITOM, event management, and AI-agent design, and document the architecture for business, leadership, and technical audiences. What do you need to bring- 5+ years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree OR any equivalent combination of education and experience Hands-on experience designing and implementing ServiceNow ITOM at enterprise scale, including Event Management, Discovery or Service Mapping Experience integrating ServiceNow with observability and monitoring platforms (e.g., Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace, or cloud-native monitoring) Working knowledge of the CMDB and the Common Service Data Model, including CI classes, relationships, identification and reconciliation, and service maps Experience designing alert correlation, deduplication, or noise-reduction approaches and measuring their effectiveness Experience building automation and AI-assisted workflows on ServiceNow (e.g., Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Now Assist, or AI Agents) or a comparable platform Proficiency in JavaScript (ServiceNow scripting), experience using PowerShell or Bash over Secure Shell (SSH) for orchestration and discovery, plus REST API design Experience defining controls for automated actions, such as approval gates, logging, rollback, and change-management integration Experience documenting technical architecture for business stakeholders, leadership, and engineers Ability to work effectively in a global team and to influence engineers and vendors without formal reporting authority Preferred qualifications ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in Event Management, Discovery, or Service Mapping; ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in Data Foundations; ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) Experience with dedicated AIOps platforms (e.g., ServiceNow Health Log Analytics, BigPanda, or Moogsoft) Experience applying large language models (LLMs) or agentic AI to IT operations, including tool design, evaluation, and guardrails Cloud or reliability credentials, such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure certifications Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) 4 Foundation or higher **We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. jobs.description: Overview: As a data engineering lead, you will be the key technical expert overseeing PepsiCo's data product build & operations and drive a strong vision for how data engineering can proactively create a positive impact on the business. You'll be empowered to create & lead a strong team of data engineers who build data pipelines into various source systems, rest data on the PepsiCo Data Lake, and enable exploration and access for analytics, visualization, machine learning, and product development efforts across the company. As a member of the data engineering team, you will help lead the development of very large and complex data applications into public cloud environments directly impacting the design, architecture, and implementation of PepsiCo's flagship data products around topics like revenue management, supply chain, manufacturing, and logistics. Act as a subject matter expert across different digital projects. Oversee work with internal clients and external partners to structure and store data into unified taxonomies and link them together with standard identifiers. Manage and scale data pipelines from internal and external data sources to support new product launches and drive data quality across data products. Build and own the automation and monitoring frameworks that captures metrics and operational KPIs for data pipeline quality and performance. Responsible for implementing best practices around systems integration, security, performance, and data management. Empower the business by creating value through the increased adoption of data, data science and business intelligence landscape. Collaborate with internal clients (data science and product teams) to drive solutioning and POC discussions. Evolve the architectural capabilities and maturity of the data platform by engaging with enterprise architects and strategic internal and external partners. Develop and optimize procedures to productionize data science models. Define and manage SLA’s for data products and processes running in production. Support large-scale experimentation done by data scientists. Prototype new approaches and build solutions at scale. Research in state-of-the-art methodologies. Create documentation for learnings and knowledge transfer. Create and audit reusable packages or libraries. Qualifications: 10+ years of overall technology experience that includes at least 5+ years of hands-on software development, data engineering, and systems architecture. 4+ years of experience with Data Lake Infrastructure, Data Warehousing, and Data Analytics tools. 4+ years of experience in SQL optimization and performance tuning, and development experience in programming languages like Python, PySpark, Scala etc.). 4+ years in cloud data engineering experience in Azure/AWS. Fluent with Azure cloud services. Azure Certification is a plus. Fluent in integrating LLM APIs into data applications and orchestrating Agentic AI workflows into full stack apps (backend and frontend). Experience with integration of multi cloud services with on-premises technologies. Experience with data modelling, data warehousing, and building high-volume ETL/ELT pipelines. Experience building/operating highly available, distributed systems of data extraction, ingestion, and processing of large data sets. Experience with at least one MPP database technology such as Databricks, Redshift, Synapse or Snowflake. Familiarity with business intelligence tools (such as PowerBI). Skills, Abilities, Knowledge: Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, along with the ability to influence and demonstrate confidence in communications with senior level management. Proven track record of leading, mentoring data teams. Strong change manager. Comfortable with change, especially that which arises through company growth. Ability to understand and translate business requirements into data and technical requirements. High degree of organization and ability to manage multiple, competing projects and priorities simultaneously. Positive and flexible attitude to enable adjusting to different needs in an ever-changing environment. Strong leadership, organizational and interpersonal skills; comfortable managing trade-offs. Foster a team culture of accountability, communication, and self-management. Proactively drives impact and engagement while bringing others along. Consistently attain/exceed individual and team goals. Ability to lead others without direct authority in a matrixed environment.

jobs.description: Who Are We? Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster. The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman. The Opportunity Search Team at Postman is responsible for enabling users to quickly find and get started with the APIs that they are looking for. Postman is growing at a rapid pace, and this manifests into an ever-increasing volume of data that users create and consume, within their teams and in the Public API Network. We focus on improving discovery and ease of consumption over this data. We are looking for a Senior Engineer with 6+ years of experience deep backend expertise on search and ETL systems and a strong product mindset, to lead core initiatives on our search platform. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of infrastructure, relevance, and developer experience—designing systems that power search across the platform. You’ll bring a bias for action, a strong backend foundation, and the curiosity to explore beyond traditional boundaries, including areas like high performance web services, high volume data pipelines, machine learning, and relevance tuning. What You'll Do Own end to end architecture and roadmap of search platform consisting of distributed indexing pipelines, storage infra and high performance web servers. Contribute to improving relevance of search results through signal engineering and better data models. Keep the system performant and reliable to handle growing data volume and query traffic, while unblocking business requirements and managing risk. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders like Product Managers, Designers, as well as other teams to drive initiatives. Uphold operational excellence in the team, showing a bias for action and user empathy. Quickly build functional prototypes to solve internal and external use-cases. Scale the technical abilities of engineers in the team and uphold quality through code reviews and mentorship. About You You have 6+ years of experience building applications in high level programming languages - Javascript, Python, Java etc. We code primarily in Python and Javascript. You have worked on customer facing search solutions and have hands-on experience with search systems like ElasticSearch/Apache Solr/OpenSearch. Experience building systems to orchestrate batch and streaming pipelines using Apache Kafka, Kinesis, Lambdas. Knowledge of compute engine/data processing engine like Apache Spark/ Apache Flink/ Ray. You are an excellent communicator who can articulate technical concepts to product managers, designers, support and other engineers. What Else? We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. At Postman we value in person collaboration. Agents: MCP servers, ACP patterns, A2A (Agent‑to‑Agent) communication, tool/plugin ecosystems, vector DBs, function calling. GCP: IAM, KMS, VPC‑SC, Vertex AI, Cloud Armor, Audit Logs. OCI: IAM, Vault, Service Gateway, Data Science, Logging & Events. Security engineering proficiency: Zero Trust, policy‑as‑code (OPA/Conftest), secrets management (HashiCorp Vault), container security, SBOMs, SLSA, Sigstore. AI/LLM stack knowledge: RAG patterns, vector databases (Pinecone/Weaviate/FAISS), prompt engineering, guardrails (e.g., policy filtering), evaluation frameworks, agent orchestration (MCP/ACP/A2A, function/tool calling). Threat modeling and offensive testing for AI systems, including prompt injection and agent misuse. Strong understanding of privacy and compliance impacting AI (GDPR, CCPA, GLBA, sector‑specific regs). And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. The Experience We are seeking a lead full stack engineer with enterprise software engineering experience to drive the architecture, technical roadmap, and execution for our next-generation Security Assurance Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform. In this role, you will hold end-to-end technical ownership over the platform’s core engines—including policy as code, compliance as code, automated evidence collection, telemetry and alerting, and risk evaluation modules. Beyond hands-on development in Python, Java, and modern front-end frameworks, you will act as a primary technical leader: defining system architecture, scoping and planning multi-quarter technical initiatives, and guiding distributed feature teams from concept through deployment. You will also pioneer the team’s operational strategy around AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) to accelerate output and elevate code quality across the engineering organization. What You'll Actually Be Doing End-to-End Ownership: Take technical ownership of complex, multi-system initiatives, driving architectural decisions, technical specifications, phase planning, and execution across the delivery lifecycle. Architecture & System Design: Architect resilient, cloud-native microservice architectures that process large-scale compliance telemetry, support automated evidence ingestion, and execute low-latency risk evaluation engines. Roadmap & Project Planning: Partner with Product Management, Security Architects, and GRC leaders to translate broad business and regulatory strategies into detailed technical roadmaps, milestones, and sprint backlogs. Technical Governance: Establish engineering standards, perform high-impact code and architecture reviews, enforce secure coding guidelines, and institute rigorous CI/CD and testing benchmarks across the engineering org. Policy & Governance as Code: Design and implement extensible Policy as Code and Compliance as Code engines (e.g., leveraging Open Policy Agent/OPA or custom evaluation frameworks) and runtime platforms (e.g. CSPM, EDR, etc) that dynamically audit infrastructure and enterprise controls. Constrain the outputs of AI coding assistants with declarative machine-readable rules. jobs.description: Job Description: JOB DESCRIPTION Principal, Product Architect – Digital/IIoT Engineering CoE · Digital/IIoT offer · India Reports to Head of Engineering - Education Segment Business Schneider Electric · Education Equipment and Services Location Bangalore, India, with travel across India and the segment's markets Scope Global: technical ownership of the Digital/IIoT offer – IIoT Supervision Development & Predictive Maintenance, OT Cyber Security, and the digital layer across the portfolio (energy-management software, AR/MR, cloud dashboards, SCADA and connected equipment) About the Education Segment Schneider Electric's Education Segment provides technical training solutions that close the skills gap in energy, automation and digital technologies. We equip technical and vocational institutes, universities, government skilling programmes and industry academies with hands-on training labs, curricula, digital learning, train-the-trainer programmes and certification. Demand is rising fast. Governments are investing heavily in workforce skilling, industry faces acute technician shortages, and the energy transition and smart manufacturing need new skills at scale. The segment has already helped more than 200,000 young people gain job-ready skills. We are now building a dedicated, multi-country organisation to grow the business across six markets, with its own business development, engineering and delivery teams. Engineering is at the heart of what we offer: training solutions built on real industrial technology. Purpose of the role Lead, maintain and grow the Education Segment's Digital/IIoT offer: the hands-on lab equipment, software and learning content that teach Industrial IoT, data-driven and predictive maintenance, augmented and mixed reality, and OT cybersecurity. As the technical owner of the offer, you will keep today's Digital Blocks safe, secure, compliant, available and relevant in every target market, and build the next generation of digital training solutions with Schneider Electric's digital, automation and cybersecurity businesses. You will also set the digital architecture used across the Smart Energy, Smart Buildings and Smart Factory offers, and lead the Digital/IIoT product architecture team in the India Engineering CoE. Market overview Industry 4.0, connected energy systems and smart buildings are changing the skills industry needs. Employers need technicians and engineers who can connect equipment, work with live data, run predictive maintenance and protect operational technology from cyber attack, and few training systems teach these skills well today. Institutions want digital labs that use real industrial hardware and software, link the shop floor to cloud dashboards and AR/MR tools, and address the growing need for OT cybersecurity skills. Schneider Electric's EcoStruxure platform and industrial cybersecurity portfolio put the segment in a strong position to meet that need. Key responsibilities Digital/IIoT offer leadership and roadmap Own the 2026–2030 Digital/IIoT technical and offer roadmap, aligned to market needs and Schneider Electric business roadmaps in industrial automation, digital energy, software and cybersecurity. Act as the principal technical authority for Digital/IIoT architectures, network and cloud design, data models, software stacks, specifications and interfaces. Define the common digital architecture and connectivity standards used across the Smart Energy, Smart Buildings and Smart Factory offers. Prioritise roadmap investment with regional business leaders by institution, employer and market needs. Maintain the current offer Manage the lifecycle of all Digital/IIoT references, including the IIoT Digital Box, Sensor Pack for IIoT, PNC Application for IIoT and the OT Cyber Security bench. Manage software and licence lifecycles, including energy-management subscriptions, PLC, HMI and drive configuration tools, AR/MR software and firewall services: versions, compatibility, renewals and end-of-support. Handle hardware obsolescence, component substitution, firmware and patch management, and change notices before they affect orders. Keep data sheets, network diagrams, user manuals, lab guides and installation instructions accurate and current. Run a closed field-feedback loop with delivery teams and service partners to root-cause issues, cut rework and release fixes. Grow the offer Partner with Schneider Electric businesses to design new and upgraded digital modules on their latest technology. Bring emerging technology into training, such as edge computing, industrial data analytics, AI and machine learning for maintenance, digital twins, private 5G and advanced OT security operations. Lead make-or-buy and partner decisions with technology and software partners, and build business cases based on market value, reuse and lifecycle economics. Adapt the offer for new markets and customer segments, from engineering universities to vocational institutes and industry academies. Cybersecurity and data protection Build secure-by-design practice into every connected product in the portfolio, in line with standards such as IEC 62443. Define secure network architectures, user access, data-privacy and cloud-connection rules for lab equipment installed at institutions. Manage vulnerabilities and security updates across the installed base with the relevant Schneider Electric product security teams. Industrialisation and availability Work with the Industrialization Leader and Global Supply Chain to take new modules from design and prototype through pilot runs to stable production. Design for modularity, localisation, cost and supply resilience across hardware, software and licences. Make sure every Digital/IIoT product is available in all target countries, built to local standards and network rules, and backed by spare parts and support. Curriculum and digital learning Align each module with learning objectives, competencies, national curricula and qualification frameworks (TVET, ITI, Diploma, Engineering) with curriculum experts and academic partners. Lead digital learning features such as remote labs, simulation, AR/MR content and learner-progress tracking across the portfolio. Standards, certification and market launch Ensure electrical safety, product compliance, radio and cybersecurity requirements are met, with the Design for Safety & Reliability and Conformity Assessment leads. Launch new and localised Digital/IIoT solutions on the roadmap timeline, with standard installation, commissioning, network set-up and training packages for delivery teams. Support pre-sales, prescription and tendering with technical answers, IT/OT network requirements, lab layouts and solution sizing. Lead the Digital/IIoT team Hire, lead and develop the Senior Engineer, Product Architect – Digital/IIoT, and grow the team as the offer scales. Apply the CoE's product development process, design reviews, release gates and lifecycle management in the Digital/IIoT domain, including software release management. Train internal teams, partners and trainers on the Digital/IIoT offer and build a culture of quality, security and reuse. Success measures Measure Target Roadmap delivery New and upgraded Digital/IIoT modules launched on the roadmap timeline Offer growth Rising Digital/IIoT revenue and share of pipeline supported by new or upgraded modules Digital across the portfolio Common digital architecture adopted across Smart Energy, Smart Buildings and Smart Factory offers Offer health Hardware, software and licences current, with obsolescence and end-of-support resolved before they affect orders Cybersecurity Connected products secure by design, with vulnerabilities patched across the installed base Quality High first-pass validation, low field defects and strong institution feedback Team build Digital/IIoT team staffed, skilled and performing Key relationships Internal: Head of Engineering; Industrialization Leader; Principal, Design for Safety & Reliability; Principal, Conformity Assessment; peer Product Architects (Smart Energy, Smart Buildings, Data Centers); Technical Specialists – Digital/IIoT and the operations centres; pre-sales, tendering, sales and marketing teams; Schneider Electric digital, automation, software and cybersecurity businesses and Global Supply Chain. External: universities, vocational education bodies and curriculum experts; technology, cloud, AR/MR and cybersecurity partners; OEMs, manufacturing partners and suppliers; certification and standards bodies. Candidate profile 12+ years in product development, R&D, systems architecture or solution engineering in Industrial IoT, industrial automation, digital or OT systems. Critical: deep hands-on expertise in IIoT architectures: sensors and wireless networks, gateways and edge devices, industrial protocols (Modbus, Ethernet/IP, OPC UA, MQTT), cloud dashboards and industrial data. Strong working knowledge of OT cybersecurity (IEC 62443, firewalls, managed switches, network segmentation) and of PLC, HMI and SCADA systems. Familiarity with predictive maintenance, data analytics and AR/MR or digital-twin tools; experience with Schneider Electric EcoStruxure is an advantage. Experience with training or educational equipment, or with academic partnerships, is a strong plus. Experience leading or mentoring engineers, ideally across locations. jobs.title: Staff AI Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Services ( Bangalore/Noida)
jobs.description: Our Purpose At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here. About Us SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters. Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity. What Are We Looking For? We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. As a Staff AI Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Services, you will be tasked with taking ownership of our AI Gateway infrastructure (built on Kong AI Gateway), the system that authenticates, routes, rate-limits, and monitors AI coding assistant traffic org-wide, while also being fluent enough across our broader platform stack to design solutions that span the two. This is a high-autonomy, high-scope role: you will set technical direction for AI infrastructure, drive incident response and reliability work, and partner closely with the engineers who own our CI/CD, GitOps, and artifact systems rather than working in isolation from them. What Will You Do? Primary responsibilities include: Work on the AI Gateway platform: architect, harden, and scale our Kong AI Gateway deployment (Konnect Hybrid on KCP/EKS), including auth (Okta/OIDC), consumer tiers and budgets, rate limiting, semantic caching, and observability. Lead reliability and incident response: drive root-cause analysis and remediation for gateway issues (timeouts, latency, capacity, failover) and build the monitoring and alerting needed to catch them before users do. Design across the platform, not just the gateway: work fluently with our CI/CD (Jenkins, JPAAS), GitOps and Kubernetes deployment tooling (ArgoCD across dev, gov, and prod), artifact management (Artifactory/Xray), GitHub Enterprise administration, and GitHub Actions runner fleet, so that AI infrastructure decisions account for how the rest of the platform actually works. Evaluate and roll out AI developer tooling: run structured pilots and adoption efforts for tools like AI-assisted PR review (Qodo) and engineering metrics platforms (LinearB), and make clear build-versus-buy recommendations. Set technical direction and mentor: define architecture and standards for AI infrastructure, review designs across the team, and raise the bar for other engineers working in this space. Partner cross-functionally: work directly with security, DevEx, and product engineering teams consuming the gateway to translate their needs into platform capabilities. Host and serve local models: stand up and operate self-hosted and open-weight model serving infrastructure (for example vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/NIM, TGI, and Ollama) for workloads where routing to an external provider is not the right fit, including GPU capacity planning, autoscaling, and cost and performance tuning. Support the broader model lifecycle: help build LLMOps practices such as model versioning, evaluation, and safe rollout, plus supporting infrastructure for retrieval-augmented generation (vector stores and embedding pipelines) as use cases mature. Track usage and cost: build observability into token usage, latency, and spend across both API-based and self-hosted models so the business can see what AI infrastructure actually costs. What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring? Ideal candidates will have: 10- 12 years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering, with a track record of owning systems end to end in production. Hands-on experience with API gateway technologies (Kong, Envoy, Apigee, or similar); direct experience with AI and LLM gateway patterns (rate limiting, semantic caching, prompt and response observability) is a strong plus. Strong Kubernetes and GitOps experience (ArgoCD or comparable), and comfort operating across multiple environments (dev, gov, and prod). Solid CI/CD background: Jenkins pipeline design and administration, build infrastructure, and runner and agent fleet management (GitHub Actions runners or equivalent). Experience with artifact and package management systems (Artifactory, Xray, or similar) and source control platform administration (GitHub Enterprise). Working knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform) and cloud platforms (AWS/EKS). Experience deploying and operating self-hosted LLM inference stacks (vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/NIM, TGI, Ollama, or similar) and GPU-backed infrastructure, including Kubernetes GPU scheduling and autoscaling. Familiarity with LLMOps practices: model versioning, evaluation harnesses, and usage and cost observability across API-based and self-hosted models. Track record of setting technical direction, driving cross-team initiatives, and mentoring other engineers; this role has significant scope and minimal day-to-day oversight. Clear, proactive communication skills, with the ability to explain infrastructure trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. Experience operating LLM and AI-assisted developer tooling at scale (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) inside an enterprise is preferred. Familiarity with Okta/OIDC and enterprise auth patterns for internal platforms is preferred. Experience with engineering productivity metrics tooling (LinearB or similar) and AI-based code review tooling (Qodo or similar) is preferred. Experience with vector databases and RAG pipelines (for example Milvus, Pinecone, pgvector, or similar) in a production setting is preferred. Exposure to model fine-tuning or lightweight training pipelines (LoRA/QLoRA or similar) for domain-specific model adaptation is preferred. Why SentinelOne? AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place. We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family: Equity & Rewards Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) Time Off & Wellbeing Competitive leave benefits Gender-neutral parental leave Insurance & Financial Security Medical and insurance benefits Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Work Perks & Flexibility Global home office allowance Internet allowance LinkedIn Learning license Social Connect program Food allowance (Bangalore office) Meal vouchers (Sodexo) Wellness & Lifestyle Health & wellness benefit SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles. To learn more about how we use AI in our hiring process, please review our AI in Hiring Candidate Disclosure.

This encompasses a wide range of financial products ranging from Foreign exchange to complex Equity Derivatives that are traded in financial markets across the globe 24/7. IT systems are integral to the business and are a key part of the value proposition to clients. These IT systems range from industry standard products for standard process automation to internally developed, often, market leading IT applications. The IT teams owning these IT systems are made up of functions that include Technical and Application production support, Business Analysis & Project Management, Development & Maintenance and Quality Control. BNP Paribas India Solutions is an equal partner in these IT functions along with colleagues in other locations including Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Singapore & Hong Kong. This partnership ranges from sharing the IT work load, executing global strategy to owning global applications offshore. The technology and engineering landscape is wide, encompassing almost all techniques and platforms. It continues to evolve and transform with the market with the business continuing to invest in it. Position Purpose The AI Engineer will design, build and deploy production-grade data and AI solutions. The role combines strong Python and data engineering fundamentals (ETL, relational databases, REST APIs) with hands-on development of AI capabilities such as LLM-powered applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and agentic workflows. The position requires working in a virtual team and international environment and is multidisciplinary in nature. It involves coordination with other locations and divisions of BNP Paribas as necessary. The candidate should have strong engineering discipline, a problem-solving mindset and the ability to turn business requirements into reliable, secure and scalable solutions. Responsibilities Direct Responsibilities Design, develop and maintain scalable Python applications and data pipelines using Pandas for data extraction, transformation and loading (ETL). Build and expose secure, well-documented REST APIs using FastAPI, applying data validation (e.g. Pydantic) and API best practices. Write efficient SQL and work with relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server, including data modelling, query optimization and performance tuning. Containerize applications using Docker and support deployment across development, test and production environments. Develop Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions – LLM-based applications, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or CrewAI. Integrate Large Language Models through provider APIs (e.g. OpenAI / Azure OpenAI) and open-source models (e.g. Hugging Face), applying prompt engineering, structured outputs and function / tool calling. Build natural-language interfaces to data (e.g. Text-to-SQL agents) that allow business users to query databases in plain English. Automate business workflows by combining AI capabilities with APIs, scheduling / workflow tools (e.g. n8n) and messaging integrations. Integrate AI solutions with enterprise data sources and tools, including vector databases and Model Context Protocol (MCP) based tool integrations. Implement LLM observability, tracing and evaluation (e.g. Langfuse) to monitor quality, cost, latency and reliability of AI applications. Develop, train and evaluate Machine Learning models where appropriate, using libraries such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow and NumPy. Follow sound engineering practices: version control with Git, code reviews, unit / integration testing and clear technical documentation. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions / Jenkins) and support deployment of AI services on on-premise or cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure). Translate business requirements into technical designs and work closely with business users, data teams and other stakeholders throughout implementation and delivery. Contributing Responsibilities Contribute to the design of reusable components, frameworks and best practices for data engineering and AI development within the team. Ensure solutions comply with the Group’s standards on data security, privacy, Responsible AI, risk and compliance. Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement, and propose AI-driven solutions. Participate in knowledge sharing, mentoring and cross-training to build AI capabilities within the team. Stay up to date with the evolving AI / LLM ecosystem and assess new tools and techniques for adoption. Technical & Behavioral Competencies Strong programming skills in Python, with hands-on experience in data manipulation and analysis using Pandas. Solid working knowledge of SQL and relational databases – Oracle / PostgreSQL / MS SQL Server. Experience designing and building REST APIs, preferably with FastAPI. Good understanding of ETL concepts, data pipelines, data quality and data integration. Practical experience with Docker and Git based development workflows. Exposure to LLM APIs (OpenAI / Azure OpenAI), Hugging Face models, prompt engineering, LLM application frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI), RAG pipelines, vector databases and LLM observability tools (e.g. Langfuse) is a strong plus. Familiarity with ClickHouse, front-end frameworks (React / Angular), Machine Learning libraries (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, NumPy), CI/CD and cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure) is an added advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail; ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Specific Qualifications Minimum 7 years of hands-on experience in Python development / data engineering, with Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience. Hands-on experience building or contributing to AI / LLM based applications (Generative AI, RAG, Agentic AI) will be preferred. Prior experience in the Banking / Financial Services domain is desirable. Technical Skills Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities) Must Have Python Pandas Oracle / PostgreSQL / MS SQL Server REST API FastAPI Docker Git ETL Concepts Good to Have ClickHouse React / Angular Agentic AI – LangGraph, CrewAI, LangChain LLM APIs – OpenAI / Azure OpenAI; Prompt Engineering Hugging Face (open-source LLMs, embeddings) Text-to-SQL / Natural-language data querying agents LLM Observability – Langfuse Model Context Protocol (MCP) RAG Pipelines and Vector Databases Machine Learning – Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, NumPy Pydantic Workflow Automation – n8n CI/CD – GitHub Actions / Jenkins Cloud Platforms – AWS / GCP / Azure Behavioral Skills Communication skills – oral & written Analytical Ability Problem Solving / Critical Thinking Team Player / Ability to collaborate Ability to deliver / Results driven Adaptability and continuous learning Education Level: Bachelor Degree or equivalent (B.E. / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc. in Computer Science, IT or related field) Location: Mumbai About BNP Paribas Group BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability. About BNP Paribas India Solutions Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. jobs.title: Software Engineer : AI
jobs.description: Summary Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless. Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here. AI & Data Platforms (AiDP) is IS&T's engine for AI-powered innovation. The team brings together data, application development, and machine learning - including generative AI - along with data services and customer success functions, to help IS&T build solutions more efficiently and streamline the adoption and embedding of generative AI across Apple. Description The Enterprise Data warehouse team within AiDP deals with Petabytes of data catering to a wide variety of real- time, near real-time and batch pipelines and data centric agentic solutions on these data assets. These solutions are integral part of business functions like Retail, Sales, Operations, Finance, AppleCare, Marketing and Internet Services, enabling business drivers to make critical decisions. You should be able to (i) understand a business challenge, (ii) Collaborate with business and other cross functional teams (ii) design a statistical or deep learning solution to find the needed answer to it, (iii) developing it by yourself or guide another person to do it, (iv) deliver the outcome into production, (v) Keep a good governance of your work. There are massive opportunities for you deliver impactful influences to Apple. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, with 1+ years in software and applied AI/ML engineering Programming proficiency in Python or Java Experience building GenAI-powered applications, including RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search integrated with structured/unstructured enterprise data Practical experience building AI agents or agentic workflows (planning, memory, tool use, execution loops) using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar. Preferred Qualifications Full-stack application development experience - able to design and ship end-to-end data/AI products spanning backend APIs, data services, and front-end/UI layers Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into scalable technical designs, and take solutions from prototype to production with attention to governance, reliability, and observability Strong collaboration and communication skills to work across cross-functional business and engineering teams, technical and non-technical alike Experience building multi-agent systems/agentic workflows that autonomously coordinate retrieval, reasoning, and action steps across a data pipeline Experience with cloud data platforms and cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure — AWS preferred), along with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow for model training and serving Experience with modern front-end/full-stack frameworks (e.g., React, Streamlit, FastAPI) for rapidly building internal data/AI-powered applications and dashboards Track record of brainstorming and shipping POCs using AI/ML/GenAI services to solve new or existing enterprise problems, with the ability to manage partner communications and ambiguity in a fast-changing, matrixed environment Prior experience in enterprise domains such as Retail, Finance, Sales, Marketing, or Operations analytics is a plus At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. jobs.description: Job Description Description of Product Oracle Integration is a strategic cloud integration platform that connects applications, data, APIs, and business processes across cloud and on-premises environments. Built on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), it provides the integration foundation for next-generation Oracle Health products, enabling secure healthcare data exchange, interoperability, and connected workflows, while supporting mission-critical integration needs for Oracle’s global enterprise customers. Description Of Role We are looking for a software engineer to build secure, scalable, and highly available cloud-native services that address the complex integration needs of modern healthcare. You will develop reusable Oracle Integration capabilities across connectivity, APIs, data transformation, security, lifecycle automation, observability, and reliability. Your work will enable Oracle Health products to integrate with healthcare systems using FHIR and other standards, while ensuring these platform capabilities remain extensible and valuable to OIC’s broader commercial customer base. This role combines distributed-systems and integration-platform engineering with the opportunity to solve demanding, real-world interoperability challenges. You will own features throughout their lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support. You will collaborate with product managers, architects, and engineering teams across Oracle Integration, OCI, and Oracle Health to turn diverse integration requirements into durable platform capabilities. This is an opportunity to shape a core OCI service, influence the integration architecture of emerging Oracle Health solutions, and deliver capabilities used by enterprises worldwide. Responsibilities RESPONSIBILITIES Build and operate the secure, scalable integration services on OCI that power next-generation Oracle Health products and mission-critical business processes for enterprise customers worldwide. Shape reusable Oracle Integration platform capabilities that address demanding healthcare interoperability requirements while serving OIC’s broader commercial customer base. Design highly available, fault-tolerant, and multi-tenant services that reliably move critical healthcare and enterprise data across cloud, private, and on-premises environments. Enable Oracle Health products to exchange data and orchestrate workflows across EHRs, healthcare applications, providers, payers, and health information networks using FHIR and other interoperability standards. Connect Oracle and third-party SaaS applications, enterprise systems, databases, messaging platforms, and APIs across OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP. Develop reusable capabilities for connectivity, API enablement, data transformation, authentication, authorization, private network access, and integration lifecycle management. Build and enhance adapters, connectors, runtime services, SDK components, APIs, and developer experiences that accelerate integration delivery across Oracle. Develop distributed Java-based microservices on OCI using Docker, Kubernetes/OKE, and Helm, following API-first and cloud-native engineering principles. Own platform components and features from inception through architecture, implementation, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and post-production support. Protect the availability, security, performance, and integrity of mission-critical integrations through resilience engineering, capacity planning, observability, automation, and continuous delivery. Investigate complex customer and production issues across distributed service dependencies, perform root-cause analysis, and deliver durable, compatibility-safe improvements. Turn Oracle Health requirements, enterprise customer feedback, and operational learnings into extensible platform capabilities rather than use-case-specific solutions. Experience with frameworks and tools such as Micronaut or Spring Boot, Maven or Gradle, Git. Experience with cloud-native development and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Understanding of scalability, high availability, fault tolerance, concurrency, security, and multi-tenant cloud architecture. Knowledge of API-first development using REST, OpenAPI, and API lifecycle and versioning practices. Experience diagnosing complex issues across distributed services using logs, metrics, traces, and other observability tools. Ability to take ownership of features through design, implementation, release, and production support. Strong analytical, problem-solving, written communication, and cross-team collaboration skills. Ability to learn unfamiliar business domains and translate specialized requirements into secure, extensible, and reusable platform capabilities. Ability to innovate and deliver high-quality software in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment. Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of enterprise integration platforms, iPaaS, API management, adapters, connectors, or integration runtimes. Experience integrating SaaS applications, enterprise systems, databases, messaging platforms, and on-premises endpoints. Knowledge of authentication and authorization technologies such as OAuth 2.0, JWT, and identity and access management. Knowledge of healthcare interoperability, including FHIR, HL7, MLLP, or healthcare data exchange, is desirable but not required. Production Operations and Reliability Experience troubleshooting production software and investigating service failures. Strong root-cause-analysis and problem-solving skills. Ability to collaborate with Support and Operations teams during incidents and service improvements. Familiarity with monitoring, alerts, logs, and operational diagnostics. AI Assisted Engineering and Collaboration Ability and willingness to use Codex or comparable agentic development tools as part of everyday engineering work, while independently validating generated results. Ability to work effectively in an Agile development environment. Strong technical communication, documentation, collaboration, and continuous-improvement skills. Good to Have Experience developing commercial software products that process large data volumes in highly available distributed environments. Hands-on experience with Terraform or comparable infrastructure-as-code technologies. Expertise in one or more public cloud platforms: OCI, AWS, Azure, or GCP. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: About the Company At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we build and operate the cloud infrastructure that powers enterprise applications and workloads. Our engineers solve challenging problems across compute, networking, storage and distributed systems. Host Provisioning Services (HoPS) builds the software that turns physical servers in our data centres into reliable, customer-ready cloud infrastructure. Our services automate server provisioning, configuration, validation, firmware management and recovery. We also enable the introduction of new hardware from companies such as NVIDIA and AMD. About the Role We are looking for a hands-on Principal Software Engineer to design, build and operate backend services that support the lifecycle of OCI’s server fleet. You will work at the intersection of distributed software, infrastructure automation and Linux systems. The role involves designing reliable workflows, supporting new hardware platforms and solving production problems across service and system boundaries. We value engineers who take ownership beyond their immediate tasks: identifying issues, understanding their wider impact and following them through to a lasting solution. You do not need deep firmware expertise to join the team; strong software engineering foundations, curiosity and a willingness to learn are key. Our primary development language is Java. We package services with Docker, deploy using Terraform and monitor service health through Grafana and other observability tools. Responsibilities Design, develop and maintain distributed backend services for server provisioning, configuration, validation, firmware management and recovery. Own substantial components from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment and production operation. Build automation that handles failures, timeouts, retries and concurrent operations safely. Develop services that support new hardware platforms and reliable firmware updates across server fleets. Improve service reliability, scalability, performance and operability. Investigate complex production issues across applications, Linux, networking, storage and hardware. Develop automated tests, validate failure scenarios and plan controlled rollouts with clear recovery procedures. Participate in on-call support, incident investigation and root-cause analysis, and deliver permanent fixes. Collaborate across teams on architecture, service dependencies and technical trade-offs. Provide technical guidance, share knowledge and help other engineers solve difficult problems. Qualifications, Skills and Experience Strong hands-on experience designing, developing and maintaining production backend software, with proficiency in Java or a comparable programming language. Experience building and operating distributed systems or infrastructure services. Understanding of reliable workflow design, including failure handling, retries, recovery and concurrent operations. Experience with Linux and troubleshooting problems using logs, metrics and diagnostic tools. Experience automating infrastructure provisioning, configuration, upgrades, validation or recovery. Sound engineering practices across automated testing, code reviews, integration testing and safe production deployments. Demonstrated ability to own technical decisions and independently deliver substantial components or services. Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams. A proactive approach to production ownership and a willingness to investigate issues beyond an assigned task. Additional experience that would be valuable: Cloud control planes, orchestration, Kubernetes operators, distributed storage or fleet management. Docker, Terraform, Grafana, Python or similar development and infrastructure tools. Server provisioning, firmware automation, BIOS/BMC, Redfish/IPMI or hardware validation. GPU, NIC/SmartNIC or NVMe platforms. Technical mentoring and architecture ownership across services or teams.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: Our Mission At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place. Who We Are In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. Job Summary Job Description We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to drive technical execution and contribute to the ongoing evolution of our platform. In this role, you will take technical ownership of core platform components, translate ambiguous feature requirements into clean, scalable software, and leverage AI-first development workflows to accelerate delivery and elevate code quality. You will serve as a key technical anchor—designing modular systems, optimizing workflows, and ensuring production reliability. What You’ll Do Drive End-to-End Feature Delivery: Take ownership of complex feature sets and components. Break down ambiguous requirements into execution-ready tasks, estimate work accurately, and reliably deliver high-quality solutions end-to-end. Implement AI-First Engineering Practices: Apply high AI tool fluency and prompt engineering to streamline daily development. Rigorously review and validate AI-generated code to prevent security gaps, logic defects, and hallucinations before committing. Design for Extensibility & Modularity: Propose clean feature designs and API interfaces using standard architectural patterns. Write modular, testable code that gracefully balances performance, reliability, and maintainability. Practice Defensive & Secure Engineering: Anticipate edge cases (limits, nulls, complex authorization paths) early in the development cycle. Write integration tests and defensive logic to lower defect escape rates. Translate Requirements into Intuitive Workflows: Partner closely with Product and Design to understand user scenarios, clarify acceptance criteria early, and build seamless frontend and backend implementations that reduce friction. Maintain Production Service Excellence: Act as a champion for component health. Actively participate in root cause analysis (RCA) on production incidents, implement durable fixes, and reduce MTTR. Foster Team Capability & Knowledge Sharing: Share technical learnings, document tribal knowledge, and author "RAG-ready" technical notes. Write clear RFCs and tickets to keep partners informed and help uplevel peer engineers. Nice to Have Identity & Access Security Domain: Experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms. Modern Frontend & Quality Tooling: Fluency in TypeScript along with automated testing frameworks such as Jest, Playwright, or JMeter for load/stress testing. DevOps & Observability Ecosystems: Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, feature flagging tools, and modern monitoring/logging frameworks. Context Engineering & Retrieval: Experience structuring codebase documentation and architecture for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and reusable prompt templating. Impact As a Staff Software Engineer , you will be a vital technical anchor for your team. By combining hands-on technical execution, modular design, and AI-first workflows, you will turn product goals into secure, scalable, and maintainable capabilities. Your success will be measured by the reliability of the software you deliver, the operational health of your services, and your ability to elevate the velocity and engineering standards of your immediate team. Qualifications Qualifications Relevant Experience: 2–5 years of professional software engineering experience building, shipping, and maintaining production-grade applications. Full-Stack Proficiency: Hands-on experience building enterprise-grade applications using the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js). Cloud Infrastructure Experience: Practical experience building, deploying, and operating scalable solutions within the AWS ecosystem. AI Tooling & Code Verification: Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools and prompt engineering, paired with peer-review rigor to verify AI outputs for correctness, safety, and security. Feature Design & System Refactoring: Solid foundation in designing clean APIs, refactoring component code bases, and applying standard design patterns for long-term maintainability. Operational Ownership & Testing: Strong debugging skills with experience in writing robust tests (unit/integration), participating in RCA processes, and resolving production issues. Navigating Ambiguity & Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to clarify requirements, adapt technical tactics as priorities shift, raise blockers early, and collaborate effectively with PM, Design, and engineering peers. Our Commitment We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com. Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship?
