jobs.title: Lead Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution. Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow. From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia. Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently. Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region. We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia. But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future. About The Role A Lead Software Development Engineer (Lead SDE) at Razorpay is a well-grounded, innovative, quality-focused product thinker and business-conscious engineer - not a mere coder. Armed with deep technical context and extensive experience, you will build production-grade, highly scalable software and see nuances and edge cases that others might overlook. At our scale, engineering creates a massive impact across global digital payments. Beyond technical excellence, you are expected to operate with a strong ownership mindset in ambiguous environments, act as a technical leader, mentor peers, and actively influence and shape Razorpay’s culture in the right way. What You Will Build Architecture & Design Thinking: Drive ambiguous requirements into clean, low-level designs (LLD) with clear interfaces, data flows, and non-functional requirements (NFRs) before execution. Engineering Leadership & AI Augmentation: Act as the "tech lead of an AI agent loop". Lead development by utilizing AI-augmented workflows and engineering assistants strategically—handling prompt decomposition, constraint management, and rigorous code validation. Scalable Systems Delivery: Build full-fledged applications and payment infrastructure from scratch, driving features to completion. Transition systems seamlessly across complex architectural scales. Code Quality & Integrity: Maintain high-quality implementation standards with clean abstractions, SOLID principles, and modular, maintainable code. Take full ownership of all code codebases, performing independent navigation, debugging, and strict verification without AI assistance when required. Product & API Strategy: Actively participate in and drive product and design discussions. Shape our public-facing REST APIs for developers worldwide and brainstorm new directions to make online payments easy and accessible. Robust Testing & Resilience: Implement comprehensive verification strategies—including unit, integration, adversarial, and known-risk testing—to ensure error-free functionality under multi-limit and distributed failure modes. Collaboration & Mentorship: Mentorship of engineering peers, clearly articulating technical trade-offs, defending architectural decisions, and engaging in constructive discussions across teams to prioritize end-user value. What We Are Looking For 5+ years of experience in professional software technology, preferably within a fast-paced product company. Expert working knowledge and deep fluency in at least one backend programming language (e.g., GoLang, Java, Python). Strong grasp of both High-Level Design and Low-Level Design. Proven understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, data storage trade-offs caching, and event-driven architectures. Resiliency Patterns: Solid understanding of system failure modes and modern mitigation patterns. Familiarity with Agentic Workflows. Ability to break complex engineering problems down into structured, promptable tasks while maintaining complete accountability for code safety, security gaps, and hallucination detection. Understanding of web architectures, HTTP protocols, and REST API conventions. Demonstrated ability to challenge the status quo, evaluate complex technical trade-offs rationally, and display immense agility when iterating on products at scale. A strong willingness to learn and unlearn new technologies to deliver the best possible product outcome. jobs.description: Full-Stack Builder |Role Summary Most engineers, PMs & designers use AI. Few are AI-native. We're hiring the latter and looking for someone who can drive things end-to-end (discovery to conceptualisation to design to building to driving adoption) for a given canvas. Own a product or a feature end-to-end. Scope the problem, build the solution, ship it to users. Flex between frontend and backend based on what the problem needs, not your title. Work on 0→1 projects with real autonomy. Be part of Razorpay's AI transformation at scale and define the journey. You Know Who You Are You have deep expertise across the building journey: Customer backward thinking Product solutioning Prototyping & designing Building & taking products live Taking solutions to market, driving adoption & measuring impact You also exhibit good competence in the others. In past roles, you've juggled multiple hats. You've been using AI tools for over a year—Claude Code or Cursor is your default environment, not a novelty. You orchestrate agents, build with skills and MCPs. AI assistance is muscle memory. You're a polyglot—picking up new stacks fast because AI handles the ramp. Discovering & solving customer problems gives joy to you. You will be a good fit if you bring Product sense: you ask "why" before "how" 3-6 years building software as technical PM, user focussed product engineer Deep expertise in one domain + breadth across others Should be able to read code, fix CI/CD configurations if needed Track record of shipping, not just building You will not be a good fit if you You need detailed specs handed to you. You prefer deep specialization over breadth. You're uncomfortable with ambiguity. You optimize for code elegance over customer outcomes. You still thrive living in a 2 week sprint. Why Razorpay Scale that matters—billions of transactions, thousands of merchants. Impact at scale: Help transform India's leading payments platform into the country's and largest and first AI-native payments platform. Great work and team: Real autonomy. Work alongside builders and a team that thinks AI-first. About US Razorpay was founded by Shashank Kumar and Harshil Mathur in 2014. Razorpay is building a new-age digital banking hub (Neobank) for businesses in India. Our mission is to enable frictionless banking and payments experiences for businesses of all shapes and sizes. We started as a B2B payments company, and today, we process billions of dollars of payments for lakhs of businesses across India. We are the leading payments provider in the country and have been the first to bring to market most major innovations in the past 7 years. Razorpay enables businesses to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale. Over the years, the company has developed a stellar track record of serving customer needs from freelancers and small businesses to large-scale enterprises. Razorpay currently processes multi-billion dollar payments on an annualized basis, touching 200Mn+ end customers through top clients like Airtel, Goibibo, Yatra, Ola, Swiggy, Zomato, Cred etc. We architect systems for scale of not just one segment leader but 1000s put together. With more than a lakh clients, you would have definitely made a payment through Razorpay if you live in India. We have raised around USD $740M+ in funding till date from marquee investors like GIC, Alkeon Capital, Lone Pine Capital, TCV, Sequoia Capital, Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners and many stellar angels.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (Frontend, Backend & Cloud) – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
jobs.description: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Description We are looking for a highly skilled, deeply hands-on Full-Stack Software Engineer who will cover frontend UI, backend architecture, cloud deployment, and DevOps engineering all under one hat. Since our team already includes dedicated AI Engineers and Data Engineers, your primary mission is to be the foundational software engineering anchor: building the robust, scalable, and secure user interfaces, infrastructure, integrations, and server-side logic that allows our AI solutions to thrive in a production environment. Description Of The Area At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we are enabling high-value AI solutions spanning advanced agentic frameworks, Generative AI applications, and classical Machine Learning. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building these innovative AI applications end-to-end to solve complex business challenges in healthcare. In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (through agentic SDLC). Job Responsibilities Frontend Architecture & Generative UI: Develop highly scalable, reusable UI components using expert-level TypeScript and modern frameworks (React/Next.js or Angular 16+). Shift from static layouts to flexible, dynamic interfaces that gracefully handle unpredictable data and real-time LLM streams. Core Backend Engineering & API Design: Design and build highly scalable, reusable backend services and APIs (using Python) that serve as the backbone for multi-agent workflows and GenAI applications. Build, host, and secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and standard APIs to standardize data exchange. Cloud Architecture & DevOps Excellence: Design, implement, and manage secure and scalable cloud infrastructure (primarily AWS) tailored for diverse AI workloads. Apply Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) practices using Terraform. Build, maintain, and optimize fully automated CI/CD pipelines and manage application containerization (Docker). Agentic SDLC & Engineering Excellence: Leverage AI coding assistants and autonomous agents (e.g., Claude Code, Ona) daily to accelerate full-stack development cycles. Conduct rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code. Qualifications / Education / Experience Experience: 7+ years of strong software engineering experience with a demonstrable focus on backend development, cloud infrastructure, advanced frontend architecture, and DevOps. AI Integration Experience: Proven experience building backends for complex solutions and AI / LLM-powered applications, managing streaming responses, and translating non-deterministic AI outputs into safe, functional user interfaces. Agentic Workflow: Proven experience leveraging AI coding agents within an agentic SDLC to accelerate feature delivery. Hold a B.Sc., B.Eng., M.Sc., M.Eng., PhD, or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Be a passionate builder, staying continuously up-to-date with the latest developments in cloud computing, backend architectures, frontend paradigms, and AI integrations. Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative, thriving in a fast-paced environment where roles are fluid and multidisciplinary. Have a deep sense of accountability, capable of diagnosing complex system-level issues across the entire stack, and able to step into a Tech Lead role when necessary. Skills Must-have: Software Engineering Best Practices: Robust automated testing (TDD) to verify both code written by AI agents and dynamic UI components generated at runtime. Frontend & User Interface: Deep expertise in TypeScript and a major framework (React/Next.js or Angular 16+). Strong capability in complex state management and handling real-time data flow. Backend Programming: Advanced, production-grade proficiency in Python. Excellent enterprise API design and microservices architecture skills. Cloud & DevOps: Deep expertise in AWS (IAM, Lambda, S3, ECS, etc.), Docker, CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions), and Terraform. APIs and integrations: Building API-driven applications and integrating different enterprise systems into one solution. Should-have: Data & AI Tooling: Experience integrating with modern databases (Snowflake, OpenSearch). Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), graph databases, and Generative UI libraries. aSDLC: leveraging Agentic AI in the Software Development Lifecycle Building scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available systems. Could-have: Regulatory Compliance: Proven experience in working within highly regulated industries. Additional Qualifications Security Mindset: Strong understanding of enterprise security risks, IAM, and safe data handling along with a strong understanding of responsible AI deployment. Communication: Be an excellent problem solver, detail-oriented, and a great communicator, able to present complex technical matters clearly to diverse audiences. Be able to communicate in English at the level of C1+. Be deeply interested in developments in AI, staying up-to-date with the latest developments in agentic SDLC, cloud computing, and software development practices. Be able to communicate in English at the level of: C1+. Working Hours: Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening). Shift: CET time zone #Hyderabad2026 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description: Our Purpose At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here. About Us SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters. Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity. What Are We Looking For? We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. As a Staff (tech-lead level) engineer you will work on Singularity Marketplace - multi-tenant, event-driven platform that enables third-party integration applications to safely deploy, execute, and stream data across our AI SIEM ecosystem. We are looking for a pragmatic platform architect who understands the messy, real-world realities of third-party vendor APIs; that context is what separates sound platform decisions from theoretical ones. However, this is fundamentally an infrastructure and core platform role. Your primary goal isn't to build individual connectors, but to design the API contracts, runtime abstractions, isolation mechanisms, and microservices that enable dozens of teams and third parties to build connectors safely at petabyte scale. What Will You Do? Primary responsibilities include: Integration & Product Responsibilities: Collaborate closely with Product Managers and engineering teams to define requirements for integrating third-party vendors with the SentinelOne platform, establishing the Singularity Marketplace / Operations Center as the central hub in the security team's toolkit Explore products from various cybersecurity vendors and widely used industry tools to determine how to ingest and correlate their data Incorporate third-party data into the SentinelOne platform so customers can correlate information across vendors, surface insights, and respond quickly to threats Provide security research context on how 3rd-party data maps to the Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework (OCSF) and how it's used for triage, investigation, and response Follow internal processes for communicating schema and API changes to maintain OCSF parity across the platform Platform Engineering Responsibilities : Develop and extend the Java/Kotlin (Spring Boot) integrations platform that gives customers an interactive UI for onboarding third-party products and vendors Design and maintain event-driven microservices communicating over Apache Kafka that process entity activities, XDR alerts, and external triggers at scale Own core infrastructure across the entire request lifecycle, spanning edge/ingress gateways, API routing layers, and high-performance relational databases (PostgreSQL/Aurora RDS) while enforcing secure JWT/OAuth authentication and shared security libraries. Participate in on-call, incident response, and troubleshooting for a multi-region, multi-cluster production platform (Kafka lag, reconciliation failures, DB connection exhaustion, ingress routing issues, etc.) Contribute to GitOps-driven CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Helm, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions) for building, testing, and deploying services and functions across environments What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring? Ideal candidates will have: Modern Java/Kotlin Ecosystem: Deep hands-on expertise in Java/Kotlin, and Spring Boot, paired with strong system design fundamentals. (Knowledge of Go or Rust is a plus) Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Apache Kafka or equivalent), including topics, consumer groups, and streaming pipelines Ability to research and reverse-engineer APIs from documentation and technical specifications, and model them into structured data schemas Demonstrated technical leadership experience - shaping engineering best practices and driving their adoption across a team Experience with Kubernetes and containerized deployments, including Helm charts, ingress controllers (e.g., Traefik), and operator/reconciler patterns Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or GCP) Experience developing integration or contract tests (e.g., pytest) and working within CI/CD pipelines Big Advantage would be any of: Familiarity with serverless/FaaS platforms (e.g., AWS Lambda); Experience building data-intensive systems (ingestion, transformation, normalization, validation) and integrating complex third-party APIs; Practical engineering experience building production software utilizing LLMs or AI agents, with an emphasis on evaluation frameworks, testing, guardrails, and data pipeline integration; and Experience operating distributed, multi-region production systems (debugging Kafka consumer lag, ingress/routing issues, connection pool exhaustion, reconciliation failures) Why SentinelOne? AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place. We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family: Equity & Rewards Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) Time Off & Wellbeing Competitive leave benefits Gender-neutral parental leave Insurance & Financial Security Medical and insurance benefits Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Work Perks & Flexibility Global home office allowance Internet allowance LinkedIn Learning license Social Connect program Food allowance (Bangalore office) Meal vouchers (Sodexo) Wellness & Lifestyle Health & wellness benefit SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Experience range: 8-12 Yrs
Role Summary: HCLSoftware is seeking a Domain and Product Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join the Incubate Delivery function. This role sits within the build pool and is responsible for customising and configuring Incubate solutions to deliver the specific business outcomes each customer engagement requires. The Domain and Product FDE acts on behalf of the client. They take the requirements and detailed design produced by the Value Owner and Context and Data Strategist and turn them into working solutions inside the product, designing workflows, configuring orchestrations, building workbenches, and implementing process-led use cases using deep product fluency and domain understanding. This is not a core product development role. The Incubate product and solution teams own the architecture, engineering, and roadmap of the core products. This role makes those products work in the customers environment, configuring, extending, and customising them to deliver the outcomes the engagement has been designed to achieve. In traditional delivery, this would be recognised as a Product Specialist or Domain SME. In AIcentred delivery, the distinction matters more. Solutions built on AI, orchestration, and agentic capabilities need people who understand both the product and the business domain well enough to configure intelligently without defaulting to unnecessary custom development, and without losing sight of what the customer is actually trying to achieve. The role requires the judgement to know when to configure versus when to customise, when to use product capability as intended versus when to extend it, and when to push back on a requirement that would be better served by a different approach. That judgement comes from combining product knowledge with practical domain understanding. Role Scope in Practice Design, configure, and build customer-specific solutions within Incubate products, including workflows, orchestrations, workbenches, agents, and process-led use cases. Work from the documented requirements and detailed design produced by the Context and Data Strategist, translating specification into working product configuration. Apply domain understanding and product fluency to make informed configuration decisions that deliver the desired outcomes without unnecessary custom development. Collaborate with AI Orchestration and Engineering colleagues where solutions require integration, API connectivity, or technical build beyond product configuration. 2 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes Support the Quality and Compliance team by ensuring that what is built is testable, traceable, and aligned to the documented requirements and acceptance criteria. Participate in delivery calls and technical discussions where product and domain input is needed, without owning customer communication directly. Contribute to the reuse and maturity of solution patterns, configuration approaches, and domain-specific knowledge across engagements. Configure and maintain the behavioural controls that shape how AI agents operate within each customer's context, including prompt templates, agent personas, business guardrails, and escalation logic, ensuring agents behave in line with the process, the client's operating context, and the documented acceptance criteria. Key Responsibilities 1. Solution Configuration and Build Design and configure solutions within Incubate products to meet the specific requirements of each customer engagement. Build workflows, orchestrations, workbenches, agents, and process-led use cases using the product’s native capabilities and tooling. Make informed decisions about when to use standard product configuration, when to extend or customise, and when to escalate where a requirement may be better addressed through a different approach. Ensure that configured solutions are robust, maintainable, and aligned to the product’s intended architecture and design patterns. Work iteratively, delivering incremental capability that can be reviewed, validated, and refined through the engagement lifecycle. Design and configure prompt templates, agent personas, and behavioural parameters that control how AI agents interact with users, data, and business processes within each use case. Implement business guardrails and constraints that keep agent behaviour aligned to the customer's expectations, regulatory context, and risk appetite, including tone, scope boundaries, escalation triggers, and response limitations. 2. Domain Expertise and Product Fluency Bring practical understanding of the business domain to inform how solutions are designed and configured, ensuring they reflect how the customer’s processes, decisions, and workflows actually operate. Maintain deep fluency in Incubate product capabilities, tooling, and configuration options, staying current as products evolve. Use domain and product knowledge together to identify the most effective solution approach for each use case, avoiding over-engineering and unnecessary complexity. This job also recommends improvements to the existing IT systems and processes. Working under limited supervision, this job collaborates with functional teams across the organization to identify and execute improvement strategies that best enhance operations. This job also analyzes metrics to measure the impact of process enhancements after they are implemented by the organization. Documents processes with specific deliverables: detailed process maps, journey maps, empathy maps, Project Charters, SIPOC, and RACI (combination of Six Sigma and Scaled Agile artifacts). Educational Requirements Bachelor s degree in business administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related discipline. Preferred: Certification in Six Sigma (Green Belt or Black Belt) and/or SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (SAFe POPM) or equivalent. Related Skills Acceptance Testing Business Analysis Business Process Improvement Business Process Mapping Data Analysis IT Business Analysis Systems Design/Analysis Systems Development Life Cycle Technical Documentation Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. jobs.description:

Title: Senior Full Stack Developer About Cognizant Cognizant is one of the world’s leading professional services companies, transforming clients’ business, operating, and technology models for the digital era. Our unique industrybased, consultative approach helps clients envision, build, and run more innovative and efficient businesses. Headquartered in the U.S., Cognizant (a member of the NASDAQ100 and one of Forbes World’s Best Employers 2025 ) is consistently listed among the most admired companies in the world. About the Team This role is part of Cognizant IOA (Intelligent Operations and Automation) and, more specifically, a product team with its own origin story. We began as Matterway , a German startup building automation software from scratch. After being acquired by Cognizant, we retained our team, culture, pace, and way of working. We move like a startup, think like a startup, and now do so with the backing of a global company. We combine human expertise with intelligent automation, ML operations, and digital experience solutions to help technology and digitalnative companies build smarter, more adaptive operating models. What’s the Opportunity? We’re looking for Senior Product Engineers to join our growing team. Today, we are a closeknit group of four engineers from different parts of the world. We are now doubling in size, and the people we hire will help shape the future of the team. We are building a platform to support the agentification of operations . You’ll work across a suite of products, including: A cloud platform for process optimization AI coding agents Specialized AI agents This is genuinely frontier work. Experience range: 6-11 Yrs
Position Description: Company Profile: . Job Title: Senior Applied AI Engineer Experience: 6-12 yrs Category: IT Main location: Hyderabad Position ID: J1126-0807 Employment Type: Full Time Job Description Summary You will design, build and operate production grade AI agents that talk to real customers. Working on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore Runtime, you will own the reasoning, retrieval, tooling and guardrails behind services handling millions of conversations. This is applied AI engineering, taking systems from prototype to reliable, evaluated, governed production, not research. Client , Technology is a core driver of how we deliver our strategy. You'll join a team modernising our platforms, strengthening cyber and operational resilience, and advancing a product led way of working that brings engineers, data specialists and business experts together to deliver meaningful outcomes at pace. We're scaling automation and AI from proof of concept into real, end to end change, improving customer journeys, reducing cost to serve, accelerating delivery, and building the digital foundations that underpin everything from energy trading and risk to field operations and critical infrastructure. If you want to work on complex, high impact problems using modern engineering practices, and help build reusable platforms that will shape how Client operates over the next decade, this is the place to do it. An opportunity to play your part. You will join the Channel Platforms team, which owns Client 's customer conversation estate across voice, chat and email. Our agents are already live: a pay as you go voice assistant built on a real time speech to speech model, a multi channel customer facing agent spanning voice, chat and WhatsApp, and a standalone agentic webchat service running on AgentCore Runtime. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer you will own the intelligence layer of these products. That means the agent's reasoning and orchestration, the tools it can call, the knowledge it retrieves, the guardrails that constrain it, and the evaluation that proves it works. You will decide what good looks like and then build the measurement to show whether we are hitting it. This is a role for someone who has taken generative AI past the demo stage. Our problems are the hard ones that show up after launch: grounding answers in the right source, keeping voice latency low enough to feel natural, handing off to a human at the right moment, and proving to a goverce board that the system behaves safely at scale. You do not need a contact centre background. If you are a strong engineer who has built real agentic systems on Bedrock or a comparable platform, we will teach you the domain. Location: UK based hybrid role, occasional travel to site. Day to day . Design and build agentic services on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore Runtime, including multi step orchestration, state and memory management, and graceful handling of failure and ambiguity. . Build and own the tool layer that agents act through, exposing business capability such as account lookup, billing and identity as reliable, well described actions with sensible error semantics. . Build retrieval augmented generation over Bedrock Knowledge Bases, taking ownership of content preparation, chunking, embedding strategy, retrieval quality and answer grounding. . Treat prompts as engineering artefacts. Version them, test them, and understand precisely what changed when behaviour shifts. . Build the evaluation harness. Define what accuracy, containment and safe behaviour mean for each product, assemble regression sets, and make it possible to ship a prompt or model change with evidence rather than optimism. . Implement guardrails and safety controls, including PII handling, out of scope refusal, jailbreak resistance and clean escalation to a human advisor. . Engineer for latency and cost. Streaming, model selection and routing, caching and token budgets all matter, and in voice they matter in real time where a pause of a few hundred milliseconds is felt by the customer. . Instrument agent behaviour end to end so that tool failures, retrieval misses and abandoned conversations are visible in Datadog and QuickSight, not discovered through complaints. . Support live AI services in production, investigating incidents and diagnosing non deterministic behaviour, then closing the loop with permanent fixes. . Make and document build versus buy calls, writing Architecture Decision Records and taking designs through our AI goverce board and change control process. . Track how the generative AI landscape is moving and bring the parts that deliver clear benefit into the roadmap, with an honest read on the risk as well as the upside. What we need from you Essential: . Substantial software engineering experience, with strong Python. You write production code, not just notebooks. . Demonstrable delivery of LLM or agentic systems into production for real users, and the scar tissue that comes with it. We will ask what broke and what you changed. . Hands on experience with tool and function calling, multi step agent orchestration, and managing conversational state across turns. . Production experience with retrieval augmented generation, including retrieval quality evaluation and answer grounding, not just wiring up a vector store. . A rigorous approach to evaluation. You have built or owned an eval harness, defined the metrics that mattered, and used them to make release decisions. . Experience deploying and operating AI services in the cloud using serverless or container based architectures, infrastructure as code such as Terraform, and CI/CD. . Practical application of responsible AI, covering data privacy, guardrails, bias, explainability and human in the loop design, in an environment with real compliance obligations. . Ability to debug systems that are non deterministic by nature, and the patience to reason about behaviour statistically rather than case by case. . Strong collaboration and communication skills. You can explain to a product owner why the agent got something wrong, and to a goverce board why the controls are sufficient. . Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Desirable: . Amazon Bedrock specifically, including AgentCore Runtime, Bedrock Knowledge Bases and Bedrock Guardrails. If your experience is on another foundation model platform, that transfers. . Voice AI experience, including speech to speech models, real time streaming, barge in and turn taking, or ASR and TTS pipelines. . Any contact centre exposure, including Amazon Connect. A bonus rather than an expectation. . Familiarity with agent interoperability standards such as the Model Context Protocol. . Experience with fine tuning, distillation or model routing where it materially improved cost or latency. . Delivery in a regulated industry, including working with vulnerable customer requirements or comparable obligations. . AWS certification at Associate level or above. Your future duties and responsibilities: Core Competencies Technical Skills (AI and emerging technology) . Designs, integrates and operates AI enabled solutions within enterprise environments, including prompt driven workflows, retrieval augmented systems and AI agents. . Applies structured evaluation, testing and monitoring practices to ensure AI outputs are reliable, secure and compliant with organisational guardrails. . Prepares and manages data used in AI workflows and takes responsibility for the responsible lifecycle of AI features from experimentation through deployment and continuous improvement. . Demonstrates the safe and responsible use of AI tools, with clear knowledge of when AI use is appropriate and strong awareness of accuracy, bias and compliance. Bringing the ability to design and reuse prompt templates to support consistent, high quality workflow outputs, and skilled in using AI to triage, classify and analyse information within Client policy guardrails. . Strong ability to recognise higher risk scenarios and escalate to goverce or security as needed. Alongside this, showing proficiency in enterprise AI copilots, knowledge assistants and AI enhanced productivity tools. Required qualifications to be successful in this role: Core Behaviours . Take Ownership . Work as One Team . Develop a Growth Mindset . Strive to Innovate . Champion Customers Skills: Python Agentic AI Generative AI Problem Solving

jobs.description: At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. jobs.description: Cloud Foundations Reliability (CFR) is part of NVIDIA’s Global Network Infrastructure (GNI) organization. We deploy, integrate, and operate the Kubernetes-based platform and shared services used to provision, monitor, and operate NVIDIA’s global network across data centers, colocation facilities, and cloud environments. The team owns the architecture and lifecycle of this platform, including cluster provisioning and upgrades, GitOps delivery, observability, capacity, and service enablement. We build software and automation to standardize how network platforms and services are deployed, scaled, and managed across environments. We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer to own the lifecycle and automation of the Kubernetes platform supporting GNI network systems. You will also provide production support for network services running on the platform, partnering with their engineering owners when issues or changes cross the platform boundary. You will take complex problems from design through production and remain accountable for the outcome. You will bring deep Kubernetes expertise and help establish consistent engineering practices across the US and Bangalore teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership and production responsibility. What You’ll Be Doing Design, build, and operate the Kubernetes platform that powers GNI network automation, telemetry, and operations across data center, colocation, and cloud environments. Own the lifecycle management for GNI Kubernetes environments, including cluster onboarding, upgrades, capacity, availability, and recovery. Develop production-quality software and automation for cluster provisioning, validation, upgrades, remediation, and safe multi-cluster delivery through GitOps. Provide production support for network services hosted on the platform, working with Network Automation and service teams that retain ownership of application architecture, code, and features. Diagnose complex Kubernetes platform and hosted-service failures involving control-plane health, cluster networking, storage, scheduling, workload placement, and multi-cluster dependencies. Drive issues from initial signal through verified resolution. Define production-readiness and observability standards for the platform and hosted network services, including health signals, capacity, alerts, runbooks, and recovery. Participate in CFR’s production on-call rotation, including scheduled after-hours and weekend coverage. Lead incident response and recovery, then drive corrective actions to completion. What We Need To See Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 8+ years of experience building or operating production Kubernetes platforms, network infrastructure, or distributed systems. Deep experience with Kubernetes at scale, including cluster lifecycle, upgrades, networking, storage, and recovery. Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language, such as Go or Python. Experience with GitOps, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and automated production delivery. Experience deploying and supporting network automation or telemetry services on Kubernetes. Experience with production on-call, incident response, root-cause analysis, and driving corrective actions to completion. The platform integrates robust enterprise security, Access Control Lists (ACLs), and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) protocols to securely connect disparate data silos (including third-party platforms like Microsoft Entra ID/M365, Salesforce, and Atlassian) while upholding organizational safety, security, and precision standards. Role: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) specializing in Gemini Enterprise, Agentic AI, and Multi-Agent Systems Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and deploy production-grade Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) and agentic workflows using Gemini Enterprise Identify need for Pro Code Vs No Code design based on customer’s problem statement and data sources Design Deploy and custom agents using the Agent Development Kit (ADK), and Agent Platform AI Reasoning Engine and integrate with Gemini Enterprise Build native integrations across the Google Workspace Ecosystem (Docs, Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Meet) and NotebookLM for grounded enterprise research, document automation, and conversational discovery. Architect scalable short-term session storage, conversation state persistence, and long-term memory architectures across multi-agent interactions. Implement advanced reasoning patterns such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT), ReAct, Plan-and-Solve, and Self-Reflection to enhance agent reliability. Establish quantitative evaluation frameworks to measure agent trajectories, tool invocation precision/recall, and reasoning faithfulness. Memory & State Architecture: Demonstrated expertise in managing agent session state, short-term context caching, and durable long-term memory backends (vector databases, relational/NoSQL session stores). Third Party Tools: Experience with MCP Connectors to securely integrate core third-party platforms (e.g., iManage, NetDocuments, Relativity, DocuSign, MS Office Suite, Sharepoint, JIRA) with Gemini Enterprise. Auth & Security: Strong understanding of authentication and authorization protocols (IAM, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, Service Accounts, Workload Identity Federation) across Google Cloud and 3rd-party SaaS platforms (Microsoft Entra ID, Salesforce, Atlassian). ACLs & Permissions: Deep working knowledge of enterprise Access Control Lists (ACLs), identity federation, permission trimming, and role-based access control (RBAC) across heterogeneous data sources. Developer Tooling: Proficiency in developer tooling such as Agent CLI and Antigravity for local simulation, debugging, prompt engineering, and execution graph tracing. CI/CD & DevOps: Proven track record of configuring and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions) for agent containerization, deployment, and test automation. Evaluation & Debugging: Practical knowledge of AI evaluation methodologies, trajectory analysis, and performing root cause analysis (RCA) on agent execution failures, tool errors, and prompt regressions. Client Collaboration: Strong technical communication, consulting acumen, and client-facing collaboration skills within an Agile environment. Good-to have skills Experience with inter-agent communication protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) architectures. Experience integrating agents with Enterprise Knowledge Graphs, structured ontologies, and hybrid vector search systems. Experience with enterprise data security frameworks such as Sensitive Data Protection (SDP/DLP) and VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC). jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer - Vice President
jobs.description: Job Description: Job Title: Lead AI Engineer - Vice President Location: Bangalore, India Role Description The AI Technology Vice President is a senior, hands-on individual contributor who turns high-value banking use cases into secure, scalable and measurable AI solutions. Embedded within Corporate Functions Technology, the role works directly with delivery teams and business stakeholders to design, prototype, engineer and productionise AI capabilities, while ensuring that implementation choices are aligned with enterprise architecture, data governance, model risk, security and regulatory expectations. The role connects grassroots experimentation with top-down strategy. It contributes practical implementation insight to the AI Centre of Excellence and translates approved tooling, roadmaps and ways of working into reusable engineering patterns that delivery teams can adopt. The position has no dependency on formal people management; influence is achieved through technical depth, demonstrable delivery, coaching and trusted partnership. This is an individual contributor role with senior technical accountability. The role may lead workstreams, guide engineers and coordinate multidisciplinary delivery, but its primary value comes from hands-on technical implementation, engineering judgement and influence rather than direct people management. Final ownership of business decisions, model-risk acceptance and control approvals remains with the relevant accountable functions. What we’ll offer you As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy, Best in class leave policy. Gender neutral parental leaves 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral) Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents Accident and Term life Insurance Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above Your key responsibilities Hands-on AI solution engineering Build and productionise: Design, code, test and deploy AI applications, services, agents and reusable components for banking and Corporate Functions use cases. Prototype with purpose: Develop rapid proofs of concept to test business value, technical feasibility, control implications and operational readiness before scaling. Own the engineering pathway: Translate business problems into solution architecture, data flows, model or service choices, APIs, integration patterns and production acceptance criteria. Integrate enterprise systems: Connect AI capabilities with approved data platforms, workflow tools, document repositories, APIs and user channels without bypassing established controls. Engineer for reliability: Implement automated testing, versioning, observability, evaluation, deployment and rollback mechanisms across the solution lifecycle. Troubleshoot deeply: Diagnose data, model, prompt, retrieval, integration, performance and production issues and drive them through to resolution. Generative AI and applied machine learning Generative AI: Implement solutions using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, tool use, structured output and agentic workflows where justified. Model selection: Compare hosted models, enterprise AI services and conventional machine-learning approaches against accuracy, explainability, latency, cost, privacy and control requirements. Evaluation: Define repeatable evaluation datasets and measures for quality, groundedness, robustness, safety, bias, latency and business usefulness. Prompt and context engineering: Develop maintainable prompt templates, context strategies, guardrails and model interaction patterns, with appropriate version control and test coverage. Classical AI/ML: Apply supervised or unsupervised learning, NLP, document intelligence, forecasting or anomaly detection when these approaches are better suited than generative AI. Data, platform and MLOps/LLMOps implementation Data readiness: Assess source quality, lineage, entitlement, retention and fitness for AI use; design data preparation and retrieval pipelines with accountable owners. Production lifecycle: Establish CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, release controls, monitoring and operational support patterns. Platform engineering: Use approved cloud, on-premises or hybrid platforms and contribute reusable reference implementations, accelerators and paved-road components. Performance and cost: Optimize token usage, compute, caching, retrieval, throughput and service design while maintaining required quality and controls. Operational resilience: Design for availability, failure handling, auditability, recoverability and human intervention in business-critical workflows. Banking controls and responsible AI Control by design: Embed privacy, confidentiality, information security, data minimisation, records management, access control and segregation of duties into solution design. Responsible AI: Implement explainability, human oversight, fairness assessment, traceability, content safety and appropriate usage boundaries. Risk partnership: Work with Model Risk, Compliance, Legal, Data, Architecture, Cyber Security and Operational Risk stakeholders to evidence design decisions and address findings. Audit evidence: Maintain clear documentation covering data sources, design rationale, evaluation outcomes, limitations, approvals, change history and production controls. Third-party risk: Assess external models, libraries and services for security, licensing, concentration, data handling, lock-in and ongoing support considerations. Technology leadership without line management Technical influence: Set a high bar through working code, design reviews, engineering standards and pragmatic decision-making. Community of Practice: Create and nurture peer learning through demonstrations, code walkthroughs, implementation clinics, reusable examples and lessons learned. Coaching: Support engineers, analysts and product teams in adopting approved AI techniques and resolving difficult implementation problems. Strategic feedback loop: Maintain continuous collaboration with the AI Centre of Excellence so delivery experience informs enterprise tooling, roadmaps and ways of working, and strategic direction is translated into execution. External awareness: Track relevant developments in AI engineering and banking technology, then assess them against real business value and risk appetite rather than novelty alone. Use-case delivery and stakeholder partnership Shape demand: Partner with business, product and technology stakeholders to frame the problem, users, expected outcomes, constraints and measurable value. Prioritize pragmatically: Distinguish use cases suitable for experimentation from those ready for production investment, using evidence rather than technology enthusiasm. Deliver iteratively: Work in multidisciplinary teams, demonstrate progress early and incorporate user, control and operational feedback throughout delivery. Communicate clearly: Explain complex AI design choices, limitations and trade-offs in language suitable for engineers, senior management, control functions and business users. Adoption: Design for usability and changed ways of working so approved AI capabilities are used safely and generate sustained value. Your skills and experience Essential Experience Relevant professional experience designing and implementing production technology solutions, including recent hands-on delivery of AI, machine-learning or generative-AI capabilities. Demonstrable evidence of moving AI use cases from discovery and prototype through engineering, control assessment, deployment and operational support. Experience operating as a senior individual contributor, technical lead, solution architect or principal engineer who influences across teams without relying on formal authority. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering Relevant cloud, data, security or machine-learning certifications are beneficial but do not replace demonstrable implementation capability. Technical Skills Strong hands-on software engineering experience in Python and API/service development, with disciplined use of source control, automated testing and code review. Working knowledge of LLM APIs - OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent and experience building applications on top of them beyond simple prompting. Understanding of agentic AI patterns, tool use, planning, multi-agent coordination and experience designing or building systems that use them. Practical implementation experience with machine learning and generative AI frameworks, model APIs, embeddings, vector databases or search platforms, retrieval-augmented generation and agent/tool integration patterns. Experience building data pipelines and working with structured and unstructured data, including documents, metadata, entitlements and lineage. Working knowledge of cloud and/or enterprise AI platforms, containerization, orchestration, CI/CD, secrets management, monitoring and infrastructure automation. Ability to design secure, modular and supportable architectures across user experience, orchestration, model, data and integration layers. Awareness of responsible AI principles, model risk considerations, and the regulatory landscape relevant to financial services AI deployment including data privacy, explainability, and governance frameworks. Experience applying evaluation and monitoring to AI solutions, including quality, safety, performance, drift or degradation, and operational outcomes. Understanding of security, privacy, identity and access management, encryption, audit logging and secure software development practices. Ability to review code and architecture, identify technical debt and control gaps, and implement practical remediation. Financial Services & Domain Knowledge Experience delivering technology in banking, financial services or another highly regulated environment. Understanding of how confidentiality, data residency, regulatory obligations, model risk, operational resilience and auditability affect AI solution design. Ability to work with sensitive business data and regulated processes while maintaining clear purpose limitation and accountable human oversight. Experience collaborating with business, operations, architecture, data, security, risk, compliance and legal stakeholders. Knowledge of Corporate Functions domains such as Finance, Risk, Compliance, Legal, HR, Procurement or Operations is advantageous. Personal Attributes Curious and evidence-led: Explores new techniques but validates them against measurable outcomes, engineering quality and risk. Delivery focused: Moves from discussion to working implementation, while knowing when controls or dependencies must be resolved first. Technically credible: Can work at architecture level and still inspect data, write code, test integrations and diagnose production behavior. Pragmatic: Selects the simplest viable approach and communicates trade-offs transparently. Collaborative: Builds trust across engineering, business and control functions and shares knowledge openly. Accountable: Owns outcomes, documents decisions and raises material risks early. Clear communicator: Adapts technical depth to the audience without obscuring limitations or uncertainty. Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs. How we’ll support you Training and development to help you excel in your career. Coaching and support from experts in your team. A culture of continuous learning to aid progression. A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs. About us and our teams Please visit our company website for further information: https://www.db.com/company/company.html We at DWS are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, one that embraces dialogue and diverse views, and treats everyone fairly to drive a high-performance culture. The value we create for our clients and investors is based on our ability to bring together various perspectives from all over the world and from different backgrounds. It is our experience that teams perform better and deliver improved outcomes when they are able to incorporate a wide range of perspectives. We call this #ConnectingTheDots.

jobs.title: Security Engineer III, PaySec, StoreSec
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Come build the future with us! In Payments Security (PaySec), we protect the foundational systems and products that allow Amazon to accept payments for all goods, content, and services that people buy at Amazon and around the world. International Emerging Stores Payments (IESP) brings Amazon's payments products to customers in some of the fastest-growing markets in the world, across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), Asia Pacific (APAC) including India, and South America. These markets run on real-time payment rails such as UPI, on local wallets, cards, bill payments, and lending products, and on regulatory regimes that differ from one country to the next. Every one of those transactions depends on customer trust, and IESP Payments Security exists to earn and keep it. Payments Security owns full-stack Product Security for Payments across Amazon and its business units. We are part of Amazon's broader Stores Security organization, responsible for protecting Amazon's global information assets. We partner with Payments builder teams to make applications and infrastructure secure-by-design from concept to launch and into continuous operations, and we build the mechanisms, guardrails, and automation that let thousands of engineers do the right thing by default. As a senior Security Engineer on IESP Payments Security, you will own the security direction for threats that cut across every IESP market. These are the hard problems that no single business can solve alone: AI agents that act on behalf of customers, the move to post-quantum cryptography, and fraud on real-time payment rails. You will operate as the technical owner for this domain, define the problems worth solving before anyone hands you a spec, and influence engineering and business leaders across organizational boundaries. Day to day, you will lead threat models, design controls, do hands-on offensive and defensive work, and work with our software engineers to turn your designs into automated mechanisms. You will mentor other security engineers and act as a trusted escalation point during security incidents. Key job responsibilities Set the technical security direction and architecture for cross-market threats in IESP, and make high-judgment trade-offs that raise the security bar across many services and markets. Threat model and assess security for emerging risks across IESP markets, starting with AI agents acting on behalf of customers, post-quantum cryptography migration, and real-time payment fraud. Design controls for AI agent identity and customer consent, so payments systems can tell an agent apart from the customer it represents and enforce limits on what it can do. Help IESP prepare for post-quantum cryptography by finding where payment data is encrypted in transit and at rest and planning a phased migration. Analyze real-time payment fraud attack paths, such as UPI, using fraud data and malware analysis, and design layered controls with clear coverage and latency trade-offs. Perform hands-on security work, including penetration testing, secure code review, and vulnerability assessment across application, cloud, and mobile layers. Work with the IESP security tooling team to turn findings into automated controls, detections, and code-creation guardrails. Drive measurable risk reduction by partnering with builder teams to prioritize, track, and close findings. Write security strategy documents and present them to senior engineering and business leaders. Mentor and develop junior security engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. Lead security escalations and incident response, and drive lasting fixes that prevent recurrence. About the team IESP Payments Security is a single-threaded Business Security Team for all of International Emerging Stores Payments. We are security engineers, technical program managers, and software engineers working as one team. We own security for regulated payments and lending businesses, for acquired companies joining Amazon, and for new markets as they launch. We believe security scales through mechanisms and automation, not headcount. As AI writes more of the code our builders ship, we move security into the moment code is created and replace episodic reviews with continuous assurance. We invest in each other's growth as much as we invest in protecting our customers. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience applying threat modeling or other risk identification techniques or equivalent Experience with security in service-oriented architectures/microservices and web services Experience with applied cryptography, PKI, or post-quantum cryptography migration. Experience with AI/GenAI security and how AI agents interact with production systems. Experience with mobile application security and anti-fraud controls. Experience acting as a technical lead for a security domain and mentoring engineers. Experience in investigations, payments, security or banking. jobs.title: Sr. Manager, AI Builder
jobs.description: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. Job Category Sales Job Details About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. As the Manager of Emerging Talent for the AI Builder Program, you will lead, mentor, and scale a high-caliber team of AI-native graduates, and bring a completely fresh approach to problem-solving.This is not a traditional engineering management role; it is a frontier-pushing leadership position designed to channel that native AI mindset into boundary-breaking, real-world customer transformations. It is a blend of people leadership, technical direction, consulting mentorship, and program development - with an exciting focus on pioneering AI approaches to delivering extraordinary outcomes. We are looking for a strong people leader with reasonable technical fluency to guide and develop a team of new computer science graduates. In this role, you will focus on people leadership and business mentorship, helping your team navigate their early careers while ensuring operational excellence. You will confidently engage with customers across a diverse cross-section of accounts (from Mid-Market through Enterprise Strategic) and serve as a strategic partner Your primary mission is to translate their unique, intuitive relationship with AI into enterprise-grade success and translate academic computer science excellence into real-world, customer-facing success. You will help your team navigate the frontier of generative AI and Agentforce, architect agent reasoning, and confidently engage with customers to drive business transformations. Additionally, you will play an active role in driving the architecture and execution of our Grad Builder Program , overseeing projects, managing development plans, and delivering advanced technical and consultative training. Key Responsibilities 1. People Leadership & Talent Development (40%) Channel AI-Native Superpowers: Champion and harness the unique, fast-paced 'group chat' collaboration styles and intuitive AI habits of recent graduates, turning their fresh perspectives into a competitive advantage for our delivery teams. Manage & Mentor: Act as the direct people manager for a cohort of Emerging Talent AI Builders. Deliver regular 1:1s, performance reviews, career development planning, and compensation management. Bridge the Gap: Help AI natives pivot from 'building experimental side projects' to deploying production-grade, secure, and ethical enterprise software, showing them how to scale their boundary-pushing ideas responsibly. Consulting Coaching: Teach technical grads how to "translate tech into business value." Coach them on active listening, stakeholder management, discovery sessions, presentation skills, and handling pushback from customers. Cultivating Belonging and Long-term Engagement: Establish a vibrant, inclusive atmosphere. Provide guidance through the specific challenges of early-career excellence, including managing rapid advancement paths, addressing imposter syndrome, and meeting the distinct professional needs of high-potential recent graduates. 2. Technical Leadership & Project Governance (30%) Agentforce Guardrails: Guide graduates through the design of agentic reasoning, prompt engineering, and tool calls. Ensure they are evaluating AI outputs with strict engineering rigor rather than trial-and-error. Technical Coaching: Support Graduates in building scalable and secure agentic solutions. Act as an internal technical sounding partner when a Graduate encounters roadblocks, ensuring they are equipped to succeed. 3. Graduate Builder Program Enablement & Strategy (30%) Pioneer Continuous Upskilling: Foster an active, experimental lab culture where testing the absolute limits of generative AI and Agentforce is celebrated. You will use insights gained from your cohort's rapid experimentation to feed back into the broader organization's upskilling initiatives. Project Matching & Bench Management: Oversee the pipeline of customer work, strategically pairing Grads with projects that stretch their technical capabilities while balancing business needs. Development Milestones: Build, track, and optimize a 12-to-24-month competency matrix detailing when a Grad is expected to master specific technical tracks (e.g., Real-Time Infra) and consulting pillars. University Recruiting Partner: Collaborate with the University Recruiting team to interview, assess, and attract top-tier Computer Science talent from target universities. The Ideal Profile You can speak their language... You have a deep background in computer science or software engineering. You understand object-oriented programming, data structures, and the current landscape of LLMs/prompt engineering. ...and you can teach them yours. You are a seasoned consultant or customer-facing tech lead. You know how to read a room, handle a tough customer question during a live deployment, and unpack complex business requirements into technical user stories. You view communication, empathy, and business acumen as core engineering skills. Crucially, you are energized by working with early-career talent who naturally think AI-first. You know how to guide their ambition to push boundaries, helping them refine raw creativity into high-impact business strategy. Qualifications & Requirements Minimum Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a highly technical discipline. Experience: 5+ years of experience in technical consulting, solution architecture, software engineering, or a highly technical customer-facing role. Leadership: 1+ years of experience managing technical teams, acting as a tech lead, or significantly mentoring early-career engineers/consultants. Technical Fluency: Proficient in at least one classic powerhouse language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java) and a solid understanding of modern web architectures (React, REST APIs, GraphQL). A passion for high quality code and best practices (OOP, SOLID, Git, etc.) AI/LLM Curiosity: Practical, hands-on experience or profound familiarity with Generative AI frameworks, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration. Preferred Qualifications: Prior experience managing university graduate programs, technical rotation programs, or tech boot camps. Direct experience with the Salesforce ecosystem, Apex, or building on Agentforce. Background in Enterprise Agile delivery and technical scoping. Why This Role is Unique Unlike traditional engineering managers who operate strictly behind the scenes, or traditional consulting managers focused purely on utilization metrics, you are at the epicenter of a workforce revolution. You are not just teaching a syllabus, you are leading a generation of AI natives who will fundamentally rewrite how businesses operate. In this role, you have a blank canvas to push boundaries, experiment with leading-edge agentic technology, and serve as the premier showcase for Salesforce's company-wide up-skilling strategy. If you want to change the trajectory of early-career professionals while actively redefining the future of work itself, this is your platform. Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. jobs.title: Product Manager II - SmartHub, Amazon Smart Commerce
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION What if running an e-commerce business could become dramatically simpler — with AI helping sellers manage orders, inventory, pricing and operations across every channel they sell on? Amazon Smart Commerce is looking for a Product Manager for SmartHub, our multi-channel e-commerce operations platform. SmartHub brings together orders, inventory, catalog, returns, warehousing and business insights across marketplaces and D2C channels into a single system, helping businesses operate at scale without navigating multiple disconnected tools. We are now at an exciting inflection point. Advances in generative and agentic AI create an opportunity to fundamentally rethink how sellers operate their businesses — moving from dashboards and workflows, toward intelligent experiences that understand their business, identify what needs attention, recommend actions and increasingly execute work on their behalf. As the Product Manager for SmartHub, you will be at the forefront of defining and executing this journey by identifying the opportunities, defining the product and deliver exceptional seller experiences. Your work will directly impact the growth and success of sellers leveraging Amazon SmartHub, enabling them to scale their business to new heights. Key job responsibilities Understand seller problems to identify unmet needs and emerging trends in the e-commerce landscape. Monitor and analyze competitor activities and market trends to identify opportunities for differentiation and innovation. Translate seller insights and market opportunities into detailed product requirements and user stories for the engineering team. Collaborate with GTM, engineering, UX, support and marketing teams throughout the product development lifecycle, from concept to launch. Analyze product performance data, identify areas for improvement, and iterate on the product based on customer feedback and business results. Conduct A/B testing and other experiments to optimize product features and improve key metrics. Develop and maintain product documentation, including user guides, training materials, and FAQs. Required Skillset: Proven ability to conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer insights to inform product strategy. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, draw conclusions, and make data-driven decisions. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across teams. Deep understanding of online product management principles, agile development methodologies, and A/B testing techniques. Bachelor's degree in a related field; MBA preferred with 3years of experience in product management A day in the life You will start your day by reviewing the product and business metrics. You morning might involve speaking to a seller processing thousands of orders across Amazon, Flipkart and other channels, identifying where manual work and exceptions slow them down. Later, you could work with engineers and scientists on an AI agent that detects inventory risks or automates an operational workflow. You will move fluidly between speaking to sellers, thinking of solutions, brainstorming with engineers, driving adoption and thinking strategy. About the team Amazon Smart Commerce is building the technology infrastructure for agentic commerce that helps businesses sell and operate wherever their customers shop. SmartHub is our multi-channel operations platform, helping sellers bring orders, inventory, catalog, returns and business insights from multiple marketplaces and D2C channels into one system. It is built for the operational realities of commerce - high-volume events, warehouse workflows, complex integrations and businesses that cannot afford downtime. We believe AI creates an opportunity to reinvent this category. Our ambition is to evolve from a software that helps sellers manage workflows to an intelligent commerce operating system that helps them run and grow their businesses. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of product management experience Experience managing technical products or online services PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services Experience building and analyzing cost/benefit scenarios and business cases and communicating results throughout the organization Experience in creating PRFAQs, BRDs and other product documentation. Bringing together Oracle product expertise, industry understanding, and delivery experience, CSS works with customers to address business priorities, strengthen technology adoption, and achieve measurable outcomes. Within CSS, Oracle Innovation Studios brings together specialists across AI Studio, Cloud Platforms Studio, Industry Studios, Fusion Apps Studios, and Security Studio. Our teams co-innovate with customers to identify valuable use cases, validate ideas through prototypes, and deliver secure, scalable solutions. We collaborate across Studios, Product Development, sales, and delivery, combining reusable assets and practical AI capabilities to improve delivery productivity and turn business priorities into lasting customer value. Why join CSS? Build on your expertise. Deepen your Oracle specialization while expanding your understanding of connected business processes and technologies across the Oracle ecosystem. Apply AI to real business needs. Develop practical knowledge of AI and automation through customer solutions and improvements to the way we design, build, and deliver. Connect your work to customer outcomes. Contribute across discovery, solution design, prototyping, delivery, and adoption, with opportunities shaped by your role and Studio. Learn through collaboration. Work with specialists, architects, engineers, and functional experts across Studios and Product Development to strengthen your solution judgment. Extend your impact.
