AI Studio The AI Studio helps customers turn AI opportunities into working solutions using embedded AI in Oracle applications, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) AI services, and Oracle database capabilities. The team identifies valuable use cases, develops and evaluates prototypes, and supports integration, adoption, and scale. Work can include AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence, and intelligent automation, with attention to security, governance, and measurable business value. You will connect customer outcomes with platform decisions, establish reusable patterns, and guide complex solutions from discovery through production. This hands-on role combines deep expertise in Oracle Visual Builder Studio, Oracle Integration Cloud, and Oracle APEX with practical AI architecture and leadership of AI-assisted engineering. Working with business and technology stakeholders, delivery teams, other Studios, and Product Development, you will define solution boundaries, nonfunctional requirements, roadmaps, and architectural tradeoffs. You will validate critical designs through prototypes and reviews, guide consistent implementation, and shape technical proposals and estimates. The role suits an experienced architect who can influence senior customer stakeholders, mentor technical leads and engineers, and balance security, operational needs, cost, and performance while demonstrating customer value and measurable delivery improvements. Architect assistants, RAG solutions, and agent workflows, defining model and service selection, knowledge access, tool invocation, orchestration, evaluation, and human approval for consequential actions. Validate high-risk assumptions through hands-on prototypes and code reviews; lead architecture reviews and resolve complex design issues to guide implementation and production readiness. THE PERSON You have a strong understanding of Ethernet MAC architecture and networking datapaths and enjoy solving complex problems spanning multiple IPs and engineering disciplines. Translate product requirements and use cases into interfaces, data flows, bandwidth, latency, buffering, clocking, reset, performance, and validation requirements. Support Ethernet speeds including 10G, 25G, 40G, 50G, 100G, 200G, 400G, and 800G, as applicable to the target product. Define requirements for features such as Auto-Negotiation/Link Training, IEEE 1588 PTP, pause/PFC flow control, statistics, loopback, interrupts, fault handling, and diagnostic capabilities. Support subsystem integration, pre-silicon verification, silicon bring-up, and root-cause analysis of issues spanning MAC, PHY, clocks, resets, interconnect, memory, firmware, and software. Each tool is paired with a dedicated, purpose-built computing platform -comprising servers, storage, and networking elements - that drives the tool's real-time processing, data acquisition, and control workloads. These platforms are self-contained computing environments, engineered specifically for each tool family and deployed in semiconductor fab conditions worldwide. Everything in between is owned by this role. This is a senior pivot role. Author technical deliverables at each gate: requirements documents, platform selection rationale, validation test plans, and manufacturing transfer packages. Identify and resolve technical obstacles that could delay the program schedule; escalate risks early and propose mitigation strategies. Validation & Productization Design and execute hardware validation plans: performance benchmarking, stress testing, thermal characterization, and compatibility validation with the tool's software stack. Collaborate with R&D and software teams to verify driver compatibility, BIOS/firmware configuration, and OS/application performance on the selected platform. Lead the transition of validated platforms from engineering to manufacturing, including production BOM release and manufacturing documentation. Support the manufacturing team during initial production builds and resolve any hardware-related integration issues. Cross-Functional Interface Management Collaborate with engineering peers across multiple disciplines -Electronics, Mechanics, Safety, and others -to ensure the computing platform integrates cleanly into the overall tool design. Serve as the technical interface with procurement for component sourcing, lead time management, and supply chain risk mitigation. Coordinate with the SPI team to ensure that NPI platform decisions account for long-term serviceability and component lifecycle. Created evaluation and benchmarking frameworks that become company standards. Reduced model and agent failure rates through systematic analysis and optimization. Influenced product direction through data-driven insights and innovation. Established yourself as a trusted technical leader across the organization. What You Will Bring Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. 7+ years of hands-on industry experience solving complex data science and AI problems. Experience building and shipping production AI systems used by real customers. Proven track record of delivering measurable business impact. Experience working in high-growth startups or startup-like environments. Demonstrated success operating across research, product, and engineering boundaries. jobs.title: Cloud Technical Solutions Engineer, Data Analytics
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India . Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience. 9 years of experience with two or more of the following: Web Technologies, Big Data, Apache Spark, Systems Administration, or Machine Learning. Experience reading or debugging code using Java, C, C++, .NET, Python, Shell, Perl, or JavaScript. Preferred qualifications: Experience with Linux/Unix or other operating systems (Kernel to Shell, file systems, client-server protocols). Knowledge in Web application development/deployment, HTTP/RESTful API troubleshooting, or database design/troubleshooting. Understanding of Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, Routing, VPNs). Ability to consistently demonstrate a well-developed systematic, logical troubleshooting methodology for each customer issue. Ability to quickly assess customer issues to determine impact, scope, and to create next steps for troubleshooting. About the job The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners. In this role, you will be part of a global team that provides support to help customers seamlessly make the switch to Google Cloud. When customers cannot resolve issues themselves, your job is to ensure that we have the necessary tools and processes to resolve the issue. You will troubleshoot technical problems for customers with a mix of debugging, networking, system administration, updating documentation, and when needed, coding/scripting. You will make our products easier to adopt and to use by making improvements to the product, tools, processes, and documentation. You will help drive the success and business growth of Google Cloud by understanding and advocating for our customers’ issues. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. Responsibilities Manage customer problems through effective diagnosis, resolution or implementation of investigation tools to increase productivity for customer issues on Google Cloud Platform products. Develop an in-depth understanding of Google Cloud Data Analytics products (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Composer) and underlying architectures by troubleshooting, reproducing, and determining the root cause for customer-reported issues, building tools for faster diagnosis. Act as consultant and subject matter expert for internal stakeholders in engineering, sales, and customer organizations to resolve technical deployment obstacles and improve Google Cloud. Work as part of a team of engineers/consultants that globally ensure 24-hour customer support, including working non-standard work hours/shifts, and may include weekend work. Advocate customer issues and their needs with cross-functional teams, including product and engineering teams to find ways to improve the product and drive quality production. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Amazon Customer Service handles hundreds of millions of customer contacts each year across every Amazon business. Our Associate Experience Technology (AE-Tech) organization owns the products, platforms, and AI systems that determine how Customer Service Associates (CSAs) handle contacts, compose responses, wrap up interactions, and collaborate with AI—across every contact channel worldwide. The Opportunity Within AE-Tech, our team owns the end-to-end associate-facing tools, workflows, and AI capabilities that power how CSAs interact with customers across contact channels. Our charter spans five high-impact workstreams: Email Contact Channel & Systems — End-to-end ownership of the Email contact channel, one of the highest-volume and most complex channels in Amazon Customer Service—encompassing email ingestion, routing, associate-facing workflows, response management, and channel-level performance optimization Contact Handling & Composition Tools — The systems associates use to handle and respond to customer contacts, including Email Composer, After Contact Work (ACW), annotation systems, and order selection workflows Wrap-up Automation & Contact Lifecycle — Intelligent automation that streamlines post-contact workflows, reduces manual documentation burden, and accelerates wrap-up to improve Average Contact Handle Time (ACHT) GenAI-Powered Customer Service — AI-assisted composition, automated response generation, intelligent summarization, and full contact automation powered by Large Language Models and Generative AI Native Widget Experiences — Modern, performant native widgets that replace legacy page-based experiences, delivering faster and more intuitive tooling for associates across all contact channels We are investing deeply in transforming the associate experience through AI and automation. Our team has already automated a meaningful percentage of contacts and delivered millions in annualized cost savings, and we are just getting started. The opportunity ahead includes scaling automation across channels, building next-generation GenAI-powered tools, and creating intelligent workflows that make every associate more effective. You will own the design, implementation, and delivery of key features and services across these workstreams—writing production code, building scalable systems, and contributing to the tools and platforms that hundreds of thousands of associates use every day to serve Amazon customers worldwide. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. jobs.description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your role As an AI Software Engineer at Kyndryl, you’ll be at the forefront of designing, developing, and implementing cutting-edge software solutions that transform how industries operate. Your work will play a critical role in our business offering, your code will deliver value to our customers faster than ever before, and your attention to detail and commitment to quality will be critical in ensuring the success of our products. Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy and teamwork to help define what comes next. What you will do Drive Production-Grade AI Engineer end-to-end solutions: Using design documentation and state-machine specifications, you’ll implement identified agentic components. You’ll ensure that every tool-call and reasoning loop is appropriately documented, evaluated via automated benchmarks, and ready for integration into the production environment. Architect for scale: You’ll have the opportunity to architect the solution—from vector database schemas to prompt-chaining logic—and build robust LLMOps (CI/CD) pipelines to ensure reliable model deployment. Scope technical possibilities: As a valued member of our team, you will provide work estimates for complex AI development—balancing token costs and latency—and guide features, functional objectives, or agent architectures for stakeholders. Innovate with impact: You’ll have the freedom to drive innovation in self-healing code and automated error correction while honing your problem-solving, collaboration, and automation skills. Together, we can redefine cloud-based managed services through the power of agentic AI. Your Future at Kyndryl At Kyndryl, we understand the importance of investing in our employees' professional growth and development. In Network Services, you can expect to receive a lot of support for training programs to keep your skills and knowledge up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects and contribute to the development of innovative solutions for our customers – including new wireless and 5G technologies – not yet adopted by most companies. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Expertise 3+ years of experience building AI solutions, multi-agent systems, and orchestration frameworks using LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel. Hands-on full-stack development experience using Python, React.js, and TypeScript, along with microservices architecture, back-end services, and RESTful API development. Proficiency in SQL (PostgreSQL), NoSQL (MongoDB), and vector databases, with practical experience deploying RAG architectures for structured and unstructured data. Strong background in Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), Git, and deployment across major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Ability to translate complex business needs into technical solutions and effectively communicate their value to executive-level stakeholders. Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Bachelor’s degree in CS/Engineering (or equivalent) Experience implementing AI telemetry and monitoring tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, and LiteLLM to track agent behavior, latency, and performance. Familiarity with data engineering libraries and distributed frameworks, including Pandas, Spark, and cloud-native AI platforms. Deep understanding of system performance tuning, scalability, security controls, and authentication protocols for enterprise AI operations. Familiarity with community-driven AI libraries, models, and repositories, including Hugging Face, fine-tuning workflows, and open-source models. Broad cross-functional exposure across AI/ML and cloud consulting, combined with deep technical specialization in core software delivery practices. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description: Who Are We? Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster. The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman. P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman. The Opportunity As a Solutions Architect, you will play a pivotal role in managing and growing Postman’s most critical enterprise relationships. This is a senior-level, high-impact role that blends deep technical expertise with business strategy, customer relationship management, and growth leadership. You will act as a trusted technical advisor and strategic partner to marquee customers, helping them unlock the full value of Postman’s API platform and our AI/Agent Stack product portfolio. By deeply understanding their architecture, goals, and organizational dynamics, you will drive technical delivery, scale adoption, and uncover new opportunities for innovation and expansion across the enterprise. This role is ideal for a technically astute and customer-obsessed individual who thrives at the intersection of technology and business. You bring a hunter mentality, a strong sense of ownership, and a passion for discovering new use cases and building lasting partnerships with engineering and leadership stakeholders alike. What You’ll Do Strategic Engagement & Customer Leadership Serve as the technical lead and trusted advisor for a portfolio of Postman’s most strategic enterprise accounts, guiding customers through every stage of the API lifecycle and in building, running, and governing AI agents. Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s strategic initiatives, organizational goals, and maturity across APIs and AI, and align Postman’s multi-product portfolio to support outcomes like digital acceleration, internal developer productivity, and API monetization. Define and drive joint success plans that reflect both technical enablement and business value realization. Business-Driven Technical Advisory Engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders to translate business drivers and pain points into actionable technical strategies using Postman’s products and capabilities. Articulate complex problem spaces - such as API and AI agent governance, developer onboarding, service discoverability, or versioning challenges—into clear implementation paths. Provide proactive, high-touch advisory to promote best practices in API and AI agent design, testing, monitoring, collaboration, and consumption. Pattern Matching, Knowledge Sharing & Product Influence Identify and synthesize recurring usage patterns, friction points, and unmet needs across your customer portfolio to influence Postman’s strategic approach to large enterprises. Contribute to internal playbooks and reusable architectures, enabling the broader team to scale enterprise best practices. Act as a critical feedback loop to Postman’s Product and Engineering teams, providing structured, prioritized insights that inform roadmap discussions and influence feature prioritization. Partner with Product Managers during roadmap reviews, early access programs, and pilot deployments to ensure enterprise requirements are incorporated early and often. Opportunity Discovery & Growth Activation Adopt a hunter mindset within each strategic account, working to uncover new use cases, teams, and departments where Postman can deliver high value and unlock account revenue growth. Use product usage data, strategic account planning sessions, and stakeholder interviews to map expansion pathways. Collaborate closely with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers to drive revenue growth through renewals, expansions, and cross-functional adoption. Cross-Functional Collaboration Operate as a hub of strategic account intelligence, collaborating seamlessly with teams across Postman, including: Sales & Customer Success to define account strategy and measure business impact. Solutions Engineering for deep technical validations and implementation guidance. Product & Engineering to advocate for critical customer needs and influence roadmap direction. Marketing and Partnerships to amplify customer stories, surface use cases, and explore integrations. Lead customer business reviews (QBRs), workshops, and innovation days, and contribute to cross-functional account reviews and internal deal desk discussions to align on strategy and execution. Relationship Building & Executive Engagement Build long-term, trust-based relationships with senior technical and business stakeholders within your accounts. Navigate complex customer organizations to influence decision-making and drive alignment across silos. Represent Postman with thought leadership and strategic presence in customer briefings, workshops, and co-innovation sessions. About You 5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role (e.g., Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Enterprise Consultant) with a strong emphasis on working with Fortune 500 or large-scale global enterprises across complex, multi-cloud and hybrid environments. This role will require about 30% - 40% travel, AND based in  Business proficiency in English is required. A big plus if French, German, Portuguese, or Spanish Speaking. Proven track record of driving enterprise adoption of API platforms and delivering measurable impact through solutioning, technical leadership, and strategic account growth. Experience driving adoption for AI Agent-related products (agent runtime, gateways, secret management, agent context) is a big plus. Strong technical knowledge of the end-to-end API lifecycle, including: RESTful API design, GraphQL, and OpenAPI/Swagger specifications API governance frameworks, schema standardization, and lifecycle management API security protocols: OAuth 2.0, JWT, API keys, SSO/SAML integrations Mocking, testing, monitoring, and documentation best practices at scale Environment and variable management for multi-stage deployments At least foundational knowledge of AI and agentic systems, including: LLM fundamentals: prompting, context management, tool calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) AI agents: multi-step orchestration, Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent skills, and exposing APIs to agents as tools Agentic coding and the AI-driven developer workflow, including AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) Designing agent-ready APIs: clear descriptions, consistent schemas, predictable errors, and discoverability Managing AI agent cost and latency (token usage, model routing, etc.) Evals, guardrails, and observing AI and agent behavior in production Securing and governing agents: identity and access management, scoped credentials, data privacy, and auditability Hands-on experience with source control (Git), CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps), and modern DevOps/infra tools (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, etc.) as well as LLMs/Agentic Coding. Ability to develop custom scripts or integrations using JavaScript or Python to enhance workflow automation, API validation, or bridge systems (e.g., analytics, internal tooling). Strong business acumen and executive presence - capable of translating technical challenges into business opportunities and aligning Postman’s value to customer KPIs such as time-to-market, API reuse, governance compliance, and platform ROI. Proven success in leading customer-facing workshops, technical enablement sessions, and strategic roadmap reviews—with the ability to communicate effectively across engineering, platform, security, and executive audiences. Comfortable navigating and influencing cross-functional internal teams (Sales, Product, Engineering, CS, Solutions Engineering) to deliver on long-term customer strategy. Highly curious, analytical, and driven by impact - with a mindset that seeks continuous learning, scalable patterns, and long-term customer advocacy. What Else? In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom. Our Values At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can. Equal Opportunity Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

THE PERSON: You are a strong circuit designer with deep understanding of CMOS Analog and Mixed-signal design , complemented by the ability to see the larger SoC and system context. Analyze I/O interfaces for signal integrity, power integrity, supply droop, ground bounce, termination, loading, and package/board interactions . Ensure designs meet appropriate ESD, EOS, electromigration, aging, TDDB, voltage-stress, and device-reliability requirements. Partner closely with layout engineers to drive matching, shielding, parasitic management, floorplanning, power routing, and analog layout quality. Collaborate with SoC architecture, RTL/DV, DFT, physical design, package, board, SI/PI, firmware, reliability, and product engineering teams to enable successful IP integration. Develop behavioral models and specifications that enable efficient mixed-signal and SoC-level verification . Support post-layout verification, design reviews, tape-out, silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and production qualification . Identify design risks early and drive technically sound solutions through data-driven analysis. Contribute to circuit and design-methodology innovation and help drive next-generation IP architecture and reuse . Own circuit design from specification and architecture through schematic design, simulation, layout supervision, extraction, sign-off, and silicon characterization . Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers while raising the overall engineering quality of the team. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Industry experience in analog, mixed-signal, I/O, or custom IC design. Strong transistor-level design fundamentals and extensive experience with CMOS circuit design and simulation . Proven experience delivering complex analog/mixed-signal or I/O IP to production silicon . Experience with advanced semiconductor process technologies and understanding of device scaling, process variation, reliability, and low-voltage design challenges . Strong knowledge in several of the following areas: GPIO and general-purpose I/O High-speed transmitter/receiver circuits Level shifters and multi-voltage-domain interfaces Analog/PVT/voltage/temperature monitoring Power and droop detection Clocking and timing circuits Bias and reference circuits Low-power analog techniques Signal and power integrity Hands-on experience with industry-standard schematic, simulation, layout, extraction, and sign-off flows , including SPICE-class circuit simulation. Solid understanding of PVT analysis, Monte Carlo analysis, mismatch, parasitics, timing, jitter, duty-cycle distortion, noise, and circuit stability . Experience debugging challenging pre-silicon and post-silicon circuit issues. Ability to translate system-level requirements into clear circuit specifications and verification requirements . Strong technical communication skills and demonstrated ability to influence architectural and design decisions across multiple engineering teams. jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Can a compliance platform onboard each new team through configuration, and still keep every team's data, permissions, and workflows separate? How do you let an artificial intelligence (AI) agent scan regulatory change or test a control, and still show an auditor every source and approval behind its output? What does it take to keep a platform that compliance teams depend on secure, available, and fast to change? We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE) to join the Engineering team within Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS). Our team builds the Signal Suite, the platform RCS uses to track regulatory change, assess risks and controls, run assurance testing, and manage issues to closure. Payments regulatory compliance is our core domain. RCS's north star is that compliance is never the step that delays a financial product launch, a response to regulatory change, or a market expansion. We are turning the Signal Suite from a compliance repository into the system where compliance work runs end to end. Automation takes on the volume, so experts focus on regulatory interpretation and risk judgment. You design and build that next stage across 3 areas: the multi-tenant platform, the generative AI (GenAI) layer and its AI agents, and the engineering foundation. The platform moves to a configuration-driven design that keeps each tenant's data and access separate in every layer. The AI agents you build run steps of the compliance lifecycle, and compliance experts supervise and approve their work. The engineering foundation covers reliability, security, and release practices. Every output faces internal audit and regulatory examination, so traceability is part of the product. As a Senior SDE, you own each problem from definition to production. You shape the requirements with product managers and Compliance Officers, write the design, build and test the services, and operate them. You make and document the trade-offs between tenant isolation, cost, latency, and delivery speed. You mentor engineers and influence technical direction across teams you do not manage. Our services run on Amazon Web Services (AWS), including AWS Lambda and Amazon DynamoDB. Your partners also include data engineers and business intelligence engineers across RCS. The successful candidate treats an auditor's question as a design requirement and proves an idea with a working prototype before scaling it. Key job responsibilities Lead the architecture of the Signal Suite as a configuration-driven, multi-tenant platform, and build the services, APIs, and data models that keep each tenant's data and access separate Design and build the GenAI layer and the AI agents that work across Signal Suite modules, from regulatory change scanning to risk assessment and assurance testing Create the guardrails that let compliance experts supervise each agent: expert-labeled evaluation sets, release criteria, approval steps, and a record of the sources behind every output Write and review production code for complex components, with AI-assisted development, automated tests, and deployment pipelines that keep every change shippable Define the technical roadmap for your area, and record each architecture trade-off and its reason in a design document Build security into every design, with least-privilege access, encryption of each tenant's data, and audit logs that show who changed what and when Own the operational health of the services you build, from monitoring and alarms to on-call runbooks and incident reviews whose actions remove the root cause Turn regulatory requirements into designs with product managers and Compliance Officers, and align partner teams across RCS through architecture reviews Mentor SDEs through design and code reviews, set the engineering standards the team builds to, and take part in hiring About the team Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS) serves as a crucial safeguard for Amazon's buyers, brands, and selling partners while ensuring business teams meet their regulatory obligations. jobs.description: About the role: Rubrik is looking for a Global Network Development Engineer to design, build, and automate the network security fabric that connects our workforce, datacenters, and multi-cloud production environments. jobs.description: Job ID 67909 Work Style Hybrid Worker Brand HSBC Department Technology Job Type Full Time Date Posted 26 November 2026 Apply By 03 December 2026 Some careers shine brighter than others. If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Service Management The Opportunity This role engineers and operates the trusted data and retrieval layer powering the enterprise Knowledge Graph and its AI-enabled consumers. You’ll build production-grade pipelines that transform structured and unstructured enterprise data into high-quality entities, relationships and retrieval-ready representations with strong controls for provenance, security, quality and operability. The focus is on creating traceable data that links back to authoritative source records and remains reliable as sources and AI use cases grow. Success means dependable graph construction and retrieval datasets that support graph traversal, semantic and vector retrieval and GraphRAG/RAG patterns. You’ll help embed automated testing, observability and recovery across environments so delivery is repeatable rather than bespoke. The outcome is a reusable engineering foundation that reduces one-off integrations and keeps critical knowledge within the permanent team. What you'll be doing Design, build, test and operate batch, incremental and event-driven pipelines from enterprise sources into the Knowledge Graph Implement graph construction logic including node and edge creation, canonical identifiers, relationship derivation, provenance capture and temporal handling Engineer entity resolution, record linkage, de-duplication and reconciliation across heterogeneous sources to prevent conflicting identities and relationships Build AI-ready pipelines for structured and unstructured data including extraction, cleansing, chunking or segmentation, and metadata enrichment Implement embedding generation and vector indexing pipelines where required, including model and version metadata and repeatable re-indexing processes Develop retrieval data services and query patterns for graph traversal, vector or semantic retrieval and hybrid or GraphRAG use cases Embed automated data-quality and graph-quality controls covering completeness, validity, freshness, duplicate entities, broken relationships and reconciliation to source Establish test frameworks and regression testing for mappings, transformations and retrieval datasets as schemas, ontologies, models and feeds evolve Implement end-to-end observability with alerts and recovery runbooks for pipeline health, ingest latency, load failures, indexing status and data freshness Optimise loads, transformations, indexing and retrieval performance for scale, latency and cost while maintaining integrity and auditability What we're looking for Demonstrate advanced Python and SQL with strong software engineering practice including modular design, automated testing, Git, code review and performance optimisation Bring substantial ETL and ELT pipeline engineering experience across APIs, relational data, semi-structured formats and large enterprise datasets Apply hands-on graph engineering experience including property graph concepts, schema or ontology implementation and graph query languages such as Cypher or equivalent Build data preparation and indexing layers for AI retrieval patterns including embeddings, vector search, semantic or hybrid retrieval and RAG or GraphRAG Implement entity resolution and data matching using deterministic and probabilistic approaches with canonical identifiers and source reconciliation Establish data quality, metadata, lineage, provenance, schema evolution and data contract practices in production environments Deliver CI/CD, containers and platform engineering patterns with production support and infrastructure-aware troubleshooting Apply secure data engineering controls including IAM or service identities, secrets management, encryption and auditability suitable for a regulated enterprise Building trusted retrieval at scale If you want your work to shape how AI systems retrieve and ground information across an enterprise this role offers the scope to do it with rigour. You’ll build pipelines and controls that keep the Knowledge Graph reliable, traceable and ready for real production use cases. The work spans ingestion, graph construction, quality, observability and retrieval services and it’s designed to scale as adoption grows. If you’re ready to turn complex enterprise data into trusted graph and retrieval foundations we’d welcome your application. You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC. www.hsbc.com/careers HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. Issued by – HSBC Software Development India

jobs.description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. You will work closely with other engineering squads/tribes to develop new features and products, and ensure that the implemented components are feature, integration, and system tested before being released to our customers. You will also be responsible for automating test cases to build test suits for regression, scalability, and performance testing. You will analyze, track, and verify defects during the software development lifecycle, and contribute to designing, developing, implementing, executing, and troubleshooting automated test tools, test frameworks, and test scripts for application and API testing. jobs.title: Manager, Ontology Engineering
jobs.description: Our Company: At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. About the role We are seeking an exceptional leader to manage and lead the Industry Domain Knowledge Team . In this role, you will build and lead Teradata's Industry Domain Knowledge organization. This is not a traditional management role . We are looking for a high-ownership, startup-oriented leader who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, attracts exceptional talent, and relentlessly drives outcomes. You will build a new strategic capability at the center of Teradata's AI vision. Your organization will own the complete lifecycle of Teradata's industry knowledge models, including ontologies, taxonomies, business vocabularies, semantic models, canonical information models, and business context assets spanning industries such as healthcare, financial services, communications, retail, manufacturing, travel, insurance, utilities, and life sciences. The team's mission is to transform decades of Teradata expertise into structured, governed, continuously improving domain knowledge that powers Context Engine, AI agents, data discovery, grounding, reasoning, and automation across enterprise customers. You will lead a multidisciplinary team of domain modelers, knowledge engineers, ontology specialists, and industry experts responsible for creating the industry's most comprehensive enterprise knowledge foundation. The output of your organization will directly influence AI accuracy, explainability, governance, and business value across the Teradata platform. This builds upon Teradata's vision of industry knowledge models, metadata, ontologies, semantic representations, and enterprise context as a governed AI-ready foundation. Responsibilities Build and Scale the Industry Domain Knowledge Organization Recruit, develop, and lead a world-class team of data modelers, ontology engineers, knowledge engineers, information architects, and industry domain experts. Establish the charter, operating model, roadmap, priorities, and success metrics for the organization. Build a strong culture of ownership, execution velocity, quality, innovation, and customer obsession. Create an environment that combines startup speed with enterprise rigor. Develop the team into a strategic competitive advantage for Teradata. Own Teradata's Industry Knowledge Assets Own the quality, completeness, consistency, governance, and evolution of all industry domain models across Teradata. Establish ownership and accountability frameworks for domain knowledge assets. Create and maintain long-term roadmaps for industry coverage expansion. Drive standardization across ontologies, taxonomies, canonical data models, semantic layers, business glossaries, and knowledge graphs. Ensure knowledge assets remain accurate, relevant, versioned, and auditable. Define the Industry Knowledge Platform Strategy Establish the vision for how structured industry knowledge powers Context Engine, AI systems, autonomous agents, search, discovery, analytics, and governance. Partner closely with engineering, product management, AI research, customer success, and field organizations. Define standards for ontology management, semantic interoperability, metadata consistency, model lifecycle management, and knowledge governance. Drive the adoption of reusable knowledge frameworks across all product teams. Drive Industry Model Expansion Prioritize and expand industry coverage based on market opportunity, customer demand, and product strategy. Lead development of deep industry models across healthcare, financial services, communications, retail, manufacturing, utilities, travel, insurance, media, and life sciences. Create repeatable frameworks for rapidly onboarding new industries and business domains. Ensure domain models accurately represent real-world business entities, processes, concepts, regulations, metrics, and relationships. Establish Operational Excellence Define rigorous processes for knowledge acquisition, validation, review, publication, change management, and governance. Implement measurable quality standards and automated validation frameworks. Create scalable workflows enabling continuous improvement of domain models. Define KPIs around quality, coverage, adoption, completeness, consistency, and business impact. Establish best practices for model stewardship and lifecycle management. AI, Semantic Systems and Knowledge Engineering Leadership Ensure industry knowledge models directly support agent grounding, semantic search, RAG systems, reasoning engines, knowledge graphs, and AI-driven workflows. Partner with engineering teams to operationalize knowledge assets within products and services. Drive innovation in semantic technologies, graph architectures, ontology engineering, and AI-assisted knowledge creation. Create feedback loops between customer usage, AI performance, and knowledge model evolution. Customer and Market Engagement Engage directly with strategic customers to understand domain requirements and validate knowledge assets. jobs.description: JOB DESCRIPTION Assume a critical role in defining the future of a globally recognized firm and have a direct and significant effect in a realm tailored for top achievers in site reliability. As a Lead Site Reliability Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Infrastructure Platforms team, you hold a leadership role in your team, demonstrate strong knowledge across multiple technical domains, and advise others on the technical and business issues facing them. Take lead and conduct resiliency design reviews, break up complex problems into digestible work for other engineers, act as a technical lead for medium to large-sized products, and provide advice and mentoring to other engineers. Job responsibilities Consistently models and champions site reliability culture and practices, documents and shares knowledge within your organization via internal forums and communities of practice Lead the design, development and delivery of the automation platform for the Global ESX Infrastructure SRE team's VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF 5.x / VCF 9) estate, covering vSphere, vCenter, ESXi, vSAN and NSX, as development lead engineer and SME Own the automation codebase and engineering standards across the full SDLC, including requirements, design reviews, Git branching, peer code review, automated testing, static analysis, secure coding, CI/CD, versioning, release notes and controlled promotion from lab to production Develop secure, high-quality, maintainable Python code (pyVmomi, vSphere Automation SDK, SDDC Manager / VCF and NSX REST APIs), and review and debug code written by others Build reusable frameworks, Infrastructure as Code and self-service workflows (VCF / Aria Automation and Orchestrator, Terraform, Ansible) that automate provisioning, patching through vLCM / SDDC Manager, configuration drift remediation, resource optimization, compliance, health checks and reporting Design safe automation based on VMware virtualization (HA/DRS, vMotion, vSAN, maintenance mode, vLCM), with pre/post validation, idempotency, automated testing, rollback and runbooks, and make sure every change follows ITIL change management with traceability and audit evidence Build observability and self-healing patterns into automation and platform tooling by correlating vCenter events, VCF Operations, VCF Operations for Logs and out-of-band (iLO/iDRAC) telemetry, and work with stakeholders to define SLIs, SLOs and error budgets Serve as SME, main point of contact and escalation point during major incidents, use enterprise-authorized AI and analysis of past incidents to speed up triage and RCA, and drive problem management to closure through preventive automation Mentor engineers on software engineering and SDLC practices, work with SRE, platform engineering and application teams to prioritize the automation backlog, lead performance testing and evaluation of new tools, and promote reuse-first adoption of AI-assisted reliability workflows with appropriate guardrails Leads reuse-first adoption of AI-assisted reliability workflows across SDLC/toolchain practices (e.g., CI/CD quality checks, test/validation automation, and operational readiness), ensuring traceability/auditability, resiliency, and security controls. Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate major-incident triage, troubleshooting, and post-incident analysis, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills Formal training or certification on site reliability engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience Demonstrated proficiency in reliability, scalability, performance, security, enterprise system architecture, toil reduction, and other site reliability best practices Hold a current VMware certification such as VCP-VCF Administrator or VCP-DCV Demonstrate proven experience as a development lead or senior software engineer delivering production-grade infrastructure automation in large-scale, high-availability VMware environments using SDLC best practices (Git, code review, unit / integration testing, CI/CD, release management) Apply advanced Python development skills (object-oriented design, packaging, testing frameworks such as pytest) against REST and SOAP APIs, with working knowledge of additional languages such as PowerShell, JavaScript or Java Bring a solid understanding of VMware virtualization, including vSphere (ESXi, vCenter), HA/DRS, vMotion, vSAN and NSX within VCF 5.x / VCF 9, and proficiency in making service-level changes and troubleshooting in enterprise environments Use Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (Terraform, Ansible), CI/CD tooling (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions), containers and container orchestration, and observability practices such as white and black box monitoring, SLO alerting, telemetry collection, VCF Operations and VCF Operations for Logs Apply a strong data center networking background (NAT, DFW, BGP, VRF, MPLS, IP, TCP, UDP) and hands-on experience with ITIL incident, problem and change management and ITSM tooling (e.g., ServiceNow) in a regulated production environment, including acting as SME on major incidents Demonstrate experience using enterprise-authorized AI to improve SRE workflows, with strong validation habits, awareness of data sensitivity and the ability to define guardrails, along with agile team leadership, self-motivation, and strong communication, documentation and problem-solving skills with both technical and non-technical audiences Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to improve SRE workflows (e.g., incident investigation support and knowledge capture) with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity. jobs.title: Staff GenAI Engineer - Evaluation & Trust
jobs.description:
Who are we? Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work. Job Summary Designs, develops and deploys the evaluation and trust capabilities of Equinix's GenAI platform. Builds platform features that let teams evaluate their agents at scale: golden datasets, synthetic test data, scoring with LLM-as-judge, and monitoring of agent quality in production. Builds and tests the trust controls that agents run on, including agent identity, access, guardrails and data boundaries. Traces agent failures to their root cause and fixes them in the platform. Works in a team with senior engineers and with product, platform and security partners to turn defined problems into robust, secure, observable and performant solutions. Knowledge and Application Applies solid knowledge of software engineering practice and of LLM and agent concepts (prompting, retrieval, tool and function calling, orchestration, MCP). Understands evaluation methods (code-based checks, LLM-as-judge, human review, golden datasets, regression suites) and evaluation statistics (sampling, variance across runs, agreement between reviewers). Understands AI security risks such as prompt injection and data leakage, and identity concepts such as OAuth and per-user access. Follows established standards and suggests improvements. Complexity and Problem Solving Works on problems of defined scope where analysis requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Traces an agent failure to its cause (retrieval, tool call, prompt, model, data or infrastructure) using logs and traces, and follows it until it is fixed. Judges whether a metric reflects real quality. Escalates unusual or high-impact issues. Work is reviewed at defined checkpoints. Collaboration and Interaction Works with AI engineers, product managers, forward-deployed engineers, platform and security teams. Turns the needs of agent builders into platform features. Explains results, defects and risks to partners who are not familiar with the subject. Asks for guidance early and shares knowledge with the team. Responsibilities Evaluation platform (primary focus) Build platform features for evaluation: dataset creation and versioning, golden datasets, synthetic test data and reusable metric templates Build scoring for agents: code-based checks, LLM-as-judge, tool-call accuracy and grounding checks Build human-review features that compare judge scores against human reviewers, and recalibrate when agreement is low Run evaluations at scale: before release, on every change to a prompt, model or tool, and on agents in production Build evaluation playbooks so agent builders can evaluate their agents without specialist help Keep results traceable to the agent, model, prompt and dataset versions tested, with a record of who approved each release Trust and safety Build and test the platform's trust controls: agent identity, per-user access to connected systems, tool permissions, guardrails and data boundaries Run adversarial tests and red-teaming (prompt injection, out-of-scope requests, data-boundary tests), and turn findings into fixes and regression tests Work with security and governance teams to turn policy requirements into automated checks Root-cause analysis and quality Investigate agent failures and performance problems end to end, and follow them until the cause is fixed Build test and performance tooling: end-to-end agent tests, load and latency tests, and failure diagnostics Turn production failures and user feedback into regression tests, so the same defect does not return Quality and responsible practice Write tested, reviewed and documented code, and contribute to shared libraries and tooling Test and build to security, data-privacy and responsible-AI requirements Qualifications Required 3 - 6 years in AI/ML or software engineering (internships and applied research count) Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent experience Proficiency in Python, with solid habits: version control, testing, code review. Experience building backend services or platform features Hands-on experience building, not only using, evaluations or test systems for ML or LLM applications, including reading failures from logs or traces Working knowledge of LLM applications (prompting, retrieval, agents) Working knowledge of evaluation statistics (sampling, confidence intervals, variance across runs) and of measuring agreement between reviewers Ability to write SQL and analyze results Clear written and verbal communication Nice to have Experience building evaluation or observability features used by many teams or at scale Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools, and tracing standards such as OpenTelemetry Experience with red-teaming or adversarial testing of LLM systems Experience with identity and access (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, delegated access) Experience with performance, load or test engineering Experience with agent frameworks, MCP or A2A Experience with Google Cloud (Vertex AI, GKE) and Kubernetes Familiarity with AI risk frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) MS in a related field What success looks like Platform features ship on schedule, with tests and documentation Teams can evaluate their agents on the platform without specialist help Every agent release carries an evaluation record with criteria, results, open defects and approver Judge scores agree with human reviewers, and teams use them to make release decisions Trust controls are enforced by the platform and covered by automated tests Defects found in evaluation become regression tests, and the same defect does not return The engineer takes on larger, less defined work each quarter with decreasing guidance Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. jobs.description: This is a 2 years fixed term contract About the Role GSK’s Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. The Forward Deployed Engineer is the engineer GSK sends in to find out whether an AI idea will work — embedded with business unit teams, proving ideas through PoCs, PoVs, and MVPs at a days-to-weeks cadence, then handing the proven solution off to the Sr. Solutions Engineer for scale-up. jobs.title: Associate, AI Data Scientist- Private Markets
jobs.description: About this role Build efficient, trusted agentic AI for private-markets intelligence Research, build and scale advanced agentic systems and fit-for-purpose language models that turn complex information into dependable data, research and decision intelligence. Your team You will join a multidisciplinary AI and data science team focused on applying advanced AI to high-value challenges in private markets. The team brings together data science, engineering, product and domain expertise, and works closely with users to develop practical capabilities that improve how information is acquired, researched and managed. You will work in an environment where applied research is expected to become dependable production capability. We value intellectual curiosity, rigorous experimentation, strong engineering and responsible AI, with quality, security and appropriate human oversight designed in from the start. Your role & impact As an Associate, AI Data Scientist, you will be a hands-on technical contributor responsible for researching, building and scaling enterprise-grade agentic AI capabilities. Working directly with users and senior technical leaders, you will translate complex private-markets workflows into well-evaluated systems that move from experimentation to governed production and sustained adoption. Your core mandate is to advance multi-agent LLM systems through effective agent design patterns, rigorous evaluation and disciplined model engineering. You will develop workflows that plan, retrieve, reason, use tools, verify and escalate appropriately, while selecting the simplest architecture and model that can meet the required quality, latency, cost and control objectives. You will also help establish the lifecycle for open-source small language models and LLMs, from model discovery and benchmarking through training, adaptation, fine-tuning, deployment, monitoring and retirement. Your impact will be visible in stronger data quality, faster research, scalable automation and reusable AI capabilities that help BlackRock Preqin remain at the forefront of private-markets data and technology. Your responsibilities · Work forward-deployed with researchers, data specialists and product teams to understand workflows, frame ambiguous problems, define measurable outcomes and iterate rapidly from evidence to production. · Research, design and deliver agentic workflows spanning planning, retrieval, tool use, structured extraction, reasoning, verification, exception handling and human escalation, using single-agent or multi-agent patterns where each is demonstrably appropriate. · Engineer advanced agent patterns, including bounded iterative loops, reflection and critique, planner-executor and evaluator-optimizer patterns, with explicit stop conditions, budgets and safeguards that prevent unproductive or uncontrolled execution. · Build agent and model harnesses that standardise tool interfaces, context assembly, state and memory handling, policy enforcement, tracing, replay and failure recovery. · Determine when an agentic architecture, retrieval workflow, specialised model or deterministic service is the best fit, and validate the decision against representative tasks and simpler baselines. · Design safe caching and reuse across retrieval, prompts, model responses, tool results and intermediate agent state, with clear cache keys, invalidation, freshness, access-control and provenance requirements. · Build systematic evaluation harnesses using representative datasets, explicit quality dimensions, adversarial and edge-case testing, regression suites, human feedback and monitored production outcomes. · Research and benchmark open-source SLMs and LLMs for task fit, considering quality, inference performance, cost, licensing, security, deployment constraints and operational supportability; apply fit-for-purpose routing and batching where they improve efficiency. · Develop model-adaptation strategies using prompt and context optimisation, supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning or other suitable techniques, supported by governed dataset creation, experiment tracking, reproducibility and controlled promotion criteria. · Operate the lifecycle for trained and fine-tuned open-source models, including data and model versioning, lineage, experiment and artifact management, evaluation gates, registry and release controls, deployment, performance and drift monitoring, rollback, retraining triggers and retirement. · Build production-quality Python components that integrate models with enterprise data, retrieval services, APIs, workflow orchestration and human-review experiences. · Improve grounding and trust through attribution, provenance, uncertainty handling, validation checks, access controls and clear separation of source evidence from model-generated conclusions. · Own delivered reliability across testing, observability, latency, cost and maintainability, and diagnose model, data, prompt and orchestration failures in production. · Document findings, reusable patterns and trade-offs; contribute to design reviews; and communicate results clearly to research, product, engineering, risk and senior stakeholders. · Partner with engineering, product, risk, privacy, information security, legal and compliance colleagues to support responsible, secure and accountable use of AI. Required experience We are looking for a hands-on applied AI practitioner who combines strong research and modelling skills with production judgment and user-focused problem solving. You should bring: · Strong experience building and deploying AI or machine-learning systems in an enterprise, SaaS, data-product or similarly complex environment, with evidence of taking work beyond prototypes. · Practical depth in LLM applications and agentic systems, including retrieval, tool use, planning, orchestration, memory or state management, structured outputs, verification and evaluation of non-deterministic behaviour. · Experience implementing and comparing bounded loops, reflection or critique, planner-executor and evaluator-optimizer patterns against simpler baselines, with measurable treatment of quality, reliability, latency, token usage, cost and failure modes. · Experience building agent or model harnesses across tool interfaces, context and state management, orchestration, policy enforcement, testing, tracing, replay, deployment and observability. · Hands-on experience evaluating, selecting, training or adapting open-source SLMs or LLMs, including benchmarking, governed dataset preparation, supervised or parameter-efficient fine-tuning and inference optimisation. · Practical ModelOps experience for trained or fine-tuned models, including dataset and model lineage, experiment and artifact tracking, registries, evaluation gates, controlled release, performance and drift monitoring, rollback, retraining and retirement. · Experience designing model routing, batching and safe caching with appropriate keying, invalidation, freshness, privacy, access-control and provenance safeguards. · Strong grounding in modern machine learning, experimentation and statistical evaluation, with disciplined handling of train-test separation, leakage, uncertainty, reproducibility and model comparison. · Ability to write production-quality Python and work effectively across data preparation, model development, APIs, orchestration, testing, deployment and observability. · Experience with unstructured or multimodal information, semantic retrieval, provenance and data-quality engineering in workflows where domain experts provide ground truth and structured feedback. · Experience working directly with users or domain specialists to turn ambiguous needs into usable capabilities and iterate based on observed workflow outcomes. · Sound judgment on model and architecture trade-offs across efficacy, efficiency, security, licensing, maintainability and operational risk. · Clear communication and collaborative delivery skills, with the ability to explain experiments, limitations and production trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences. · Understanding of private markets, alternative investments, financial data or adjacent institutional-investment workflows is desirable; curiosity and the ability to build domain depth quickly are essential. · Commitment to responsible AI, data provenance, privacy, security and meaningful human control in high-trust enterprise workflows. Why this role This is an opportunity to work on consequential AI problems, real user workflows and high standards for trust. You will have meaningful hands-on ownership, direct access to users and the opportunity to turn emerging agent and model techniques into durable capabilities with enterprise reach. Our benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. Our hybrid work model BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. Guidance on AI use for candidates At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. About BlackRock At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com . We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn , Instagram , YouTube , X , and TikTok . BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.
