jobs.description: Working at Atlassian Atlassians can choose where they work â whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. This is a remote position. To help our teams work together effectively, this role requires you to be located in India. We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team, dedicated to developing innovative solutions to make AI services responsible (Responsible AI). You will join the Responsible AI (RAI) & AI Safety engineering team. We are responsible for building, operating, and advancing the centralized AI safety, content moderation, and guardrail platforms powering Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo. Our systems run inline and asynchronously across high-throughput production workloads, detecting and mitigating jailbreaks, prompt injection, harmful content, bias, and policy violations while preserving latency and user experience. We partner closely with Product Engineering, Central AI Platform, AI Gateway, Legal, and Trust teams to deliver safety systems that scale globally. We have teams in the USA, Australia, New Zealand, and this will be our expansion to India. This team is responsible for building solutions and operating mature platforms to improve the entire company's security and trust & safety posture. If you are passionate about improving security, trust & safety, and combating abuse, this role presents a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact! At Atlassian, a Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) is responsible for building, training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models into production systems at scale. The role sits at the intersection of software engineering and data science, requiring production-grade code to turn research prototypes into real-world systems like search ranking, recommendations, and GenAI platforms. What Youâll Do Design & Productionize Safety Models: Architect, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM-based guardrail and moderation models (text, multi-modal, and code) to safeguard user inputs and model outputs across Atlassian products. Build Robust Evaluation & Benchmarking: Design offline and online evaluation frameworks, adversarial test suites (red-teaming), and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to measure precision, recall, false-positive rates, and robustness against model drift. Optimize for Real-Time Serving: Work at the intersection of model accuracy and low latency (P50/P99 targets) to deliver cost-effective, high-throughput safety filtering integrated with our central AI Gateway and inference layers. Combat Emerging Threats: Research and build defenses against adversarial prompts, jailbreaks, data leakage, hallucinations, and unauthorized tool-calling behaviors in agentic systems. Drive Global Compliance & Governance: Support technical readiness for enterprise standards and emerging AI regulations (e.g., EU AI Act, ISO 42001 / AIMS, FedRAMP) through verifiable safety controls, audit logging, and watermarking capabilities. Collaborate & Mentor: Partner with engineering managers, staff engineers, data scientists, and product managers to steer technical strategy; provide code/design reviews and mentor junior engineers across the team. Your background Bachelorâs or Masterâs degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, with 7+ years of industry experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production. Deep hands-on experience with modern NLP and LLM techniques, transformer architectures, prompt engineering, fine-tuning (e.g., PEFT/LoRA), and model alignment. Proficiency in Python (and familiarity with Kotlin, Java, or Go) with a track record of writing clean, testable, and performant production-grade code. Proven experience constructing rigorous evaluation pipelines, benchmarking datasets, and managing precision/recall trade-offs for high-consequence classification or safety systems. Expertise at telling stories with data and familiarity with at least one visualization tool (e.g. Tableau, R-Shiny, Microstrategy, SAP Business Objects, Looker, etc.) Experience deploying and scaling ML services in cloud environments (AWS / GCP) using containerized platforms (Kubernetes/Docker) and distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, SQL). Strong analytical problem-solving skills, ability to navigate ambiguity, and clear communication skills to articulate ML trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. An agile development mindset focused on constant iteration, solving problems from first principles, and navigating ambiguity. It's great, but not required, if you have Experience specifically in Trust & Safety, Content Moderation, or AI Red-Teaming / Adversarial Robustness. Hands-on experience optimizing inference engines (e.g., Triton Inference Server, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM) or model quantization techniques for low-latency serving. Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, content provenance/watermarking, or regulatory compliance standards (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001). Experience with large-scale streaming pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis) or graph-based entity systems. Benefits & Perks Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits . About Atlassian At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Machine Learning Engineer Description - We are looking for a Senior MLOps Engineer to design, build, and operate the infrastructure that enables machine learning models and large language models to be deployed safely, reliably, and at scale. In this role, you will create the end-to-end capabilities required to move models from experimentation into production, expose them through secure and highly available endpoints, and enable users and applications to interact with AI-powered services. You will work across AWS and Databricks to establish robust CI/CD pipelines, model-serving infrastructure, observability, governance, rollback mechanisms, and operational standards. You will partner closely with data scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers, security teams, and platform engineers. The ideal candidate combines strong cloud and DevOps engineering skills with a practical understanding of machine learning systems, LLM deployment patterns, and production reliability. Key Responsibilities MLOps Platform and Architecture Design and implement a scalable MLOps platform using AWS and Databricks. Define reference architectures and reusable deployment patterns for traditional machine learning models, deep learning models, and large language models. Build standardized workflows that move models from development and validation into staging and production. Develop self-service capabilities that allow data scientists and ML engineers to deploy models without manually managing infrastructure. Establish clear separation between development, testing, staging, and production environments. Design multi-region or multi-availability-zone architectures where required by business continuity and availability objectives. CI/CD and Model Deployment Build automated CI/CD pipelines for model code, inference services, infrastructure, configuration, and model artifacts. Implement automated testing across the deployment lifecycle, including: Unit testing Integration testing Model validation Data contract validation API and endpoint testing Security testing Performance and load testing Regression testing Automate model packaging, containerization, versioning, approval, promotion, and deployment. Support deployment strategies such as blue-green deployments, canary releases, shadow deployments, and controlled traffic shifting. Implement reliable rollback and roll-forward mechanisms for application code, infrastructure, model versions, prompts, and configuration. Ensure deployments are reproducible, auditable, and recoverable. Model and LLM Serving Design and operate secure, scalable, low-latency inference endpoints. Deploy models using appropriate services and patterns across AWS and Databricks, such as: Databricks Model Serving MLflow Model Registry Amazon SageMaker Amazon ECS or EKS AWS Lambda, where appropriate API Gateway Application Load Balancers Build synchronous, asynchronous, batch, and streaming inference capabilities. Design serving architectures for LLM-powered applications, including: Hosted foundation models Open-source models Fine-tuned models Retrieval-augmented generation Embedding services Vector search Prompt and response orchestration Tool-calling and agentic workflows Optimize inference performance, scalability, GPU utilization, concurrency, throughput, latency, and cost. Implement autoscaling, request throttling, queuing, caching, timeout handling, and graceful degradation. Reliability, Recovery, and Business Continuity Build recoverable model-serving endpoints with clearly defined recovery time and recovery point objectives. Implement automated health checks, failover mechanisms, retry policies, circuit breakers, and service recovery procedures. Design backup and recovery processes for: Model artifacts Model registry metadata Feature definitions Deployment configurations Infrastructure state Prompts and application configuration Vector indexes and knowledge-base assets Create disaster recovery procedures and regularly test restoration and failover capabilities. Ensure production services can recover from failed deployments, infrastructure outages, model errors, and upstream dependency failures. Develop operational runbooks and incident response procedures. Monitoring and Observability Implement end-to-end observability for infrastructure, applications, models, data, and user interactions. Monitor: Availability Request volume Latency Error rates Resource utilization Model performance Data quality Data drift Concept drift Prediction distributions LLM response quality Hallucination and safety indicators Token consumption Cost per request Establish dashboards, alerts, service-level indicators, and service-level objectives. Integrate monitoring with incident management and on-call processes. Enable traceability from user requests through model inference, retrieval, orchestration, and downstream services. Support root-cause analysis by maintaining structured logs, metrics, traces, model lineage, and deployment history. Security and Governance Implement security controls for model-serving environments, APIs, data access, and deployment pipelines. Apply least-privilege access using AWS IAM, Databricks permissions, service principals, and role-based access control. Secure secrets, credentials, API keys, certificates, and tokens using approved secrets-management solutions. Implement encryption in transit and at rest. Design private networking, endpoint controls, firewall rules, and secure connectivity patterns. Support authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and tenant isolation for AI services. Ensure models and LLM applications comply with organizational requirements for privacy, security, auditability, and responsible AI. Maintain model lineage, approval records, version history, and deployment audit trails. Implement controls for sensitive data, personally identifiable information, prompt injection, unsafe outputs, and unauthorized model access. Infrastructure as Code and Automation Build and maintain cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation. Automate environment provisioning, policy enforcement, deployment configuration, and platform upgrades. Create reusable modules, templates, libraries, and deployment frameworks. Implement configuration management and environment-specific parameterization. Ensure infrastructure changes are peer-reviewed, tested, version-controlled, and traceable. Collaboration and Engineering Standards Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to productionize models and define deployment requirements. Work with software engineering teams to integrate model endpoints into user-facing products and internal applications. Collaborate with cybersecurity, architecture, legal, privacy, and governance teams. Define MLOps engineering standards, design principles, coding practices, and operational requirements. Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and production-readiness assessments. Machine Learning Experience : Significant experience in MLOps, platform engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, cloud engineering, or production machine learning. Proven experience deploying and operating machine learning models in production. Strong hands-on experience with AWS services and cloud architecture. Strong hands-on experience with Databricks, including MLflow, model registries, jobs, clusters, permissions, and model-serving capabilities. Experience building CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or AWS CodePipeline, Docker and containerized application deployment. Experience with Kubernetes and managed container platforms such as Amazon EKS or ECS. Proficiency in Python and experience building production-quality APIs and inference services. Experience with REST APIs, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and distributed systems. Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform. Experience with model versioning, artifact management, experiment tracking, and deployment promotion workflows. Experience implementing monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and production support processes. Strong understanding of high availability, disaster recovery, fault tolerance, and rollback strategies. Knowledge of cloud networking, IAM, secrets management, encryption, and secure software delivery. Training and inference workflows Online and batch inference Model serialization and packaging Feature engineering and feature consistency Model validation and evaluation,l drift and data drift Model explainability and reproducibility GPU-based model serving Embeddings and vector databases Retrieval-augmented generation Prompt management and versioning LLM evaluation and guardrails Token limits, context management, and inference cost optimization Responsible AI, content safety, and human-in-the-loop controls This role does not necessarily require the candidate to develop new machine learning algorithms. However, the candidate must be able to understand model behavior, deployment constraints, performance characteristics, and operational risks. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 12+ years of total experience Experience deploying generative AI or LLM-based applications in production. Experience with Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Databricks Mosaic AI, or similar AI platforms. Experience with vector-search technologies such as Databricks Vector Search, OpenSearch, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or pgvector. Experience with LLM application frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent orchestration tools. Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, or Splunk. Experience applying SRE practices to machine learning and AI systems. Experience operating platforms in regulated, enterprise, or data-sensitive environments. Relevant AWS, Databricks, Kubernetes, or cloud architecture certifications. What Success Looks Like Within the first 6 to 12 months, the successful candidate will: Establish a standardized and automated path from model development to production. Reduce the time required to deploy a new model or LLM service. Enable repeatable deployments across development, staging, and production. Provide reliable and secure endpoints through which users and applications can interact with AI. Implement automated rollback and recovery for failed deployments. Establish monitoring for service health, model performance, quality, security, and cost. Improve availability, deployment frequency, change-failure rate, and recovery time. Create reusable platform components that increase engineering productivity. Establish production-readiness standards for machine learning and generative AI services. Example Performance Indicators Model deployment lead time Deployment frequency Percentage of automated deployments Change-failure rate Mean time to detect incidents Mean time to recover Endpoint availability P95 and P99 inference latency Model rollback success rate Recovery-test success rate Infrastructure provisioning time Cost per inference request Percentage of production models with complete lineage and monitoring Number of security or compliance exceptions Internal developer and data scientist satisfaction Ideal Candidate Profile You are a pragmatic platform engineer who understands that deploying a model is only the beginning. You think about security, reliability, monitoring, recovery, cost, governance, and the end-user experience from the start. You are comfortable moving between cloud architecture, infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, Python services, Databricks workflows, model registries, Kubernetes, and production incident management. You can translate experimental AI solutions into dependable services that users can trust. Job Purpose The Automation Architect owns the technical design of a DPTF platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the platform's services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations. Platforms span cloud, network and digital workplace domains, and the specific platform is set on appointment. The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture. Key Responsibilities Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture. Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations. Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational. Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after. Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity. Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim. Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work. Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions. Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why. Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it. Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted. Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build. Education & Professional Qualifications Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems). Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform). Job Experience: Typically 15+ years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to. Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud, network or digital workplace. Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard. Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets. Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context. Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet. Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations. Desirable Hands-on experience architecting and building AI/agentic systems — LLMs, evaluation pipelines, ML lifecycle — at production scale. Experience assessing data readiness (availability, quality, access, labeling) and flagging risks before builds start. Working knowledge of at least one pharma value chain area (R&D, manufacturing, or commercial). Background spotting reusable patterns across engagements and turning them into shared, durable technical capability. Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented. Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard. Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them. Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome. Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright. Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform. #AGTech Skills Asset Life Cycle Management, Data Integrity, Digital Fluency, Enterprise Architecture (EA), Enterprise IT Architecture, GxP Regulations, Information Security, Lean Management, Manufacturing Technologies, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Platform Architecture, Problem Solving, Risk Awareness, Solution Architecture, Standards Compliance Why GSK? We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Develop and deploy solutions on AWS , integrating relevant cloud, security, logging, data, and application services and applying Amazon Bedrock where suitable; work with structured and unstructured enterprise data across platforms such as Amazon S3, Databricks, and Snowflake. Use Python and Jupyter Notebook for rapid experimentation, prototyping, evaluation, and technical validation , maintaining a clear path to production and applying software engineering discipline through modular design, version control, automated testing, documentation, CI/CD, release management, and production support. Monitor and continuously improve live solutions across reliability, response quality, performance, usability, security, and cost; troubleshoot production issues while applying responsible AI, security, privacy, and data-handling requirements throughout solution design, development, and operation. Strong programming capability in Python and practical experience using Jupyter Notebook for AI experimentation and development. Professional software development experience in Python and at least one additional language such as JavaScript/TypeScript or Java. Hands-on working experience with AWS and developing or deploying cloud-based applications. Proven hands-on experience designing and implementing RAG applications, including embeddings, chunking, retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, context management, grounding, and hallucination mitigation. Hands-on experience with LangChain and LangGraph for LLM applications, agentic workflows, or multi-step orchestration. Hands-on experience with AI/LLM evaluation and observability using LangSmith, Ragas, or equivalent tools and methods. Practical working experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), including building or consuming MCP-enabled integrations. Strong understanding of REST APIs, API-driven architecture, API Gateways, authentication/authorization, API security, rate limiting, and enterprise integration patterns. Experience building user-facing web applications with React.js, Next.js, or similar modern front-end frameworks. Experience taking AI capabilities from prototype through production, with testing, monitoring, documentation, and operational support. Desirable Requirements: Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock, including foundation model APIs, Knowledge Bases, Agents, Guardrails, or model evaluation capabilities. Working knowledge of Databricks, Snowflake, Amazon S3, vector databases, hybrid search, and enterprise data platforms. Knowledge of multi-agent patterns, AI security, responsible AI, prompt and context engineering, and LLM observability. Relevant AI, Generative AI, cloud, or software engineering certifications. jobs.title: Research Engineer, Post-Training & Vision-Language Models
jobs.description: Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe. We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture. Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security? About the Role : Enterprise documents such as contracts, invoices, filings and reports hold some of the world’s most valuable data, and most of it is still locked in layouts, tables and charts that software struggles to read. The Gaia team at Cohesity is building a world-class agentic document processing product to change that. At its heart are vision language models (VLMs) that read documents as images, extract structured data, understand complex layouts, tables and charts, and answer questions about their content. We’re looking for a Research Engineer to push that capability forward. You’ll work where research meets production, owning the fine-tuning, evaluation and data pipelines that determine how well our models understand and act on real enterprise data. You’ll have broad scope, significant compute, and a direct line from your work to a shipping product. The problems are open-ended: the path is ambiguous, the signal is noisy, and the right answer takes both research taste and engineering execution. Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data protection and security, trusted by over 13,600 enterprise customers, including more than 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500. Together they entrust us with over 200 exabytes of data. We’re backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud and others, and headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe. Want to join a scaled multi-billion ARR private company? On a team that’s operating like a Series A company? HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE: Evaluate, select, and adapt VLMs (open-weight and API-based) for document parsing, layout understanding, table and chart extraction, OCR-heavy content, and document question answering. Fine-tune vision-language models using SFT and latest RL techniques such as RLHF / RLAIF / RLVR, GRPO or PPO-style RL for document understanding to hill climb towards the best document understanding in the industry. Build reinforcement learning (RL) training platforms, design reward signals, and optimize model reasoning. Build and maintain evaluation harnesses to measure model performance across capability and reliability dimensions. Create pipelines for synthetic data generation to support training and evaluation. Develop and refine post-training recipes that measurably improve production model quality. Collaborate with the agentic engineering team so agents can perceive and act on visual inputs such as documents, screens, and diagrams. Debug training instabilities, regressions, and unexpected model behavior; establish best practices for reproducible training and experiment tracking. WE’D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING: Experience 5+ years of professional experience in machine learning engineering or research. Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, using RL techniques or evaluating large language or vision-language models. Track record of taking models from experimentation to production. Education Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field preferred. Required Skills Languages: Python ML/AI: PyTorch (or JAX), Hugging Face ecosystem, supervised fine-tuning, VLMs/LLMs Evaluation: building eval harnesses and benchmarks for model quality Data: synthetic data generation, data curation pipelines Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills Document AI experience: OCR, layout analysis, table and chart extraction Visual grounding and region-level reasoning Post-training and distillation for smaller or on-prem-deployable models Publications or open-source contributions in post-training, alignment, or multimodal models Prior experience in enterprise data protection, security, or infrastructure software Expectations from the Role Balance research exploration with engineering rigor and reliable delivery. Work effectively across research and engineering and stay productive amid ambiguity and shifting priorities. Communicate experimental results and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Be hands-on: write and review production-quality code and run experiments regularly. jobs.title: LLM & Agentic AI Performance Engineer
jobs.description: Job Details: Job Description: The Role and Impact: Join Intel's Data Center AI organization and help shape how LLM and Agentic AI workloads perform on Intel platforms. Our team operates at a unique intersection of core performance optimization, AI frameworks, and customer-facing AI solutions. We bridge the gap between teams that deeply understand silicon and benchmarking and teams building real-world AI solutions, turning performance insights into software optimizations that developers and customers can use. In this role, you will own end-to-end performance characterization and optimization of LLM and Agentic AI workloads, from Python-level frameworks and inference runtimes down to Linux, system architecture, and hardware performance counters. This is not simply a benchmarking role. Benchmarking tells us what the number is. Your job is to understand why the number is what it is, identify the hardware or software bottleneck, and determine what needs to change to remove it. Your work will translate into code contributions, framework optimizations, best-known configurations (BKCs), customer-ready solutions, and insights that help influence future Intel hardware and software. If you enjoy working across the complete AI stack, from agent frameworks and LLM serving engines to NUMA, memory bandwidth, cache behavior, and silicon counters, this role provides an opportunity to work at that intersection. About the Team: The AI Solutions and Toolkit Engineering team is part of Intel's Data Center organization, focused on enabling modern AI workloads and solutions on Intel platforms. We work across the AI ecosystem, collaborating with AI framework and runtime developers, performance and optimization teams, hardware architects, open-source communities, and solution engineering teams. Our goal is to take deep platform capabilities and performance insights and translate them into practical, optimized AI solutions that developers and customers can deploy. The team works across areas including LLM inference, Agentic AI, AI frameworks and runtimes, workload optimization, open-source software, and datacenter AI systems. Key Responsibilities: · Characterize and optimize LLM and Agentic AI workloads across the complete software and hardware stack. · Identify performance bottlenecks across AI frameworks, inference runtimes, operating systems, memory, compute, and platform architecture. · Design and develop hardware-aware and hardware-agnostic optimizations for AI frameworks and runtimes. · Optimize LLM inference techniques including KV-cache management, attention, continuous batching, and quantization. · Work hands-on with serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, or equivalent technologies. · Analyze host and accelerator performance using tools such as VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, and roofline modeling. · Debug complex performance issues spanning Python frameworks, native code, Linux, runtime libraries, and hardware. · Convert performance findings into software changes, upstream contributions, BKCs, and reusable optimization guidance. · Collaborate with open-source communities to upstream and integrate performance improvements. Translate silicon-level findings into actionable recommendations for framework developers, while bringing application and framework insights back to Intel platform and silicon teams. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications: · BE +10 years / M.Tech +8 years in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. · Significant hands-on experience in performance engineering, systems optimization, or workload characterization on server-class platforms. · Demonstrated ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and deliver measurable performance improvements. · Strong programming skills in Python and C++, or equivalent systems programming experience in C/Rust. · Strong understanding of server architecture including cache hierarchy, memory bandwidth, NUMA, interconnects, and system-level performance behavior. · Hands-on experience with Linux performance and system technologies such as affinity, huge pages, cgroups, eBPF, ftrace, perf, or equivalent tools. Preferred Qualifications: · Deep understanding of LLM inference, including KV-cache, paged attention, continuous batching and quantization such as INT8, INT4, or FP8. · Hands-on experience modifying or optimizing AI serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, OpenVINO, or equivalent. · Experience building, profiling, or optimizing Agentic AI systems using technologies such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MCP-based frameworks, or similar platforms. · Experience with hardware counter-level performance analysis using VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, or roofline modeling. · Contributions to significant open-source projects, including upstream code contributions. · Ability to communicate across abstraction layers, translating silicon-level findings for software developers and application-level requirements for hardware architects. Why Join This Team? This role gives you the opportunity to work across boundaries that few engineering positions span: Agentic AI & LLMs → AI frameworks → inference runtimes Linux → server architecture → silicon You won't be limited to measuring performance or optimizing an isolated component. You'll help connect the entire stack, identify where the real bottlenecks are, implement improvements, and make those optimizations available to developers and customers. The result is tangible: better AI performance today, stronger software solutions for customers, and insights that can influence tomorrow's Intel platforms. The Boeing AI India team is seeking a Principal AI Engineer (NLP & GenAI) to join its team in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. The selected individual will co-lead a team that innovates, develops & implements next generation AI/ML and engineering analytics for aerospace applications. The successful candidate will lead and participate in projects to develop solutions that help improve aircraft performance, increase the operational efficiency of aircraft fleet operators, improve/optimize the productivity of Boeing engineering, operations & manufacturing and simulate aircraft lifecycle scenarios for potential customers. In addition, the candidate will support senior members of the team in developing future vision and direction of Boeing’s technology development in the field of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, NLP, and GenAI and their application to diverse areas relevant to Boeing. Position Responsibilities: Lead the architecture, design, and production delivery of scalable Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Generative AI (GenAI) systems. Drive technical strategy, mentor senior and mid-level engineers, and partner with product, data, and business leaders to turn complex language and reasoning challenges into high-impact products. Architect end-to-end LLM applications, RAG pipelines, and multi agentic workflows with the right guardrails. Design & fine-tune transformer and NLP models alongside frontier and open-weight LLMs. Establish rigorous benchmarking, evaluation suites, latency/cost optimization, and production observability to measure accuracy, grounding, safety, and reliability. Own high-quality codebases, reusable AI libraries/APIs, CI/CD, AIOps and cloud deployments across multi-cloud platforms. Set engineering standards, conduct architecture reviews, evaluate emerging AI research and tooling, and align technical roadmaps with business goals. Work closely & collaboratively with an international team comprising software development and research engineers. Develop and maintain relationships / partnerships with customers, stakeholders, peers, and partners to develop collaborative plans and execute on projects. The selected candidate will undergo the Fellowship selection process for Associate Technical Fellow (ATF). Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience): Bachelor’s Degree. 17+ years of overall work experience in core engineering/manufacturing organizations with 7+ years in software development, AI, data analytics with proven leadership taking GenAI/NLP products from prototype to production at scale. Hands-on experience with end-to-end ML lifecycle: data pipelines, training, deployment, monitoring, and optimization. Excellent presentation & communication skills: Demonstrate strong written, oral, presentation and interpersonal communication skills. Strong research background in innovating & developing technologies & solutions thru data science & analytics. Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience): Master’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering or related discipline from a reputed academic institution. PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience). Deep expertise in Python, PyTorch, transformer architectures, embeddings, vector databases, hybrid/semantic retrieval, and LLM orchestration/agent frameworks. Strong hands-on experience with distributed systems, APIs, containers, MLOps, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), balancing performance, security, and token/compute costs. Track record in performing and leading research & development of highly innovative AI-driven solutions for difficult problems. Expertise in building and productizing Machine Learning/Deep Learning models. Experience with containerization, model deployment, data management, and monitoring. ML experience with synthetic data generation / domain adaptation / self-supervised learning. Solid software engineering practices: unit/integration testing, CI/CD, version control, and traceability to requirements. Be a self-starter who is not afraid to pro-actively seek information and direction to successfully complete the statement of work. Be self-motivated and able to work independently with a positive attitude and highest ethics. Must be willing to work flexible hours (early or late as needed) to interface with Boeing teams around the world. Build document digitization and Optical Character Recognition pipelines, including PDF text extraction, OCR processing, normalization, and handling of noisy or low-quality scans. Apply Large Language Model techniques, including prompt engineering, structured or JSON-schema outputs, and robustness methods for real-world tasks. Use LangGraph or an equivalent graph-based orchestration framework to build multi-step AI workflows. Define and validate schemas using Pydantic and perform data processing using pandas. Implement Optical Character Recognition and document digitization workflows, including PDF text extraction, OCR tools such as AWS Textract or equivalent, post-OCR cleanup, validation, and exception handling. Integrate external tools and services via application programming interfaces, including tool-using assistant patterns with strong validation and error handling. Define objective success metrics and evaluate solution quality with clear problem framing and effective communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders. Analyze adoption and performance drivers (such as accuracy and override patterns) using structured root-cause analysis and measurable remediation. Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities: Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes. Interpret evaluation and statistical concepts such as confusion matrix, precision, recall, F1, error analysis, A/B testing, and statistical significance to measure and defend model performance. jobs.title: Lead Data & AI Engineer - Semantic Intelligence
jobs.description: Job Description: We are looking for a Lead Data & AI Engineer - Semantic Intelligence to build trusted data and semantic foundations that turn enterprise AI into scalable business capability. You will combine data engineering, data-product thinking, dimensional and semantic modelling, application development, AI engineering, and practical data science. You will own delivery from raw data to AI-enabled decisions. This covers medallion architecture, reusable data products, semantic models, agents, and applications. You will partner early with business, product, Data & Analytics, and technology stakeholders to define outcomes, success measures, and data needs. You will turn ambiguous challenges into technical designs, prototypes, and production solutions, and you will stay involved through adoption and improvement. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with mentoring responsibilities. It has no direct people management. Key Responsibilities: Deliver production-ready Data & AI solutions, staying hands-on in investigation, architecture, coding, modelling, testing, and implementation. Build AI-ready data foundations and agentic solutions grounded in structured data, governed measures, semantic metadata, and enterprise knowledge. Build production-ready Agentic AI, LLM, RAG, and tool/API orchestration patterns using enterprise engineering standards. Build analytical and AI-enabled applications using Fabric application capabilities, Rayfin, or comparable frameworks, integrated with semantic models, APIs, agents, and enterprise security. Build robust ELT/ETL pipelines using Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Python, dbt, Apache Airflow, or comparable technologies. Implement bronze, silver, and gold medallion layers with lineage and auditability. Integrate lakehouse, warehouse, and semantic assets using batch, streaming, Direct Lake, or API patterns. Deliver reusable, domain-aligned data products with clear ownership, data contracts, quality controls, documentation, and consumption interfaces. Design dimensional models with explicit grain, conformed dimensions, facts, hierarchies, slowly changing dimensions, and bridge and relationship patterns. Build and optimize Fabric and Power BI semantic models with governed measures, DAX, relationships, and metadata, so analytics, applications, and AI share consistent business context. Explore data, frame hypotheses, engineer features, and apply segmentation, forecasting, classification, or anomaly detection where they support a business decision. Evaluate analytical and machine-learning approaches against suitable baselines using statistical reasoning, validation, and business-relevant measures. Explain limitations and integrate useful results into data products or applications. Lead end-to-end technical delivery: define scope, estimate and plan work, manage dependencies and risks, coordinate stakeholders, and own release readiness, adoption, and operational handover. Mentor engineers through architecture, design, and code reviews, debugging, testing, and production-readiness practices. Build data quality, observability, automated testing, lineage, security, privacy, responsible AI, version control, and CI/CD into every stage of delivery. Turn successful solutions into reusable data products, semantic assets, agent capabilities, and engineering accelerators. Start with the business decision or workflow, and co-shape outcomes, success measures, data needs, and adoption with stakeholders. Move from discovery to prototype to production, validating assumptions with real enterprise data and early feedback. Measure success by business value, trusted metrics, adoption, engineering quality, and reuse. Solve immediate needs while strengthening reusable enterprise foundations. Required Qualifications: 10+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, AI engineering, or closely related technical roles. Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, LLMs, agents, RAG, and tool/API integration or orchestration. Experience building data-driven or AI-enabled applications using Fabric, Rayfin, or comparable frameworks. Experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or comparable analytical platforms, including lakehouse and warehouse patterns. Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience delivering production-grade data solutions. Experience delivering data products through bronze, silver, and gold layers, with quality controls, lineage, and clear consumption interfaces. Strong dimensional modelling skills, including grain, facts, dimensions, star and snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and many-to-many patterns. Proven enterprise semantic modelling experience, including governed business definitions and reusable measures. Proficiency in Power BI, DAX, and performance optimization, or equivalent technologies. Working knowledge of exploratory analysis, statistical reasoning, feature engineering, and practical predictive methods such as forecasting, classification, or anomaly detection. Ability to frame hypotheses, select baselines and evaluation measures, validate results, communicate uncertainty, and work with data scientists on modelling approaches. Experience with orchestration, automated testing, version control, CI/CD, data quality, and operational support. Ability to lead technical workstreams as a hands-on senior individual contributor and mentor engineers through design and code reviews. Experience managing scope, estimates, dependencies, risks, releases, and operational handover, taking solutions from concept through adoption. Clear communication with technical, business, and senior stakeholder audiences. Preferred Qualifications Experience with dbt, Apache Airflow, Git/GitHub, and automated deployment frameworks. Broader Power BI and Fabric experience across OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Notebooks, Direct Lake, and application capabilities. Experience with AI solutions grounded in semantic models, metadata, knowledge graphs, or governed enterprise data. Experience with agentic frameworks, model evaluation, observability, and responsible AI practices. Exposure to machine-learning experimentation, feature pipelines, and operationalizing lightweight predictive solutions. Knowledge of governance, privacy, security, lineage, and enterprise architecture. Experience delivering reusable data products and platforms in Agile or iterative models. Experience designing data contracts and consumption interfaces that enable reuse across analytics, applications, and AI solutions. Experience integrating lakehouse, warehouse, and semantic assets through batch, streaming, Direct Lake, or API-based patterns, with end-to-end lineage and auditability. Experience optimizing dimensional and semantic models with conformed dimensions, hierarchies, bridge tables, and complex relationships. Experience evaluating analytical and AI-enabled solutions against suitable baselines and business-relevant measures, communicating limitations, and incorporating stakeholder feedback. Experience partnering with business and product stakeholders to take ambiguous needs from discovery and prototyping through production adoption and operational handover. Experience creating reusable engineering accelerators and guiding engineers through architecture reviews, debugging, and production-readiness practices. #LI-VGA1 What’s in it For You? Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. jobs.title: Assistant Manager- Access Management
jobs.description: Job Title: Assistant Manager | Access Management Job Location : Bangalore, India About Unilever: Be part of the world’s most successful, purpose-led business. Work with brands that are well-loved around the world, that improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We promote innovation, big and small, to make our business win and grow; and we believe in business as a force for good. Unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas and disrupt processes; use your energy to make this happen. Our brilliant business leaders and colleagues provide mentorship and inspiration, so you can be at your best. Every day, nine out of ten Indian households use our products to feel good, look good and get more out of life – giving us a unique opportunity to build a brighter future. Every individual here can bring their purpose to life through their work. Join us and you’ll be surrounded by inspiring leaders and supportive peers. Among them, you’ll channel your purpose, bring fresh ideas to the table, and simply be you. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we’ll work to help you become a better you. PURPOSE OF THE ROLE The Access Management product team delivers the privileged access controls that protect Unilever’s most critical technology platforms, identities and business services. The PAM capability enables secure, governed and auditable access for administrators, engineers, suppliers, service accounts and other privileged identities across on-premises, cloud and SaaS environments. As the Privileged Access Management Product SME, you will be part of internal technical authority for PAM. You will oversee the design, engineering, integration, support and operational health of CyberArk, Beyond Trust and Cloud console capabilities, while shaping and leading the technical delivery of Unilever’s PAM modernization programme. The role requires strong hands-on expertise, strategic thinking and the ability to translate emerging security capabilities into scalable, resilient and user-centered services. Additionally, you will strive to continuously improve our services, ensuring they meet the evolving needs of our users and customers, and provide robust support to maintain secure, efficient and frictionless access. WHAT WILL YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES BE Serve as the internal technical authority for Privileged Access Management, including CyberArk, BeyondTrust and associated identity, directory, endpoint, cloud and security integrations. evolve the PAM technical strategy, target architecture, standards and roadmap, aligned to Zero Trust, least privilege, identity-first security and Unilever technology strategy. Lead the technical workstreams of the PAM modernization programme, including discovery, platform rationalization, migration planning, solution design, proof of concept, implementation and transition to operations. Design secure, scalable and resilient solutions for credential vaulting, password rotation, privileged session management, remote privileged access, endpoint privilege management, secrets management and just-in-time access. Define onboarding patterns for human, service, application, machine and cloud privileged identities, ensuring appropriate controls, approvals, ownership, monitoring and lifecycle governance. Provide clear technical direction and oversight to strategic suppliers and delivery partners; assure designs, engineering practices, operational procedures and contracted outcomes against Unilever standards. Act as the escalation point for complex PAM incidents and problems, leading advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, service restoration and permanent remediation across integrated platforms. Improve 24x7 operational readiness through effective monitoring, alerting, capacity management, disaster recovery, resilience testing, patching, vulnerability management and service continuity controls. Partner with IAM, Active Directory, Entra ID, cloud, endpoint, SOC, application, infrastructure and risk teams to embed PAM controls across hybrid and multi-cloud technology environments. Establish measurable technical and service outcomes, including privileged account coverage, credential rotation compliance, session control adoption, onboarding throughput, platform health and reduction of standing privilege. Support audits, control testing, risk assessments and remediation, ensuring evidence is accurate, repeatable and traceable and that suppliers remain accountable for agreed actions. Monitor market and technology developments, evaluate new PAM and identity security capabilities, and recommend forward-looking improvements such as identity threat detection, password less administration, workload identity protection and policy-driven automation. Coach engineers and operational teams, create reusable engineering patterns and documentation, and build sustainable internal capability for PAM design and support. EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS Necessary experience 5-7+ years of hands-on experience in PAM, IAM, cyber security engineering or a related technical role within a large, complex and regulated enterprise. Demonstrable engineering and operational experience with CyberArk PAM and strong working knowledge of BeyondTrust capabilities; experience across both platforms is highly desirable. Proven delivery of PAM transformation or modernisation initiatives, including current-state assessment, target-state design, migration, platform consolidation and adoption planning. Experience designing and operating highly available PAM services across global, hybrid and multi-cloud environments, including disaster recovery and cyber recovery considerations. Deep understanding of privileged account discovery, vaulting, rotation, Just In Time, Zero Standing Privilege, session isolation and recording, remote access, endpoint privilege management, secrets management and non-human identity controls. Experience integrating PAM with Active Directory, Entra ID, GCP, MFA, ITSM, SIEM/SOC, cloud platforms, databases, network devices, applications. Advanced troubleshooting capability across complex identity, network, authentication, certificate, API and platform dependencies, with experience providing L3/L4 engineering support. Experience governing third-party service providers, assuring technical designs and procedures, managing escalations and driving measurable service improvement. Strong knowledge of cyber security risk, audit and control frameworks, with the ability to convert requirements into practical engineering standards and evidence. Excellent stakeholder communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence architects, engineers, suppliers, control owners and senior decision-makers. Qualifications and desirable certifications Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cyber Security, Engineering or a comparable discipline, or equivalent professional experience. PAM Product certifications such as Cyberark, Beyond Trust or equivalent practical accreditation is desirable. Experience working within Agile, product-led and DevSecOps delivery models. FORWARD-LOOKING TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP Anticipate how privileged access must evolve for cloud-native platforms, machine identities, AI-enabled services and increasingly automated technology estates. Challenge legacy operating models and standing privilege, using data and threat insight to priorities modernization and control uplift. Balance strategic architecture with pragmatic delivery, creating transition plans that reduce risk while maintaining business continuity. Build proof points through experimentation and pilots, then industrialize successful patterns through automation, standards and reusable onboarding journeys. Promote secure-by-design and user-centred controls that improve both security outcomes and the administrator experience. SKILLS Innovation & Problem Solving Automation & Integration Cyber Security & Risk Supplier Governance Incident & Problem Solving Stakeholder Communication Learning Agility & Innovation KEY BEHAVIOURS Focus on What Counts: Prioritise the highest-risk privileged access challenges, set clear outcomes and deliver measurable security and service improvements. Stay Three Steps Ahead: Anticipate technology and threat changes, explore emerging PAM capabilities and shape a modern, adaptable target state. Deliver with Excellence: Maintain high engineering standards, take accountability for outcomes and continuously improve platform resilience, controls and customer. Note: All official offers from Unilever are issued only via our Applicant Tracking System (ATS). Offers from individuals or unofficial sources may be fraudulent—please verify before proceeding.

By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Job Purpose The Process Automation Architect determines what should be automated before anything is built. The role analyses end-to-end technology processes across CTO to find inefficiency, manual effort and automation or AI hotspots, quantifies the opportunity, and architects the redesigned process so that automation improves the work rather than encoding the current way of doing it. This is the front end of the hub's pipeline. It works alongside the other three intake dimensions of workforce, workbench and digital platform, and hands prioritised, evidenced use cases to the Director, Automation Engineering / Product Manager for delivery. Solution build sits with the engineering squad, patterns and enablement with the Principal Automation Enablement Lead, and the processes themselves remain owned by the teams that run them. Key Responsibilities Analyse end-to-end technology processes across CTO to identify inefficiency, manual effort, handoff friction and automation or AI hotspots. Quantify the opportunity in each case, covering effort, cycle time, error rate and cost, so that use cases can be compared on evidence, not enthusiasm. Architect the redesigned process, deciding what should be removed, simplified, automated or made agentic, and in what sequence. Challenge automation that would encode a poor process, and make the case for fixing the process first where that is the better answer. Assess processes for agentic readiness, including whether decisions within them can be made safely by an agent and what human oversight is required. Work with the workforce, workbench and digital platform analysis so that the four intake dimensions produce one coherent set of prioritised use cases. Hand evidenced, prioritised use cases to the Director, Automation Engineering / Product Manager, with the process design and expected outcome defined. Partner with the process owners in RE and Operations, platform teams and Service Owners, who own the processes being changed and must adopt the redesign. Define the measurement approach for each automation, so realised benefit can be tested against the opportunity claimed at the outset. Ensure redesigned processes remain compliant with control, audit and regulated requirements, including GxP where relevant, and that automation does not weaken the control. Build process analysis capability in the platform domains over time, so hotspot identification does not depend permanently on the hub. Hold the boundaries with the process owners on the processes themselves, the SRE Principal, Automation and Toil Reduction on reliability toil inside Reliability Engineering, the Director, Automation Engineering / Product Manager on what gets built, the Principal, Automation Enablement Lead on patterns, and Service Owners on operational service standards. Education & Professional Qualifications Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Process Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Professional certifications desirable (e.g., Lean Six Sigma, process mining or business process management accreditation, ITIL or an equivalent service management qualification). Job Experience: Typically 15+ years in process architecture, process improvement, business analysis or automation consulting within technology. Experience analysing end-to-end processes and quantifying automation opportunity with evidence, not estimate. Experience redesigning processes, not simply automating them as they stand. Experience assessing where a decision can safely be made by automation and where human oversight must remain. Experience of technology and service management processes such as incident, change, request and provisioning. Experience working within regulated control requirements, including where automation affects an audited process. Experience defining benefit measurement and testing realised outcomes against the original case. Familiarity with process mining or equivalent analytical tooling. Desirable Working knowledge of GxP, regulatory, and data-governance requirements shaping AI deployment in pharma. Background documenting processes and workflows, and redesigning how work gets done. Experience with product development and discovery phases Preferred Skills: Strong analytical rigour, able to quantify an opportunity rather than assert it. Willingness to conclude that a process should be fixed or removed instead of automated. Ability to challenge process owners constructively about how their own work is done. #AGTech Clear documentation and process modelling capability. Understanding of what agents can and cannot be trusted to decide. Awareness of control and audit requirements, so that redesign does not weaken assurance. Skills AI Frameworks, Algorithm Optimization, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Business Analysis, Computer Programming, Deep Learning, Feature Engineering, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for Machine Learning, GxPs, Machine Learning Algorithms, Machine Learning Operations, Microsoft Azure Data and AI, ML Frameworks, Model Evaluation, Model Training, Model Validation, Performance Optimizations, Process Architecture, Process Improvement, Services Management, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) Why GSK? Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. Inclusion at GSK: As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs. Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable. If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com , so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer – GKE & CI/CD
jobs.description: Company Overview: Headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, Cardinal Health, Inc. (NYSE: CAH) is a is a global, integrated healthcare services and products company, providing customized solutions for hospitals, health systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and physician offices worldwide. The company provides clinically proven medical products and pharmaceuticals and cost-effective solutions that enhance supply chain efficiency from hospital to home. Cardinal Health connects patients, providers, payers, pharmacists and manufacturers for integrated care coordination and better patient management. Backed by nearly 100 years of experience, with approximately 50,000 employees in 46 countries and Fiscal 2020 revenues of $152.9 billion, Cardinal Health ranks among the top 25 on the Fortune 500. About Cardinal Health International India (CHII): In Bangalore we are excited to create an Innovation and Capability Centre that allows us to further inhouse talent and scale that talent across our business. Our ambition is to build differentiated opportunities that allows our organization to advance rapidly, and develop the skills across Software-defined networking, machine learning and big data. What Application Development & Maintenance contributes to Cardinal Health Information Technology oversees the effective development, delivery, and operation of computing and information services. This function anticipates, plans, and delivers Information Technology solutions and strategies that enable operations and drive business value. Application Development & Maintenance performs configuration or coding to develop, enhance and sustain the organization's software systems in a cross-functional team environment through adherence to established design control processes and good engineering practices. This job family programs and configures end user applications, systems, databases and websites to achieve the organization's internal needs and externally-facing business needs. Application Development & Maintenance partners with business leaders, investigates user needs and conducts regular assessments, maintenance and enhancements of existing applications. We are seeking a Cloud Engineer to help drive the evolution of our enterprise‑scale cloud and CI/CD platforms. Operating in a multi‑cloud, multi‑tenant environment, our platforms support thousands of developers across hundreds of teams, powering mission‑critical workloads across IaaS, PaaS, and CaaS models. As part of the Serverless Platforms Team, you will help design, build, operate, and continuously improve our cloud‑native and CI/CD platforms—including Kubernetes, serverless runtimes, and the enterprise Harness CI/CD ecosystem. You will work closely with application teams, security partners, and platform stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and repeatable deployment patterns using GitOps, infrastructure as code, and modern DevSecOps practices. With a strong foundation in cloud‑native development and platform engineering, you will help ensure our platforms are reliable, governed, and easy to consume—while fostering a culture of technical excellence, automation, and continuous improvement. If you are passionate about Kubernetes, CI/CD platforms, and solving complex platform‑scale challenges, join us to help shape the future of healthcare technology. Role Summary As a Cloud Engineer, your primary responsibility will be to design, deploy, and support containerized and serverless platforms on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) and to operate and evolve the enterprise Harness CI/CD platform. You will enable application teams to build, test, and deploy software through standardized, secure, and scalable pipelines while ensuring platform reliability, compliance, and developer experience. Responsibilities Design, deploy, and manage Kubernetes clusters and workloads on GKE using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps practices. Operate and support the enterprise Harness CI/CD platform, including build, deploy, and infrastructure pipelines, ensuring availability, reliability, and consistent developer experience across teams. Develop and maintain standardized Harness pipeline templates for build, test, security scanning, and deployment to Kubernetes and serverless runtimes. Partner with application teams to onboard services to Harness, providing guidance, troubleshooting, and best‑practice enablement. Integrate CI/CD pipelines with Infrastructure as Code tooling (e.g., Terraform) and GitOps solutions (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux) to support repeatable and auditable deployments. Embed security and compliance controls into CI/CD workflows, including vulnerability scanning, policy enforcement, secrets management, and audit logging to meet HIPAA, SOX, and enterprise security requirements. Collaborate with DevSecOps and Application Security teams to shift security left within the SDLC, leveraging tools such as Trivy, Aqua, or equivalent scanners integrated into Harness pipelines. Monitor platform health, pipeline execution, and application performance using tools such as Dynatrace, Prometheus, and cloud‑native monitoring; perform root cause analysis and drive incident resolution. Participate in code and pipeline reviews, establish platform standards, and ensure adherence to engineering best practices. Enforce platform governance and guardrails using policy‑as‑code approaches (e.g., OPA), ensuring consistency, observability, and compliance across all environments. Act as a technical liaison between the Serverless Platforms Team and partner organizations, translating business and delivery needs into scalable platform capabilities. Communicate platform changes, incident status, and best practices through clear runbooks, release notes, and stakeholder updates; facilitate working sessions to drive alignment and unblock delivery. Stay current with cloud‑native and CI/CD trends, contributing to the ongoing evolution of Cardinal Health’s cloud and DevOps strategy. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 5-8 years of experience in cloud engineering with a strong focus on Kubernetes and GCP (preferred). Hands‑on experience designing, operating, or supporting CI/CD platforms, preferably Harness CI/CD in an enterprise environment. Strong understanding of microservices, event‑driven architectures, and distributed systems. Experience with GitOps, Infrastructure as Code, and automated delivery pipelines. Familiarity with DevSecOps practices, security scanning, and compliance requirements in regulated environments. Exceptional communication skills—able to translate complex platform and security concepts for both technical and non‑technical audiences, and to influence outcomes through clear documentation and stakeholder alignment. Proven problem‑solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in complex, evolving environments. What is expected of you and others at this level Applies comprehensive knowledge and a thorough understanding of concepts, principles, and technical capabilities to perform varied tasks and projects May contribute to the development of policies and procedures Works on complex projects of large scope Develops technical solutions to a wide range of difficult problems Solutions are innovative and consistent with organization objectives Completes work; independently receives general guidance on new projects Work reviewed for purpose of meeting objectives May act as a mentor to less experienced colleagues Cardinal Health supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate the power of our differences to create better solutions for our customers by ensuring employees can be their authentic selves each day. Cardinal Health is an Equal Opportunity employer.
