jobs.description: Career Area: Technology, Digital and Data Job Description: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. The Engineering Manager – Enterprise Search will provide technical and engineering leadership for Caterpillar’s enterprise search platforms and capabilities. This role is responsible for defining the enterprise search strategy, reference architecture, engineering standards, and technology roadmap, while leading engineering teams responsible for the design, development, integration, deployment, and operation of highly scalable search solutions. The Engineering Manager will drive modernization of Caterpillar’s search ecosystem using technologies such as Coveo, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Lucene, Solr, and Lucid works Fusion, while advancing capabilities including semantic search, vector search, personalization, NLP, Machine Learning, and Generative AI. The role requires a strong combination of engineering management, search architecture expertise, hands-on technical knowledge, stakeholder leadership, and product-focused execution. What You Will Do Engineering & Technical Leadership Lead and develop engineering teams responsible for enterprise and eCommerce search capabilities. Establish engineering standards, architecture principles, development practices, and technical governance for search platforms. Provide technical direction through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and engineering decision-making. Mentor senior engineers, technical leads, and architects while building sustainable search expertise within the organization. Drive engineering excellence across availability, scalability, performance, security, observability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Enterprise Search Strategy & Architecture Define and execute the long-term Enterprise Search technology strategy and roadmap. Own reference architecture and architecture patterns for Search, eCommerce, AEM, content management, API, AI/ML, and cloud-based solutions. Design scalable search architectures capable of supporting large data volumes, complex queries, global websites, and low-latency customer experiences. Establish reusable headless search services and APIs that can be consumed across multiple digital and eCommerce applications. Lead technical evaluation and adoption of platforms such as Coveo, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Solr, Lucene, and Lucidworks Fusion. AI-Powered Search & Innovation Advance search capabilities using Generative AI, semantic search, vector search, embeddings, NLP, ML-based ranking, recommendations, and personalization. Evaluate emerging AI and search technologies and determine their applicability within Caterpillar's enterprise architecture. Establish appropriate architecture patterns for integrating search, enterprise content, structured data, and AI capabilities. Promote adoption of AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and ChatGPT to improve engineering productivity. Search Relevance & Analytics Establish measurable KPIs for search effectiveness, including Click-Through Rate (CTR), zero-result searches, query distribution, search-to-conversion, latency, and relevance quality. Use search analytics, experimentation, and customer behavior data to continuously improve relevance and user experience. Implement A/B testing and relevance evaluation frameworks to objectively measure search improvements. Partner with product, UX, data science, analytics, and business teams to translate customer behavior into search improvements. Platform Engineering & Operations Ensure search platforms meet enterprise requirements for performance, reliability, scalability, security, disaster recovery, and availability. Define architecture for low-latency APIs and distributed services using AWS, Azure, or equivalent cloud technologies, including appropriate caching and in-memory storage patterns. Establish DevOps, CI/CD, monitoring, observability, automated testing, and operational practices. Ensure effective execution of ITSM processes, including incident, problem, and change management. Drive root-cause analysis and sustainable remediation for production incidents and performance issues. People & Organizational Leadership Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing global engineering organization. Build internal search engineering capability and reduce dependency on external/vendor expertise for strategic capabilities. Support workforce planning, hiring, talent development, succession planning, and technical capability development. Create clear accountability across architects, technical leads, software engineers, and partner teams. Foster a culture of innovation, engineering excellence, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner with Product Management, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Data Science, UX, eCommerce, Digital Marketing, and business stakeholders to align search capabilities with enterprise priorities. Influence technology decisions across multiple organizations and platforms. Communicate complex architecture and technology decisions clearly to both technical teams and senior business stakeholders. Lead architecture walkthroughs and communicate business, technology, data, integration, and security impacts. Technical Expertise The successful candidate should demonstrate strong knowledge across several of the following areas: Search: Coveo, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Solr, Lucene, Lucidworks Fusion AI/ML: Generative AI, NLP, embeddings, vector search, semantic search, ML-based relevance and personalization Programming: Java, Python, Scala Digital Platforms: eCommerce, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), content management and headless architectures Integration: REST APIs, event-driven architectures, API gateways and microservices Cloud: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Data: Event streaming, structured/unstructured data ingestion, indexing pipelines and caching/in-memory technologies Engineering: GitHub, CI/CD, DevOps, automated testing and observability Operations: ITSM, incident management, problem management, change management and production support Considerations for Top Candidates Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 10+ years of progressively responsible software engineering or technology experience, with significant experience in search, digital platforms, or distributed systems. 3+ years in architecture, technical leadership, or engineering leadership roles. Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams and complex enterprise technology initiatives. Strong experience delivering enterprise or eCommerce search platforms. Deep understanding of modern search architecture, relevance, indexing, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud technologies. Experience building and operating large-scale, highly available, low-latency platforms. Practical experience applying AI/ML capabilities to search and digital experiences. Experience operating within Agile and globally distributed engineering organizations. Demonstrated ability to influence architecture and technology decisions across organizational boundaries. Strong stakeholder management, communication, organizational, and technical leadership skills. Ability to lead complex, sensitive, business-critical, and highly visible technology initiatives. jobs.description: At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology. Role Summary Cadence is hiring a Principal AI Forward Deployment Engineer to embed with strategic semiconductor customers and operationalize Cadence's AI and agentic solutions across their end-to-end silicon design flows. This is a senior, customer-facing applied-AI role for an experienced chip-design practitioner who can translate front-end, physical-design, and methodology workflows into concrete, measurable productivity wins powered by flagship LLMs and Cadence AI tooling. You will be the trusted technical lead at the customer who turns 'AI for chip design' from a slideware promise into a deployed, adopted, and ROI-positive reality. Why This Role Exists Customers are racing to apply LLMs and agentic AI to RTL, verification, implementation, and signoff - but they need a partner who deeply understands *both* their tape-out flows and how to wield modern AI systems. This role owns the last mile: taking Cadence AI products (AgentStack, BU Super-Agents, Cadence.AI / JEDAI platform, Cerebrus, Verisium, Allegro X AI, etc.) and making them work inside the customer's actual methodology, PDKs, compute fabric, and security boundaries. Success here directly accelerates customer tape-outs, expands Cadence AI footprint, and feeds product roadmaps with real-world signal. What You Will Do Customer-Embedded Deployment. Lead end-to-end deployment of Cadence AI / LLM-powered solutions into the customer's silicon design flows - from RTL design and verification through synthesis, place-and-route, timing, power, signoff, and packaging. Applied AI for Chip Design. Architect and tune agentic workflows, prompt strategies, RAG pipelines, and tool-calling patterns on top of flagship LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama, Qwen, etc.) to automate real EDA tasks - debug triage, constraint authoring, ECO loops, PD recipe tuning, methodology Q&A, log/report summarization, and design-review copilots. Methodology & Flow Integration. Map customer methodology (FE design, DV, PD, CAD, signoff) onto Cadence AI building blocks; identify the highest-ROI insertion points; build reference flows the customer's CAD/methodology team can own long-term. Productivity & ROI Ownership. Define and report KPIs - cycle-time reduction, engineer-hours saved, iteration count, first-pass success, license/compute efficiency. Own the story from pilot to production rollout across BUs and sites. Trusted Technical Advisor. Be the senior technical face to customer fellows, methodology leads, and design-team principals. Run design reviews, technical readouts, and joint roadmaps. Translate customer pain into actionable feedback for Cadence R&D and AI platform teams. AI Systems Enablement (plus). Where needed, guide customer IT/InfoSec on secure LLM access patterns, on-prem vs. gateway deployment, model routing, prompt/response logging, data-egress controls, and GPU/inference capacity planning. Knowledge Multiplier. Capture playbooks, reference designs, and 'golden prompts' so every deployment compounds. Mentor field AEs, FAEs, and customer champions. Must-Have Qualifications BS/MS/PhD in EE, ECE, CS, or related discipline. 10+ years of hands-on semiconductor / chip design experience in one or more of: front-end design (RTL, micro-architecture, DV), physical design / implementation (synthesis, P&R, timing, power, signoff), CAD / methodology / flow development, or design execution / project technical leadership on production tape-outs. Deep, practitioner-level fluency with industry EDA flows and pain points - you have personally shipped silicon and know where the cycle-time and engineer-time really go. Demonstrated ability to apply LLMs / AI tools to get real engineering work done (e.g., agent-based debug, code/RTL generation assist, scripted automation, copilots, RAG over design docs/logs). Doesn't have to be your title - has to be your reflex. Excellent customer-facing communication: equally credible with a staff RTL engineer, a PD methodology lead, and a CAD / design-enablement leader. Bias to action, ownership, and shipping. Comfortable being the single throat-to-choke for a customer-facing AI deployment. Based in or willing to relocate to Portland, OR; able to be on-site at customer locations as the engagement requires. Nice-to-Have / Bonus Prior experience as a Cadence / Synopsys / Siemens EDA customer power user, AE, or methodology architect. Hands-on with at least one agentic framework (Claude Code, Cursor, LangGraph, AutoGen, custom MCP/tool-calling stacks) applied to engineering workflows. Experience standing up secure enterprise LLM access (gateways, model routing, key management, audit logging) for engineering orgs. Familiarity with GPU/inference infrastructure, vLLM/TGI/Triton, fine-tuning / LoRA / SLM workflows, and evaluation harnesses for code/EDA tasks. Background in low-power, high-performance, AI/ML, networking, automotive, or HPC silicon programs. Public artifacts - papers, talks, OSS, or internal champions - showing applied AI in EDA/silicon contexts. We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.

jobs.description: Req ID: 142335 Remote Position: Hybrid Region: Asia Country: India State/Province: Chennai City: Guindy, Chennai Summary We are seeking a senior technical leader for the role of Infrastructure Automation Manager to direct and execute our enterprise-wide end-to-end automation strategy. This role bridges traditional on-premises data centers, private cloud hypervisors, container platforms, and public cloud environments into a unified, code-driven delivery ecosystem. With 12 to 15 years of industry experience, you will manage a specialized team of automation, infrastructure, and network reliability engineers. You will drive declarative infrastructure practices across bare-metal systems, hyperconverged/virtualization layers (Nutanix AHV, VMware vSphere), enterprise container fleets (Red Hat OpenShift, native Kubernetes), and software-defined network hardware (Cisco, Arista, Juniper switches and routers). You will own the full operational lifecycle—from architecture alignment and automated rollouts to fleet hygiene, automated DR failover, L3 support escalations, and executive operational reporting. Detailed Description Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following: Enterprise Automation Framework: Define and enforce declarative automation standards across hybrid environments spanning on-premise data centers, private clouds, and multi-cloud landing zones. Virtualization & HCI Automation: Architect automated provisioning, node expansion, and policy baselines across VMware vSphere/vCenter (vROps, PowerCLI, Terraform vSphere provider) and Nutanix AHV/Prism Central (Calm, Prism APIs). Container Platform Orchestration: Standardize deployment, node scaling, and operator lifecycle automations for Red Hat OpenShift and native Kubernetes clusters across bare metal and virtual platforms. Network as Code (NetDevOps): Champion automated configuration, deployment, and validation of physical and virtual network infrastructure (leaf-spine fabrics, switches, routers, firewalls, and load balancers) using Ansible, NAPALM, Nornir, and NetBox as a single source of truth. Unified Pipeline Orchestration: Build and manage enterprise GitOps pipelines (ArgoCD, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins) that drive zero-touch provisioning for compute, storage, virtualization, and network layers. Multi-Tier IaC & Configuration: Direct the authoring, testing, and modularization of production-grade Terraform modules, Ansible playbooks, Python automation frameworks, and Kubernetes Helm/Kustomize manifests. Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP): Establish automated PXE/IPXE booting, bare-metal imaging, switch boot-strapping, and dynamic host/hypervisor configuration workflows. Rolling Cluster & Hypervisor Lifecycle: Coordinate and automate rolling non-disruptive upgrades across VMware ESXi, Nutanix AOS/AHV, and OpenShift/Kubernetes worker and control-plane nodes. Configuration Drift & Compliance: Implement continuous drift detection and compliance auditing tools to guarantee that on-prem hardware, network device configurations, and cloud workloads strictly match source-controlled code baselines. Automated Patching & Vulnerability Remediation: Build automated orchestration pipelines for monthly firmware updates, hypervisor security patches, base OS updates, and network OS (NOS) upgrades. L3 Operational Support: Serve as the senior escalation manager for critical automation, networking, hypervisor, and platform outages, leading cross-functional debugging sessions. Knowledge/Skills/Competencies Virtualization & HCI: Extensive, production-level expertise automating and administering VMware vSphere/vCenter and Nutanix (AOS, AHV, Prism Central). Container Orchestration: Hands-on experience configuring, automating, and operating Red Hat OpenShift and native Kubernetes at scale (CNI, CSI, Operators, Helm, Kustomize). NetDevOps & Network Automation: Proven track record automating physical switch and router configurations (Cisco IOS-XE/NX-OS, Arista EOS, Juniper Junos) using NetBox, Ansible, Python (Netmiko, Nornir), or Terraform. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. In this role, you’ll design, build and maintain the high-volume business logic that runs on the mainframe. At the same time you’ll play a key role in refactoring legacy code to enable modern cloud and mobile applications to seamlessly interact with the mainframe’s core data. Who You Are Required skills and experience •Experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects. •Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills. •Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software. •Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST-based web services. •Knowledge of architecture design - Microservices architecture, containers (Docker & k8s), messaging queues. •Deep understanding of OOP and design patterns. Preferred skills and experience •Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. •Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl. •Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! jobs.title: Senior Data Modeler
jobs.description: Our Company: At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. About the role We are seeking a highly experienced and hands-on Senior Data Modeler to lead the design and evolution of enterprise-scale data models that power analytics, AI, knowledge discovery, operational systems, and next-generation data and knowledge platforms across multiple domains. This role is ideal for a technically deep practitioner who excels at translating complex business domains into scalable, high-quality conceptual, logical, and physical data models. The successful candidate will have extensive experience modeling large-scale enterprise data assets across structured, semi-structured, and graph-oriented environments while partnering closely with engineering, architecture, analytics, governance, and AI teams. You will be responsible for establishing data modeling standards, driving enterprise-wide consistency, and ensuring that data is organized for scalability, interoperability, discoverability, governance, and AI readiness for Teradata Context Engine, our Autonomous Knowledge Platform. Context Engine is a platform that converts enterprise data estates into governed, agent-ready knowledge. Built for organizations where AI reliability and auditability are non-negotiable, Context Engine enables companies to deploy AI workflows on the data they already own — without rebuilding their infrastructure, without retraining their models, and without waiting for generic AI synthesis to learn the business terminology that took their analysts years to master. Responsibilities Data Architecture & Modeling Design and maintain enterprise conceptual, logical, and physical data models across multiple business domains. Create scalable data models supporting transactional systems, operational platforms, analytics, machine learning, and AI workloads. Develop canonical data models, business information models, and semantic layers that enable consistent enterprise understanding of data. Drive standardization of entities, relationships, taxonomies, hierarchies, and business definitions across the organization. Define and enforce data modeling best practices, naming conventions, modeling patterns, and architecture standards. Enterprise Data Platform Model data for modern cloud data platforms, data lakes, lake houses, warehouses, and real-time streaming architectures. Design data structures optimized for performance, scalability, governance, and consumption. Collaborate with data engineers to implement dimensional, normalized, denormalized, and domain-oriented data models. Support data product development initiatives and data mesh architectures. AI, Analytics & Knowledge Systems Design models that support advanced analytics, AI, machine learning, RAG applications, semantic search, and knowledge management platforms. Build and maintain business-friendly semantic representations that improve discoverability and reuse. Partner with AI and data science teams to model features, training datasets, metadata, lineage, and business context. Contribute to enterprise ontology, taxonomy, and knowledge graph initiatives where applicable. Governance & Quality Partner with data governance teams to align models with data quality, stewardship, privacy, security, and compliance requirements. Establish traceability between business definitions, metadata, source systems, and downstream data assets. Ensure model consistency across operational, analytical, and AI ecosystems. Support master data management (MDM) and reference data initiatives. Collaboration & Leadership Work directly with business stakeholders to understand complex processes and translate them into enterprise information models. Mentor junior modelers, architects, and engineers on data modeling principles and best practices. Lead architecture reviews and influence long-term data strategy. Drive cross-functional alignment across product, engineering, analytics, governance, and architecture organizations. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field. 8+ years of experience in data modeling, information architecture, or enterprise data architecture. Demonstrated hands-on expertise creating conceptual, logical, and physical data models for large-scale enterprise environments. Deep understanding of relational modeling theory, normalization, dimensional modeling, and analytical schema design. Experience modeling enterprise-wide business domains and integrating data across complex systems. Strong SQL and database design expertise. Experience working with cloud-based data platforms and modern data architectures. Proven ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders. Proven expertise in at least one of the following domains: healthcare, communications, retail, utilities, transport and logistics, travel and hospitality, life sciences, insurance, manufacturing, and/or media and entertainment. Preferred Qualifications Experience with cloud ecosystems such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, Synapse, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar platforms. Knowledge of Data Vault, Kimball, Inmon, data mesh, and domain-driven design methodologies. Experience with metadata management, data catalogs, and lineage platforms. Exposure to graph databases, semantic technologies, ontologies, RDF, or knowledge graphs. Understanding of AI/ML data requirements and semantic modeling for generative AI applications. Experience supporting enterprise governance and master data management programs. Technical Skills Data Modeling & Architecture Conceptual, Logical, and Physical Data Modeling Enterprise Information Modeling Dimensional Modeling (Star/Snowflake) Data Vault Modeling Master & Reference Data Modeling Canonical Data Models Domain-Driven Design Semantic Data Modeling Data Platforms Azure Data Platform Snowflake Databricks Synapse Analytics AWS Data Services Google Cloud Data Platform Databases SQL Server PostgreSQL Oracle MySQL MongoDB Snowflake Graph Databases (Neo4j, Neptune, Cosmos DB Graph) Tools Erwin ER/Studio SAP PowerDesigner Lucidchart Visio Collibra Alation Informatica Microsoft Purview What Makes Someone Exceptional The ideal candidate combines: Deep hands-on modeling expertise with enterprise-scale architecture thinking. Strong business domain abstraction skills and technical implementation ability. Experience designing data foundations that support analytics, governance, AI, and knowledge management. Ability to influence enterprise standards while remaining close to implementation details. Passion for creating reusable, understandable, and scalable information structures that become strategic organizational assets. This role is best suited for a senior practitioner who can operate as both a hands-on data modeler and a strategic information architect, helping shape the enterprise data foundation for analytics, AI, and knowledge-driven innovation. Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

jobs.description: Work Schedule First Shift (Days) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Job Title: Engineer III, TEM SEMI Location/Division Specific Information Hyderabad, IN - Analytical Instruments Group, Materials & Structural Analysis Division About the product: The Thermo Scientific™ Metrios ™ is an advanced TEM imaging system designed to automate and optimize imaging workflows. With the Metrios ™ AX, we introduced the world's first commercially available Scanning Transmission Electron Microscope (S/TEM) using machine learning for automated, high-quality data collection. Exclusively designed for the semiconductor industry, the Metrios series removes automation barriers, enabling labs to measure critical dimensions of semiconductor devices during development and manufacturing. How will you make an impact? We're seeking a Software Engineer to join our TEM Semiconductor value stream, driving the development of innovative 4D-STEM and Image Processing solutions for semiconductor metrology workflows. As a member of a distributed agile Scrum team, you will collaborate closely with teams in the Netherlands and Czech Republic. You'll develop high-performance software primarily in Python, with contributions in C# and Rust, to process, analyze, and visualize large-scale microscopy datasets. The ideal candidate brings experience in scientific computing, numerical methods, and performance optimization, with the ability to leverage CPU and GPU resources for computationally intensive workloads. Experience with TypeScript is a plus for contributing to user-facing applications. What will you do? You will be part of the TEM organization within Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Materials and Structural Analysis R&D organization, which is committed to bringing game-changing solutions to our customers to help them achieve success. You will be based in Hyderabad, IN, and report to the Functional Group Lead. In this role, you'll collaborate with developers, product owners, architects, and other stakeholders, uniting multi-site teams to deliver reliable and secure software solutions. Your responsibilities include: Design, develop, test, and maintain robust, scalable, and high-performance software solutions for advanced 4D-STEM applications. Develop image-processing software and libraries to support advanced microscopy and metrology applications. Develop scientific and computational software using Python, contributing to data acquisition, processing, analysis, and visualization workflows. Write and maintain high-quality unit tests, integration tests, and system-level component tests to ensure software reliability and performance. Participate in code reviews, promoting software quality, maintainability, and adherence to engineering best practices. Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects, performance bottlenecks, and computational challenges. Apply scientific computing and numerical methods to microscopy and metrology challenges, leveraging CPU and GPU acceleration to process, analyze, and optimize large-scale 4D-STEM data workflows. Stay current with advancements in scientific computing, high-performance computing, numerical methods, and software engineering practices. Learn TEM, 4D-STEM, and semiconductor metrology domain knowledge and validate software solutions using experimental and simulated datasets. How will you get here? The ideal candidate for this position enjoys working in a multi-disciplinary and multi-cultural environment to address software challenges. If you enjoy the development of software solutions on top of high-performance systems, this is an excellent opportunity. The successful candidate will possess the following combination of education and experience: E ducation: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, with expertise in software development. E xperience: 5 + years of Strong software development experience in Python; experience with C#, Rust is a plus. Experience developing scientific and computational software in Windows environments. Knowledge of numerical methods, linear algebra, and scientific computing concepts used in data analysis and computational applications. Solid understanding of software engineering principles, including object-oriented design, testing, code reviews. Experience with scientific computing libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, CuPy or similar frameworks. Experience with image processing and analysis techniques, preferably using libraries such as OpenCV, scikit-image, or similar scientific imaging frameworks. Experience processing and analyzing large-scale datasets and developing performant computational workflows. Knowledge of concurrent and parallel programming, including multithreading, multiprocessing, and asynchronous processing. Experience leveraging CPU and GPU acceleration technologies, including CUDA or equivalent frameworks, for computationally intensive workloads. Experience writing and maintaining unit tests, integration tests, and system-level tests. Familiarity with TypeScript and modern web technologies is a plus.

Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next. The ideal candidate will have expertise in AI platforms, ML modelling techniques, development life cycle, GCP Vertex AI, and a proven track record of the team successfully delivering impactful AI solutions. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES AI and ML strategy Develop and implement AI and ML strategies aligned with business objectives. Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies to ensure our strategies remain cutting-edge. Constructively challenge the other data scientists on approach. Utilize and provide expertise in leading AI platforms, frameworks, and libraries. Evaluate and recommend new tools and technologies to enhance our machine learning capabilities. Exposure to Generative and Agentic AI solutions ecosystem. Lead the AI solutions deliver: Partners with business stakeholders to deliver value add insights and intelligent solutions through ML and AI. Collaborates with ML engineers and systems engineers to ensure the models are deployed in a scaled and optimized way. Additionally ensure support the post-production to ensure model performance degrades are proactively managed.  Is considered an expert in at least one of functional areas; brings together business knowledge, resources, people, and technology to create more effective solutions. Manager of People: Accountable for data scientists team performance management. Sets goals and objectives for team members for achievement of operational results. Ensures team skill management and devise apt training needs Responsible for timely staffing of the right resources. Team Collaboration and Communication.  Own development of the resources and career progression. Guide Project Prioritization and Resource Allocation. Collaborate with global partners to evolve ways of working and deliver AI solutions. AI Literacy and Mentorship to broader organization: Mentor and guide a team of data scientists in approach for AI solution delivery. Foster a collaborative and innovative team environment. Contribute to the overall effort to educate stakeholders on AI practices. Closely collaborates with the stakeholders on projects and data science leaders to ensure practices are developed and enhanced to support accelerated analytic development and maintainability. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Overall minimum 12 years of experience, with relevant minimum 8 years in providing data science solutions. Bachelor’s degree in computer science/Statistics/Applied Mathematics. Proven skills in leading implementations of AI solutions. Experience in People management, with handling team size of 8-10 members. Experience in providing technical mentorship. Technical Concepts- ML Algorithms, ML Ops, Data Lineage and Visualization Experience working with an Agile development methodology featuring sprints, point estimation and daily stand-ups. Excellent stakeholder management skills and storytelling skills. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Publications or contributions to the data science and AI community. Certifications in AI, machine learning, or related fields. ELIGIBILITY Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

jobs.description: When you join Verizon You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. What you’ll be doing ... As a Senior Consultant (Analytics) you will be a pivotal player in modernizing telecom financial operations. Bridging the gap between implementation and architectural strategy, you will design, develop, and deploy advanced AI/ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions tailored for the finance domain. Your work will transition complex financial workflows—such as Forecasting as a Service, Explainability framework, Funnel Forecasting, Customer Profitability etc., and also performing analyses that impact Bad Debt, Cash flow, Credit Score cut models, etc., among others—into automated, intelligent, and proactive systems. You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of critical AI models while translating complex technical results into compelling business narratives for finance leadership. Design, Build and deploy core AI/ML and Generative AI solutions to optimize financial operations. Build and orchestrate Agentic AI workflows to automate multi-step financial analysis and decision-making processes. Utilize foundational models and AI assistants (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to rapidly prototype, iterate, and deliver agile AI solutions to meet dynamic business needs. Engineer robust data pipelines and write complex SQL/BigQuery queries to extract and transform large-scale financial datasets using GCP and Python. Act as a data storyteller—synthesizing complex AI/ML model outputs into clear, actionable, and prescriptive insights for non-technical finance stakeholders. Design, develop, and optimize Artificial Intelligence, NLP, SLM/LLM solutions to diverse real-world problems. Implement MLOps best practices to ensure continuous integration, deployment, and monitoring of financial AI models in production environments. Driving data-derived insights across the business domain by developing advanced statistical models, machine learning algorithms and computational algorithms based on business initiatives. What we’re looking for... Your primary focus will be transforming traditional financial operations into a proactive, AI-driven organization. You are a hands-on builder who thrives at the intersection of core ML, cutting-edge GenAI, and business strategy. You have a knack for rapid prototyping and possess the communication skills required to explain the "why" and "how" of AI to business leaders. You'll need to have: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field Six or more years of relevant professional work experience. Four or more years of experience practicing data science, AI engineering, or machine learning, with a strong focus on core AI/ML, GenAI, and Agentic frameworks . Experience with all phases of end-to-end Analytics project, such as (but not limited to): Ingestion, Munging, Model Building, Validation, Operationalization, Monitoring Strong programming proficiency in Python and advanced SQL. Proven experience working within cloud platforms (Teradata/ GCP) and using tools like BigQuery for large-scale data processing. Demonstrated experience in rapid prototyping and building solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot). Hands-on familiarity with specific Agentic AI and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex). Exceptional data storytelling and communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into confident financial business decisions. Even better if you have one or more of the following: Advanced degree (Master’s) in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field. Prior experience in the telecommunications industry specifically dealing with financial data, billing systems, FinOps, revenue assurance. Experience in designing and deploying end-to-end MLOps and LLMOps pipelines . A strong understanding of financial forecasting models, anomaly detection algorithms, and time-series analysis. Why Verizon? Verizon is committed to maintaining a Total Rewards package which is competitive, valued by our employees, and differentiates us as an Employer of Choice. We are a ‘pay for performance’ company and your contribution is rewarded through competitive salaries and performance-based incentives. We create an opportunity for us all to share in the success of Verizon and the value we help to create through this broad-based discretionary equity award program. Your benefits are market competitive and delivered by some of the best providers. You are provided with a full spectrum of health and wellbeing resources, including a first in-class Employee Assistance Program, to empower you to make positive health decisions. We offer generous paid time off benefits to help you manage your work life balance and opportunities for flexible working arrangements*. Verizon provides training and development for all levels, to help you enhance your skills and develop your career, from funding towards education assistance, award-winning training, online development tools and access to industry research. You will be able to take part in volunteering opportunities as part of our environmental, community and sustainability commitment. Your benefits package will vary depending on the country in which you work. subject to business approval If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. jobs.description: When you join Verizon You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. As a Senior Engineer Consultant - AI Science , you will architect, build, and deploy production-grade Generative AI, Agentic workflows, and Advanced NLP systems for enterprise clients. You will bridge the gap between applied research and enterprise engineering—translating ambiguous business requirements into robust, high-performance AI architectures. You will guide business from proof-of-concept (PoC) to scalable production, establish technical governance, and mentor emerging AI talent. What You Will Do Architect & Deliver End-to-End Solutions: Design, prototype, benchmark, and deploy enterprise-grade Agentic systems, multi-stage RAG pipelines, and fine-tuned Foundation/Small Language Model (LLM/SLM) architectures to solve complex business problems. Lead AI Engineering & Productionization: Implement modern LLMOps/GenAIOps standards, including prompt orchestration, deterministic guardrails, structured outputs, automated red-teaming, latency/token-cost optimization, and continuous evaluation (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge). Execute High-Impact Fine-Tuning & Quantization: Conduct parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT/LoRA/QLoRA), alignment tuning (DPO, RLHF), and model quantization/distillation for downstream domain specialization and edge/on-premise inference. Drive Client Advisory & Executive Communication: Partner with cross-functional global stakeholders, translate complex algorithmic decisions into measurable business impact (ROI, cost-per-query, latency budgets), and deliver compelling technical presentations to C-suite leadership. Practice Growth & Technical Evangelism: Lead technical proposals (RFPs/POCs), formulate point-of-view (PoV) whitepapers, explore emerging frontier models and open-source tooling, and continuously enhance internal IP, reference architectures, and reusable accelerators. Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Foster engineering excellence by conducting rigorous code/design reviews, guiding junior scientists on applied ML/GenAI methodologies, and enforcing reproducible data science standards. What We Are Looking For You are an applied AI practitioner and pragmatic engineer who thrives on turning raw research and frontier models into secure, reliable software systems. You balance algorithmic depth with system architecture, understand the operational bottlenecks and scaling best practices and are able to own technical delivery at scale end to end. Minimum Qualifications Education & Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, paired with 4+ years of hands-on experience in applied machine learning, deep learning, and advanced NLP/GenAI in an enterprise or consulting environment. GenAI & Agentic Architectures: Deep hands-on experience building autonomous agents and complex multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel) using tool-calling, stateful memory, and routing graphs. Advanced RAG & Retrieval Systems: Demonstrated expertise implementing hybrid search pipelines (dense vectors + sparse BM25), semantic routing, contextual compression, reranking models (e.g., Cohere, BGE), and production vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector). Fine-Tuning & Model Adaptation: Practical experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs/SLMs (e.g., Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi) using PEFT, LoRA/QLoRA, DeepSpeed, or Unsloth, paired with robust knowledge of post-training evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, DeepEval, TruLens). Software Engineering & APIs: Strong proficiency in Python, modern asynchronous web frameworks (FastAPI), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and designing secure, low-latency REST/gRPC endpoints. Cloud & Distributed Computing: Hands-on experience architecting ML/AI workloads on at least one major cloud platform (AWS SageMaker/Bedrock, Azure OpenAI/ML, or GCP Vertex AI). Where you’ll be working In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager. jobs.description: Our Company: At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. Power the Platform Behind Enterprise Generative AI At Teradata, we’re not just managing data; we’re unleashing its full potential. Our ClearScape Analytics platform and Enterprise Vector Store help the world’s largest enterprises derive value from their most complex data. Generative AI and agentic systems are the next frontier, and they run on infrastructure that has to be fast, efficient, and dependable at scale. As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will build the serving layer that runs large language models and other generative models inside the Teradata Vantage ecosystem. You will work on GPU-accelerated inference, high-performance Go and Rust services, and the cloud-native platform that lets teams ship models to production with confidence. You will own systems end to end, from a CUDA kernel profile to a Kubernetes rollout. What You’ll Do Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency model-serving platforms for LLMs and generative models, covering batching, streaming, routing, autoscaling, and multi-tenant isolation. Develop high-performance control-plane and data-plane services in Go and performance-critical components (tokenizers, schedulers, runtimes, gRPC/HTTP gateways, native extensions) in Rust . Optimize GPU inference for throughput, latency, and cost using continuous batching, KV-cache management, quantization (INT8/FP8/AWQ/GPTQ), speculative decoding, tensor/pipeline parallelism, and efficient memory use. Integrate and extend inference engines such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, Ray Serve, KServe, SGLang, llama.cpp, and ONNX Runtime ; contribute fixes upstream where it makes sense. Build and manage GPU cluster infrastructure on Kubernetes (NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, MIG/time-slicing, node pools, scheduling and bin-packing) across cloud and on-prem environments. Own the full delivery path : CI/CD pipelines, model packaging and registries, canary and blue/green rollouts, infrastructure as code, and automated performance regression testing. Build AI observability into everything: metrics, logs, and traces for token throughput, time-to-first-token, GPU utilization, queue depth, error and hallucination signals, using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. Provide clean APIs, SDKs, and developer tooling (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, internal services, and lightweight UIs or dashboards) so AI engineers and agent builders can deploy and monitor models self-serve. Support agentic and RAG workloads by serving embedding, reranking, and generation models alongside the Enterprise Vector Store, with predictable latency and graceful degradation. Drive reliability, security, and cost efficiency: SLOs, load and chaos testing, capacity planning, GPU cost attribution, and secure model and tenant isolation. Who You’ll Work With You will collaborate daily with AI researchers, ML engineers, data scientists, and platform and SRE teams who champion diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to our success. You’ll be part of a cohesive team delivering high-quality, highly visible AI/ML functionality within the Teradata Vantage platform. You will report to the Sr. Manager, Software Engineering, who will champion your growth and empower your contributions. What Makes You a Qualified Candidate 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend systems, distributed systems, or AI/ML infrastructure. Strong, production-level proficiency in Go (concurrency, gRPC, profiling, service design) and working proficiency, or a demonstrated passion for learning, Rust (ownership, async runtimes such as Tokio, FFI, performance tuning). Hands-on experience with GPU computing for ML: CUDA fundamentals, GPU profiling (Nsight, nvidia-smi/DCGM), memory and bandwidth tradeoffs, and multi-GPU or multi-node inference. Experience serving LLMs or generative models in production, with practical knowledge of inference optimization techniques and the serving frameworks listed above. Solid understanding of transformer architectures and the LLM inference lifecycle (prefill vs. decode, attention, KV cache, sampling), plus familiarity with PyTorch and Hugging Face tooling. Strong system design skills and a deep understanding of distributed systems, networking, concurrency, and failure modes. Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, or similar), plus infrastructure as code (Terraform). Full-stack engineering experience : comfortable building REST/gRPC APIs and a pragmatic front end (React or similar) for dashboards, playgrounds, or admin tools; Python for glue, tooling, and ML integration. Experience with observability practices and tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, tracing) applied to ML or LLM workloads. You are obsessive about reliability, debuggability, and ensuring AI systems behave predictably and deterministically when needed. You code daily, own systems end to end, and are knowledgeable about open-source tools and know how to leverage and extend them. What You Bring A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Genuine excitement for AI, LLMs, and the systems that make them efficient and affordable to run at scale. Strong communication skills and a bias toward measuring, benchmarking, and iterating. Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Teradata, Snowflake, or Databricks is a plus. Bonus Points Experience writing or tuning CUDA / Triton (OpenAI) / CUTLASS kernels, or contributing to inference engines. Experience with on-device or edge ML inference (ONNX, TFLite, llama.cpp, quantized small language models), embedded or mobile deployment. Knowledge of RAG pipelines, vector databases, embeddings , and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, ReAct-style agents). Experience with model monitoring, drift detection, evaluation harnesses, and responsible AI practices. Open-source contributions, technical writing, or public projects in ML systems, Go, or Rust. Experience with service meshes, RDMA/InfiniBand/NCCL, Slurm, or Ray clusters. #LI-VB1 Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

You will help build systems that are scalable, observable, secure and reliable across cloud, on-premises and hybrid environments. What You’ll Do Core Systems & Services: Build high-performance control/data plane services and runtime components (gateways, schedulers, tokenizers) in Go, Python, Java and Rust. Agentic Workflows & MCP: Design production multi-agent systems and MCP servers/tools using frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, Autogen, etc. Enterprise RAG & Vector Infrastructure: Architect scalable retrieval pipelines and vector-store systems covering embedding generation, indexing, hybrid search, and reranking. Deployment & Platform Operations: Own infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD rollouts, and container orchestration across Docker, Kubernetes, and hybrid/cloud environments. Observability & Model Evaluation: Instrument end-to-end telemetry (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana) and automated evaluation harnesses (e.g., Langfuse, LangSmith) to benchmark latency, token throughput, GPU metrics, and hallucination/drift signals. Automate operations: Develop Python, Go and shell-based tooling and scripts for deployment, environment management, debugging, validation and operational automation. Build reliable APIs: Design and maintain well-defined REST/gRPC APIs, SDKs and service interfaces used by AI applications, Developers and platform components. Own production issues: Debug problems end to end across application code, APIs, Kubernetes, networking, infrastructure, models and data layers. Who You’ll Work With You will work closely with AI/ML engineers, platform engineers, infrastructure and SRE teams, data scientists and product teams to deliver enterprise AI capabilities across Unstructured, Enterprise Vector Store and agentic AI systems. The role requires strong end-to-end ownership. Engineers are expected to investigate problems across multiple layers of the stack rather than limiting themselves to application development. What Makes You a Qualified Candidate 4+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend systems, distributed systems, AI/ML infrastructure and Agentic / GenAI. Strong, production-level proficiency in Python (FastMCP, FastAPI), Go (concurrency, gRPC, profiling, service design) and working proficiency, or a demonstrated passion for learning, Rust (ownership, async runtimes such as Tokio, FFI, performance tuning), with willingness to learn / adapt to different programming languages or frameworks. Experience with Java is a plus. Strong system design skills and a deep understanding of distributed systems, networking, concurrency, and failure modes. Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar), plus infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible). Full-stack engineering experience : comfortable building REST/gRPC APIs and a pragmatic front end (React or similar) for dashboards, playgrounds, or admin tools; Python for glue, tooling, and ML integration. AI Observability & Evaluation: Hands-on experience instrumenting distributed AI workloads using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana, along with LLM evaluation platforms (LangSmith, Langfuse, or Arize Phoenix). You are obsessed about reliability, debuggability, and ensuring AI systems behave predictably and deterministically when needed. Comfortable with Linux and shell scripting and debugging production systems. You code daily, own systems end to end and are knowledgeable about open-source tools and know how to leverage and extend them. Agentic AI & MCP Systems: Production experience building agent workflows and multi-agent systems (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) leveraging Model Context Protocol (MCP), dynamic tool routing, context management, and model serving integration. Enterprise RAG & Data Systems: Strong architecture knowledge of enterprise RAG pipelines (chunking, hybrid retrieval, embeddings, reranking) and hands-on integration with vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant) alongside relational/NoSQL stores (Postgres). What You Bring A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science Engineering Genuine excitement for AI, LLMs, and the systems that make them efficient and affordable to run at scale. Strong problem-solving and debugging capability across software and infrastructure. Strong communication skills and a bias toward measuring, benchmarking, and iterating. Bonus Points Familiarity with GPU infrastructure and AI inference optimization. Experience with security and compliance requirements for enterprise AI. Experience deploying software into on-premises, restricted or air-gapped environments. Contributions to open-source AI, infrastructure or distributed systems projects. Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Teradata, Snowflake, or Databricks is a plus. #LI-VB1 Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Pune, Maharashtra, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India . Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience. Experience in data engineering, cloud data migrations, and building distributed production data pipelines using Python, SQL, and Apache Spark/PySpark. Experience with data lakes and lakehouse platforms (specifically Databricks) and cloud data warehouses and analytical or transactional data stores (BigQuery, AlloyDB, Cloud SQL, Snowflake, or Oracle). Experience in generative AI and agentic AI workflows, including RAG pipelines and vector embeddings. Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Preferred qualifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer or Professional Machine Learning Engineer certification (or equivalent Databricks/cloud certifications). Experience executing migrations from Databricks, Snowflake, or Oracle to Google Cloud. Experience with AI agent frameworks (Google ADK, Vertex AI, LangChain, or LangGraph). Experience building and evaluating tool-using AI agents connected to enterprise data using Google ADK, Vertex AI, or Model Context Protocol (MCP). Experience with open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake), orchestration tools (Airflow/Cloud Composer), and transformation or semantic tools (dbt, Dataform, Looker). About the job The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners. As a Data Engineer, you will guide customers on ingesting, storing, processing, cataloging, governing, and activating data using AI on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Partnering closely with customers, you will design, migrate, optimize, and operationalize scalable data lakehouses, data catalog and governance controls, and AI-ready pipelines and data-connected AI agents on GCP including platform modernization projects across technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, and Oracle. You will also resolve platform or product challenges, travel to customer sites as needed to deploy solutions, and lead technical workshops to empower client teams. Additionally, you will collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to drive product quality and excellence across Google's data and AI portfolio. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. Responsibilities Interact with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical designs, implementation plans, and advisory recommendations. Collaborate with technical leads, customers, and partners to execute high-velocity workload migrations and modernizations from enterprise and third-party platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Oracle) to Google Cloud. Design, build, and optimize scalable batch and streaming pipelines using Python, complex SQL, and Apache Spark/PySpark across GCP data services (BigQuery, Dataproc, BigLake, AlloyDB, Cloud Spanner). Establish data cataloging, quality, and governance procedures using Databricks Unity Catalog, Collibra, or Dataplex Knowledge Catalog covering automated metadata harvesting, data lineage, business glossaries, data quality checks, PII tagging, and fine-grained row/column-level security. Build, test, and integrate practical, data-connected AI agents using Google ADK, Vertex AI, or LangGraph. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Demonstrated track record of leading technical implementation across multiple simultaneous projects and collaborating effectively with cross-functional business and technical stakeholders. Experience providing technical mentorship, conducting architectural and code reviews, and giving feedback to junior engineers and data scientists. Experience architecting and deploying AI/ML and Agentic solutions in the Telecommunications domain or large-scale enterprise environments. Experience with Vector Databases and advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques (hybrid search, reranking, contextual compression). Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks and guardrail systems Experience with cloud AI platforms (GCP Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI) and distributed compute/data infrastructure. jobs.title: Software Engineer II, AI Security
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Experience integrating generative AI tools or Large Language Model (LLM) interfaces into workflows. Preferred qualifications: Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field. About the job Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. As a part of the Google Cloud Model Armor, you will serve as the critical security gateway and runtime defense boundary for enterprise Generative AI applications, while detection models provide the intelligence to catch adversarial prompts and malicious outputs, the Platform Engineering Team builds and scales the core distributed infrastructure that makes real-time protection possible across multi-cloud and multi-model ecosystems. As a part of this journey, you will build a strong Cloud security engineering team. jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI/ML
jobs.description: Company Overview Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design. Position Overview We are seeking a talented and versatile AI / Machine Learning Engineer with 3–10 years of experience to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI-powered capabilities across our electronic design and verification tools. In this hands-on engineering role, you will contribute to the design and implementation of AI/ML pipelines and Agentic AI systems, bridge modern GenAI architectures with robust software engineering, and integrate intelligent capabilities directly into engineering workflows. Collaborating closely with domain experts, software architects, and product teams, you will translate cutting-edge AI concepts—such as intelligent copilots, multi-step reasoning agents, and automated EDA verification assistants—into reliable, scalable, and high-impact solutions. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and deploy end-to-end AI/ML and Agentic AI solutions integrated into EDA software workflows and developer environments. Build and enhance intelligent agent systems capable of automated reasoning, planning, multi-step execution, and tool usage using modern frameworks (LangGraph, Model Context Protocol / MCP, etc.). Develop and optimize production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, leveraging vector databases, hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, and semantic reranking. Build robust data preprocessing, feature extraction, model inference, and evaluation pipelines adhering to clean code, testability, and CI/CD practices. Work closely with domain experts (chip design, verification), product managers, and core software engineering teams to formulate AI use cases, prototype solutions rapidly, and harden them into production. Ensure robust model safety, evaluation against hallucinations, prompt injection defenses, IP protection, and compliance with enterprise security and governance standards. Qualifications 3 to 10 years of professional software engineering and AI/ML experience, with proven hands-on involvement in taking AI/ML or LLM-based solutions from concept to production. Strong proficiency in Python with solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, modular architecture, and automated testing (pytest, CI/CD). Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, deep learning architectures (Transformers, CNNs/GNNs), feature engineering, data preprocessing, and model evaluation metrics. Practical experience building applications with foundational LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, LLaMA, etc.), prompt engineering best practices, and Agentic design patterns (ReAct, plan-and-execute, tool calling). Hands-on experience implementing RAG systems, embedding models, vector databases, and semantic retrieval strategies. Proficiency with modern ML and AI development libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Scikit-learn, LangChain, or LangGraph. Familiarity with containerization (Docker), REST/gRPC API development (e.g., FastAPI), and model serving/evaluation workflows. Demonstrated ability to break down complex domain problems, rapidly prototype AI solutions, benchmark performance, and iterate toward production-quality implementations. Preferred & Good-to-Have Skills Hands-on experience with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA), instruction tuning, dataset preparation/curation, or domain-specific model adaptation using Hugging Face TRL or Axolotl. Familiarity with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Apache AGE) and knowledge graph-augmented retrieval. Familiarity with C/C++, compiler concepts, or GPU profiling/acceleration (CUDA). Background or curiosity in digital logic design, SystemVerilog, hardware verification, or Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) and experiment tracking platforms (MLflow, Weights & Biases). Why Us We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! Diversity & Inclusion We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday #LI-Hybrid #LI-EDA

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II - Advertising
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Job summary Love to work in Digital Advertising; one of the biggest revenue drivers for internet giants of the world and Amazon’s fastest-growing business with an explosive growth? Love to conceptualise and build applications from grounds-up? Like to develop real-time, distributed and large-scale applications? Like to interact with worldwide advertising customers to build systems that makes advertising and it's functions automated and frictionless? Then, Software Development team that builds Tier-1 Advertising Experience wants you! Amazon Advertising is looking for an entrepreneurial Software Development Engineer who shares Amazon Advertising’s passion for building and delivering a global, scaleable, extensible, and secure platform that singularly manages the Sourcing, Storage, Supply, Aggregation, Processing, Reporting of billions of clicks and impressions across multiple Advertising Billing, Budgeting, Financial and Payments services. You will build and ship software that directly impacts our end customer experience. You'll develop your team of highly motivated and talented multi-functional builders who can collaborate with product managers, technical specialists, and principals across the company. You will participate in defining the technology roadmap for our advertising billing strategy, and shape building technology tools that can disrupt the billing industry. You should be comfortable with a degree of ambiguity that’s higher than most projects and relish the idea of solving problems that, frankly, haven’t been solved at scale before - anywhere. You will encounter challenging, novel situations every day and given the size of this initiative, you’ll have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. We’re looking for entrepreneurs who are passionate about innovating on behalf of customers, can demonstrate a high degree of ownership, and want to have fun while they make history and craft beautiful products. A successful candidate will have strong technical skills, and a history of growing their talent, and ability go hands-on with their technologies to identify the real problems you're solving. Written and verbal communication in this role are critical: you will author narratives that will be consumed by Amazonians at all levels, including executive leadership. Key Technical Challenges: Distributed and Scalable Architecture: Looking at advertising international expansion and business growth plans for next year, we expect this traffic to grow 10X in near future. Billing and Budgeting system should be easily scalable to manage exponential increase in traffic and extensible to support different business needs. High Availability: Downtime of Billing and Budgeting system can cause a huge loss in revenue and loss of business opportunity for our advertisers. High Availability architecture is to make sure that the system is configured to handle different loads and different failures with minimal or no downtime. Precision: Every click or impression needs to be counted, accounted, invoiced, and charged in near real-time, without any exception. It impacts both revenue and regulatory compliance. We need to build generic and extensible reconcilers for any anomaly detection and raising an appropriate alarm. Tags: SDE, SDE-II, Software Development Engineer Key job responsibilities Design, build and run distributed services for the Advertising Billing and Budgeting platform. These services source, store, aggregate and process billions of clicks and impressions, and they need to scale to 10X traffic growth as Amazon Advertising expands internationally. Own the high availability and operational health of Tier-1 billing systems. This means designing for failure tolerance and graceful degradation, keeping downtime close to zero, taking part in on-call, and driving root-cause fixes so the same issues don't come back. Work with product managers, principal engineers and partner teams in Amazon's Ads, Finance and Payments organizations to turn ambiguous business needs into clear technical designs. Write design docs and narratives for readers at every level, up to leadership. Raise the bar on operational and engineering excellence for systems that move billions of dollars. Find systemic risks before they turn into incidents, build mechanisms that make the platform self-healing and resilient, and set engineering standards that let the team move fast without giving up precision. Strengthen the team through thorough code and design reviews, mentoring junior engineers, and helping shape the technical roadmap for the advertising billing strategy. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
