jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer – Generative AI Model Serving (Go / Rust / GPU)
jobs.description: Our Company: At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. Power the Platform Behind Enterprise Generative AI At Teradata, we’re not just managing data; we’re unleashing its full potential. Our ClearScape Analytics™ platform and Enterprise Vector Store help the world’s largest enterprises derive value from their most complex data. Generative AI and agentic systems are the next frontier, and they run on infrastructure that has to be fast, efficient, and dependable at scale. As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will build the serving layer that runs large language models and other generative models inside the Teradata Vantage ecosystem. You will work on GPU-accelerated inference, high-performance Go and Rust services, and the cloud-native platform that lets teams ship models to production with confidence. You will own systems end to end, from a CUDA kernel profile to a Kubernetes rollout. What You’ll Do Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency model-serving platforms for LLMs and generative models, covering batching, streaming, routing, autoscaling, and multi-tenant isolation. Develop high-performance control-plane and data-plane services in Go and performance-critical components (tokenizers, schedulers, runtimes, gRPC/HTTP gateways, native extensions) in Rust . Optimize GPU inference for throughput, latency, and cost using continuous batching, KV-cache management, quantization (INT8/FP8/AWQ/GPTQ), speculative decoding, tensor/pipeline parallelism, and efficient memory use. Integrate and extend inference engines such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, Ray Serve, KServe, SGLang, llama.cpp, and ONNX Runtime ; contribute fixes upstream where it makes sense. Build and manage GPU cluster infrastructure on Kubernetes (NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, MIG/time-slicing, node pools, scheduling and bin-packing) across cloud and on-prem environments. Own the full delivery path : CI/CD pipelines, model packaging and registries, canary and blue/green rollouts, infrastructure as code, and automated performance regression testing. Build AI observability into everything: metrics, logs, and traces for token throughput, time-to-first-token, GPU utilization, queue depth, error and hallucination signals, using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. Provide clean APIs, SDKs, and developer tooling (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, internal services, and lightweight UIs or dashboards) so AI engineers and agent builders can deploy and monitor models self-serve. Support agentic and RAG workloads by serving embedding, reranking, and generation models alongside the Enterprise Vector Store, with predictable latency and graceful degradation. Drive reliability, security, and cost efficiency: SLOs, load and chaos testing, capacity planning, GPU cost attribution, and secure model and tenant isolation. Who You’ll Work With You will collaborate daily with AI researchers, ML engineers, data scientists, and platform and SRE teams who champion diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to our success. You’ll be part of a cohesive team delivering high-quality, highly visible AI/ML functionality within the Teradata Vantage platform. You will report to the Sr. Manager, Software Engineering, who will champion your growth and empower your contributions. What Makes You a Qualified Candidate 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend systems, distributed systems, or AI/ML infrastructure. Strong, production-level proficiency in Go (concurrency, gRPC, profiling, service design) and working proficiency, or a demonstrated passion for learning, Rust (ownership, async runtimes such as Tokio, FFI, performance tuning). Hands-on experience with GPU computing for ML: CUDA fundamentals, GPU profiling (Nsight, nvidia-smi/DCGM), memory and bandwidth tradeoffs, and multi-GPU or multi-node inference. Experience serving LLMs or generative models in production, with practical knowledge of inference optimization techniques and the serving frameworks listed above. Solid understanding of transformer architectures and the LLM inference lifecycle (prefill vs. decode, attention, KV cache, sampling), plus familiarity with PyTorch and Hugging Face tooling. Strong system design skills and a deep understanding of distributed systems, networking, concurrency, and failure modes. Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, or similar), plus infrastructure as code (Terraform). Full-stack engineering experience : comfortable building REST/gRPC APIs and a pragmatic front end (React or similar) for dashboards, playgrounds, or admin tools; Python for glue, tooling, and ML integration. Experience with observability practices and tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, tracing) applied to ML or LLM workloads. You are obsessive about reliability, debuggability, and ensuring AI systems behave predictably and deterministically when needed. You code daily, own systems end to end, and are knowledgeable about open-source tools and know how to leverage and extend them. What You Bring A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Genuine excitement for AI, LLMs, and the systems that make them efficient and affordable to run at scale. Strong communication skills and a bias toward measuring, benchmarking, and iterating. Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Teradata, Snowflake, or Databricks is a plus. Bonus Points Experience writing or tuning CUDA / Triton (OpenAI) / CUTLASS kernels, or contributing to inference engines. Experience with on-device or edge ML inference (ONNX, TFLite, llama.cpp, quantized small language models), embedded or mobile deployment. Knowledge of RAG pipelines, vector databases, embeddings , and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, ReAct-style agents). Experience with model monitoring, drift detection, evaluation harnesses, and responsible AI practices. Open-source contributions, technical writing, or public projects in ML systems, Go, or Rust. Experience with service meshes, RDMA/InfiniBand/NCCL, Slurm, or Ray clusters. #LI-VB1

Job Responsibilities Generative& Agentic AI Testing Strategy: Design and implement comprehensive testing strategies specifically tailored for LLM-based applications and agentic systems, including evaluation of model responses, RAG pipelines accuracy, and overall system reliability. You will expand this to evaluate autonomous multi-agent behaviors and tool-use accuracy. Full-Stack Test Automation: Design and implement automated testing solutions for continuous evaluation of LLM applications, including integration tests, performance tests, and specialized AI behavior tests. This spans both our Python backend services and modern TypeScript/React/Angular frontends. Quality Assurance Framework& Compliance: Utilize Roche's testing frameworks that address both traditional software quality aspects and AI-specific concerns such as output consistency, contextual accuracy, and ethical compliance; co-create and maintain such frameworks when required. Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation testing strategy, test cases, and testing guidelines specific to AI applications and compliant with Roche practices. Edge Case, Bias, and Fairness Testing: Identify and develop test scenarios for edge cases in LLM behavior, including handling of ambiguous inputs, potential biases, and unexpected response patterns. Design and execute tests to identify potential biases in model outputs and ensure fair treatment across different user groups and use cases. Security& Performance Testing: Collaborate within development teams to test for potential vulnerabilities specific to LLM applications, including prompt injection, data leakage, and other AI-specific security concerns. Collaborate with other engineers to conduct thorough performance testing of GenAI applications, including response time analysis, load testing, and resource utilization monitoring. Qualifications Hold B.Sc., B.Eng., M.Sc., M.Eng. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent degree with strong background in testing methodologies. Be passionate about quality assurance and testing, particularly in the context of AI and GenAI applications and agents. Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Utilize critical thinking and problem-solving when using AI prompts (in e.g. NLP, data distributions and edge cases). Be proactive in identifying potential issues and suggesting improvements. Education / Experience Experience: 7+ years of experience in software testing, with at least 1 year focused on genAI and/or agentic applications. Regulated Environments: Be ready to work in a regulated environment with qualified infrastructure and validated applications, understand the difference between GxP and non-GxP products and the importance of CSV and ITSM processes in the delivery. Agile Integration: Be experienced in working with Agile development teams. Skills Must-have: Comprehensive Full-Stack Testing Mastery Core Languages& Testing Frameworks: Advanced command of Python and standard testing frameworks (e.g., pytest, allure), alongside practical familiarity with specialized AI evaluation tools. High competence in TypeScript-driven test frameworks (such as Playwright, Jest, and Cypress) for thoroughly verifying dynamic generative user interfaces. End-to-End Automation& CI/CD: Proven expertise in architecting and maintaining end-to-end automated testing suites that bridge traditional UI/API validation with complex, asynchronous AI/LLM evaluation pipelines. Pipeline Integration: Hands-on experience integrating these comprehensive suites within GitHub Actions or modern CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous, reliable quality checks throughout the entire development lifecycle. Advanced AI Quality& Evaluation Mastery AI Evaluation Frameworks: Expertise in implementing evaluation harnesses (e.g., RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo) to quantify LLM performance, hallucination rates, and answer relevancy. Agentic Workflow Validation: Ability to test autonomous agentic loops, including tool-use accuracy, step-by-step reasoning verification, and goal-directed performance metrics. Evaluation Datasets: Experience in curating, managing, and versioning 'Golden Datasets' for benchmarking model responses against ground truth in both development and production environments. Observability& Feedback Loops: Leveraging tracing (e.g., LangSmith, Arize Phoenix) to monitor production inputs/outputs, identify drift, and capture user feedback for continuous improvement. Basic broad AI knowledge: Understanding of LLM architectures, RAG systems, agents, and common failure modes in AI applications. Python Expertise: Advanced proficiency in writing robust, maintainable Python code for test automation (e.g., pytest). Experience using Python to orchestrate complex AI evaluation workflows, process large datasets for benchmarking, and automate interactions with LLM/AI services. Ability to integrate Python scripts into CI/CD pipelines for automated quality checks and performance observability in agentic systems. Should-have: Cloud: Practical experience with testing applications on cloud platforms (AWS) and working with cloud-based AI services. Observability& ALM: Experience with monitoring and observability tools, log analysis, and performance metrics tracking (Grafana). Experienced in Roche mandatory ALM tools (Jira, GitHub). Could-have: Regulatory Compliance: Proven understanding of AI quality assurance and testing standards within highly regulated industries. Additional Qualifications Stay current with the latest developments in AI and GenAI testing methodologies and best practices. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Senior AI Engineer Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. In this hands-on role, you'll design, build, and ship production-grade agentic AI systems. These include agents that make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs, handle complex multi-step workflows, and deliver secure, scalable, reliable results. You'll work across agent orchestration, tool calling, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps, help set the engineering standard for Gen AI development, and mentor other engineers on the team. Much of this work is strong backend engineering. If you bring deep experience building production services and have started building with LLMs, we'd love to Roles & Responsibilities Architect and build the tool-calling layer that powers our agents: wrap internal services, data platforms, and external APIs as well-defined tools with clear schemas, contracts, and permissions. Engineer reliable tool execution at scale, including parallel and chained tool calls, timeouts, retries, idempotency, error recovery, and graceful handling of tool failures or bad model outputs. Develop high-performance Python backend services for LLM orchestration, covering async job handling, streaming responses, caching, rate limiting, and distributed workflows supporting high-throughput Gen AI operations. Engineer state, memory, and context management subsystems so agents can maintain session continuity across long, multi-step, tool-heavy interactions. Architect multi-agent and skills-based agent systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar, enabling autonomous reasoning, tool use, inter-agent coordination, and adaptive decision-making at enterprise scale. Build observability for agent behavior, including end-to-end tracing of tool calls, measuring tool-selection accuracy, and debugging multi-step agent runs in production. Build retrieval systems (RAG and Graph-RAG) where agents need grounded knowledge, using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune). Establish LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS), covering MLflow, prompt and agent evaluation, model lineage tracking, CI/CD, and monitoring. Design multimodal generative AI pipelines that unify text, image, tabular, and graph data using modern transformer-based and foundation models. Guide fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and alignment strategies (e.g., PEFT, LoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF) to adapt foundation models for specialized enterprise use cases, working closely with ML specialists. Implement Responsible AI practices, including hallucination mitigation, bias detection, output safety guardrails, explainability, and compliance with data ethics standards. Evaluate and productionize advances in agentic AI, multimodal models, and frontier foundation models, benchmarking them against enterprise performance and safety requirements. Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, and set the engineering standard for Gen AI development across the program. All About You Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. A strong track record of building and operating production backend systems at scale, including distributed services, APIs, async processing, data stores, and observability. Strong API design and integration experience: you know how to build services that other systems, and now LLMs, can call safely and reliably. Excellent Python engineering skills, including async programming, API development (FastAPI or similar), and microservices, plus SQL proficiency. Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM-powered application to production that uses tool/function calling, such as agents that call APIs, query databases, or trigger workflows. This can be with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models. A working understanding of Gen AI engineering patterns, such as prompt design, embeddings, semantic search, and agent memory, or a demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on new technical domains. Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome). Experience leading or mentoring engineers, plus strong communication and stakeholder management skills. You should be able to translate technical work into business value. Nice to have: experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building tool servers and connectors for LLM agents. Nice to have: experience evaluating agent performance, such as tool-selection accuracy, task completion rates, or multi-step reasoning reliability. Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, knowledge graphs, or MLOps tooling like MLflow, Weights & Biases, SageMaker, or Bedrock. Coming from a backend background? We value engineers who take AI from prototype to production as much as those who train the models. If you've built high-throughput systems and started applying those skills to LLM-powered products, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't worked with every tool listed here Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Lead Engineer, VP
jobs.description: Job Description: Job Title: Lead Engineer, VP Location: Pune, India Corporate Title: Vice President Role Description Overview: Corporate Banking is a technology centric business, with an increasing move to real-time processing, an increasing appetite from customers for integrated systems and access to supporting data. This means that technology is more important than ever for business. Deutsche Bank is one of the few banks with the scale and network to compete aggressively in this space, and the breadth of investment in this area is unmatched by our peers. Joining the team is a unique opportunity to help rebuild the core of some of our most mission critical processing systems from the ground-up. Our Corporate Bank Technology team is a global team across 30 countries. The primary businesses that we support within Corporate Bank are Cash Management, Securities Services, Trade Finance and Trust & Agency Services. CB Technology supports these businesses through ‘vertical’ CIO aligned teams and by ‘horizontals’ such as Client Connectivity, Surveillance and Regulatory, Infrastructure, Architecture, Production, and Risk & Control. About Role: As the Lead Engineer of the Channel Security team, you will be responsible for the development and end-to-end technical delivery of a mission-critical platform designed to protect the Corporate Bank’s online channels from real-time fraud. You are expected to be a hands-on backend developer with deep architectural expertise to meet demanding performance, reliability, and security requirements, while also providing coaching and technical guidance to the development squad to enable their success. What we’ll offer you As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy Best in class leave policy Gender neutral parental leaves 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral) Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents Accident and Term life Insurance Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above Your key responsibilities Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the team, foster a culture of engineering excellence and ownership. Lead by example through direct, hands-on development of the core services and critical components of the Fraud Monitoring Platform. Partner closely with the platform architect to define and drive the implementation of the solution design, ensuring the Fraud Monitoring Platform is scalable, resilient, and secure. Work closely with Engineering Heads, Project Management, and leaders of related platforms to build, integrate, and deliver the software. Drive continuous improvement in the team's performance across the entire SDLC, including code quality, automated testing (QA), CI/CD pipelines, and post-release operational activities. Act as the primary technical expert on the platform in strategy meetings, stakeholder discussions, and future product development opportunities. Partner with SRE and L3 support teams to proactively identify and implement architectural improvements that enhance system reliability and reduce operational toil. Your skills and experience Proven, hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying complex, scalable applications on a major public cloud platform (GCP strongly preferred). Extensive hands-on backend programming experience, with expert-level proficiency in the modern Java ecosystem (Java 17+, Spring Boot). Familiarity with AI/ML, Generative AI and agentic AI patterns, with an understanding of how ML models, LLMs or AI agents can be safely integrated and orchestrated within enterprise and real-time decisioning platforms. Experience applying AI-assisted engineering techniques across software development, testing, operational support or developer productivity is required. Overall experience of 15+ years in software engineering, with a proven track record of leading the design and delivery of complex, business-critical systems. Strong knowledge of Microservices Architecture, Kubernetes, Docker, and building cloud-native applications. Proficiency with event-driven architecture and messaging systems like Kafka or MQ. Expertise with relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and in-memory data stores/caches (Redis). jobs.title: AI Principal Architect
jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary AI Principal Architect Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you. Roles & Responsibilities Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale. Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks). Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context. Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond. Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention. Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune). Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models. Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency. Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards. Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness. Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program. Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point. All About You Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure. Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM. Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail. Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency. Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI. A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry. The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms. Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks. Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs. Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem. Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q2 FY27 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026. About Position: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior GenAI & AI Agent Engineer to design, develop, and scale intelligent AI-driven platforms that transform natural language into meaningful business insights. This role sits at the intersection of Generative AI, Data Engineering, Analytics, and Backend Development, focusing on building production-grade AI agents, conversational systems, and semantic data layers. Role: Senior GenAI & AI Agent Engineer Location: All Persistent Locations Experience: 6 to 12 Years Job Type: Full-Time Employment What You'll Do: Design, develop, and enhance LLM-powered AI agents using LangGraph, LangChain, RAG frameworks, and advanced orchestration techniques. Build and maintain scalable FastAPI-based services with asynchronous processing, authentication, observability, and Redis-based checkpointing. Create and manage semantic data layers, metadata repositories, and knowledge structures that improve AI-generated query accuracy. Develop conversational AI applications and chatbot interfaces that deliver data insights through natural language interactions. Analyze conversation-level metrics and user interactions to continuously improve AI agent performance and response quality. Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate business rules, KPIs, and metric definitions into AI-driven solutions. Integrate enterprise data platforms such as AWS Athena, Databricks, and PySpark-based environments into AI workflows. Build integrations and automated export mechanisms for collaboration platforms such as Slack and Google Sheets. Develop and maintain AI Skills, Agent Workflows, and reusable components within the AI ecosystem. Design, build, and integrate MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and services to enable seamless AI agent interactions. Write unit tests, integration tests, evaluation frameworks, and monitoring capabilities to ensure production-grade reliability. Fine-tune prompts, retrieval strategies, evaluation pipelines, and agent behaviors to improve accuracy and business outcomes. Follow best practices in software engineering, DevOps, version control, and system observability. Expertise You'll Bring: 6-12 years of experience in Software Development, AI/ML Engineering, Data Engineering, or related domains. Strong hands-on expertise in Python, PySpark, FastAPI, Pydantic, and asynchronous programming patterns. Advanced SQL skills with experience in Spark SQL, Hive, Athena, query optimization, performance tuning, and complex data transformations. Extensive experience designing scalable APIs, backend services, and distributed applications. Strong understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI architectures, and AI application development. Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI APIs, LangFuse, RAG frameworks, and prompt engineering. Experience building intelligent agent workflows, tool integrations, retrieval systems, and evaluation frameworks. Knowledge of semantic search, vector databases, embeddings, and enterprise AI architectures. Experience working with cloud platforms, preferably AWS, and modern data platforms. Strong understanding of data analytics concepts including dimensional modeling, KPI design, cohort analysis, and data governance. Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau or Qlik Sense. Proven experience developing conversational AI systems, chatbots, and user-facing AI applications. Hands-on experience building AI Skills, Agent Frameworks, and workflow orchestration platforms. Experience developing and integrating MCP servers and AI interoperability frameworks. Strong knowledge of Git, CI/CD practices, testing frameworks, monitoring, and production support. Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. Benefits: Competitive salary and benefits package Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards Annual health check-ups Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment: Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds. We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles. Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities. If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers "Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind." 1 Open Positions AI ML,LLM Skills Required PUNE Location AI ML,LLM Desirable Skills 187202 Job Code

jobs.description: Job Description: Job Title: Data Science and AI Engineering Lead, VP Location: Pune, India Role Description Driving the creation of new AI solutions for Chief Strategy & Innovation Office(CSIO). We are seeking an AI Engineer with more than 18+ years of experience who will stand at the forefront of innovation, architecting, developing, and deploying groundbreaking AI solutions that redefine what's possible. We are seeking a visionary and highly motivated Engineer eager to leverage advanced AI models and platforms to conquer complex business challenges and accelerate digital transformation across Deutsche Bank. As Deutsche Bank enters a phase where a variety of data and AI development tools are becoming more accessible, we are seeking an experienced Data Scientist and AI Engineer to help drive the implementation and deliver our AI Strategy for the Deutsche Bank. The role holder will be expected to lead the design, development and implementation of new AI solutions for stakeholders across the Deutsche Bank. These solutions will vary in terms of complexity, but all will have the goal of simplifying and accelerating Operations and Controls activities, achieving cost save targets, and driving revenue growth. What we’ll offer you As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy: Best-in-class annual leave policy Gender-neutral parental leaves 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender-neutral) Sponsorship for industry-relevant certifications and education Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members Comprehensive hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents Accident and term life Insurance Complementary health screening for 35 yrs. and above Your key responsibilities Leadership (20%): Help lead and develop a high-performing Data Science and AI Engineering team Help drive the adoption of AI and analytics best practice across CSIO, IT (TDI), and Deutsche Bank more widely Foster a collaborative and innovative team environment, encouraging continuous learning and skill development on topics across AI Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies in data warehousing, business intelligence, and cloud analytics, particularly within the Google Cloud Platform ecosystem. Conduct performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and support career progression for team members as needed Stakeholder Management and Governance (10%): Help ensure the CBIBOC Data Science and AI Engineering book of work is transparently documented and managed to ensure tasks are efficiently allocated and executed, and progress is easily tracked and reported Ensure AI governance requirements, as mandated by bank policy, regulation, or law, are adhered to for all new solutions developed Provide demos of new solutions, training materials, slides, and other materials as required to support the CBIBOC communication and upskilling agenda Hands-on Development of AI Solutions (70%): Lead by example, working with other Squad members to design, develop, and implement novel AI solutions Partner with business stakeholders and other Squad members to understand their needs and priorities, and identify new opportunities for the development or use of AI solutions Ensure new AI use cases (Squad projects) are rigorously evaluated and prioritized based on expected ROI, strategic alignment, technical feasibility and risk Ensure all new AI solutions are thoroughly tested, validated, controlled (e.g. implementation of guardrails, access permissions, etc.), and monitored on an ongoing basis Ensure all new AI solutions are recorded in a centralized inventory and brought through the required approval steps prior to production implementation Track against agreed KPIs to demonstrate the effectiveness and value of each AI solution (e.g. costs and benefits as well as accuracy/consistency/performance) Your skills and experience Strategic AI Solution Development: End-to-End AI Architecture & Leadership: Lead the design, architecture, and implementation of highly scalable and robust AI-powered applications and services utilizing Python, FastAPI/Flask, FastMcp LangGraph, ADK and Google VertexAI. Advanced Model Integration & Optimization: Architect, integrate, and expertly fine-tune large language models, with a strategic focus on the Gemini Model, for advanced tasks and cutting-edge generative AI applications. Demonstrable experience using Data Science / AI developer tools and platforms such as Github, VS Code, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, MLflow, Weights and Biases, Jupyter Notebook, Hugging Face, Langchain, Langgraph, Google Vertex, Neo4J, etc. Experience with front-to-back AI solution design and architecture, particularly the design of agentic AI solutions Scalable System Integration & Cloud Infrastructure API Architecture & Integration: Drive the design and implementation of seamless API architectures and integrations with diverse internal and external systems, ensuring optimal data flow and functionality across the enterprise. Cloud Infrastructure Leadership: Lead the deployment, management, and optimization of AI solutions on cloud platforms, leveraging services like GCP CloudRun/GKE, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, and CloudSQL for resilient data processing and infrastructure management. Operational Excellence & Quality Assurance Code Quality & AIOps Governance: Establish and enforce rigorous code quality standards and best practices for software development and AIOps, ensuring clean, maintainable, and well-documented code across all AI projects. Advanced Testing & Deployment Oversight: Architect and execute comprehensive test strategies for AI solutions, leading the deployment and continuous monitoring of models in production environments, ensuring high performance and reliability. Thought Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Research & Innovation Leadership: Actively lead research into the latest advancements in AI, machine learning, and natural language processing, translating cutting-edge developments into innovative solutions and strategic initiatives. Cross-Functional Strategic Partnership: Collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, and other engineering leaders to define strategy, align priorities, and ensure the successful delivery of high-quality, impactful AI products that meet business objectives. Demonstrable experience with data / feature engineering, data product creation, and modern data solutions such as BigQuery, Looker, PostgreSQL, Pinecone, Spark, MongoDB, Redis, Databricks, Denodo, Snowflake, etc. Strong knowledge of current best practice for AI risk management across the solution lifecycle, and how to leverage technology to implement these controls (e.g. from development, testing, and validation of new solutions to setting access controls/permissions, implementing guardrails, and automating performance monitoring and reporting / dashboards) Ability to write / review Python code and experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Github Copilot, etc.). SQL and Java experience desirable but not essential. Experience developing production-grade software within a Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) control framework The ability to balance people management, hands-on development work, and governance activities in a flexible day-to-day manner. The desire to grow and learn, keep up with the latest developments and new AI offerings emerging across the industry, and progress their Data Science / AI career. Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs. How we’ll support you Training and development to help you excel in your career Coaching and support from experts in your team A culture of continuous learning to aid the progression of your career A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs About us and our teams Please visit our company website for further information: https://www.db.com/company/company.html We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively. Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group. We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

jobs.title: Senior Associate - AI - ML Engineer
jobs.description: AI Platform Lead Engineer-IN The AI Platform Lead Engineer builds and maintains the systems that support AI and machine learning applications, working to ensure the systems are scalable, efficient, and reliable. Key Responsibilities and Duties Deploy, manage and scale AI systems, as well as support model activity and deployment infrastructure in cloud environments Work with infrastructure and application development teams, data engineers, and model owners, to better integrate the AI applications into mainstream enterprise applications. Put into production the ML models keeping in mind the scalability, optimization, resource availability, and security for the AI solution. Educational Requirements University (Degree) Preferred Work Experience 5+ Years Required; 7+ Years Preferred Physical Requirements Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work Career Level 8IC Total experience required : Between 9 to 15 Years Job location : Mumbai / Pune Responsibilities Design and implement end-to-end Generative AI solutions that address complex business challenges, with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and production readiness. Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines by integrating vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, and FAISS with embedding models and large language models (LLMs) to deliver context-aware, knowledge-grounded responses at scale. Develop and optimize prompting strategies, templates, and workflows that maximize LLM accuracy, consistency, and performance across diverse use cases and user scenarios. Customize and fine-tune foundation models using techniques such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and parameter-efficient methods including LoRA and QLoRA to meet domain-specific performance requirements. Establish and maintain rigorous model evaluation frameworks that measure accuracy, latency, cost-efficiency, hallucination rates, and task-specific metrics, conducting A/B testing and comparative analysis to drive informed model selection and configuration decisions. Implement comprehensive observability and monitoring systems — including logging, tracing, and alerting — to continuously track model behavior, prompt-response patterns, token consumption, error rates, and performance drift in production environments. Design and deploy production-grade AI agents leveraging both low-code platforms and custom high-code implementations, balancing flexibility, maintainability, and performance to meet evolving business needs. Integrate a broad range of AI and ML capabilities — including natural language processing, computer vision, document intelligence, and traditional machine learning models — to build holistic, multi-modal solutions that solve complex problems. Continuously evaluate the rapidly evolving AI landscape, proactively researching and adopting emerging models, frameworks, and tools to enhance solution quality and sustain competitive advantage. Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable AI architectures, ensuring alignment between technical solutions and organizational objectives. Contribute to the development of best practices, reusable components, and internal standards for Generative AI development, fostering a culture of innovation, quality, and responsible AI use across the organization. Must-Have Skills Proven hands-on experience building and deploying Generative AI solutions, including RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and LLM fine-tuning using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or simila Strong proficiency in Python and experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face) and vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or FAISS Solid understanding of model evaluation methodologies, including benchmarking, A/B testing, hallucination detection, and performance monitoring in production environments Experience with fine-tuning techniques such as SFT, RLHF, LoRA, and QLoRA, along with familiarity with parameter-efficient training approaches for domain-specific model customization Demonstrated ability to design and deploy production-grade AI systems with robust observability, logging, and monitoring capabilities ensuring reliability and performance at scale Good-to-Have Skills Exposure to multi-modal AI capabilities including computer vision, document intelligence, or speech processing integrated within broader AI/ML pipelines Familiarity with low-code AI agent platforms (such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Flowise, or similar) alongside the ability to build custom high-code agent implementations Experience working within cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, leveraging managed AI/ML services for model training, deployment, and scaling Knowledge of responsible AI principles, including bias detection, fairness evaluation, and compliance considerations relevant to regulated industries such as financial services Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools such as MLflow, Weights & Biases, or similar platforms for experiment tracking, model versioning, and deployment automation Related Skills Business Acumen, Data Preprocessing, Data Science, Innovation, Machine Learning, Market/Industry Dynamics, Predictive Modeling, Programming, Statistics _____________________________________________________________________________________________________ Company Overview TIAA Global Capabilities was established in 2016 with a mission to tap into a vast pool of talent, reduce risk by insourcing key platforms and processes, as well as contribute to innovation with a focus on enhancing our technology stack. TIAA Global Capabilities is focused on building a scalable and sustainable organization , with a focus on technology , operations and expanding into the shared services business space. Working closely with our U.S. colleagues and other partners, our goal is to reduce risk, improve the efficiency of our technology and processes and develop innovative ideas to increase throughput and productivity. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. TIAA does not discriminate against any candidate or employee on the basis of age, race, color, national origin, sex, religion, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status. Our Culture of Impact At TIAA, we're on a mission to build on our 100+ year legacy of delivering for our clients while evolving to meet tomorrow's challenges. We equip our associates with future-focused skills and AI tools that enable us to advance our mission. Together, we are fighting to ensure a more secure financial future for all and for generations to come. We are guided by our values: Champion Our People, Be Client Obsessed, Lead with Integrity, Own It, and Win As One. They influence every decision we make and how we work together to serve our clients every day. We thrive in a collaborative in-office environment where teams work across organizational boundaries with shared purpose, accelerating innovation and delivering meaningful results. Our workplace brings together TIAA and Nuveen's entrepreneurial spirit, where we work hard and work together to create lasting impact. Here, every associate can grow through meaningful learning experiences and development pathways—because when our people succeed, our impact on clients' lives grows stronger. Accessibility Support TIAA offers support for those who need assistance with our online application process to provide an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities. Location: Pune, India Years of Experience: 8 to 12 Years About Position We are seeking a highly skilled Senior AI Security Project Manager with extensive experience in AI Security, Cybersecurity, and Cloud Security. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of AI/ML systems and a proven track record in securing AI applications and infrastructure. This role requires a hands-on approach to conducting security assessments and implementing robust security measures throughout the AI/ML lifecycle. What You'll Do Conduct comprehensive security assessments across the AI/ML lifecycle, including data ingestion, training, deployment, inference, monitoring, and retirement. Perform AI threat modeling using established frameworks such as MITRE ATLAS, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, and NIST AI RMF. Secure and assess LLM-based applications, RAG solutions, AI agents, and AI APIs. Implement AI security testing, abuse-case analysis, and validation of AI security controls. Manage AI model risk and assurance frameworks effectively. Ensure security of AI/ML workloads deployed on GCP or AWS. Conduct application security reviews, architecture assessments, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing. Secure containers, Kubernetes platforms, APIs, and AI service endpoints. Oversee IAM, secrets management, encryption, and key management controls. Support audits, evidence collection, risk assessments, remediation tracking, and compliance reporting. Engage with stakeholders to communicate security strategies and document technical processes. Mandatory Skills 8+ years of experience in AI Security, Cybersecurity, Application Security, Cloud Security, or Model Assurance. Strong understanding of AI/ML systems, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures, AI agents, and MLOps pipelines. Hands-on experience conducting security assessments across the AI/ML lifecycle. Experience performing AI threat modeling using frameworks such as MITRE ATLAS, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, or NIST AI RMF. Experience securing AI/ML workloads deployed on GCP or AWS. Strong knowledge of SSDLC, DevSecOps, CI/CD security, and cloud security best practices. Experience working within healthcare, medical device, life sciences, or other regulated environments. Familiarity with HIPAA, GDPR, and FDA-regulated software environments. Strong stakeholder management, communication, and technical documentation skills. Preferred Skills Experience with AI Red Teaming and Adversarial Machine Learning testing. Hands-on experience with AI security tools such as Garak, PyRIT, Counterfit, or similar. Experience assessing foundation models, fine-tuned models, and multimodal AI systems. Experience implementing AI guardrails, content moderation controls, and safety mechanisms. The role combines hands-on software and platform engineering with AI solution delivery, technical enablement, and responsible adoption. Conduct business workshops and convert operational challenges into AI-enabled use cases focused on automation and productivity enhancement opportunities. Rapidly design and develop proof-of-concepts using Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, and Mendix. Support deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI solutions. Operational Platform and Application Engineering Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain AI-enabled platforms, applications, services, and reusable components, not only proofs of concept. Build user-facing and backend application capabilities that integrate LLMs with enterprise data, workflows, and business systems. Develop APIs, microservices, event-driven components, connectors, and integration adapters using secure and maintainable engineering practices. Design, configure and implement APIs, MCP servers and MCP tools that expose controlled business capabilities to compatible AI clients and agents. Create reusable platform services for prompt and model access, retrieval, memory, tool orchestration, authorization, observability, evaluation, and cost tracking. Contribute production-quality code, automated tests, technical documentation, deployment assets, and operational runbooks. Help development teams adopt shared patterns through pair development, code reviews, reference implementations, and technical coaching. AI Solution Delivery Identify and assess AI, GenAI, agentic AI, machine learning, and automation opportunities across service operations. Conduct discovery workshops and translate operational challenges into clear product requirements, architecture decisions, prototypes, and delivery plans. Design and implement RAG pipelines, knowledge assistants, document intelligence solutions, agentic workflows, and LLM integrations having an automation mindset. Design short-term and long-term memory patterns that separate chat history, durable user or task context, and authoritative enterprise knowledge. Build agent-based applications for planning, retrieval, tool selection, controlled execution, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Rapidly prototype using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Mendix, and suitable open-source frameworks, then harden successful prototypes into supportable products. Architecture, Integration, and Operations Design scalable and secure architectures across LLM applications, RAG, APIs, MCP, data platforms, and cloud services. Apply appropriate separation between LLM reasoning, retrieval, memory, API access, tool execution, and system-of-record responsibilities. Use API gateways, domain services, tool registries, and controlled orchestration patterns to avoid unmanaged point-to-point integrations. Architect data and application pipelines for deployment and monitoring on Azure or AWS using Docker, Airflow, Kubernetes, and CI/CD. Define and monitor evaluation metrics covering answer quality, retrieval quality, task success, latency, cost, safety, and reliability. Implement logging, tracing, alerting, retry, timeout, fallback, and audit patterns for production AI services. Support incident analysis, performance optimization, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of deployed platforms and applications. Governance and Technical Leadership Implement Responsible AI guardrails, privacy controls, PII handling, access controls, auditability, and secure tool-execution patterns. Ensure retrieved content, memory, and tool calls respect user identity, authorization, source provenance, and data-access permissions. Provide technical leadership on AI architecture, engineering standards, platform reuse, governance, and adoption of proven practices. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend innovations based on business value, maintainability, security, interoperability, and total cost of ownership. Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to business stakeholders, architects, engineers, security teams, and product owners. What You Bring (required qualification and skill sets) Experience and Education Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 4+ years of experience delivering AI, ML, data, software, or digital solutions, with ownership of architecture and implementation. Hands-on experience developing and operating enterprise applications, platforms, or shared technical services. Practical experience delivering Generative AI or LLM applications, including MCP, RAG, tools, agents, or conversational systems. Experience taking solutions from discovery and proof of concept through production deployment and operational support. Experience working in global, cross-functional, agile teams with strong communication and stakeholder-management skills. Core Technical Skills Programming and application engineering: Strong Python and SQL; API development with FastAPI; testing, secure coding, microservices, asynchronous processing, and resilient integration patterns. GenAI and RAG: Prompt design, embeddings, indexing, hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, evaluation, and retrieval optimization. Memory, agents, and orchestration: Short- and long-term memory patterns, structured tool calling, approval gates, and frameworks such as LangGraph or Semantic Kernel. APIs and MCP: REST APIs, API gateways, OAuth2/RBAC, MCP servers and tools, input schemas, controlled execution, and enterprise integration patterns. Cloud, data, and delivery: Hands-on experience with Azure or AWS and relevant services such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake; Git, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD. Observability and governance: Logging, tracing, monitoring, auditability, cost management, privacy, security, and permission-aware data access. Preferred Qualifications Experience building reusable AI platform capabilities and MCP-based integrations used across multiple applications or teams. Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Prompt Flow, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Mendix, or integrations with platforms such as PowerBI, Tabeau, SharePoint, Teams, Jira, SalesForce, or SAP. Front-end or full-stack exposure, such as React or TypeScript, and experience with ML or document intelligence use cases. Experience mentoring engineers, reviewing code and architectures, and creating technical standards or reference implementations. Indicative Technology Stack Python, FastAPI/Flask, SQL, LangGraph, React/TypeScript. Azure OpenAI or approved models, Azure AI Search or comparable retrieval services, Snowflake/Fabric, REST APIs, MCP, API gateways, and messaging services. Git, Jira or Azure DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, logging, and tracing. Success in This Role Delivers working, secure, maintainable AI platforms and applications that solve measurable service-operation problems. Creates reusable engineering capabilities that reduce duplication and accelerate other development teams. Balances rapid experimentation with production engineering, security, governance, usability, and operational ownership. Can clearly explain and implement the relationship between LLMs, RAG, memory, APIs, MCP servers, MCP tools, orchestration, and enterprise systems. Helps colleagues develop solutions through practical technical guidance and co-development, while remaining accountable for hands-on delivery.

You will leverage your expertise in Databricks, dbt, Python, and modern data architectures to create scalable, intelligent, and high-performing data ecosystems that enable AI-driven innovation across the enterprise. You will work with large volumes of structured and unstructured data, developing robust data pipelines, semantic data layers, and retrieval frameworks that support Generative AI, advanced analytics, and business transformation initiatives. By ensuring data quality, accessibility, governance, and operational excellence, you will help organizations unlock the full potential of AI-ready data platforms. Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy, and collaboration needed to help shape the future of data engineering and Generative AI. What You Will Do Design and build scalable data pipelines supporting Generative AI, advanced analytics, and enterprise data initiatives. Develop and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks by preparing, transforming, and managing large volumes of enterprise data for AI-driven applications. Create and maintain vectorized data processing pipelines that enable fast and accurate retrieval of information for AI and agentic workflows. Build semantic data layers, knowledge frameworks, and contextual datasets that improve the effectiveness and accuracy of AI-powered solutions. Develop and manage dbt models, macros, tests, documentation, and deployment pipelines to ensure trusted and reusable data assets. Leverage Databricks Lakehouse capabilities, including Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, and Workflows, to deliver scalable and secure data solutions. Implement automated data quality controls, governance frameworks, and validation processes to identify data inconsistencies, bias, duplication, and compliance risks. Collaborate with AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Architects, and Business Stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Build, deploy, and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support continuous integration, testing, and delivery of data engineering solutions. Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data platform performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency. Drive engineering best practices in data modeling, version control, testing, documentation, security, and cloud-native development. If you are passionate about modern data engineering, Databricks, dbt, cloud technologies, and Generative AI, this is the role for you. You will work alongside talented professionals on innovative projects that help organizations accelerate data-driven transformation and unlock new business opportunities through AI. Your Future at Kyndryl As a Senior Data Engineer – Databricks, dbt & GenAI, you will collaborate closely with AI specialists, Data Scientists, Data Architects, Cloud Engineers, and Business Leaders to solve complex data and AI challenges. Whether you aspire to become a Lead Data Engineer, Data Architect, AI Platform Engineer, GenAI Solutions Architect, or Data Engineering Manager, Kyndryl provides the opportunities, mentorship, and resources to accelerate your professional growth and help shape the future of enterprise AI and modern data platforms. Who You Are You're good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally important, you have a growth mindset and are committed to continuous learning and professional development. You are customer-focused, passionate about building modern data platforms, and thrive in collaborative, fast-paced environments. You enjoy solving complex data challenges, enabling AI-driven innovation, and delivering scalable, production-grade solutions that create business value. Required Technical and Professional Expertise 7+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, with a proven track record of designing, developing, deploying, and supporting enterprise-scale data solutions in production environments. Expert-level proficiency in dbt Core , including project structuring, model development, macros, testing, documentation, source management, environment configuration, CI/CD integration, and production troubleshooting. Strong hands-on experience with the Databricks Lakehouse Platform , including Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows, and performance optimization techniques. Advanced proficiency in SQL , including complex transformations, query optimization, dimensional modeling, partitioning strategies, data warehousing concepts, and large-scale analytical workloads. Strong experience designing and implementing dimensional models (SCD Type 1 and Type 2) , enterprise reporting layers, and scalable data products. Proficiency in Python for data engineering, automation, orchestration, and ingestion frameworks. Experience developing and supporting data ingestion pipelines from diverse sources including REST APIs, SFTP, relational databases, cloud storage platforms, and large-scale file-based datasets. Strong understanding of Generative AI concepts , including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic layers, and AI-ready data architectures. Experience preparing, governing, and optimizing enterprise data for AI, machine learning, and GenAI use cases. Hands-on experience implementing and enforcing enterprise data governance, security, lineage, and quality frameworks using Databricks Unity Catalog and dbt testing capabilities. Experience designing and building governed, reusable, and scalable data products that support analytics, AI, and business transformation initiatives.
