jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist
jobs.description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: This job will design and implement advanced data science models to support business needs. You will work with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions. Your role involves driving best practices in data science, ensuring data quality, and mentoring junior scientists. We are looking for a Staff Data Scientist with strong computer science and software engineering fundamentals and deep, hands-on experience taking ML models and AI applications into production. We have a strong preference for candidates who have built AI applications in production and who bring a research background in ML. You will own systems end to end, from modeling and evaluation to deployment, and monitoring, and you will help shape how AI is used to detect and respond to fraud. Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Lead and manage data science projects, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business goals. Develop and maintain data models, algorithms, and reporting systems to support data analysis and decision-making. Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive strategic initiatives. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data needs and provide actionable insights. Ensure data quality and integrity through regular audits and validation processes. Mentor and guide junior data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Minimum Qualifications: 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : What you need to know about the role This role is in the AI/ML team within the PayPal Artificial Intelligence org. This team supports Payment Services and Crypto, one of the 3 Business Units within PayPal. We partner with large, strategic customers to design, build and deploy fraud-detection solutions – machine-learning models, rules and AI-assisted tooling – that stop emerging attacks while keeping the experience smooth for good customers. We are looking for a Staff Data Scientist with strong computer science and software engineering fundamentals and deep, hands-on experience taking ML models and AI applications into production. We have a strong preference for candidates who have built AI applications in production and who bring a research background in ML. You will own systems end to end, from modeling and evaluation to deployment, and monitoring, and you will help shape how AI is used to detect and respond to fraud. Your day to day In your day-to-day role, you will Develop, train, tune and evaluate models for fraud detection and risk assessment. Own feature development, modeling choices, reproducible experiments and error analysis as fraud patterns evolve. Design, implement, and maintain ML and generative AI applications, including multi agent workflows built on payments data in production. Build maintainable Python services, APIs, and SQL data pipelines that connect models with enterprise data, databases, and user applications. Own full-stack delivery of ML applications: Backend API services, data pipelines on BigQuery, containerized deployments, and PR-based review. Work with strategic merchants and cross-functional partners to understand their fraud challenges, design solutions together, and explain results clearly to technical and executive audiences. Identify areas of improvement in internal systems and product, design, and project manage solutions end to end. Independently execute projects end to end, while also mentoring and guiding junior team members, with a strong people-oriented mindset Mentor Data Scientists, and ML Engineers; lead design reviews, set coding and documentation standards, and act as a bar-raiser in hiring. What do you need to bring- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Mining or related field or equivalent practical experience A minimum of 8 years of experience in building and shipping machine-learning systems to production, with demonstrated Staff-level scope, ownership and technical leadership. Hands-on experience with ML models and AI applications in production: training, evaluating, deploying and monitoring models (classical ML, deep learning and/or LLMs) for real users. Strong SQL and practical experience preparing data, building reliable pipelines, and integrating analytical or relational data with model workflows. Experience deploying and operating services on a public cloud (GCP preferred). Excellent communication and influencing skills; able to translate business and customer needs into technical solutions and to mentor others. Strongly preferred End-to-end experience building and launching AI applications in production, with ownership of evaluation, reliability and user outcomes; risk or decision-support applications are especially relevant. Research background in machine learning: PhD or MS with research experience, publications, or research-engineering work that moved from papers to products. Nice to have Experience in fraud, risk, trust & safety, payments or e-commerce, including real-time decisioning or rule engines. Experience with graph, sequence or anomaly-detection methods, or adversarial / drifting data. Experience with multi-agent orchestration, Vertex AI, MCP, vector stores, or LLM cost and latency optimization. Customer-facing consulting experience with enterprise clients; track record of mentoring across teams. Subsidiary: PayPal Travel Percent: 0 PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us. For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. Our Benefits: At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health. Who We Are: Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com. Belonging at PayPal: Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal. Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community. We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us. Job Description This role serves as the Solution Architect and strategic technical owner for the Customer Support technology ecosystem. The architect will partner closely with Customer Support Operations, Customer Experience (CX), Product, Engineering, and IT teams to design scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions across Freshdesk , customer support platforms, and enterprise integrations. The ideal candidate brings deep experience with one or more leading customer support platforms such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM), or similar enterprise service management solutions , along with strong expertise in integrations, automation, AI, and enterprise architecture. As a Manager-equivalent Individual Contributor , this role provides architectural leadership while remaining hands-on in solution design, platform configuration, integrations, automation, and complex technical problem-solving. Key Responsibilities Own the architecture and technical roadmap for Customer Support applications and related integrations. Design scalable solutions across Freshdesk , knowledge management, chat, messaging, telephony, CRM, and enterprise applications. Provide architectural guidance for platform configuration, automation, integrations, and customizations. Design and govern integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, and event-driven architectures. Establish best practices for application architecture, security, data governance, and platform scalability. Lead architecture reviews for major implementations, platform upgrades, migrations, and transformation initiatives. Drive platform standardization while reducing technical debt and improving operational efficiency. Evaluate and implement AI capabilities including ticket summarization, intelligent routing, virtual agents, knowledge recommendations, and agent productivity enhancements. Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for automation and continuous improvement. Mentor administrators, business systems analysts, and engineers on architecture standards and best practices. Key Decisions Responsible For Customer Support application architecture and technology roadmap. Case management and workflow architecture. Omnichannel support design including email, chat, messaging, and voice. Integration architecture and middleware strategy. Automation and AI strategy. Platform governance and security. Build vs. configure vs. integrate decisions. Long-term scalability and platform modernization. Technical Skills Strong experience architecting enterprise Customer Support platforms such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, ServiceNow CSM , or similar solutions. Deep understanding of customer support operations including case management, ticketing, SLAs, routing, queues, knowledge management, and omnichannel support. Experience with REST APIs, middleware platforms, webhooks, and enterprise integrations. Experience implementing workflow automation using platform-native capabilities and low-code/no-code tools. Knowledge of CRM integrations and customer lifecycle processes. Experience with AI-powered customer service capabilities and Generative AI technologies. Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture, security, data modelling, and governance. Ability to troubleshoot complex application and integration issues across multiple platforms. Leadership Skills Ability to influence architecture decisions across business and technology teams. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Proven experience leading enterprise platform implementations and transformation initiatives. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to mentor technical teams and establish architecture standard Qualifications 7 - 12 years of IT experience with 5+ years supporting or architecting enterprise Customer Support platforms . Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise customer support solutions. Hands-on experience with Freshdesk is highly preferred. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Our Company: At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. What You'll Do: Shape the Way the World Understands Data Teradata is building the next generation of AI-native analytics, enabling customers to deploy production-grade Generative AI systems directly where enterprise data lives . We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to play a key role in designing and building Teradata’s vector store and retrieval infrastructure , powering RAG, multimodal AI, agentic workflows, and semantic search at enterprise scale. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of LLMs, information retrieval, and distributed systems , and wants to work on core platform capabilities , not just application demos. You will: Design and implement vector store capabilities integrated with Teradata’s analytics platform, including indexing, storage, retrieval, and query optimization. Build end-to-end RAG pipelines , including: Data ingestion and chunking strategies Embedding generation and lifecycle management Retrieval (dense, sparse, and hybrid search ) Context assembly and prompt orchestration Develop and optimize semantic search algorithms and ranking strategies for enterprise workloads. Enable multimodal RAG (text, structured data, images, etc.) and agent-based workflows. Design agentic AI patterns, including tool calling, planning, memory, and orchestration. Implement guardrails for safety, reliability, and governance (hallucination mitigation, rounding, policy enforcement). Build and maintain RAG evaluation frameworks , including relevance, faithfulness, accuracy, and cost metrics. Collaborate with product, research, and platform teams to translate customer use cases into scalable features. Benchmark Teradata’s vector store and RAG capabilities against industry alternatives (e.g., cloud and open-source solutions). Contribute to technical design reviews, architecture decisions, and long-term AI platform strategy. Who You'll Work With: Join Forces with the Best You’ll collaborate with a world-class team of AI architects, ML engineers, and domain experts at Silicon Valley , working together to build the next generation of enterprise AI systems. You’ll also work cross-functionally with: Product managers and UX designers to craft agentic workflows that are intuitive and impactful. Domain specialists to ensure solutions align with real-world business problems in regulated industries. Infrastructure and platform teams responsible for training, evaluation, and scaling AI workloads. This is a rare opportunity to shape foundational AI capabilities within a global, data-driven company. This is a deeply collaborative environment where technical innovation meets real-world application, where your ideas are not only heard but implemented to shape the next generation of data interaction. Minimum Requirements BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field. 3+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on backend systems. Hands-on experience with vector databases or vector search systems. Practical experience building LLM-powered applications , especially RAG systems Strong understanding of: Embeddings and similarity search Data chunking and context optimization Dense vs sparse vs hybrid retrieval Semantic search and relevance ranking Proficiency in Python (and/or Java); experience with production-grade systems. Experience working with large-scale data and performance-sensitive systems. Preferred Qualifications Experience with multimodal embeddings and retrieval. Familiarity with agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent). Experience implementing AI guardrails and evaluation frameworks. Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Experience with distributed systems or analytics platforms. #LI-PG1 Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance. Design and implement RAG-based workflows to enhance content generation and information retrieval. Work closely with customers to integrate RAG workflows into their applications and systems and stay abreast of the latest developments in language models and generative AI technologies. Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG-based solutions. Collaborating and working with Government, Research and Public sector departments What we need to see: B.Tech ,Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience 10+ years of hands-on experience in a technical role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs). Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments. In-depth understanding of state-of-the-art language models, including but not limited to GPT-3, BERT, or similar architectures. Expertise in training and fine-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers. Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs. Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference. Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization. Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment. Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts. jobs.description: Location: Gurgaon, Haryana Team: Data Science Job Requisition #: R266889 Date posted: Nov. 16, 2026 Job description About this role The Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (AI) team helps transform how technology, data, and AI drive better outcomes for clients and the business. The team partners closely with client-facing teams, product strategists, engineers, and business leaders to develop and scale AI-powered solutions that enhance productivity, improve decision-making, strengthen client engagement, and unlock commercial value. Design, develop, evaluate, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions in partnership with engineering teams. Build intelligent AI-powered assistants, agentic workflows, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications that deliver measurable business value. Establish experimentation, evaluation, monitoring, and performance measurement frameworks to assess business impact and solution effectiveness. Leverage modern cloud, data, and directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing to build scalable AI solutions. Champion responsible AI practices, model governance, security, scalability, and reliability standards. Partner across product, engineering, business, and AI teams to advance enterprise AI capabilities and communicate insights effectively. Your Experience Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or another quantitative discipline; advanced degrees are a plus. Demonstrated ability to build and deploy AI and machine learning solutions in production environments. Strong technical proficiency in Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), data engineering, and analytical platforms. Demonstrated expertise in machine learning, statistics, experimentation, and predictive modeling. Experience developing generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, natural language processing (NLP), and related techniques. Experience in asset management, financial services, fintech, or modern cloud-based AI ecosystems is preferred. Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and responsible AI practices. Our benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. Our hybrid work model BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. About BlackRock At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. Connect agents to enterprise systems and data through REST APIs, SDKs, tool / function calling and MCP servers. Use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar) for development, testing, code reviews and documentation. Package and deploy AI services using Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines on Azure, AWS or GCP. Build user interfaces for human-AI interaction, including human review and approval steps. Set up evaluation and monitoring for accuracy, hallucinations, latency and cost, and act on the results. Ensure solutions meet security, privacy and responsible AI guidelines, including bias mitigation and prompt-injection safeguards. Lead AI projects end to end, ensuring timely delivery and quality. Mentor junior engineers, review code and share best practices with the team. Present AI opportunities and project updates to senior management and stakeholders. Support RFPs, RFIs, solution demos and proofs of concept. Document prompt strategies, agent designs and outcomes for reuse across teams. Must Have Skills Qualifications 7+ years of overall experience in software engineering, data engineering or ML engineering. 3+ years of relevant experience in AI / ML, including hands-on GenAI work. Strong hands-on coding in Python (C# acceptable alongside Python). Hands-on experience building AI agents with at least one framework such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen or Semantic Kernel. Experience with LLMs from OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini), Azure OpenAI or open-source models. Strong prompt engineering skills for real business use cases. Experience with RAG, embeddings and vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, pgvector or Azure AI Search. Experience integrating AI with applications through REST APIs, SDKs and tool / function calling. Daily use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor. Working knowledge of at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP) and its AI services. Experience with Docker, Git and CI/CD pipelines. Good problem-solving, analytical and communication skills. Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments. Front-end skills to build simple agent interfaces (React, Streamlit, Gradio or similar). Experience in client-facing delivery, pre-sales or proofs of concept. Nice to have skills Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or agent-to-agent (A2A) protocols. Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Ragas or DeepEval. Exposure to classic ML using TensorFlow, PyTorch or scikit-learn, and data processing with pandas, NumPy or Spark. Knowledge graphs (Neo4j) or graph-based RAG. Educational Qualification Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science or a related field. Key Competencies Strong ownership and accountability. Ability to work in cross-functional teams. Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders. At the same time you’ll play a key role in refactoring legacy code to enable modern cloud and mobile applications to seamlessly interact with the mainframe’s core data. Debug and Test •Find and fix: Debug, troubleshoot, and analyze complex system interactions to keep mission-critical applications running. Develop for the Future •Bridge the gap: As an instrumental player in modernization, you’ll extract business logic from legacy systems for migration or integration with cloud-based services. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. About Position: We are seeking a skilled GCP Data Engineer with 3 to 5 years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in cloud-native data engineering, ETL/ELT pipeline development, Python programming, and data warehousing technologies. You will play a key role in building reliable and efficient data platforms that support analytics, reporting, and business intelligence initiatives. Working closely with data analysts, data scientists, and cross-functional teams, you will help deliver scalable, high-quality, and secure data solutions. Role: Data Engineer Location: All Persistent Locations Experience: 3 to 5 Years Job Type: Full-Time Employment What You'll Do: Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT data pipelines on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Implement batch and streaming data ingestion frameworks using GCP services such as Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, and Composer. Build, manage, and optimize cloud-based data warehouses and data lakes using BigQuery and Cloud Storage. Develop efficient Python-based data processing, transformation, and automation solutions. Optimize data pipelines for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency. Extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources including APIs, databases, flat files, and streaming platforms. Work with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured datasets to support business requirements. Ensure data quality, integrity, governance, and compliance across all data pipelines and platforms. Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver data-driven solutions. Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline performance issues and production incidents. Document data workflows, schemas, architectures, and processes to ensure maintainability and knowledge sharing. Build interface contracts (message types, service interfaces), implement routing, transformation, enrichment, correlation, and exception handling patterns. Develop and maintain integration artifacts in the repository and configuration layers, ensuring consistency and reusability. 2) Adapter & Connectivity Development Implement integrations using common enterprise adapters (e.g., IDoc, RFC, File/SFTP, HTTP/REST, SOAP, JDBC, JMS, Mail) depending on landscape requirements. Engineer secure connectivity patterns (certificates, credentials, encryption) and define transport-level controls aligned to enterprise policies. 3) Mapping & Transformation Engineering Build message mappings and operation mappings for complex transformation needs, including context-based routing, reusable mapping functions, and XSLT where required. Implement advanced transformation logic using Java mappings or script-based approaches when standard mappings are insufficient. Design canonical payloads to reduce point-to-point complexity and support long-term maintainability. 4) API Development & API-Led Integration Design, build, and expose APIs for integration consumption with a focus on contract-first design, versioning strategy, and backward compatibility. Implement policies for security, throttling, validation, and observability enable consistent API governance across teams. Support API testing and lifecycle automation through robust test harnesses and environment promotion practices. 5) Testing, Debugging & Quality Engineering Create integration test strategies covering contract tests, schema validation, payload regression, replay testing, and negative scenarios. Use API testing tools and structured logs/traces to debug and resolve integration defects across layers (connectivity, mapping, runtime, downstream dependencies). Maintain technical documentation (specs, mappings, test cases, runbooks) as part of delivery and handover. 6) Monitoring, Operations & Reliability Monitor interfaces, queues, and runtime health implement alerting and dashboards aligned to SLAs and operational KPIs. Build failure-mode handling (retries, reprocessing, dead-letter/error queues, idempotency patterns) to reduce incident frequency and mean-time-to-recover. Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventive fixes to improve stability over time. 7) AI Native Integration Intelligence (Agentic Integration Layer) Build integration agents that can: o Draft interface specifications and mapping proposals from requirements and standards. o Generate initial mapping logic and routing templates, then validate against enterprise patterns. o Recommend remediation steps grounded in runbooks, prior incidents, and observed runtime signals. Implement retrieval-grounded assistance for integration engineering (interface catalogs, mapping rules, known errors, operational runbooks) so outputs stay verifiable and consistent. Establish evaluation loops (offline golden tests + online monitoring) to measure accuracy of AI-generated mappings, recommendations, and troubleshooting outputs. Enforce guardrails: tool permissions, human-in-the-loop approvals for high-impact changes, and strict handling of sensitive data. 8) Modernization & Transition Enablement Support modernization from legacy or tightly-coupled integrations toward API-led and cloud-ready patterns while keeping business continuity. Refactor legacy mappings (e.g., complex Java mappings) into maintainable equivalents where required, improving performance and operability. jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: About the Team The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform. You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how." Role Description As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption. You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production. This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset. The impact you will have C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline. End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against. Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early. Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution. Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering. What we look for Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions. Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome. Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions. Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting. Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram. Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Company Profile: Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com. Job Title: Senior Applied AI Engineer Experience: 6-12 yrs Category: IT Main location: Hyderabad Position ID: J1126-0807 Employment Type: Full Time Job Description Summary You will design, build and operate production grade AI agents that talk to real customers. Working on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore Runtime, you will own the reasoning, retrieval, tooling and guardrails behind services handling millions of conversations. This is applied AI engineering, taking systems from prototype to reliable, evaluated, governed production, not research. Client , Technology is a core driver of how we deliver our strategy. You'll join a team modernising our platforms, strengthening cyber and operational resilience, and advancing a product led way of working that brings engineers, data specialists and business experts together to deliver meaningful outcomes at pace. We're scaling automation and AI from proof of concept into real, end to end change, improving customer journeys, reducing cost to serve, accelerating delivery, and building the digital foundations that underpin everything from energy trading and risk to field operations and critical infrastructure. If you want to work on complex, high impact problems using modern engineering practices, and help build reusable platforms that will shape how Client operates over the next decade, this is the place to do it. An opportunity to play your part. You will join the Channel Platforms team, which owns Client 's customer conversation estate across voice, chat and email. Our agents are already live: a pay as you go voice assistant built on a real time speech to speech model, a multi channel customer facing agent spanning voice, chat and WhatsApp, and a standalone agentic webchat service running on AgentCore Runtime. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer you will own the intelligence layer of these products. That means the agent's reasoning and orchestration, the tools it can call, the knowledge it retrieves, the guardrails that constrain it, and the evaluation that proves it works. You will decide what good looks like and then build the measurement to show whether we are hitting it. This is a role for someone who has taken generative AI past the demo stage. Our problems are the hard ones that show up after launch: grounding answers in the right source, keeping voice latency low enough to feel natural, handing off to a human at the right moment, and proving to a governance board that the system behaves safely at scale. You do not need a contact centre background. If you are a strong engineer who has built real agentic systems on Bedrock or a comparable platform, we will teach you the domain. Location: UK based hybrid role, occasional travel to site. Day to day . Design and build agentic services on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore Runtime, including multi step orchestration, state and memory management, and graceful handling of failure and ambiguity. . Build and own the tool layer that agents act through, exposing business capability such as account lookup, billing and identity as reliable, well described actions with sensible error semantics. . Build retrieval augmented generation over Bedrock Knowledge Bases, taking ownership of content preparation, chunking, embedding strategy, retrieval quality and answer grounding. . Treat prompts as engineering artefacts. Version them, test them, and understand precisely what changed when behaviour shifts. . Build the evaluation harness. Define what accuracy, containment and safe behaviour mean for each product, assemble regression sets, and make it possible to ship a prompt or model change with evidence rather than optimism. . Implement guardrails and safety controls, including PII handling, out of scope refusal, jailbreak resistance and clean escalation to a human advisor. . Engineer for latency and cost. Streaming, model selection and routing, caching and token budgets all matter, and in voice they matter in real time where a pause of a few hundred milliseconds is felt by the customer. . Instrument agent behaviour end to end so that tool failures, retrieval misses and abandoned conversations are visible in Datadog and QuickSight, not discovered through complaints. . Support live AI services in production, investigating incidents and diagnosing non deterministic behaviour, then closing the loop with permanent fixes. . Make and document build versus buy calls, writing Architecture Decision Records and taking designs through our AI governance board and change control process. . Track how the generative AI landscape is moving and bring the parts that deliver clear benefit into the roadmap, with an honest read on the risk as well as the upside. What we need from you Essential: . Substantial software engineering experience, with strong Python. You write production code, not just notebooks. . Demonstrable delivery of LLM or agentic systems into production for real users, and the scar tissue that comes with it. We will ask what broke and what you changed. . Hands on experience with tool and function calling, multi step agent orchestration, and managing conversational state across turns. . Production experience with retrieval augmented generation, including retrieval quality evaluation and answer grounding, not just wiring up a vector store. . A rigorous approach to evaluation. You have built or owned an eval harness, defined the metrics that mattered, and used them to make release decisions. . Experience deploying and operating AI services in the cloud using serverless or container based architectures, infrastructure as code such as Terraform, and CI/CD. . Practical application of responsible AI, covering data privacy, guardrails, bias, explainability and human in the loop design, in an environment with real compliance obligations. . Ability to debug systems that are non deterministic by nature, and the patience to reason about behaviour statistically rather than case by case. . Strong collaboration and communication skills. You can explain to a product owner why the agent got something wrong, and to a governance board why the controls are sufficient. . Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Desirable: . Amazon Bedrock specifically, including AgentCore Runtime, Bedrock Knowledge Bases and Bedrock Guardrails. If your experience is on another foundation model platform, that transfers. . Voice AI experience, including speech to speech models, real time streaming, barge in and turn taking, or ASR and TTS pipelines. . Any contact centre exposure, including Amazon Connect. A bonus rather than an expectation. . Familiarity with agent interoperability standards such as the Model Context Protocol. . Experience with fine tuning, distillation or model routing where it materially improved cost or latency. . Delivery in a regulated industry, including working with vulnerable customer requirements or comparable obligations. . AWS certification at Associate level or above. Your future duties and responsibilities Core Competencies & Technical Skills (AI and emerging technology) . Designs, integrates and operates AI enabled solutions within enterprise environments, including prompt driven workflows, retrieval augmented systems and AI agents. . Applies structured evaluation, testing and monitoring practices to ensure AI outputs are reliable, secure and compliant with organisational guardrails. . Prepares and manages data used in AI workflows and takes responsibility for the responsible lifecycle of AI features from experimentation through deployment and continuous improvement. . Demonstrates the safe and responsible use of AI tools, with clear knowledge of when AI use is appropriate and strong awareness of accuracy, bias and compliance. Bringing the ability to design and reuse prompt templates to support consistent, high quality workflow outputs, and skilled in using AI to triage, classify and analyse information within Client policy guardrails. . Strong ability to recognise higher risk scenarios and escalate to governance or security as needed. Alongside this, showing proficiency in enterprise AI copilots, knowledge assistants and AI enhanced productivity tools. Required qualifications to be successful in this role Core Behaviours . Take Ownership . Work as One Team . Develop a Growth Mindset . Strive to Innovate . Champion Customers Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Amazon Customer Service supports customers around the world through one of the world’s largest and most diverse customer service workforces. As AI fundamentally changes how customer service work is performed, it also creates an opportunity to reinvent how associates learn, develop their capabilities, receive coaching, and continuously improve. The Associate Development team is building the next generation of learning, coaching and performance experiences for Amazon Customer Service Associates. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build these systems from the ground up. This is a highly greenfield opportunity. Rather than digitizing traditional training and coaching processes, we are rethinking how associate development should work in an AI-native world. What does an associate need to learn before doing a job? What can they learn through experience? What should AI provide in the flow of work? How can we understand an associate’s evolving capabilities and use that understanding to personalize development? How can generative AI help provide timely, relevant and effective coaching at the scale of a global workforce? Imagine systems that continuously learn from an associate’s experience and outcomes, identify where they would benefit from development, and deliver personalized learning or AI-powered coaching. The outcomes of those interventions can then become new evidence about the associate, creating a closed loop that gets smarter over time. As an SDE on this team, you will help define and build the technical foundations that make this possible. You will work on problems spanning generative AI, personalization, intelligent recommendations, learning and coaching systems, experimentation, data and distributed systems. You will have the opportunity to influence architecture at an early stage rather than inherit a predetermined technical solution. You will partner closely with Product, Science, UX and engineering teams across Amazon to turn ambiguous customer problems into scalable technical solutions. The systems you build have the potential to shape how Customer Service Associates around the world develop and succeed at work. This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys zero-to-one problems, emerging AI technologies, large-scale systems and building products with direct human impact. Key job responsibilities Design and build scalable services and experiences that power personalized learning, coaching and associate development across Amazon Customer Service. Build AI-powered coaching capabilities, including applications of generative AI that can understand context, generate relevant guidance and adapt experiences to individual associate needs. Develop systems that connect signals about associate capability and performance with the right development intervention at the right time. Help create closed-loop systems that measure the outcomes of learning and coaching interventions and use that evidence to continuously improve future recommendations. Work with Product and Science partners to translate emerging models and experimentation into reliable production systems. Make foundational architectural decisions for a greenfield product space while determining where existing Amazon capabilities can be reused or evolved. Design APIs, data models and integration patterns that allow Associate Development capabilities to interact with associate context, workflow and other Customer Service systems. Build mechanisms for experimentation, measurement and observability so we can understand whether the experiences we create actually improve associate and customer outcomes. Deliver secure, reliable and globally scalable systems while maintaining a high bar for operational excellence. A day in the life You might start the day working with a scientist on how an AI coaching experience can use an associate’s recent performance context to generate more useful coaching. Later, you could whiteboard an architecture for measuring whether that coaching actually changed future performance, review an API contract with another CS platform team, and prototype a new generative-AI capability. Because the space is early, you won’t simply be executing against a fully specified roadmap. You will help answer fundamental technical questions, prototype alternatives, make architecture decisions, and turn successful experiments into production systems capable of serving associates globally. About the team The Associate Experience (AE) team is building the future of work for Amazon Customer Service Associates. Our vision is to create a trusted Customer Service experience by enabling associates to succeed as the role evolves toward complex and non-deterministic problem solving. Within AE, the Associate Development team is reinventing how associates learn, develop and improve, moving beyond one-size-fits-all training and coaching towards, personalized development powered by AI. Engineers joining the team will shape foundational architecture, drive technology choices, and build AI-powered products from the ground up for one of the world's largest customer service workforces. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: AI Solution Architect I
jobs.description: Job Summary AI Engineer for Bias Assessments The AI Engineer for Bias Assessments serves as HCLTech’s central technical specialist for conducting bias and fairness assessments, investigating potential root causes, and recommending and validating mitigation measures. The role combines hands-on statistical analysis and AI engineering with practical knowledge of responsible AI, algorithmic auditing, explainability, and data governance. The engineer assesses HCLTech-developed and third-party AI systems used in HCLTech’s internal operations, including models, AI agents, decision-support tools, and AI-enabled workflows. The role identifies potential unfair impacts and disparate performance across relevant population groups and produces documented, reproducible evidence to support governance decisions. The engineer works alongside LoB testers, engineering teams, and data scientists, providing specialist methods, tools, training, and technical review. LoB teams retain responsibility for their assigned testing and implementation activities. Key Responsibilities Bias and Fairness Assessments Plan and conduct assessments across the AI lifecycle, including before deployment, after material changes, periodically during operation, and following relevant incidents. Define assessment scope, intended use, affected populations, potential harms, data requirements, metrics, and acceptance criteria with system owners and relevant stakeholders. Assess classification, regression, ranking, recommendation, and decision-support systems; adapt evaluation methods for generative AI and agentic workflows. Select, calculate, validate, and interpret appropriate measures, including selection and scoring rates, impact ratios, demographic parity, equal opportunity, equalized odds, error-rate disparities, calibration, and intersectional performance. Evaluate statistical uncertainty, confidence intervals, effect sizes, sample sufficiency, and practical significance. Identify when available evidence is insufficient to support a conclusion. Develop reusable assessment scripts, notebooks, test suites, and reporting templates using Python and appropriate fairness and statistical tools. Data Evaluation and Root-Cause Investigation Determine whether training, validation, test, benchmark, production, and reference datasets are suitable for each assessment. Evaluate data provenance, lineage, representativeness, missingness, imbalance, labeling quality, measurement error, data leakage, and potential proxy variables. Identify relevant protected characteristics and intersectional groups, working with Legal and Privacy to confirm appropriate collection, access, use, and handling of sensitive data. Investigate potential sources of disparities across data collection, labeling, feature transformations, model objectives, thresholds, prompts, retrieval sources, agent interactions, and human decision processes. Use subgroup analysis, error analysis, controlled comparisons, sensitivity analysis, and explainability techniques such as SHAP or LIME to investigate potential causes. Recognize that feature attribution alone does not establish causation or demonstrate fairness. Generate or evaluate synthetic data where appropriate for scenario testing or underrepresented cases, documenting its assumptions, limitations, and suitability. Mitigation and Validation Recommend practical mitigation options, including data remediation, feature or model changes, fairness constraints, threshold adjustments, prompt or retrieval improvements, human review, workflow controls, monitoring, and use restrictions. Explain trade-offs involving fairness, accuracy, privacy, reliability, and operational performance. Work with accountable technical and business teams to establish remediation plans with owners, actions, milestones, target dates, acceptance criteria, and validation methods. Reassess systems after remediation to determine whether disparities have improved and identify residual risks or unintended effects. Recommend ongoing monitoring for changes in data, system behavior, users, and affected populations. Escalate material, unexplained, or recurring disparities and overdue corrective actions through HCLTech’s AI governance process. LoB Enablement and Audit Support Serve as the central technical expert supporting LoB testers through assessment planning, troubleshooting, peer review, and interpretation of findings. Develop practical guidance and train internal teams to conduct consistent, reproducible assessments. Prepare assessment reports, stakeholder summaries, and audit evidence covering scope, datasets, methodology, results, limitations, root-cause findings, remediation, and residual risks. Explain findings clearly to Engineering, Data Science, business owners, governance, Legal, Privacy, Risk & Compliance, and leadership. Skill Requirements Demonstrated hands-on experience independently conducting bias and fairness assessments, with the ability to explain dataset selection, metric rationale, statistical limitations, root-cause investigation, mitigation options, and validation results. Strong Python and SQL proficiency, including practical experience with pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statistical libraries, and reproducible analytical workflows. Hands-on experience with AI Fairness 360, Fairlearn, or equivalent tools, with the ability to explain and validate the underlying calculations. Strong understanding of fairness metric families, their assumptions and limitations, and trade-offs between different fairness objectives. Strong statistical skills, including sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, effect sizes, small-sample limitations, and intersectional analysis. Experience selecting appropriate datasets, identifying data-quality problems and proxy variables, and investigating potential sources of bias. Production AI Engineering : Good knowledge of RAG Architecture, Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI Observability/Tracing, and scaling production-grade agentic solutions. jobs.description: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Join Thermo Fisher Scientific, the world leader in serving science, as a Staff Engineer, Software to make a meaningful impact. The role combines platform engineering, data engineering, AI/ML enablement, business intelligence, and operational support, working closely with engineering, data science, analytics, security, DevOps, architecture, and business stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Outcome 1: Secure, scalable, and governed Databricks platform Configure and manage Databricks workspaces, clusters, policies, runtimes, and separate Development, QA/UAT, and Production environments. Implement platform security and governance using Unity Catalog, IAM/RBAC, service principals, secrets, private connectivity, and enterprise access controls. Automate Databricks infrastructure and deployments using Terraform, source control, and CI/CD practices. Outcome 2: Reliable and high-performing data products Build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and Lakehouse solutions using Apache Spark, PySpark, Databricks workflows/jobs, and Delta Lake. Integrate Databricks with enterprise data sources, cloud storage, databases, APIs, and downstream applications. Optimize Spark workloads, queries, clusters, and resource usage for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost. Outcome 3: Production-ready AI, machine learning, and generative AI solutions Prepare data and build ML workflows covering feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and lifecycle management using Databricks and MLflow. Develop generative AI solutions using LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation, and model serving. Evaluate and monitor AI solutions for accuracy, relevance, safety, bias, latency, cost, privacy, and governance. Outcome 4: Trusted analytics and decision support Create analytical datasets, semantic models, KPIs, dashboards, and reporting layers using Databricks SQL and tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker. Translate business requirements into accurate, performant, user-friendly dashboards and self-service analytics solutions. Ensure analytics solutions follow applicable data governance, security, quality, and accessibility standards. Collaborate across architecture, security, infrastructure, engineering, data science, analytics, and business teams to define practical Databricks standards and best practices. Maintain concise technical documentation for platform configuration, deployment, data pipelines, AI workflows, dashboards, and operational procedures. Experience with streaming technologies such as Spark Structured Streaming, Kafka, or Event Hubs. jobs.title: Lead Data & AI Engineer - Semantic Intelligence
jobs.description: Job Description: We are looking for a Lead Data & AI Engineer - Semantic Intelligence to build trusted data and semantic foundations that turn enterprise AI into scalable business capability. You will combine data engineering, data-product thinking, dimensional and semantic modelling, application development, AI engineering, and practical data science. You will own delivery from raw data to AI-enabled decisions. This covers medallion architecture, reusable data products, semantic models, agents, and applications. You will partner early with business, product, Data & Analytics, and technology stakeholders to define outcomes, success measures, and data needs. You will turn ambiguous challenges into technical designs, prototypes, and production solutions, and you will stay involved through adoption and improvement. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with mentoring responsibilities. It has no direct people management. Key Responsibilities: Deliver production-ready Data & AI solutions, staying hands-on in investigation, architecture, coding, modelling, testing, and implementation. Build AI-ready data foundations and agentic solutions grounded in structured data, governed measures, semantic metadata, and enterprise knowledge. Build production-ready Agentic AI, LLM, RAG, and tool/API orchestration patterns using enterprise engineering standards. Build analytical and AI-enabled applications using Fabric application capabilities, Rayfin, or comparable frameworks, integrated with semantic models, APIs, agents, and enterprise security. Build robust ELT/ETL pipelines using Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Python, dbt, Apache Airflow, or comparable technologies. Implement bronze, silver, and gold medallion layers with lineage and auditability. Integrate lakehouse, warehouse, and semantic assets using batch, streaming, Direct Lake, or API patterns. Deliver reusable, domain-aligned data products with clear ownership, data contracts, quality controls, documentation, and consumption interfaces. Design dimensional models with explicit grain, conformed dimensions, facts, hierarchies, slowly changing dimensions, and bridge and relationship patterns. Build and optimize Fabric and Power BI semantic models with governed measures, DAX, relationships, and metadata, so analytics, applications, and AI share consistent business context. Explore data, frame hypotheses, engineer features, and apply segmentation, forecasting, classification, or anomaly detection where they support a business decision. Evaluate analytical and machine-learning approaches against suitable baselines using statistical reasoning, validation, and business-relevant measures. Explain limitations and integrate useful results into data products or applications. Lead end-to-end technical delivery: define scope, estimate and plan work, manage dependencies and risks, coordinate stakeholders, and own release readiness, adoption, and operational handover. Mentor engineers through architecture, design, and code reviews, debugging, testing, and production-readiness practices. Build data quality, observability, automated testing, lineage, security, privacy, responsible AI, version control, and CI/CD into every stage of delivery. Turn successful solutions into reusable data products, semantic assets, agent capabilities, and engineering accelerators. Start with the business decision or workflow, and co-shape outcomes, success measures, data needs, and adoption with stakeholders. Move from discovery to prototype to production, validating assumptions with real enterprise data and early feedback. Measure success by business value, trusted metrics, adoption, engineering quality, and reuse. Solve immediate needs while strengthening reusable enterprise foundations. Experience delivering data products through bronze, silver, and gold layers, with quality controls, lineage, and clear consumption interfaces. Strong dimensional modelling skills, including grain, facts, dimensions, star and snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and many-to-many patterns. Working knowledge of exploratory analysis, statistical reasoning, feature engineering, and practical predictive methods such as forecasting, classification, or anomaly detection. Experience with orchestration, automated testing, version control, CI/CD, data quality, and operational support. Ability to lead technical workstreams as a hands-on senior individual contributor and mentor engineers through design and code reviews. Experience managing scope, estimates, dependencies, risks, releases, and operational handover, taking solutions from concept through adoption. Clear communication with technical, business, and senior stakeholder audiences. Preferred Qualifications Experience with dbt, Apache Airflow, Git/GitHub, and automated deployment frameworks. Broader Power BI and Fabric experience across OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Notebooks, Direct Lake, and application capabilities. jobs.description: Job Description: As a Security Associate Architect, you will join Thomson Reuters' Security Architecture team to embed security across our products, platforms, and enterprise systems. You will work with business and technical teams to make secure-by-design architectures and secure-by-default configurations practical, consistent, and scalable. Key Responsibilities: In this role, you will provide technical leadership across the organization or within a business unit, partnering with information security and risk management, platform engineering, service management, commercial engineering and product engineering teams. This can happen through various activities; to start and establish a strong foundation you will clarify technology risks by assessing evolving threats and technologies, and translate industry best practices, security frameworks, and applicable regulatory requirements into actionable guidance. This work will in turn help you establish repeatable assessment frameworks and security requirements that help teams identify risks, select controls, and demonstrate measurable outcomes through consistent governance. Working with domain architects and engineering teams, you will define reference architectures and secure design patterns, guide reference implementations, and support adoption across shared services and cloud landing zones to drive standardization and organizational alignment. When teams need to deviate from a standard, you will assess risks, recommend controls, and document architectural decisions and trade-offs. You will lead architecture reviews and threat modeling for new systems, integrations, migrations, and emerging technologies. This includes multi-cloud platforms, modern application stacks, and AI and agentic systems. From these reviews, you track findings and help translate them into practical recommendations, align stakeholders on security trade-offs, and support through implementation. As new valid use cases are identified and reviewed, you will make sure reference architectures, implementations and guardrails are continuously updated. Through these activities, you will become a trusted technical advisor, build relationships across teams, mentor engineers, and improve our architecture review methods and knowledge base. You will expand your expertise across our diverse technology landscape while helping teams adopt secure solutions that protect our customers. Required Qualifications: Strong understanding of cryptography concepts and key management, authentication and authorization, identity federation, network and operating system security, data protection, and detection and response both at system level, network layer or application layer. Hands-on experience and deep understanding of at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) including identity and access management, networking, and shared platform services. Experience leading security architecture reviews, threat modeling, and risk assessments across multiple products or platforms, and translating findings into prioritized engineering actions. Ability to develop security requirements, reusable design patterns, and reference architectures, and guide their adoption. Experience translating security frameworks, standards, and applicable regulatory requirements into controls, assessment methods, and practical engineering guidance. Experience designing and implementing secure applications, APIs, and container platforms, with knowledge of Kubernetes and secure CI/CD practices. Ability to read and discuss infrastructure configurations, validate design assumptions, and guide secure implementation. Working knowledge of AI and agentic system security, including prompt injection, model and data integrity, and controls for agent and tool use. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer science, or equivalent practical experience. 10+ years of hands-on experience in security architecture, software engineering, application security, or cloud security. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex security concepts and build alignment across technical and business stakeholders. Passionate about security, with the curiosity to explore unfamiliar technologies and translate ideas into practical solutions. Strong analytical skills and sound judgment when balancing security risks, engineering constraints, and business needs. Passionate about sharing knowledge across teams, the broader security community and to mentoring others. #LI-VGA1 What’s in it For You?
