jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer {DNS Infoblox}
jobs.description: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 10 About the Role: Senior Network Engineer The Team: Global Network Services is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to join our dynamic, multi-disciplinary team. You will design, automate, and operate the DNS, edge delivery, and application delivery services that keep S&P Global’s platforms fast, secure, and available. We value continuous learning, excellence, and a proactive mindset. Responsibilities and Impact DDI, Edge Security, and Application Delivery Own the architecture and operation of enterprise DDI services, including Infoblox (DNS, DHCP, IPAM) and cloud DNS (AWS Route 53, Azure DNS/Private DNS, Google Cloud DNS), with hybrid DNS resolution across on-premises and multi-cloud environments. Integrate IPAM/DDI with the CMDB to keep IP, host, and network records accurate and in sync, using discovery data and API-driven reconciliation to detect and correct drift. Design and operate DNS security controls, including DNSSEC, DNS firewall (e.g., Infoblox BloxOne Threat Defense), protection against DNS attacks Design and manage CDN, WAF, bot management, and DDoS protection using Akamai and Cloudflare, including rule tuning, policy management, and traffic analysis. Design and operate load balancing and traffic management, including F5, cloud-native load balancers (AWS ELB/ALB, Azure Application Gateway, GCP Load Balancing), and global server load balancing. Automation and Infrastructure as Code Write, test, and maintain Terraform modules to provision DNS, edge, and load balancing services across AWS, Azure, and GCP, setting shared-module patterns. Build Python tooling and API integrations (e.g., Infoblox WAPI, Akamai ,Cloudflare APIs) to remove repetitive manual tasks and improve consistency. Build and improve CI/CD pipelines for changes, including automated validation, pre-deployment testing, and policy checks. Develop automated configuration and compliance checks to catch deviations from approved standards (e.g., DNS records, WAF policies, IPAM allocations) early. Follow good engineering practice in shared repositories: version control, peer review, modular code, and clear documentation. Collaboration and Continuous Improvement Serve as subject matter expert and third-line escalation point for complex incidents, leading root cause analysis. Collaborate with application, product, engineering, and security teams to deliver changes meeting enterprise standards and compliance requirements. Plan and execute approved changes within agreed maintenance windows, with documented back-out steps, and join out-of-hours change windows as required. Produce and maintain architecture documentation, automation runbooks, and standard operating procedures. Mentor engineers, share knowledge, and identify ways to reduce risk, improve efficiency, and raise standards. What We’re Looking For Basic Required Qualifications 5+ years’ experience in network or infrastructure engineering supporting hybrid, multi-cloud environments. Extensive hands-on experience with Infoblox DDI, including DNS architecture, DHCP, and IPAM design and operations. Hands-on experience with DNS in Infoblox and at least two cloud DNS providers: AWS Route 53, Azure DNS, Google Cloud DNS. Strong experience with Akamai and/or Cloudflare, including CDN, WAF, bot mitigation, and DDoS protection. Hands-on experience with load balancers (e.g., F5, NGINX, AWS ELB/ALB, Akamai GTM). Strong experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, including module design and Git-based version control. Proficiency in Python for automation and API integration, following software development best practices (testing, code review). Solid understanding of core networking, DNS, and HTTP protocols, able to read configuration as code and assess a change’s impact before deploying it. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team. Additional Preferred Qualifications Experience querying observability and logging platforms (e.g., Splunk, Grafana , Google Secops etc) to analyze DNS, CDN/WAF, and load balancer telemetry, build dashboards and alerts, and troubleshoot incidents. Experience building AI-assisted automation, such as agents that call Infoblox, Akamai, Cloudflare, or cloud APIs (e.g., via MCP servers). Experience integrating IPAM/DDI with a CMDB or ITSM platform including discovery-based synchronization and automated request workflows. Experience with low-code automation platforms. Active Directory infrastructure knowledge. Experience in a regulated environment with formal change and audit requirements. AI fundamentals. Relevant certifications, such as Infoblox DDI Professional, Terraform Associate, Akamai or Cloudflare certifications, or AWS, Azure, or GCP networking certifications. jobs.title: Sr DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 10 Role: Senior DevSecOps Engineer – Enterprise Developer Platform and Toolchain The Team The Enterprise Developer Platform & Toolchain team owns the platforms, tools and capabilities that support software engineers across S&P Global. Our core functions span DevOps, DevSecOps, FinOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Developer Experience (DevEx). We partner with divisional DevOps/TechOps teams and Information Security (InfoSec) to establish consistent controls and governance across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). As a globally distributed team, we build services, policies and automated controls that secure the developer toolchain while keeping platforms simple, consistent and engineer friendly. The Impact You will embed security governance into the software delivery lifecycle by translating requirements into clear policies and automated controls. Your work will protect source control, CI/CD pipelines, build infrastructure and the software supply chain without creating unnecessary friction for engineers. You will strengthen credentials, secrets and non-human identity governance; drive security findings through to remediation; and contribute to AI-assisted development governance and developer endpoint security. Working with platform teams, divisional DevOps/TechOps teams and Business Information Security Officers (BISOs), you will support audit and compliance and make secure practices the default across S&P Global. What’s in It for You Help shape how thousands of engineers build and ship software securely. You will work hands-on with enterprise security tooling and emerging areas such as AI tool governance and policy as code. You will own controls end to end, from policy design to automated enforcement, and collaborate with InfoSec, audit and engineering leaders. We support your growth through innovation projects, training, certification support and knowledge sharing. Responsibilities Define and implement baseline security policies and automated guardrails across source control and CI/CD environments. Integrate, manage and tune code quality and application security tools, including SonarQube, GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS), Checkmarx and Wiz, within developer workflows. Triage security findings, prioritise vulnerabilities by risk and track remediation against service-level agreements (SLAs). Establish governance for credentials, secrets and non-human identities across the developer toolchain. Harden build infrastructure and software supply chain controls, including artifact management with JFrog Artifactory/Xray. Provision, secure and optimise AWS services supporting the developer platform, including EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, IAM and CloudFormation/CDK. Contribute to governance for AI-assisted development tools and developer endpoint security. Monitor sensitive configuration changes, implement alerting and support audit and compliance activities. Partner with platform and engineering teams to automate security controls and drive adoption. What We’re Looking For 5–8 years of experience in DevSecOps, application security or security governance. Strong experience designing and automating enterprise-scale CI/CD pipelines, with an understanding of source control security and common pipeline threats. jobs.description: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 11 Role Summary The Application & Cloud Security Lead will serve as a key security leader within the S&P Global Energy Division BISO team, responsible for coordinating security initiatives across application, cloud, and AI-enabled environments. jobs.description: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 03 Who We Are Kensho is S&P Global’s hub for AI innovation and transformation . Our solutions help businesses harness the power of data and Artificial Intelligence to innovate and drive progress. We collaborate using our teammates' diverse perspectives to solve hard problems. Our communication with one another is open, honest, and efficient. Our teams are small, product-focused, and committed to shipping reliable, well-architected systems that scale. We work closely with Machine Learning, Product, and Infrastructure teams to turn advanced AI technology into high-quality, production-ready software. jobs.description: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 10 S&P Global Corporate The Role: Cyber Security Risk Engineer Grade: 9 The Location: Hyderabad The Team: Part of the Global Security Architecture team that is responsible for Security Consulting, Security Assessments and Measurement, Security Exceptions Management, New Security Technology Evaluation and Acquisitions and Divestitures. The Team is based in New York, Princeton, London, Hyderabad, Beijing and Shanghai. The Impact: The Security Risk Measurement analyst will interact extensively with internal technology and business clients in order to review, assess and report on the maturity of the security controls of current and proposed solutions within S&P Global. The position is critical as the business is very dynamic and constantly evolving to Power the Markets of the Future. What’s in it for you: S&P Global is on a journey to enhance its existing security controls and processes. This role will allow you to be present at the start of the firms journey towards a mature security assessment and measurement model. The role involves engaging with a broad range of technologists and business professionals allowing you to develop a broad understand of the technology and business flows. As your experience of the technology and the firm grows there is an opportunity to grow your role to work with the technologists and business professionals directly to partner on developing and assessing the firm’s security architecture. Responsibilities: Part of a team that enforces corporate, regulatory and risk management policy configurations. The position also assists in developing, implementing and maintaining corporate information security standards, technologies, processes and procedures. Reviews and provides guidance on the controls relating to all S&P Global current and future solutions. The role holder will look to ensure that the business adheres with expected minimum requirements and operates within agreed risk appetites for information, data and cyber security and ongoing assurance. The role holder will be expected to understand areas of concern and in conjunction with stakeholders provide advice and guidance, recommendations and mitigations where required. Serves as a subject matter expert for colleagues and line-of-business managers, and experience with multiple technologies, compliance requirements and risk analysis methodologies is crucial. Improve efficiencies using automation and orchestration solutions to reduce manual work that can be done programmatically. Influence tactical and strategic decisions. Identify process efficiencies through analysis and metrics driven decision making Responsible for the creation of guidance, security documentation and configuration practices. Ensure systems are protected against threats through the deployment of Security controls. Ensure guidance and assessment provides is aligned to regulatory and compliance requirement and local laws. Administer best practices and required configuration standards for compliance and privacy law obligations. Remain current with new security threats and assessing systems to ensure they can defend the business. Provide metrics and other management information to leadership to ensure decision making is sound. Perform other duties as assigned. What We’re Looking For: Basic Qualifications At least 5-7+ years’ experience in cybersecurity, including compliance and risk management with a system and network security engineering background. Highly technical and analytical expertise, with a proven deep background in technology design, implementation and delivery. Experience of aligning to a NIST controls framework. Familiarity with the concepts of Security Control Frameworks Experience in cloud computing technologies, including software-, infrastructure- and platform-as-a-service, as well as public, private and hybrid environments. Extensive knowledge of traditional security controls and technologies, such as SIEM systems, IDS/IPS, public key infrastructure (PKI), IDAM systems, antivirus and firewalls, in addition to newer offerings such as endpoint detection and response (EDR), threat intelligence platforms, security automation and orchestration, deception technologies and application controls. Experience driving measurable improvement in monitoring and response capabilities at scale. Track record of acting with integrity, taking pride in work, seeking to excel, being curious and adaptable, and communicating effectively. Experience of information security and Data protection practices in financial services. Experience of working within cyber security and information security teams within an international business of scale and complexity Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information assurance, MIS or related field, or equivalent. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure. Experience with one or more of the following: ISO 27001, NIST, Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), Health Information Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), Health Information Technology for Economic and Clinical Health (HITECH) Act, Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Center for Internet Security (CIS) standards or Service Organization Controls (SOC) 2. Working knowledge of Windows, Linux and Unix. Highly trustworthy; leads by example. About S&P Global Corporate: At S&P Global, we don’t give you intelligence—we give you essential intelligence. Build digital learning features such as remote labs, simulations and AR/MR content. jobs.title: Principal, Product Architect - Smart Energy
jobs.description: Job Description: JOB DESCRIPTION Principal, Product Architect – Smart Energy Engineering CoE · Smart Energy offer · India Reports to Head of Engineering - Education Segment Business Schneider Electric · Education Equipment and Services Location Bangalore, India, with travel across India and the segment's markets Scope Global: technical ownership of the Smart Energy offer’s – Solar Energy Solutions, Smart Power Distribution, and LV and MV Smart Panels, Microgrid About the Education Segment Schneider Electric's Education Segment provides technical training solutions that close the skills gap in energy, automation and digital technologies. We equip technical and vocational institutes, universities, government skilling programmes and industry academies with hands-on training labs, curricula, digital learning, train-the-trainer programmes and certification. Demand is rising fast. Governments are investing heavily in workforce skilling, industry faces acute technician shortages, and the energy transition and smart manufacturing need new skills at scale. The segment has already helped more than 200,000 young people gain job-ready skills. We are now building a dedicated, multi-country organisation to grow the business across six markets, with its own business development, engineering and delivery teams. Engineering is at the heart of what we offer: training solutions built on real industrial technology. Purpose of the role Lead, maintain and grow the Education Segment's Smart Energy offer: the hands-on lab equipment, software and learning content that teach the skills needed for solar energy, smart power distribution and LV/MV electrical networks. As the technical owner of the offer, you will keep today's modules safe, compliant, available and relevant in every target market, and build the next generation of Smart Energy solutions with Schneider Electric's energy businesses. You will lead the Smart Energy product architecture team in the India Engineering CoE and work closely with industrialisation, supply chain, delivery and commercial teams. Market overview The energy transition is creating strong demand for technicians and engineers who can design, install, operate and maintain solar, storage and smart electrical systems. Distributed solar, micro-grids, digital power distribution and critical power are spreading faster than training systems can keep up. Institutions want Smart Energy labs that use real industrial equipment, connect hardware with energy-management software, and support national qualifications and electrical accreditation. Schneider Electric's energy portfolio puts the segment in a strong position to meet that need. Key responsibilities Smart Energy offer leadership and roadmap Own the 2026–2030 Smart Energy technical and offer roadmap, aligned to market needs and Schneider Electric business roadmaps in power systems, secure power, digital energy and home and distribution. Act as the principal technical authority for Smart Energy architectures, design rules, bills of material, specifications and interfaces. Prioritise roadmap investment with regional business leaders by institution, employer and market needs. Maintain the current offer Manage the lifecycle of all Smart Energy references, including the Solar Hybrid Home System, Solar AC Micro Grid System, Solar Water Pumping Bench, Smart IoT Panel, Critical Power Supply, Smart LV Panel, Medium Voltage Panel and measuring packs. Handle obsolescence, component substitution, configuration and version control, and change notices before they affect orders. Keep data sheets, wiring diagrams, user manuals, lab guides and installation instructions accurate and current. Run a closed field-feedback loop with delivery teams and service partners to root-cause issues, cut rework and release design fixes. Grow the offer Partner with Schneider Electric energy businesses to design new and upgraded modules on their latest technology. Bring emerging energy technology into training, such as lithium-ion battery storage, grid-tied and rooftop solar, EV charging, micro-grid control, power quality and energy management. Lead make-or-buy and partner decisions and build business cases for new modules based on market value, reuse and lifecycle economics. Adapt the offer for new markets and customer segments, from engineering universities to vocational institutes and CSR skilling programmes. Industrialisation and availability Work with the Industrialization Leader and Global Supply Chain to take new modules from design and prototype through pilot runs to stable production. Design for modularity, localisation, cost and supply resilience, including locally procured items such as batteries and racks. Make sure every Smart Energy product is available in all target countries, built to the right local standards and backed by spare parts. Curriculum and digital learning Align each module with learning objectives, competencies, national curricula and qualification frameworks (TVET, ITI, Diploma, Engineering) with curriculum experts and academic partners. Extend the digital side of the offer around EcoStruxure Energy Hub and IT Expert, including remote labs, simulation and connected equipment. Standards, certification and market launch Ensure electrical safety, product compliance and cybersecurity are built in, with the Design for Safety & Reliability and Conformity Assessment leads. Launch new and localised Smart Energy solutions on the roadmap timeline, with standard installation, commissioning and training packages for delivery teams. Support pre-sales, prescription and tendering with technical answers, lab layouts and solution sizing. Lead the Smart Energy team Hire, lead and develop the Smart Energy Senior Engineers, Product Architect. Apply the CoE's product development process, design reviews, release gates and lifecycle management in the Smart Energy domain. Train internal teams, partners and trainers on the Smart Energy offer and build a culture of quality and reuse. Success measures Measure Target Roadmap delivery New and upgraded Smart Energy modules launched on the roadmap timeline Offer growth Rising Smart Energy revenue and share of pipeline supported by new or upgraded modules Offer health All catalogue references available, with obsolescence resolved before it affects orders Market availability Smart Energy portfolio certified to local standards and available in all target countries Quality High first-pass validation, low field defects and strong institution feedback Cost Value-engineering savings and higher localisation share Team build Smart Energy team staffed, skilled and performing Key relationships Internal: Engineering Director; Industrialization Leader; Principal, Design for Safety & Reliability; Principal, Conformity Assessment; peer Product Architects (Smart Buildings, Digital/IIoT, Data Centers); Technical Specialists – Smart Energy and the operations centres; pre-sales, tendering, sales and marketing teams; Schneider Electric energy businesses and Global Supply Chain. External: universities, vocational education bodies and curriculum experts; OEMs, manufacturing partners and suppliers; technology and digital-learning partners; certification and standards bodies. Candidate profile 12+ years in product development, R&D, systems architecture or solution engineering in power distribution, renewable energy, energy storage or electrification. Critical: deep hands-on expertise in solar PV (on-grid, off-grid, hybrid), LV distribution and switchgear, MV systems up to 12 kV, protection relays, UPS/critical power and energy metering. Proven record of owning product or solution lifecycles from concept through industrialisation, launch and field support. Working knowledge of industrial communication (Modbus, Ethernet, wireless sensors) and energy-management software, ideally Schneider Electric EcoStruxure. Experience with electrical safety and international and Indian product standards and certification (for example IEC, BIS or CE). Experience with training or educational equipment, or with academic partnerships, is a strong plus. Experience leading or mentoring engineers, ideally across locations. Degree in Electrical or Electrical & Electronics Engineering; master's in power systems or renewable energy preferred. Willing to travel across India and the segment's markets. jobs.description: Job Description: Job Title: Power Systems Trainer Role Summary: The Power Systems Instructional Trainer designs and delivers technical learning programs to build engineering capability across power systems, products, tools, and digital solutions. The role develops effective learning solutions and collaborates with Experts and stakeholders to address business and technical needs. Department: Global Technology Alliance (GTA) Reporting Structure: Engineering Excellence Manager, GTA*, Bangalore, India Dotted line reports to: Global Training Leaders, NAM & Europe Work Details Location : Schneider Electric GTA, Electronic City Phase II, Bangalore India Location Work Category : Hybrid (onsite initially for training & alignment), flexible hours Collaboration : 2-3 hours with North American teams after 5 PM IST Travel : Minimal; domestic and international travel for training/conferences Career Path: DRDT3 - Technical Trainer II DRDT4 - Senior Technical Trainer I DRDT5 - Senior Technical Trainer II DRDT6 - Principal, Technical Trainer DRDT7 – Senior Principal Technical Trainer About GTA GTA (Global Technology Alliance) is an engineering program under the Energy Management | Power Systems | ETO Business of Schneider Electric. GTA has ~400 Electrical & Mechanical Engineers that offer Engineering Services (Quotations, Order Engineering, Product enhancement/maintenance, Electrical CAD Content Creation etc.) to the ETO (Engineer to Order) plants of Schneider Electric in North America, Europe, India etc. The team continues to grow and expand its presence across multiple geographies, creating a strong need for dedicated trainers who possess deep technical expertise and are committed to fostering a culture of continuous learning. Conduct training on new products, engineering tools, applications, and emerging technologies. Use practical demonstrations, e-learning, videos, and plant/lab visits to enhance learning. Assist engineering tools, software, and product design training efforts. Coordinate global training needs and provide post-training technical support. Engage with the quality team to identify engineering design barrier opportunities and develop targeted training to address the knowledge gap. Curriculum Development: Develop and maintain technical training content, curricula, and assessments. Apply instructional design and adult-learning principles to create effective learning journeys. Create high-quality digital and e-learning content using appropriate authoring tools. Assessment & Evaluation: Evaluate learner performance through knowledge checks, practical assessments, assignments, observations, and feedback. Establish and track metrics for participation, completion, effectiveness, application, and business impact. Use feedback and performance data to continuously improve learning content and delivery. Connect learning outcomes to relevant engineering and business performance indicators where feasible. Technical Expertise: Maintain advanced knowledge within the relevant Engineer-to-Order product and engineering domain. Stay current with product developments, engineering practices, automation, digital solutions, and applicable standards. Support learning related to low- and medium-voltage equipment, engineering design, controls, communication systems, testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance based on domain expertise. Maintain working knowledge of relevant engineering applications, product-data systems, CAD tools, productivity tools, and associated software. Stay updated with emerging trends in power systems, smart grids, renewable integration, and digital substations. Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with engineering teams, HR, quality teams, global training leaders, subject-matter experts, and business stakeholders. Represent the training function in audits, reviews, technical forums, and capability-development discussions. Manage multiple learning requirements and assignments while maintaining clear priorities. Support mentorship, buddy, and knowledge-sharing programs as required. Promote a culture of continuous learning, knowledge sharing, engineering excellence, and measurable improvement. jobs.description: Job Description: We are seeking an experienced System Integration HW & SW Test Engineer to qualify Building Management System (BMS) products and solutions, with a particular focus on system-level testing across connected, distributed, and cloud-enabled environments. The role combines hands-on hardware and software testing with the design and development of physical and hybrid system test environments. The successful candidate will build representative BMS test systems, integrate hardware and software components, develop structured test suites, and execute system-level qualification testing across controllers, field devices, networks, edge components, and cloud-connected services relevant to EcoStruxure Building Operation (EBO). The engineer will work closely with software development, hardware development, system engineering, product management, and certification specialists to identify issues early and ensure that products meet functional, system, integration, connectivity, and quality requirements. The role will initially have a strong focus on establishing the test environment and performing hands-on testing. Over time, the engineer will help develop repeatable test suites covering both on-premise and cloud-connected workflows, while identifying opportunities for test automation and broader regression coverage. Key Responsibilities Design, build, configure, and maintain physical system integration test environments for BMS products and solutions. Integrate hardware, software, controllers, networks, field devices, and other required system components into representative test configurations. Perform HW/SW system integration testing to verify functionality, interoperability, stability, and expected system behavior. Develop and maintain structured system-level test plans, test cases, and reusable test suites. Reproduce, analyze, document, and communicate defects discovered during system testing. Work closely with software and hardware development teams to support root-cause investigation and verification of corrections. Maintain test configurations and ensure that test setups are repeatable and representative of intended product configurations. Document test results and provide clear evidence of system behavior and compliance. Identify opportunities for test automation and develop test cases with automation in mind. Automate suitable system tests directly or collaborate with software developers and test automation engineers to implement automated testing. Contribute to continuous improvement of system integration, qualification, and certification processes. Support formal certification activities by providing tested configurations, test evidence, technical information, and engineering support. Perform HW/SW system integration testing to verify functionality, interoperability, stability, and expected system behavior. Contribute to continuous improvement of system integration, qualification, and certification processes. Support validation of cloud-related qualities such as performance, observability, access control, and operational robustness in connected environments. Preferred Qualifications Experience in system testing, system integration testing, or HW/SW integration testing. Experience with building/industrial data platforms. Knowledge of IoT protocols (MQTT, BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA). Experience with security frameworks (OWASP, threat modeling, secure SDLC). Familiarity with semantic data layers such as Brick, Haystack or similar metadata frameworks. Strong hands-on experience working with systems containing both hardware and software components. Experience designing, setting up, configuring, and troubleshooting physical test systems. Experience testing distributed or cloud-connected systems. Ability to translate system and certification requirements into structured and repeatable test cases. Experience developing test plans, test cases, test procedures, and test reports. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills across hardware, software, communication, network, and system boundaries. Understanding of the network technologies and connectivity environments in which BMS systems operate. Familiarity with APIs, web services, and integration points between local systems and cloud-connected services. Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex system-level test activities. Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively with hardware engineers, software developers, system engineers, and certification specialists. Good English communication skills, both spoken and written, including the ability to clearly document test procedures, results, issues, and technical findings. Curious and investigative; quickly learning new systems and finding problems by going beyond what is specified in written test cases What Success Looks Like A robust and representative physical and hybrid system test environment is established and maintained. HW/SW integration issues are identified early in the product-development lifecycle. Cloud-connected and distributed system behaviors are systematically tested before release. Test cases covering local, networked, and cloud-connected workflows are documented, repeatable, and traceable. Test suites evolve from individual manual tests into structured and reusable system test suites. Suitable tests are progressively automated, reducing repetitive manual testing and improving regression-test coverage. Test results and identified issues are clearly documented and effectively communicated to engineering teams. Software, hardware, systems, and connected-services teams have a common understanding of product readiness and remaining technical risks. Product releases become more predictable because issues are discovered during internal qualification across both on-premise and cloud-connected environments. jobs.title: Senior Engineer I, Embedded Software Design
jobs.description: Job Description: Company Overview: Schneider Electric is a global leader in energy management and automation, committed to providing innovative solutions that ensure Life Is On everywhere, for everyone, and at every moment. We are expanding our team in Gurugram and looking for a Senior Design Engineer to enhance our Edge software capabilities and drive the integration of digital technologies in our operations. Job Description: As Senior Design Engineer at Schneider Electric, you will play a crucial role in developing and implementing IoT solutions across our global infrastructure, with a primary focus on Edge software — specifically protocol driver development (Modbus, BACnet, and other field protocols). This position requires practical hands-on ability to design, implement, and optimize protocol driver software running on resource-constrained edge gateways and devices deployed at large scale (100s of thousands) in the field. Key Responsibilities: Develop scalable, high-performance protocol driver software (Modbus, BACnet, and other field/industrial protocols) for Edge computing devices. Independently design and implement communication drivers in C, including serial and IP-based transport layers, ensuring efficient and reliable device communication. Design and implement inter-process communication (IPC) mechanisms between protocol drivers and application services for efficient data exchange. Work on device-level data acquisition and integration with upstream application services and edge data pipelines. Ensure driver software is secure, reliable, and optimized for resource-constrained and real-time edge environments. Apply RTOS/embedded Linux concepts to ensure deterministic behavior, efficient resource usage, and robustness of protocol drivers. Implement and manage Linux process management, including systemd services, resource allocation, and performance tuning for driver processes. Collaborate with application teams (built primarily in Python) to integrate protocol drivers into the broader Edge software stack. Stay updated with emerging protocol standards, embedded Linux, and edge computing technologies. (External) English Qualifications: Requirements: Technical 4-10 years of overall experience in software engineering with a strong focus on C programming in embedded/Linux environments. Strong proficiency in C, with solid understanding of OOPs concepts (as applied in C or C++) for structuring driver and protocol stack code. Good understanding of Linux fundamentals, including process/thread management, IPC mechanisms (shared memory, message queues, sockets, pipes), and systemd. Working knowledge of RTOS concepts (task scheduling, priorities, determinism, resource contention) as applicable to embedded/edge systems. Understanding of industrial/field protocols such as Modbus and/or BACnet, or strong aptitude to learn them quickly. Willingness and ability to learn Python, as some integration with application services (written in Python) will be required — prior Python experience is a plus but not mandatory. Proficiency and experience with Git or any other VCS. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to lead complex technical projects. Working knowledge of communication protocols UART, I2C, SPI Good to have: Knowledge of Rust, C++, or Golang for performance-critical edge applications. Prior experience of working in IoT. Hands-on experience with Docker. Familiarity with cloud IoT platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT, Google Cloud IoT) and how edge devices integrate with them. Knowledge of industrial protocols (BACnet, Modbus, CAN) Knowledge of wireless protocols (Zigbee, BLE) Good Understanding of IoT architectures, protocols (MQTT, HTTP/REST), and edge computing frameworks. Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving abilities and strong communication skills. Advanced verbal and written communication skills including the ability to explain and present technical concepts to a diverse set of audiences. Good judgment, time management, and decision-making skills. Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills; ability to communicate and thrive in a cross-functional environment. Willingness to work outside documented job description. Has a "whatever is needed" attitude. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related field. Working experience designing robust, scalable & maintainable driver/protocol stack software in C. Prior experience in building embedded or edge IoT solutions. Prior experience in the energy sector, building automation, or industrial automation is advantageous. jobs.title: Senior Engineer II, Product Architect - Smart Energy
jobs.description: Job Description: JOB DESCRIPTION Senior Engineer, Product Architect – Smart Energy Engineering CoE · Smart Energy offer · India Reports to Principal, Product Architect – Smart Energy Business Schneider Electric · Education Equipment and Services Location Bangalore, India, with travel to customer sites, plants and partners as needed Scope Hands-on engineering of the Smart Energy offer – Solar Energy Solutions, Smart Power Distribution, LV and MV Smart Panels, and Microgrid About the Education Segment Schneider Electric's Education Segment provides technical training solutions that close the skills gap in energy, automation and digital technologies. We equip technical and vocational institutes, universities, government skilling programmes and industry academies with hands-on training labs, curricula, digital learning, train-the-trainer programmes and certification. Demand is rising fast. Governments are investing heavily in workforce skilling, industry faces acute technician shortages, and the energy transition and smart manufacturing need new skills at scale. The segment has already helped more than 200,000 young people gain job-ready skills. We are now building a dedicated, multi-country organisation to grow the business across six markets, with its own business development, engineering and delivery teams. Engineering is at the heart of what we offer: training solutions built on real industrial technology. Purpose of the role Design, build, test and maintain the Education Segment's Smart Energy training solutions: the lab equipment, software set-ups and learning content that teach solar energy, micro-grids, smart power distribution, critical power and LV/MV electrical networks. Working with the Principal, Product Architect – Smart Energy, you will turn the offer roadmap into working products. You will own the technical detail of current Smart Energy modules, develop new and upgraded modules from prototype to launch, and support delivery teams and institutions in the field. Market overview The energy transition is creating strong demand for technicians and engineers who can design, install, operate and maintain solar, storage and smart electrical systems. Distributed solar, micro-grids, digital power distribution and critical power are spreading faster than training systems can keep up. Institutions want Smart Energy labs that use real industrial equipment, connect hardware with energy-management software, and support national qualifications and electrical accreditation. Schneider Electric's energy portfolio puts the segment in a strong position to meet that need. Key responsibilities Design and development Develop new and upgraded Smart Energy modules from concept to release: system design and sizing, component selection, bills of material, single-line and wiring diagrams, and panel layouts. Build and test prototypes, including solar PV and hybrid systems, micro-grids, battery storage, smart LV panels, MV switchgear, protection relays and critical power systems. Integrate Schneider Electric technologies, such as intelligent circuit breakers, energy meters, communication gateways, protection relays and EcoStruxure energy-management software, into complete, teachable solutions. Develop proofs of concept for emerging technology, such as lithium-ion storage, grid-tied solar, EV charging and micro-grid control. Maintain the current offer Own the technical detail of Smart Energy references, including the Solar Hybrid Home System, Solar AC Micro Grid System, Solar Water Pumping Bench, Smart IoT Panel, Critical Power Supply, Smart LV Panel, Medium Voltage Panel and measuring packs. Track and resolve component obsolescence and substitutions, and raise change notices. Manage software and licence versions and compatibility, including EcoStruxure Energy Hub and IT Expert. Keep data sheets, single-line and wiring diagrams, user manuals, lab guides and installation instructions accurate and current. Verification, validation and safety Write and run test plans for equipment, protection settings, communication networks and lab experiments before release. Build electrical safety into every design: insulation, earthing, protection coordination, safe access for learners and battery safety. Prepare technical files for safety and product compliance (IEC/IS, BIS where required) with the Design for Safety & Reliability and Conformity Assessment leads. Industrialisation and launch Support the Industrialization Leader and plants or partners with design transfer, pilot builds, test procedures and production issues. Create standard installation, commissioning and training packages for delivery teams, including guidance for locally procured items such as batteries and racks. Adapt products for local standards, supply voltages and installation practices in each target country. Field and customer support Act as the technical expert for the Technical Specialists – Smart Energy, service partners and pre-sales teams. Answer technical questions in tenders and prescriptions, and help size solutions and lab layouts for institutions. Analyse field issues, find root causes and deliver fixes, feeding lessons back into designs. Train internal teams, partners and trainers on the Smart Energy offer. Curriculum and content Write and review lab experiments, exercises and technical content aligned to learning objectives and qualification levels (TVET, ITI, Diploma, Engineering). Build digital learning features around the offer, such as remote monitoring labs and simulations, with the Digital/IIoT team. Success measures Measure Target Development delivery Assigned new and upgraded Smart Energy modules released on schedule Design quality High first-pass validation and few design changes after release Offer health Components, software and licences current, with obsolescence resolved before it affects orders Safety and compliance Every release meets electrical safety and product compliance requirements Field support Fast resolution of technical escalations and low repeat issues Documentation Complete, current technical files, manuals and lab guides for every reference Knowledge sharing Delivery teams, partners and trainers trained and confident on the offer Key relationships Internal: Principal, Product Architect – Smart Energy; fellow Senior Engineer – Smart Energy; Head of Engineering; Industrialization Leader; Principal, Design for Safety & Reliability; Principal, Conformity Assessment; peer Product Architects and Senior Engineers (Digital/IIoT, Smart Buildings, Data Centers); Technical Specialists – Smart Energy and the operations centres; pre-sales and tendering teams; Schneider Electric energy product teams. External: institutions and trainers; OEMs, manufacturing partners and suppliers; technology partners; test and certification bodies. Candidate profile 7+ years in product development, R&D, design or solution engineering in power distribution, renewable energy, energy storage or electrification. Critical: strong hands-on skills in solar PV (on-grid, off-grid, hybrid) and micro-grids, LV distribution and switchgear, MV systems up to 12 kV, protection relays, UPS/critical power and energy metering. Practical knowledge of industrial communication (Modbus RTU/TCP, Ethernet, wireless sensors) and energy-management software, ideally Schneider Electric EcoStruxure. Experience taking products or solutions through design, testing, documentation and release. Sound knowledge of electrical safety and IEC and Indian standards. Experience with training or educational equipment is a strong plus. Clear technical writing and the ability to explain complex topics simply to trainers and customers. Degree in Electrical or Electrical & Electronics Engineering. Willing to travel within India and occasionally to the segment's markets. jobs.description: Job Description: Position Objective The primary objective of this role is to lead the design engineering efforts for the development of Low Voltage (LV) Air Circuit Breakers and associated accessories. The role focuses on delivering innovative, cost-effective, and standards-compliant solutions tailored to customer-specific technical and market requirements. The candidate will be actively involved in all phases of the product development lifecycle, from concept through to production readiness. Key Responsibilities Design and develop LV electrical distribution products in alignment with technical specifications and market needs. Lead the end-to-end product development process including design, prototyping, testing, documentation, and manufacturing readiness. This role also involves ensuring that customer-specific needs regarding technology, cost, and quality are met while complying with IEC standards. Lead engineering analysis of design concepts by applying engineering principles and analysis tools and conduct in-depth design feasibility studies using Creo. Possess knowledge of manufacturing and tooling processes to design metallic and plastic components. jobs.title: Deputy Manager - Field Service Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description: Role Overview We are seeking a hands-on Deputy Field Service Manager to lead and execute commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting of SCADA and Substation Automation Systems across Pan-India projects. The role demands strong technical proficiency in SCADA software (PSO, EPAS, Zenon), industrial communication protocols, and protection/automation systems, along with the ability to manage site deliverables, customer expectations, and cross-functional coordination. Key Responsibilities / Deliverables SCADA Commissioning & SAT Plan and conduct commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting of SCADA systems for substation automation projects using PSO, EPAS, and Zenon . Perform Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) ; prepare test procedures and reports. Substation Automation & Protection Integration Configure and integrate numerical relays (Schneider, ABB, Siemens, GE) and verify protection I/O, GOOSE messaging, and HMI/SCADA mappings. Validate SAS architectures including IED integration, bay-level controls, gateway engineering, and time synchronization. Protocols & Communication Implement and troubleshoot IEC 61850 , Modbus RTU , Modbus TCP/IP , Profibus , and Ethernet/IP networks, including VLANs, managed switches, and redundancy (RSTP/PRP/HSR where applicable). PLC/RTU Engineering Develop, modify, and debug logic for PLC (M580/M340) and RTU (Saitel/T500) ; perform point-to-point checks and interlocking validation. Quality, Documentation & Compliance Maintain as-site documentation: architecture drawings, communication matrices, ICD/SCD/CID files, I/O lists, test sheets, method statements, and redlines markup. Ensure compliance with utility standards, cybersecurity guidelines, and safety protocols. Customer & Stakeholder Management Lead site execution, manage contractors, and act as the primary technical interface with customers (utilities, EPCs, end users). Provide on-site training and knowledge transfer to customer teams. Issue Resolution & Escalation Drive root cause analysis, corrective/preventive actions, and coordinate with engineering/R&D for complex issues. Operational Rigor Plan daily site activities, track milestones, and report progress; manage materials, tools, and test equipment availability. jobs.description: Job Description: Job Title: Senior Engineer II – Electronics Hardware Design Location: Bangalore Experience Required: 10+ years Industry: Battery Management Systems (BMS), Energy Storage Systems (ESS), and Power & Embedded Electronics Job Summary: Schneider Electric is looking for a Senior Engineer II for Battery Management Systems (BMS) & Battery Packs for its Energy Storage Centre of Excellence (CoE). SE’s Energy Storage CoE enables company’s growth through the development of innovative energy storage products that are battery technology-agnostic, scalable, cost-effective, and manufacturable. We are looking for an experienced engineer with hands on in Battery Management Systems (BMS), Energy Storage Systems (ESS), and Power Electronics & Embedded domain. This role will focus on electrical system design, circuit development, power management, and safety compliance for energy storage solutions. The ideal candidate will work on the electrical engineering aspects of BMS and ESS projects, ensuring high-performance, efficient, and reliable energy solutions and own specific projects or part of them. Key Responsibilities: Own the technical roadmap for BMS and ESS platforms, aligning engineering activities with business objectives, product strategy, and customer requirements. Drive system architecture decisions, design reviews, technical risk assessments, and root cause analysis for complex engineering challenges. Manage end-to-end hardware development activities, including requirements definition, design, validation, regulatory compliance, and product release Coordinate cross-functional collaboration with firmware, software, mechanical, manufacturing, quality, safety, and certification teams. Collaborate with manufacturing and operations teams to support prototype builds, product industrialization, production ramp-up, and sustaining engineering activities Follow and contribute to engineering best practices, design guidelines, FMEA processes, verification plans, and design-for-test/manufacturability (DT/DFM) methodologies. Contribute and be part of technical reviews, gate reviews, and project milestone assessments to ensure product quality, schedule adherence, and risk mitigation. Provide support/ input related to effort estimation and technical project execution to meet delivery commitments Measure, define and monitor key engineering metrics related to quality, reliability, cost, schedule, and technical performance. (External) English Qualifications: Must Have Skills: Experience in Design and develop electrical architectures for Battery Management Systems (BMS) and Energy Storage Systems (ESS). Experience designing and optimize power electronics circuits, including DC/DC converters and on-board chargers. Added advantage if high power level has been handled. Experience in Analog & Mixed signal circuit design & digital circuit designs. Experience in handling digital interfaces like - SPI, I2C, RS-232 & RS-485, CAN, USB, & Ethernet interfaces. Experience in compliance with industry standards (UL 1973, IEC 62619, UL 60703 & IEC / EN/ FCC standards) & certification test strategies. Experience in handling product level EMI/EMC issue & trouble shooting the same. Experience in handling WCA/ derating, and tolerance stack-up analysis. Knowledge on performing circuit simulations, PCB design, and system-level testing to validate electrical performance. Knowledge on Electrical safety, thermal management, and fault detection techniques. Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills & System-level issue isolation across analog, digital, and power domains. Must have an experience of technically leading minimum of one product; end to end responsibility from Design to Release to Market Key Qualifications Education: Batchelors Or master’s degree in electrical engineering or a related field. Experience: 10+ years in electrical design for energy storage, BMS, or power electronics. Experience in leading team & cross functional collaboration would be added advantage. Why Join Us? Work on cutting-edge electrical innovations in energy storage. Lead and shape next-generation battery technologies. Competitive compensation and career growth opportunities. jobs.description: Job Description: The Team We're a global R&D / Innovation team across the Middle East, Asia, and Europe, building the next generation of software-defined automation (SDA). We close the gap between today's automation systems and tomorrow's open, software-defined plants, turning emerging standards and technologies into solutions that matter. jobs.title: Senior User Experience Designer II
jobs.description: Job Description: Schneider Electric creates connected technologies that reshape industries, transform cities and enrich lives. Our 135,000+ employees thrive in more than 100 countries. From the simplest of switches to complex operational systems, our technology, software and services improve the way our customers manage and automate their operations. Help us deliver solutions that ensure Life Is On everywhere, for everyone and at every moment. Great people make Schneider Electric a great company. What will be your role? As a Senior User Experience Designer II, you create innovative, user-centric designs that enhance product usability and elevate user satisfaction. You conduct thorough user research, develop wireframes and prototypes, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine and optimize designs. You lead usability testing efforts and incorporate user feedback to drive continuous improvement in design quality. Your mission is to enhance the overall user experience by crafting intuitive and enjoyable interfaces that align with user needs and business goals. Your work plays a critical role in driving product success by ensuring that designs are both effective and user-focused. You are a specialized contributor with advanced expertise in user experience design, concentrating on the technical aspects of interface creation and user research. You leverage your skills to tackle complex design challenges and develop innovative solutions. You apply moderate to advanced technical knowledge of UX design, delivering impactful results with direct influence on product outcomes. You independently make decisions about your work and priorities, often navigating ambiguous situations, with decisions guided by past experiences, established practices, and organizational procedures. You set your work priorities autonomously and provide guidance to other professionals when needed. Your work requires minimal supervision, and you actively seek guidance in challenging situations. What do you get to do in this position? As part of the Schneider Electric design organization, every team member is responsible for representing and upholding these core competencies: User-centered design. Apply the tools and methodologies the problem, timing, and context require. Be transparent and mentor colleagues across every stage of the design process. Facilitation and co-design. Prepare and lead workshops to align teams and converge on a common product and service vision. Include others and motivate with curiosity, a constant interest to learn, and a default to doing. Culture and advocacy. Be a representative of design and a user advocate within Schneider Electric. Promote our digital ecosystem, strengthen the brand, and form a unified experience. Systems thinking. Expand and adjust perspectives to understand the problem space. Empathize with users and colleagues and appreciate a diversity of inputs. Find cohesion across areas of the business for our users. Data driven. Know how to use and analyze qualitative and quantitative data in decision making. Design interactions that empower users with information and collect data as a natural part of the experience. As part of specifically being a Senior User Experience Designer II, you will be responsible for these additional competencies: AI-assisted design. Use generative AI tools fluently to explore concepts and scaffold prototypes, then refine AI-generated mockups and HTML/React output — resolving UX issues, aligning to the design system, and bringing them to enterprise-grade quality. Accelerate concept generation without substituting AI for user insight. Requirements translation. Convert ambiguous requirements into low-fidelity wireframes, user flows, and journey maps that surface gaps and misalignments before development starts. Facilitate working sessions that move stakeholders from assumptions to documented, testable requirements. Design execution. Own the full design workflow in Figma from rough concept to pixel-precise, developer-ready specs. Work within and contribute to the Quartz Design System, and maintain design artifacts as a living record across the product lifecycle. Design documentation. Produce annotated documentation a development team can build from independently — interaction states, edge cases, error handling, and component behavior fully specified. Your files should be navigable by a developer who has never met you. Concept testing and risk reduction. Establish a regular cadence of lightweight concept testing with real users to validate direction early and reduce the cost of course corrections downstream. Synthesize findings and communicate them clearly to stakeholders who may be new to incorporating user feedback. Human-centered culture. Model what good design review, critique, and iteration look like. Help the team build user-centered habits pragmatically, without heavy process, and connect to the broader Schneider Electric UX community to bring best practices back to the team. (External) English Qualifications: Qualifications: We know skills and competencies show up in many different ways and can be based on your life experience. If you do not necessarily meet all the requirements that are listed, we still encourage you to apply for the position. This job might be for you if: You bring strong, well-rounded UX craft to enterprise software: solid interaction design and information architecture for complex workflows, fluent prototyping, and hands-on usability testing and user research that you turn into decisions. You design to a clear accessibility bar, work within and extend the design system, and collaborate comfortably with front-end engineers. 8+ years of UX/product design experience, with the majority in enterprise B2B software. Experience as a solo or lead designer embedded in a cross-functional product team, shipping real product in agile teams — not just concepts. Designs for complex, permission-heavy or role-based enterprise systems (building management, access control, facilities, industrial platforms, or equivalent complexity). Expert-level Figma fluency: components, variants, auto layout, prototyping, Dev Mode, and FigJam — low-fidelity artifacts in minutes, developer-ready specs in hours. Applies and extends established enterprise design systems in Figma. Sufficient React understanding to collaborate effectively: component architecture, props, and state, and how design decisions create or eliminate engineering complexity — without writing production code. Uses generative AI tools as a design accelerant and critically evaluates AI-generated UI for design-system and user-need fit. Strong information architecture instincts for workflows involving multiple user roles, permission levels, and administrative hierarchies. Writes clear, precise design documentation that stands on its own without a walkthrough meeting. Portfolio with at least one case study from a complex enterprise domain or a design-immature environment. Fluent written and spoken English. Even better Works fluently with React-based design systems (MUI, Ant Design, Radix, or similar) and understands how they intersect with design tooling. Comfortable holding substantive feasibility conversations with front-end developers. Experience adding design rigor to an AI-assisted development process without creating friction for the team. Experience establishing design habits and practices in a design-immature team. Familiarity with Dovetail, Maze, or similar research and testing tools. jobs.title: Principal, Conformity Assessment
jobs.description: Job Description: JOB DESCRIPTION Principal, Conformity Assessment Engineering CoE · Product compliance and certification · India Reports to Head of Engineering - Education Segment Business Schneider Electric · Education Equipment and Services Location Bangalore, India, with travel to test laboratories, plants and the segment's markets Scope Global: regulatory compliance and certification for the full training-solutions portfolio – Smart Energy, Smart Buildings, Smart Factory, Digital Blocks, Data Centers and Fundamental Learning – in all target countries About the Education Segment Schneider Electric's Education Segment provides technical training solutions that close the skills gap in energy, automation and digital technologies. We equip technical and vocational institutes, universities, government skilling programmes and industry academies with hands-on training labs, curricula, digital learning, train-the-trainer programmes and certification. Demand is rising fast. Governments are investing heavily in workforce skilling, industry faces acute technician shortages, and the energy transition and smart manufacturing need new skills at scale. The segment has already helped more than 200,000 young people gain job-ready skills. We are now building a dedicated, multi-country organisation to grow the business across six markets, with its own business development, engineering and delivery teams. Engineering is at the heart of what we offer: training solutions built on real industrial technology. Purpose of the role Make sure every Education Segment training solution can be legally sold, shipped, installed and used in each target country, on time and at the lowest practical cost. The portfolio combines electrical panels, solar and battery systems, motors and drives, robots, wireless and connected devices, and software, so each product can fall under many different regulations and certification schemes. As the single technical authority for conformity assessment in the Engineering CoE, you will set the compliance strategy for the portfolio, plan and run certification with test laboratories and certification bodies, and own the technical files and declarations of conformity. You will work closely with the Principal, Design for Safety & Reliability, who builds safety and reliability into the designs, and with the Product Architects, so compliance is planned from the start of every project. Market overview Product regulations are getting stricter and more varied. Many countries now require mandatory local certification, in-country testing or local representatives, and new rules on cybersecurity, radio equipment, batteries and environmental substances keep coming into force. Government and institutional tenders often ask for proof of certification before an order can be placed. Fast, reliable market access is therefore a direct driver of growth for the segment, and a delay in certification can mean a lost tender. Key responsibilities Compliance strategy and regulatory intelligence Build and maintain a compliance map for the portfolio: which regulations, standards and certification schemes apply to each product in each target country. Track regulatory changes, such as new cybersecurity, radio, battery, machinery and environmental rules, and assess their impact on products and timelines. Define the most efficient certification route for each product family, reusing test reports through schemes such as the IECEE CB Scheme where possible. Align with Schneider Electric's global compliance and regulatory teams, and reuse certifications of Schneider Electric components wherever possible. Certification and market access Plan and run certification for new and localised products, covering schemes such as CE and UKCA (low voltage, EMC, radio, machinery, RoHS), BIS in India, CCC in China, UL or cUL, G-Mark and other Gulf schemes, and national schemes in other target markets. Manage radio and telecom type approvals for wireless and connected equipment, and transport and safety requirements for batteries (for example UN 38.3). Select and manage test laboratories, certification bodies and local representatives, including budgets, schedules and test samples. Make sure certificates are in place before launch and renewed on time, so they never block orders, shipments or tenders. Technical files and declarations Own the technical files, declarations of conformity, test reports and certificates for every product. Define rules for compliance markings, rating plates, labels, warnings and user-manual content in each market. Manage environmental and material compliance, such as RoHS, REACH, WEEE and battery regulations, with procurement and suppliers. Compliance in development and change Set compliance requirements at the start of every project and check them at each release gate, with the Product Architects. Assess every design change, component substitution and localisation for its impact on existing certificates, and manage re-certification where needed. Work with the Principal, Design for Safety & Reliability on pre-compliance testing, risk assessments and safety evidence for certification. Build in-house pre-compliance testing capability, such as EMC pre-scans and safety tests, to cut cost and time. Supply chain, trade and tenders Work with Global Supply Chain, plants and partners so production stays in line with certified designs, including factory inspections and surveillance audits. Support import and customs clearance with the right compliance documents for each country. Give commercial and tendering teams accurate compliance statements, certificates and answers to technical questions in tenders. Process and capability Set up the conformity assessment process, tools and certificate database for the Education Segment. Train Product Architects, engineers, delivery and commercial teams on compliance requirements. Grow the compliance capability as the portfolio and number of markets expand. Success measures Measure Target Market access All products certified for every target country before launch, with no orders or tenders lost to missing certification Certification lead time Certification completed on the project timeline Certificate health Certificates current and renewed on time, with no lapses Change control Every design change assessed for compliance impact before release Audit results No major findings in certification, factory or market surveillance audits Cost Certification cost reduced through test-report reuse and pre-compliance testing Process Compliance map, process and certificate database in place and used Key relationships Internal: Head of Engineering; Principal, Design for Safety & Reliability; Product Architects and Senior Engineers (Smart Energy, Smart Buildings, Digital/IIoT, Data Centers); Industrialization Leader; Operations Head, Delivery/Purchase Managers and the operations centres; commercial, tendering and order-management teams; Schneider Electric global compliance, regulatory, legal and Global Supply Chain teams. External: test laboratories and certification bodies; national standards and regulatory authorities; local representatives and customs agents; manufacturing partners and suppliers. Candidate profile 12+ years in product compliance, certification, regulatory affairs or test engineering for electrical, electronic or industrial equipment. Critical: deep hands-on experience certifying electrical and electronic products in multiple countries, including CE marking and other schemes such as BIS, CCC, UL, CB Scheme and Gulf or African national schemes. Strong knowledge of electrical safety (IEC 61010, IEC 61439, IEC 60204-1), EMC and radio standards, and of environmental rules such as RoHS, REACH and WEEE. Experience with battery, machinery or cybersecurity regulations is a strong advantage. Proven record of managing test laboratories, certification bodies and budgets, and of building compliance processes. Experience with training or educational equipment, or with government tenders, is a strong plus. Well organised and detail-minded, able to manage many products, markets and deadlines at once. Degree in Electrical, Electrical & Electronics or Electronics Engineering. Willing to travel across India and the segment's markets. (External) English Qualifications: What's in it for me? jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description: The Team We're a global R&D / Innovation team across the Middle East, Asia, and Europe, building the next generation of software-defined automation (SDA). We close the gap between today's automation systems and tomorrow's open, software-defined plants, turning emerging standards and technologies into solutions that matter. IT/OT convergence is at the heart of everything we build. The Role You'll join a team of automation and software engineering experts, designing, testing, validating, and troubleshooting network architectures that address critical customer needs . You'll also own the testing and verification lab network, ensuring it performs reliably and remains optimized. Working across both IT and OT systems , you'll turn bold ideas into high-impact, real-world innovations through hands-on engineering. What You'll Do Serve as the networking expert for global and cross-functional teams , supporting Engineered Solutions and verification and validation activities in local and remote labs. Manage the operation, maintenance, and upgrades of multiple local and remote lab networks. Design, configure, and troubleshoot Layer 2/Layer 3 networks , including VLANs, routing, switching, redundancy, link aggregation, and network segmentation. Evaluate and validate new networking technologies for software-defined and OPA-based automation, and turn results into reference architectures . Troubleshoot complex network issues using packet capture and protocol analysis , addressing latency, packet loss, routing, MTU, interface errors, and performance issues. Implement network security and resilience controls , including firewalls, ACLs, VLAN/VRF segmentation, secure management access, redundancy, and device hardening. Design and maintain lab networks that span physical switches, hypervisors, and container hosts, including VLAN trunking into VMs and container networking. Must-Have Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a related field, with 5 + years of experience in network design, testing, troubleshooting, and industrial process-control network infrastructure. Strong knowledge of Layer 2/Layer 3 networking , including TCP/IP, IP addressing, subnetting, routing, VLANs, trunking, multicast, IGMP snooping, QoS, network segmentation, and RSTP across diverse network topologies. Hands-on experience with at least one industrial network redundancy protocol (such as MRP, PRP/HSR, DLR, or ERPS), including testing failover, recovery and convergence times, latency, and packet loss. Proficiency with network equipment, monitoring, and troubleshooting tools , including Wireshark, SNMP, Syslog, and port mirroring/SPAN. Hands-on experience with industrial networking platforms such as Cisco Industrial Ethernet, Hirschmann, or Moxa. Experience developing technical network documentation , including test plans, test reports, topology diagrams, and configuration documentation. Experience with OT cybersecurity architecture , including firewalls, DMZs, network zoning/segmentation, secure remote access, and defense-in-depth principles aligned with ISA/IEC 62443. Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, Modbus TCP, OPC UA, and IEC 61850. Professional certification in networking or OT cybersecurity (such as CCNP Enterprise, Juniper JNCIP-ENT, or an ISA/IEC 62443 certificate). Strong written and spoken English , with the ability to explain technical ideas clearly to a global team. Nice-to-Have Experience with virtual and container networking on Linux hosts and hypervisors, including Linux bridges, Open vSwitch, VLAN trunking to VMs, and Docker networking (bridge, macvlan). Experience with time synchronization and deterministic networking , including PTP (IEEE 1588) and TSN. Familiarity with FAT/SAT, commissioning, migration, and cutover activities , including troubleshooting live industrial networks while minimizing operational disruption. Experience with n etwork automation and monitoring using Python or Ansible, and tools such as Zabbix. Position: Software LCS (Lifecycle & Configuration Specialist) – Digital Solutions Location: Navi Mumbai (Mahape) Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech Experience: 4–8 Years Role Summary We are seeking a skilled and proactive Lifecycle Support Engineer for SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems. The role involves end-to-end lifecycle management of SCADA applications, including deployment, maintenance, troubleshooting, upgrades, and continuous optimization to ensure system availability, performance, and reliability. Key Responsibilities SCADA System Support & Maintenance 1. Provide L2/L3 support for SCADA applications and infrastructure. 2. Monitor system performance, alarms, and events to ensure uptime and reliability. 3. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to SCADA software, communication protocols, and field devices. Lifecycle Management 1. Manage complete lifecycle of SCADA systems: design support, implementation, operation, and decommissioning. 2. Plan and execute system upgrades, patches, and migrations. 3. Maintain version control and configuration management of SCADA systems. Incident & Problem Management 1. Handle incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and implement corrective/preventive actions. 2. Work with cross-functional teams to resolve critical issues within SLA timelines. System Integration & Enhancements 1. Support integration of SCADA with PLCs, RTUs, historians, and enterprise systems (MES/ERP). 2. Develop and modify SCADA screens, scripts, alarms, and reports. 3. Implement new features and system improvements based on business requirements. Cybersecurity & Compliance 1. Ensure SCADA systems comply with cybersecurity policies and industry standards. 2. Implement security patches, user access controls, and network segmentation. 3. Conduct vulnerability assessments and audits. Documentation & Training 1. Maintain technical documentation including system architecture, SOPs, and troubleshooting guides. 2. Train operators and support teams on SCADA usage and best practices. Strong experience with SCADA systems (e.g. PME, Wonderware, WinCC, iFIX, Ignition, GE Proficy). 2. Knowledge of PLC/RTU systems (Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, etc.). 3. Familiarity with databases (SQL Server, Oracle) and historian systems. 5. Exposure to networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLANs, firewalls). 6. Knowledge of Python, Node, React and C++ languages. Soft Skills 1. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 2. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 3. Ability to work in a 24x7 support environment if required. Preferred Qualifications 1. Experience in industries like Power, Water, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Utilities. 2. Knowledge of Industrial Cybersecurity (ISA/IEC 62443, NIST). 3. Certifications in SCADA systems or automation platforms. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 1. System uptime and availability 2. Incident resolution time (MTTR) 3. jobs.description: Job Description: MISSION The primary objective of this role is to carry out the design engineering for the development of Low Voltage (LV) Circuit Breakers and associated accessories. The role focuses on delivering innovative, cost-effective, and standards-compliant (IEC..) solutions tailored to customer-specific technical and market requirements. The candidate will be actively involved in all phases of the product development lifecycle, from concept through to production readiness. Key Responsibilities Design and develop LV electrical distribution products in alignment with technical specifications and market needs. Lead development process including design, prototyping, testing, documentation, and manufacturing readiness. Utilize 3D CAD software (e.g., Pro/ENGINEER) for design feasibility studies and modeling. Maintain and update product documentation including drawings, BOMs, and design guidelines. Product release in PDM softwares Demonstrate knowledge of manufacturing processes and tooling for both metallic and plastic components. Implement Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) evaluations, recommending alternative materials and production methods. Apply six sigma requirements like QFD, DFMEA, P-Diagram Manage prototype development, build, and testing activities. Conduct detailed engineering analysis using design fundamentals and tools (e.g., material strength, tolerance stack-up, mechanism design). Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for design issues. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including manufacturing, sourcing, finance, marketing, and suppliers to ensure design validation and production readiness. Define & carry out product qualification as well as validation testing. Support certification testing as per IEC testing (IEC 60947) using knowledge of standard, test procedure & acceptance criteria. Root cause analysis in case of failure.
