jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Native Engineering, Integrations
jobs.description: Company Description It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. Join us to put AI to work for people. Job Description About Team Flow by ServiceNow is a standalone conversational AI service desk, with its own product and its own codebase. Employees ask for help wherever they already work — Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, or the browser. Flow answers from connected knowledge, handles the request, and runs automations the team publishes. AI is how the product works, and a person stays in control when the action is sensitive. Flow is a new company inside ServiceNow, reimagining every function from first principles. We hire builders with agency and curiosity who use AI as the default way to design, review, and operate. They challenge inherited ways of working and treat their work as craft. Flow is only as good as the systems it can read and the actions it can take. On Integrations, you’ll turn identity, devices, ticketing, documents, and chat into assets Flow can inventory, knowledge it can cite, and actions it can run — with each source’s permissions intact. In your first 12 months, you’ll make sure priority systems support assets, automations, and knowledge that Flow can actually use. Connection health and failed actions will be operable without a specialist in the room, and every new system will follow one contract for permissions, audit, and proof. Types of problems you’ll get to work on Integrations that power automations: Connect multiple systems (identity, devices, ticketing, documents, chat) and compose them into automations that run end to end. Own sync correctness, versioned behavior, and a repeatable contract for every provider as the catalog grows. Tool surfaces an AI can actually call : An action’s name, description, schema, and examples are the product surface a model sees. Design them so the assistant picks the right action first try, scope them so they are safe for an AI to call, and measure whether it does. Permissions and credentials you can prove: If a file is private to HR, a marketer must not see its title, its URL, or that it exists. Own access-model mirroring and delete detection, and pick the smallest credential policy each provider needs across validation, reconnect, revocation, and tenant isolation. AI-native development itself: Agentic coding is how this team ships, not a productivity add-on. Author the skills and guardrails that let agents do integration work correctly, keep the deterministic provider-fake harness that makes fast iteration possible, and review generated code critically before anything ships. Our stack TypeScript on Bun, PostgreSQL, Temporal for durable execution, Nango as the OAuth broker. We expect you to be excellent in a comparable stack and fluent in ours within weeks. We are not screening for this list. Qualifications To be successful in this role you have: Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This includes current, hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development. Hands-on depth building and operating third-party integrations that real tenants depended on — webhooks, rate limits, pagination, incremental sync, delete detection. 8+ years of software engineering with strong fundamentals in system design, API design, relational data modeling, and testing. Experience designing API or SDK surfaces that another system consumes correctly without a human reading the documentation — and interest in doing that for a model. Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This includes current, hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development. Ownership of a versioned contract where a rename breaks a customer: stable identifiers, deprecation, and migration. Sound judgment about least-privilege access — scope minimization per action, admin consent, secrets handling, tenant isolation — and about which actions an AI may take on its own. Comfort with ambiguity and the drive to build from 0–1 without a playbook. A record of technical leadership: architecture ownership, code-quality bar-raising, and mentoring engineers. Nice to have Experience evaluating tool or function selection — measuring whether a model picks the right action. Experience with RAG or the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Familiarity with SCIM or directory sync. Background in IT service management or employee support products. Why join us Intelligence is commoditizing. Connection and execution are not. A model that reasons brilliantly and cannot act on the systems a company actually runs is a demo. Flow already reaches a broad and growing share of the systems enterprises run day to day, and this team decides how fast that surface grows and how far each connection can be trusted. We aren’t writing connectors one at a time. We’re building the generator, the contract every provider follows, and the proof that what Flow says it did, it actually did. Real problems: a vendor specification that lies, an access model that must be mirrored exactly or not at all, a sync that resumes cleanly a million items later, and a tool surface a model has to get right without reading the documentation. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. About the Role We are looking for a DV manager to drive verification strategy and technical leadership for image sensor-based SoC programs. The candidate will own SoC-level verification architecture end-to-end, set methodology direction across IP and subsystem teams, and act as the primary technical authority for verification sign-off on imaging SoCs, partnering closely with architecture, design, and software teams from concept through tape-out. Key Responsibilities Define and own the overall SoC verification strategy, architecture, and closure plan for image sensor-based SoC programs. Drive verification planning across IP, subsystem, and full-chip levels, ensuring coherent coverage and sign-off criteria. Provide technical leadership across multiple verification teams, setting direction on methodology, tooling, and reuse strategy (UVM, formal, emulation/FPGA prototyping as applicable). Review and approve verification plans, testbench architectures, and coverage models for critical IPs and subsystems (e.g., image sensor interface, ISP pipeline, MIPI/I3C connectivity, security/crypto blocks). Drive SoC-level integration verification — power-up sequences, clocking/reset, interconnect, low-power modes, and cross-IP interactions. Champion the use of formal verification for control-logic, FSM, and connectivity verification, and identify where formal can accelerate closure or replace simulation effort. Own escalation and resolution of critical verification issues, including specification ambiguities, cross-team dependencies, and schedule-critical bugs. Represent verification in program-level reviews, providing risk assessment, closure confidence, and sign-off readiness to senior management and stakeholders. Drive root-cause analysis for any post-silicon issues traced to verification gaps, and feed learnings back into methodology and coverage models. Mentor and develop senior and mid-level verification engineers; build technical depth and succession within the team. Evaluate and drive adoption of new verification tools, flows, and AI-assisted verification techniques to improve productivity and quality. Collaborate with external IP/VIP vendors and EDA partners to resolve tool and methodology issues. Required Skills Bachelor's/master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering (VLSI specialization preferred). 12+ years of experience in digital design/SoC verification, including demonstrated ownership of full-chip or SoC-level verification sign-off. Deep expertise in SystemVerilog and UVM methodology, including testbench architecture at IP and SoC level. Strong background in functional coverage, code coverage, and assertion-based verification (SVA), with the ability to define SoC-level coverage and closure criteria. Hands-on and architectural experience with formal verification tools and methodology (e.g., JasperGold) for FSM, connectivity, and control-path verification. Strong understanding of image sensor interfaces and imaging SoC architecture (e.g., MIPI CSI, sensor control protocols such as I3C/I2C, ISP pipelines). Proven experience driving SoC-level integration verification: clocking, reset, power domains, low-power verification, and interconnect/fabric verification. Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Perl, or TCL) and experience with regression/CI infrastructure at scale. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional technical discussions and drive alignment across design, architecture, DFT, and software teams. Expertise in Gate-Level Simulation with timing annotation (SDF) , including efficient debugging of timing-related failures. Exposure to AI/ML-assisted verification techniques (e.g., test generation, debug automation, coverage analysis) to improve verification productivity and efficiency. Preferred / Good to Have Experience with emulation or FPGA-based prototyping for SoC-level verification. Familiarity with security/crypto IP verification in an SoC context. Experience with low-power verification (UPF/CPF) at SoC level. Prior experience defining or contributing to verification methodology standards/guidelines across an organization. Experience working directly with EDA vendors (e.g., Cadence, Synopsys) on tool evaluation and escalations. Experience in an automotive-qualified or safety-critical (ISO 26262) SoC verification environment. Soft Skills Strong technical leadership with the ability to set direction and influence without direct authority across teams. Excellent judgment in balancing schedule, risk, and verification thoroughness for sign-off decisions. Strong communication skills — able to translate technical risk into clear, actionable input for senior management. Structured, logical approach to problem decomposition and root-cause analysis on complex, ambiguous issues. Passion for mentoring and building technical capability within the team. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, cross-functional, globally distributed program environment. Ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and drive closure under deadlines. Collaborative approach to working with design, architecture, and cross-functional teams. Exposure to AI/ML assisted verification techniques to improve verification productivity and efficiency. What We Offer A high-impact technical leadership role shaping verification strategy for next-generation image sensor SoCs. Direct influence over methodology, tooling, and technical direction across the verification organization. Opportunity to work at the intersection of imaging, connectivity, and security IP verification. Mentorship and people-development opportunities as a manager Collaborative environment with global design, architecture, and EDA partner teams. A technical leadership track with visibility into IP-level and subsystem-level verification strategy. Opportunity to shape verification methodology, including formal and protocol verification practices. Exposure to advanced verification domains including formal verification and next-generation Security IP and systems. jobs.description: OUR STORY At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. About the Role We are seeking an experienced Digital Verification Engineer to take on a Technical Leader role within our Imaging verification team. The candidate will drive verification strategy and closure for complex digital IPs in imaging and automotive subsystems, mentor junior engineers, and act as the technical point of contact for verification across cross-functional teams. Key Responsibilities Own end-to-end verification strategy, planning, and closure for one or more complex IPs/subsystems. Architect and review UVM-based verification environments, ensuring reusability and scalability across projects. Drive functional and code coverage closure; define coverage models and identify verification gaps early in the cycle. Lead protocol-level verification efforts (e.g., I3C, MIPI, AMBA), including VIP evaluation, integration, and debug. Apply the use of formal verification techniques (e.g., JasperGold) to complement simulation-based verification, particularly for FSM and control-logic-heavy blocks. Review test plans, testbenches, and verification collateral authored by team members; provide technical guidance on methodology and debug approaches. Interface with design, architecture, DFT, and software teams to clarify specification ambiguities and drive design-for-verification practices. Identify and resolve spec ambiguities/errata; work with IP/protocol working groups where applicable. Mentor and technically guide junior verification engineers; support their ramp-up on tools, methodology, and protocols. Drive process improvements: regression infrastructure, debug efficiency, coverage methodology, and verification reuse. Communicate verification status, risks, and closure plans to management and stakeholders. Support root-cause analysis of silicon/post-silicon issues traced back to verification gaps, where relevant. Required Skills Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering (VLSI specialization preferred). 5-7 years of experience in digital design/IP verification, with demonstrated ownership of verification closure for at least one complex IP or subsystem. Strong expertise in System Verilog and UVM methodology — testbench architecture, sequences, scoreboards, and reference models. Proven experience with functional coverage, code coverage, and assertion-based verification (SVA); ability to define coverage models from specification. Hands-on experience with industry-standard simulation tools (VCS, Xcelium, or Questa) and debug tools. Experience with formal verification tools and methodology (e.g., JasperGold) for FSM, connectivity, or control-logic verification. Solid understanding of one or more protocols such as I3C, I2C, SPI, AMBA,MIPI-CSI, or similar interconnect/interface standards, including VIP-based verification. Strong scripting skills (Python, Perl, or TCL) for automation, flow development, and regression management. Ability to read and interpret design specifications, RTL, and identify verification risk areas independently. Preferred / Good to Have Experience mentoring or technically leading a small team of verification engineers. Exposure to mutation testing or other coverage-quality assessment techniques. Familiarity with low-power verification (UPF/CPF) and Gate Level simulations. Experience working with EDA vendors (e.g., Cadence, Synopsys) for tool/methodology support and issue resolution. Prior contribution to internal verification methodology documents, guidelines, or reusable verification IP (VIP) development. Experience working in a globally distributed team environment. Soft Skills Strong technical leadership and mentoring ability. Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous or under-specified requirements. Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to present technical status and risk clearly to management. Ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and drive closure under deadlines. Collaborative approach to working with design, architecture, and cross-functional teams. Exposure to AI/ML assisted verification techniques to improve verification productivity and efficiency. What We Offer A technical leadership track with visibility into IP-level and subsystem-level verification strategy. Opportunity to shape verification methodology, including formal and protocol verification practices. Mentorship and people-development opportunities within a growing team. Exposure to advanced verification domains including formal verification and next-generation Security IP and systems. Collaborative, cross-functional work environment with global teams. jobs.title: Validation Engineer
jobs.description: Position/ Role: Validation/ Characterization Engineer The LP-SPS team works on high side switches and controllers. SPS products are responsible in protecting sensitive electronics used in automotive and industrial applications. We develop Functional Safe (ASIL-B or above rated) smart eFuses and HSSC for Zonal architectures in EV and BEV vehicles. We are developing GaN based solutions to support the 48V automotive battery rails. We also develop products which help protect the L2+ ADAS systems. This is a high visibility and high growth product area. We are looking for a highly motivated and agile Silicon Characterization engineer with strong technical skills who can lead validation efforts on across the HSS and HSSC portfolios. What will you be doing in this role? (Responsibilities and Opportunities) As a member of the SPS validation team, you will be responsible for validating any of the 48V/24V/12V automotive or industrial HSS or high side switch controller products including products based on MV GaN. Validation work will involve the following: Work with the product definition and design team before device availability to thoroughly understand validation requirements, including device-level and system-level specifications. Define, own, and drive a comprehensive validation test plan and schedule that covers every specification in the VVCM, the datasheet, and required functional tests, ensuring full traceability and on‑time delivery of results. Design and build validation PCBs using Cadence Allegro X that meet high-voltage high-current and power integrity requirements while leveraging and integrating with existing validation hardware infrastructure. Define the Validation Strategy in terms of Hardware, Software and Instrumentation for newer customer process and IP requirements Build reusable, automated test sequences using Python to execute the validation plan, collect characterization data across multiple devices and test conditions, and drive execution of all functional tests. Analyze characterization data collected across multiple devices and test conditions against VVCM specifications to assess device compliance, verify that all functional tests have defined pass/fail criteria, and confirm all tests have passed prior to validation sign-off. Drive cross-functional reviews covering validation hardware, test results, and debug findings with stakeholders across design, systems, applications, and test engineering teams. Perform datasheet plot generation; apply statistical analysis (distributions, Cpk, limit capability) to assess spec margins and drive datasheet limit decisions. Investigate unexpected behavior when observed during validation through structured design of experiments (DoE) to narrow down the root cause — whether an error in stimulus, error in hardware, or a suspect on-device circuit block — and drive resolution with the design team. Maintain clear, thorough documentation of validation test plans, test procedures, and debug findings. Author concise validation summaries that include all test results for cross-functional reviews and program records. Qualifications Knowledge and Skills expected: Self-driven with a strong sense of ownership — able to independently plan and execute validation work from test plan definition through sign-off with minimal direction. Strong analog, power and mixed-signal fundamentals and ability to translate that into practical circuits useful for test and measurement and debug Proven ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, results‑driven development environment. Demonstrated expertise in diagnosing and resolving complex hardware, software, and device-level issues using systematic debugging methodologies and root-cause analysis. Strong hands-on laboratory skills, board bring up, and equipment setup for validation testing. Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to success, both internally and externally. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Experience testing high‑voltage and high-power devices, SOA, and IDSAT measurements—is a strong plus. Good team player, attitude and thirst for continuous learning and ability to function independently Hardware/ Software and Data Analysis Hands-on PCB design experience using Cadence Allegro X. Understanding of power electronics layout fundamentals specifically for high power designs involving power MOSFETs and GaN Experience working with high-voltage power circuits in a lab environment. Proficiency with Python for automated data collection and test sequence development. Familiarity with VVCM/Starfish or equivalent validation compliance tracking tools Experience with Git or equivalent version control system Experience with Spotfire or equivalent tool for data visualization and analysis Experience generating datasheet-quality characterization plots from data Minimum requirements: Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field of study 2+ years of relevant semiconductor industry experience in Characterization or Validation Proficiency with lab instrumentation: oscilloscopes, SMUs, DMMs, signal generators, and power supplies Experience developing test automation using Python About Us Why TI? jobs.description: Position Overview Hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and maintaining CI/CD infrastructure, build and release automation, and software deployment solutions supporting SLT, Burn-In, and semiconductor software platforms. The role focuses on GitHub Enterprise Server, GitHub Actions, self-hosted runner infrastructure, cross-platform build and deployment automation, and reliable delivery of on-premises software across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments, with supporting Azure services. This position requires strong technical ownership of automation, infrastructure reliability, release engineering, and deployment troubleshooting across distributed engineering environments. The engineer will work closely with software development, QA, IT, infrastructure, and global engineering teams to establish scalable, secure, and repeatable software delivery practices. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Enterprise Server and GitHub Actions for multiple software products and repositories. Architect and manage self-hosted GitHub Actions runners across Windows, Linux, and macOS, including runner PCs used for hardware-dependent testing, integration, and deployment. Automate software build, unit testing, integration testing, packaging, artifact management, release, installation, and deployment workflows. Develop reusable GitHub Actions workflows, composite actions, scripts, and shared pipeline components to standardize engineering practices across teams. Design and maintain cross-platform deployment automation for on-premises applications, services, tools, and supporting infrastructure. Implement automated deployment, configuration management, environment provisioning, upgrade, rollback, and recovery procedures for customer and internal environments. Manage runner lifecycle, capacity, labels, groups, access controls, service accounts, credentials, connectivity, and job execution reliability. Build and maintain deployment automation using Bash, PowerShell, Python, and other appropriate scripting technologies. Integrate Azure services into software delivery workflows, including identity, secrets management, artifact storage, infrastructure provisioning, and monitoring, as applicable. Implement secure software supply chain practices, including least-privilege access, secret management, dependency and vulnerability scanning, artifact integrity, and controlled release approvals. Establish infrastructure-as-code and configuration-as-code practices using appropriate tools, including Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent technologies where applicable. Design CI/CD pipelines that support automated quality gates, test result publishing, code coverage, static analysis, security checks, and release readiness validation. Monitor pipeline health, runner availability, deployment outcomes, and infrastructure capacity; troubleshoot failures across GitHub, operating systems, networking, permissions, and application dependencies. Establish deployment observability, actionable logging, alerts, operational dashboards, and incident recovery procedures for on-premises environments. Manage release versioning, artifact traceability, environment configuration, release promotion, and deployment auditability across independently evolving software components. Collaborate with software and QA teams to improve build times, test reliability, deployment frequency, and developer productivity. Lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, document operational procedures, and drive continuous improvement in DevOps standards and practices. Work directly with global engineering teams during software integration, customer deployments, production issues, and release support. Requirements: 7+ years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, build and release engineering, or infrastructure automation, with demonstrated technical ownership. Strong hands-on expertise with GitHub Enterprise Server, GitHub Actions, workflow design, reusable workflows, runner management, and GitHub APIs. Proven experience configuring, operating, troubleshooting, and scaling self-hosted CI/CD runners in enterprise environments. Strong experience with Linux administration, command-line tools, Bash scripting, and service management; practical experience supporting macOS build and deployment environments. Experience with Windows environments and PowerShell-based automation for cross-platform software delivery. Proven experience designing CI/CD pipelines covering build, automated testing, packaging, artifact publishing, deployment, and rollback. Experience deploying and supporting on-premises software in enterprise or customer environments, including environments with restricted network access. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, proxies, firewalls, ports, and service connectivity. Experience with Azure services and cloud infrastructure integration for enterprise software delivery. Experience with containers and container tooling, such as Docker or Podman, and container-based development or deployment workflows. Strong understanding of identity and access management, secrets handling, permissions, secure automation, and software supply chain security. Ability to troubleshoot complex failures spanning source control, build agents, operating systems, networking, application dependencies, and deployment environments. Experience owning infrastructure and automation solutions from design through implementation, rollout, and operational support.

jobs.title: TD Software Test and Support Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description: TD Software Test and Support Engineer ACCOUNTABILITIES Within Airbus Customer Services, “Tech Data Support & Services” (SID) is in charge of defining, producing, delivering and supporting the Technical Data (TD) products and services which are necessary for Customers to safely and efficiently operate their aircraft. Technical Documentation is characterized by large amounts of data, configuration management, direct impact on A/L operability, complexity of the processes and associated tools, complexity and diversity of the aircraft design, multiple interfaces to manage and obtain source data from Engineering or Suppliers. And finally, this is combined with the core competence of Maintenance Operations (how aircraft are maintained by operators). In this context, airnav X application is the Airbus solution allowing our Customers (internal & external) to browse and manage Airbus Technical Data. Since its Entry Into Service in 2017, the Online version has been complemented with the Intranet and the Standalone versions and it has been enriched with new features to ease the access to the documentation. Moreover, during the last years, airnav X Ecosystem has been completed with 2 new services: airnav X Full Online and airnav X Editing. With these services, Airbus offers to our Customers advanced features to better manage Airbus documentation: The possibility to attach documents, images or videos in the documentation, to manage more than 2 revisions, to control the access to their documentation by the end users and to add Airline customized data directly in the manuals thanks to the editing function. airnav X Ecosystem helps our Customers to access the Airbus Technical Data they need in an efficient way allowing them to meet their operational requirements and even to improve their operational reliability. airnav X is accessed today by more than 50,000 end users per month from Airlines, MROs and other organizations. More than 400 Customers rely on Airbus to access the technical documentation they need to maintain and operate their aircrafts. Now more than ever they are relying on Airbus expertise and support to ensure the business continuity in their operations in the current challenging context. Within the framework of the TD strategy and policy, the jobholder will be responsible for: The validation of the evolutions and defect management of the airnav X applications in its complete ecosystem (Online, Full Online, Intranet, Standalone, Editing, Offline), and/or GenEWIS application which is the digital solution for the Wiring Data and/or the STDO application which is the platform to access the Supplier data in the frame of the Tech Data deliveries. Support the BAO. He/she would also participate in the support analysis of the above applications. MAIN ACTIVITIES The job holder main activities are described here below: User Acceptance Test (UAT) Managing the test activities in coordination with the Business Application Owners and in case by case with other entities: UAT Coordination team, Project Leaders, Product Leaders, to manage: Dataset availability for tests campaigns execution “Validation environment” test accounts availability when required Tests execution (Functional tests and non-regression tests) Defects opening and tracking during the test campaign Update & maintainability of non-regression test-scripts based application evolution over the time. Participation in the relevant meeting along the test and deployment process. Support the BAO on the activities: Business Requirements Dossier, Features, Users stories, Contribute to M5 maturity and validate RCS (Request Change Sheet), Prepare the test strategy and test cases. The USP of this team is working in a multi-functional environment providing digital solutions to engineering problems. The team is composed of people with Core Engineering domain knowledge complemented by software development skills. The team plays an enabler role in various digitization initiatives across Airbus utilizing the latest technologies and the domain knowledge they have. We are seeking a Senior Java Developer with 7+ years of core software engineering experience and a background in electrical engineering or aerospace domains . In this role, you will design, customize, and build advanced software solutions and tools, with a focus on electrical harness design and systems integration. Hands-on product development or integration experience with Siemens Capital (formerly Mentor Graphics Capital) is strongly preferred. Key Responsibilities Software Architecture & Development: Design, build, and optimize backend Java applications, microservices, and custom extensions for complex electrical system design platforms. Siemens Capital Integration: Develop custom plugins, custom actions, data bridges, and automation rules using the Siemens Capital API (Capital Logic, Capital Harness XC, Capital Enterprise Integrator). Domain Modeling: Translate complex electrical harness structures, wiring schematics, pinouts, and EWIS (Electrical Wiring Interconnection System) rules into robust, scalable software models. System Interoperability: Build APIs and integration pipelines between ECAD software, MCAD platforms (e.g., CATIA, Siemens NX), and PLM systems (e.g., Teamcenter, Enovia). Technical Leadership: Conduct code reviews, establish best practices for Java and API development, and collaborate with cross-functional aerospace/electrical engineering teams. Required Qualifications Experience: Minimum 7 years of professional software development experience in Java/J2EE within electrical, aerospace, defense, or automotive engineering environments. Core Technical Stack: Advanced proficiency in Core Java (Java 11+, object-oriented architecture, multi-threading, RESTful APIs, design patterns).Deep experience with enterprise Java frameworks (Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, Maven/Gradle). Domain Expertise: Solid understanding of electrical wiring schematics, harness layout, pin-to-pin connectivity, or aerospace EWIS standards. Platform Expertise: Hands-on development experience with Siemens Capital suite (Capital Logic, Harness XC, Systems Architect) and its custom plugin/API ecosystem. Preferred Qualifications Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Exposure to XML, JSON data transformation pipelines, and database optimization (PostgreSQL, Oracle). Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development practices, Git, and automated CI/CD pipelines. jobs.description: Job Description: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Technical Expert with a strong background in Java and React (preferred) / Angular . The ideal candidate will be a proactive and dynamic individual who excels at solving complex technical problems and driving development projects to completion. In addition to the core technologies, cloud experience is a plus, Requires a good understanding of Software Architecture , Message queue pattern , microservice development. As a Technical Expert , you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and support high-quality software solutions. You will also provide technical guidance, mentorship, and support to other developers. Key Responsibilities Full Stack & Software Engineering Expertise Full Stack Development: Design, develop, test, and maintain robust, full-stack applications leveraging Spring Boot (Java) , and modern frontend frameworks including ReactJS . Scalability & Performance: Develop and optimize backend systems with a core focus on scalability, performance, and reliability . API Design: Design and implement high-quality RESTful APIs to meet business requirements, documented using the OpenAPI specification , and tested with tools like Postman . Microservices & Containers: Implement resilient Microservices architecture and manage application deployment using container technologies like Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes . Architecture Understanding : Have good exposure to Message queue based architecture , RabbitMQ , DRY concepts , focus on Code quality , security topics DevOps, Testing, & Quality Assurance DevOps Mindset: Champion a 100% DevOps mindset and collaborate across teams to manage workflows and deployment. Testing & Quality: Ensure high-quality code through the development and execution of unit tests for Java and React applications, utilizing relevant testing frameworks, and participating in rigorous code reviews . Source Control & CI/CD: Manage source code version control using Git and utilize comprehensive DevOps toolsets, including GitHub , Jenkins , Containers , and OpenShift . System Deployment: Deploy highly available, scalable, maintainable, and monitored systems and services . Data & Database Management Relational Databases: Design and implement relational databases using PostgreSQL , with strong expertise in writing SQL queries and stored procedures for efficient data access. Data Integrity: Ensure robust data integrity and performance across all database systems. Agile & Cross-Functional Collaboration Agile Methodology: Proficiently work within the product delivery lifecycle using Agile/Scrum and SAFe methodologies , leveraging tools such as VersionOne/JIRA . Product Lifecycle: Participate in all phases of the product development lifecycle , including analysis, design, testing, and integration. Stakeholder Communication: Collaborate effectively with product management and cross-functional teams (e.g., gathering requirements, creating technical specifications, and communicating technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders). Continuous Improvement: Proactively stay current with the latest technologies, research and evaluate new tools, and support the adoption of tooling and industry best practices . Required Skills & Qualifications Full Stack Software Engineer Core Expertise & Experience Experience: Engineering graduate with 3-6 years of professional experience in full stack development. Fundamental Principles: Strong foundational knowledge in Data Structures, Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), and the SOLID principles. Agile Methodology: Proficient in agile development, specifically experienced with SAFe and SCRUM methodologies. Backend & Java Ecosystem Java Proficiency: Strong expertise in the Java programming language (including JDK 8+) and its ecosystem. Frameworks & Tools: Extensive experience with the Spring Framework, including Spring Boot and Hibernate, and build automation using Maven. Architecture: Proven ability to develop multithreaded, scalable applications and implement Microservices using Java/Spring Framework. API Development: Skilled in designing and implementing APIs, including RESTful web services and SOAP-based web services. Frontend & Database Skills Frontend Proficiency: Proficient in front-end development utilizing the React framework, npm, and JavaScript. Database Knowledge: Knowledge of SQL databases (e.g., Oracle, PostgreSQL). Good to have: Specific experience with PostgreSQL and knowledge of NoSQL databases like MarkLogic. Lead - Airbus Innovation Centre Job Summary: Airbus Innovation Centre India & South Asia (AIC) is one of the only three innovation centres for Airbus outside the European Union. AIC collaborates with a number of stakeholders both internal and external to develop innovative and bleeding edge products with a particular focus on digital and AI topics. We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled AI Lead to lead our team of data scientists and data analysts in the development of cutting-edge AI products within the aviation field. The ideal candidate should possess a minimum of 10 years of hands-on experience working with Large Language Models (LLM), Computer Vision, and various open-source machine learning models. A strong foundation in system engineering is essential. The AI Lead will be responsible for guiding the team's technical direction, ensuring successful project outcomes, and driving innovation in the application of AI technologies. jobs.title: Group Manager (Software Engineering Manager)
jobs.description: Job Description: Description: Airbus started its digital journey. The objective being to transform the company and to prepare it for the future. This transformation includes new global governance, new ways of working and the implementation of digital business services and platforms. Skywise is an Airbus digital services company operated under Airbus India roof in Bangalore. Skywise is a leading flight operations specialist, operating as a wholly owned Airbus subsidiary. We provide comprehensive ground and onboard solutions designed to increase productivity for aircraft operators worldwide. We combine deep industry knowledge with an agile development culture to drive innovation in operational efficiency and sustainable aviation. As a Software Engineering Manager (Backend chapter Leader) you will be responsible for driving technical direction and engineering excellence of our backend discipline within the dynamic Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment. Operating in a matrix structure, you will set the standard for code quality by defining robust design patterns and championing Non Functional requirements to ensure our software remains sustainable and scalable. You will balance the technical leadership with people management, empowering your chapter members distributed across various Scrum teams to deliver high-performing, secure, reliable and robust solutions. This job offer is for a position based at the Airbus office in Bangalore. Qualification & Experience: We seek out curious minds. We value attention to detail, and we care deeply about outcomes. We’re looking above all for passionate people, eager to learn, willing to share, establishing innovative ways of working and influencing culture change, building high performance teams with deep technical knowledge. Are you ready to share this exciting challenge with us? Bachelor/Master Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or any relevant field with 12 to 15 years of overall experience Minimum 4 to 6 years of experience managing people and leading technical excellence across distributed teams working for enterprise products You will report to the Delivery Manager for Skywise, Asia within the Airbus India organization. Core roles & responsibilities: Technical Strategy: Define and maintain the backend technical vision ensuring alignment with broader architectural roadmap. Standards and best practices: Lead the global “Community of practice” for backed engineering. Collaborate with the chapter leaders across the globe to have standard guidelines to deliver robust, reliable, scalable, secure customer products. Enforce coding and testing standards, security best practices, code review guidelines and testing protocols to ensure craftsmanship and consistency across all squads. Architecture: Actively participate in architectural reviews. Balance feature delivery with long term technical health, advocating for the strategic reduction of technical debt and modernization of legacy systems. Devops Mindset: Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines (eg. gitlab), Infrastructure as a code, Docker Operational Excellence: Champion Grow the Business and Run the Business culture. Drive initiatives to improve high availability, observability (logging, tracing, metrics) and reliability of backend services. Align engineering initiatives and objectives directly with the overall company strategic goals. Ensure high standards are met, resulting in high-quality software deliverables that meet both functional and non-functional requirements. Develop Competency: Direct the necessary development team training to ensure the team possesses the required skills for future projects. Growth and mentorship: Drive performance review and career development conversations. Mentor engineers from junior to senior levels, helping them navigate technical and organization challenges. Resource allocation: Collaborate with the ART Trio (PM/SA/RTE) to ensure the right engineers are deployed to the right squads based on the skills, business needs, individual growth goals Psychological Safety: Foster an inclusive environment where engineers feel free to take calculated risks, speak up, constructively challenge each other to develop quality product and innovate. Qualifications: MUST Have: Engineering Background: 6+ years of hands on software engineering experience in backend development C# / .NET with a deep understanding of distributed systems, software performance, databases concurrency and data structures. System Design: Strong grasp of microservices architecture, REST APIs, ASP.NET Web API, AWS cloud-native principles. Ability to understand and review scalable systems design that can handle complex business logic. Strong AWS experience to be able to lead the AWS chapter globally in the software factory for Skywise - also lead topics like FinOps, explore upcoming AWS features and suggest the improvements for our products Management experience: 3+ years of experience directly managing engineers, including performance management, hiring, handling difficult conversations, conflict management. Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value for stakeholders and to bridge the gap between technical and non-technical teams. GOOD TO HAVE Experience with a matrix / SAFe organization: Proven ability to influence without absolute authority and navigate complex matrix structures where your direct reports work in different squads. Experience Operating within the SAFe setup. Aviation domain knowledge: Understanding of Airline operations, specifically Operations Control, Flight planning, crew management. Experience building mission critical software where high availability and safety are non-negotiable. jobs.title: Lead Skywise Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description: Description We are seeking an experienced and highly analytical Data & AI Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, building, and operationalizing machine learning models and scalable data architectures. Beyond technical execution, this role requires exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills to bridge the gap between complex AI capabilities and strategic business objectives. You will partner with cross-functional leaders to identify opportunities where data and artificial intelligence can drive measurable value, optimize processes, and enhance our product offerings. Job Responsibilities Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end Machine Learning and AI solutions (including traditional ML, deep learning, and Generative AI) to solve complex business problems. Act as the primary liaison between the Data/AI team and business units, translating non-technical business requirements into clearly defined data science problems. Build and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from diverse sources. Manage expectations, timelines, and deliverables with executive sponsors and project stakeholders. Present complex analytical findings, model performance metrics, and strategic recommendations to non-technical audiences clearly and compellingly. Lead cross-functional workshops and meetings to evangelize AI capabilities and identify new use cases across the organization. Optimize ML models for performance, scalability, and deployment in production environments (MLOps). Collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, and data analysts to integrate AI features into enterprise applications. Job Qualifications Experience: 10+ years of proven experience in Data Science, Data Engineering, AI/ML development, or a closely related field. Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline. Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Python, Pyspark and SQL. Strong understanding of statistical modeling, predictive analytics, NLP, and deep learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-Learn). jobs.description: Job Description: Job Description - JR Job Description Date : August 2026 Role : AIOps Leader Number of positions : 1 Description: We are seeking a seasoned, hands-on AIOps Leader (7+ Years of Experience) to serve as the principal technical architect and lead builder for our centralized AI Product Support & Operations function. Operating within a high-growth AI PSL (Product/Service Line), you will design, architect, and execute the end-to-end automation strategy that transforms raw operational chaos into scalable, self-healing, and data-driven infrastructure. In this role, you will bridge software engineering, site reliability, and AI/ML architectures. You will lead the creation of intelligent diagnostic pipelines, custom RAG-driven knowledge tools, self-healing systems, and automated triage engines. You will work closely with cross-functional leadership, L1/L2 support teams, and platform engineering to systematically eliminate operational toil, optimize MTTR, and build proactive anomaly detection mechanisms across our AI ecosystem. Qualification & Experience: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related quantitative field. Overall Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience across Software Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, or Systems Operations—with a focused concentration on cloud infrastructure automation and AI/ML operational tooling. Platform Specialization: At least 3+ years architecting and running operations directly within major cloud ecosystems ( AWS or GCP ), including native AI/ML compute platforms. Key Responsibilities 1. Architecture & Advanced AI/ML Automation Self-Healing Infrastructure & Workflows: Architect, build, and deploy auto-remediation routines, script-based diagnostic runners, and event-driven automation triggers that autonomously resolve platform issues. LLM & RAG Systems Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) knowledge tools, vector databases, and LLM utilities that index telemetry, historic logs, and RCAs for instant incident context. Bot & Agent Development: Lead the development and production rollout of conversational AI agents, custom webhooks, and self-service bots integrated into ticketing engines to automate Tier-1 and Tier-2 resolutions. 2. Observability, Telemetry & Predictive Analytics Observability Architecture: Build enterprise-grade telemetry ingestion workflows, automated log scraping, and context-enrichment pipelines that dynamically append system metrics directly to incident tickets upon creation. Predictive Anomaly Detection: Configure and tune real-time predictive alerting, log-pattern analysis, and AI-driven monitoring models across AWS, Azure, or GCP microservices. Operational BI & Analytics: Architect and own centralized executive and operational dashboards (e.g., ServiceNow, Datadog) tracking MTTR velocity, system uptime, defect density, ticket deflection rates, and SLA/CSAT compliance. 3. Operational Engineering & L1/L2 Empowerment Toil Elimination: Continuously audit support operational bottlenecks across product teams, transforming high-volume manual intervention points into production-grade, single-click, or fully autonomous workflows. Log & Metadata Standardization: Standardize system log outputs, stack-trace formatting, and tagging taxonomy across all AI products to ensure platform telemetry remains machine-readable for AI engines. Technical Mentorship: Guide L1/L2 support engineers on best practices for automation, code-based triage, and log parsing. Technical Essentials AWS & GCP Native AI Platforms: Deep hands-on experience orchestrating production AI/ML workflows on AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker AI, OpenSearch, AWS Lambda) or GCP (Vertex AI, Vertex AI Agent Builder, Cloud Run, BigQuery). Cloud Infrastructure & Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Advanced experience writing and managing cloud provisioning scripts using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or Google Cloud Deployment Manager to deploy auto-scaling, resilient operations environments. Containerization & Orchestration: Production experience managing microservices via Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) and Docker to support agentic AI workers, vector indexing engines, and automated micro-tasks. jobs.description: Position: Product Security- Embedded / IoT Job Description: Job Description: Product Security Engineer, Embedded / IoT Experience: 2 to 10 years Role Overview We are looking for product security professionals with hands-on experience in assessing and securing embedded systems and IoT products. The role involves performing product security assessments, conducting VAPT, developing threat models and security requirements, reviewing security controls, and supporting SSDLC activities. The selected candidate will work closely with hardware, firmware, software, and product engineering teams to identify vulnerabilities, recommend practical mitigations, and validate remediation. Key Skills Understanding of embedded product architecture, microcontrollers, processors, bootloaders, memory, storage, and embedded Linux and/or RTOS environments. Ability to interpret hardware block diagrams, relevant schematic sections, and firmware architecture. Hands-on experience assessing debug, programming, or communication interfaces such as UART, JTAG/SWD, SPI, I²C, and USB. Familiarity with device debugging, flash access, firmware acquisition, and evaluation of debug and readout protections. Experience with firmware extraction or acquisition, unpacking, filesystem analysis, configuration review, and static and/or dynamic analysis. Ability to identify hardcoded credentials, exposed secrets, insecure services, weak permissions, vulnerable components, and weaknesses in firmware update mechanisms. Experience conducting manual and tool-assisted security testing of physical devices, firmware, and exposed interfaces. Ability to validate vulnerabilities, distinguish false positives, demonstrate impact safely, and recommend relevant remediation. Working knowledge of threat modeling, attack-surface analysis, security risk assessment, product security requirements, secure design review, and security validation. Understanding of assets, data flows, trust boundaries, attack scenarios, and requirement-to-test traceability. Understanding of secure boot, firmware signing, secure OTA updates, rollback protection, authentication, authorization, cryptographic key storage, certificate management, secure communications, and production security configuration. Knowledge of TCP/IP and relevant embedded or IoT interfaces and protocols, such as Ethernet, Wi-Fi, BLE, CAN, MQTT, HTTP(S), and TLS. Experience capturing and analyzing traffic and assessing communication security. Ability to understand C/C code and develop or modify Python or shell scripts. Experience with relevant tools such as Ghidra or IDA, Binwalk, GDB, OpenOCD, Wireshark, Nmap, flash programmers, debug probes, and logic analyzers. Familiarity with SAST, SCA, and Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) analysis. Job Responsibilities Review product architecture, hardware and firmware designs, interfaces, deployment environments, and use cases to identify assets, attack surfaces, trust boundaries, and security risks. Plan and execute hardware and firmware VAPT using black-box, grey-box, or white-box approaches, as applicable. Assess physical access, debug interfaces, firmware, operating-system configuration, services, communication interfaces, and device management interfaces. Perform firmware analysis, binary analysis, reverse engineering, and security-focused source code reviews where applicable. Investigate vulnerabilities and document reproducible evidence, root causes, and product impact. Develop and maintain threat models, security risk assessments, product security requirements, security test plans, test cases, and traceability records throughout the product lifecycle. Review and validate security controls, including secure boot, signed firmware updates, rollback protection, credential handling, access control, secure communications, and debug restrictions. Execute or review SAST, SCA, and firmware/binary scanning results. Analyze SBOMs, assess vulnerability applicability, eliminate false positives, and prioritize findings based on exploitability, exposure, and product impact. Prepare technical reports with findings, evidence, risk ratings, and actionable remediation recommendations. Collaborate with engineering teams, verify fixes, and document residual risks. Develop reusable testing scripts, procedures, and checklists. Support security activities within development and release workflows and assess newly disclosed vulnerabilities affecting supported products. Location: IN-GJ-Ahmedabad, India-Ognaj (eInfochips) Time Type: Full time Job Category: Engineering Services

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Summary #LI-Hybrid Location: Hyderabad, India About The Role: This role is an opportunity to build the trusted, scalable, and AI-ready data foundations required to deliver Corporate Affairs insights and AI solutions. The Data Engineer will design, develop, and optimize enterprise data platforms and pipelines that ingest, transform, curate, govern, and serve structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data. Working closely with AI Engineering, Product Management, Architecture, Analytics, and Corporate Affairs stakeholders, the role will make high-quality data available for reporting, semantic search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and other data- and AI-driven use cases. The Data Engineer will be accountable for the end-to-end engineering and production performance of assigned data products and pipelines. Success will be measured by reliable delivery, data quality, scalability, security, governance, maintainability, and the ability to move data from source systems into trusted, reusable consumption layers. About the Role Key Responsibilities: Design, build, test, deploy, and support scalable enterprise data pipelines for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data, covering ingestion, transformation, validation, orchestration, monitoring, lineage, error handling, and both batch and streaming ETL/ELT workloads. Architect and implement modern lakehouse or data warehouse solutions using Databricks and/or Snowflake integrated with AWS services, applying Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold) or equivalent layered patterns for raw ingestion, validation, enrichment, curation, and business consumption. Develop data engineering solutions using Python, Pandas, DataFrames, SQL, notebooks, and distributed data-processing frameworks such as Apache Spark or PySpark, alongside AWS-based data solutions using Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Amazon Redshift, and other relevant AWS services. Process, integrate, and normalize heterogeneous data formats and sources , including relational data, JSON, XML, APIs, documents, text, logs, and other enterprise content. Implement comprehensive data quality and governance controls , covering completeness, accuracy, consistency, validity, uniqueness, timeliness, reconciliation, anomaly detection, metadata, lineage, cataloging, ownership, classification, access control, privacy, retention, and auditability. Optimize data pipelines and platforms for performance, availability, scalability, maintainability, and cloud cost, while creating reusable frameworks, components, standards, and data products that support analytics, Power BI/Tableau, AI, RAG, and semantic-search use cases. Where appropriate, integrate AI services and Agentic AI capabilities , including Amazon Bedrock, into data pipelines for classification, extraction, enrichment, summarization, entity identification, and metadata generation. Where applicable, enable graph, knowledge-graph, vector database, and semantic-retrieval solutions through entity extraction, entity resolution, relationship modeling, graph-oriented data preparation, parsing, chunking, embedding generation, metadata enrichment, indexing, and lifecycle management. Ensure engineering and production excellence through testing, CI/CD, documentation, monitoring, production support, and disciplined release management for data solutions. Demonstrate independence, accountability, strong problem solving, and continuous learning , proactively managing technical risks, dependencies, and production issues. Essential Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 8–12 years of overall experience in data engineering, software engineering, data platforms, or related technology roles, including substantial hands-on experience delivering production data solutions. Strong hands-on experience with Databricks and/or Snowflake in enterprise environments. Proven experience implementing Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold) or a comparable layered lakehouse/data-platform architecture. Strong experience designing and building enterprise ETL/ELT pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, orchestration, validation, monitoring, recovery, and production support. Strong programming skills in Python, including practical experience with Pandas, DataFrames, and notebook-based development. Strong SQL skills and experience with data modeling, schema design, transformation, performance tuning, and query optimization. Hands-on experience with AWS data services, particularly Amazon S3, AWS Glue, and Amazon Redshift. Proven experience processing structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data from heterogeneous enterprise sources. Strong practical knowledge of data governance and data quality, including metadata, lineage, cataloging, validation, reconciliation, security, and access control. Experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, data observability, monitoring, and operational support for production data pipelines. Ability to collaborate with AI Engineers, analysts, architects, product managers, BI developers, security teams, and business stakeholders. Desirable Requirements: Hands-on experience with both Databricks and Snowflake, including workload optimization, governance, and secure data sharing. Relevant certifications such as Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional, SnowPro Core or Advanced, or AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate. Experience with Amazon Bedrock or other AI/LLM services embedded in data pipelines for document processing, classification, extraction, summarization, enrichment, or metadata generation. Knowledge of Agentic AI patterns and the use of agents or AI-assisted workflows within enterprise data-processing solutions. Experience with vector databases, embeddings, chunking, vector search, hybrid retrieval, semantic search, and data preparation for Retrieval-Augmented Generation. Experience with graph databases such as Neo4j, knowledge graphs, entity resolution, relationship modeling, and graph-based retrieval. Experience developing dashboards or analytical products using Microsoft Power BI or Tableau. Experience with streaming platforms, orchestration tools, data catalogs, master/reference data, and infrastructure-as-code. jobs.description: Consistently models the advanced qualities of a servant leader and exhibits the behaviors of a Lean-Agile Leader with a Lean-Agile Mindset. Trains and coaches Agile teams and Stakeholders to embrace SAFe Core Values, adopt and apply SAFe Principles, and implement SAFe practices. Effectively removes impediments and actively communicates with leadership and outside stakeholders to protect the team from uncontrolled expansion of work while improving performance in the areas of quality, predictability, flow and velocity. Requirements Experience- 9 years Plus Certification- Certified Advanced SAFe Scrum Master certification, Certified SAFe Practitioner or Agilist certification Acts as a servant leader for multiple teams and their stakeholders. Aids the team and Product Owner in efforts to manage and sequence the backlog. Leads more complex teams involving work with routine external team impact or dependencies including multiple system integration points. Eliminates impediments and resolve issues and dependencies more independently with limited support from Release Train Engineer or other resources. Assists in building a high-performing team and foster relentless improvement at the Team and Program level while improving team performance in areas of quality, predictability, flow and velocity. Identifies SAFe anti-patterns and resolves with limited support and applies SAFe principles to facilitation, enablement, and coaching for multiple teams. Utilizes intermediate to advanced experience using tools to create metrics that measure and report on team performance, backlog health and continuous improvement. Utilizes advanced coaching capabilities to influence teams and advise on practices and procedures, soft-skills and Lean Agile mind-set. With limited support from RTE and others, guides teams through the decision making process and teach techniques on how to problem solve, improve communication, self-manage and self-organize. With limited support from RTE and others, Scrum Master supports a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised. Helps manage interpersonal conflicts, challenges and opportunities for growth within the team. Applies SAFe principles to facilitation, enablement, and coaching in a multi-team environment. Mentors and guides other scrum masters on SAFe principles and manifesto. Organizes and leads a Community of Practice, and protects the team from uncontrolled expansion of work. Leads problem solving techniques and continuously challenges norms to improve performance in quality, predictability, flow and velocity. Independently participates, facilitates and manages the outputs of all agile ceremonies including Daily Stand Up meetings, Sprint review, sprint retrospective, sprint planning, backlog refinement sessions, prepare for Program Increment Planning Sessions. Participates in the Scrum Master Communities of Practice, Scrum Mastery Sync Sessions and Agile Release Train Sync Sessions. Provides advanced mentorship to other scrum masters through Agile ceremonies. Provides back up support to RTE when needed. Trains and coaches Agile teams and stakeholders to embrace SAFe Core Values, adopt and apply SAFe Principles, and implement SAFe practices. Demonstrates ongoing thirst for knowledge and a desire for continuous improvement by creating an environment for continuous learning and builds improvement roadmaps for team(s). Pursues continuous education with regards to everything Agile (e.g. visit user groups, attend conferences, read books, write blogs, etc.). Continuously works with the Scrum Master Community of Practice to ensure standard procedures are in place and ultimately improve the organizations' product delivery capability. Seeks advice and works occasionally with the Release Train Engineer to establish best practices and resolve challenging issues, risks, conflicts or impediments. Demonstrate intermediate to advanced experience with Behavior Driven Development and Test Driven Development and support the adoption of engineering practices, DevOps, and Agile Architecture. Performs other duties as Benefits Competitive compensation and benefits package: Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses Comprehensive benefits package Career development and training opportunities Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based) Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group Private Health Insurance Pension Plan Paid Time Off Training & Development Note: Benefits differ based on employee level. It is a responsible and diverse organization of over 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong 55-year heritage and deep industry expertise, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to address the entire breadth of their business needs, from strategy and design to operations, fueled by the fast evolving and innovative world of cloud, data, AI, connectivity, software, digital engineering and platforms. The Group €22.5 billion in revenues in 2023. https://www.capgemini.com/us-en/about-us/who-we-are/

jobs.title: Manager, IT Infrastructure 2
jobs.description: Req ID: 142661 Remote Position: Hybrid Region: Asia Country: India State/Province: Chennai City: Guindy, Chennai General Overview Functional Area: Information Technology (ITM) Career Stream: IT Infrastructure (INFR) Role: Manager 2 (MG2) Job Title: Manager, IT Infrastructure 2 Job Code: MG2-ITM-INFR Job Level: Level 10 Direct/Indirect Indicator: Indirect Summary We are seeking a senior technical leader for the role of Infrastructure Automation Manager to direct and execute our enterprise-wide end-to-end automation strategy. This role bridges traditional on-premises data centers, private cloud hypervisors, container platforms, and public cloud environments into a unified, code-driven delivery ecosystem. With 12 to 15 years of industry experience, you will manage a specialized team of automation, infrastructure, and network reliability engineers. You will drive declarative infrastructure practices across bare-metal systems, hyperconverged/virtualization layers (Nutanix AHV, VMware vSphere), enterprise container fleets (Red Hat OpenShift, native Kubernetes), and software-defined network hardware (Cisco, Arista, Juniper switches and routers). You will own the full operational lifecycle—from architecture alignment and automated rollouts to fleet hygiene, automated DR failover, L3 support escalations, and executive operational reporting. Detailed Description Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following: Enterprise Automation Framework: Define and enforce declarative automation standards across hybrid environments spanning on-premise data centers, private clouds, and multi-cloud landing zones. Virtualization & HCI Automation: Architect automated provisioning, node expansion, and policy baselines across VMware vSphere/vCenter (vROps, PowerCLI, Terraform vSphere provider) and Nutanix AHV/Prism Central (Calm, Prism APIs). Container Platform Orchestration: Standardize deployment, node scaling, and operator lifecycle automations for Red Hat OpenShift and native Kubernetes clusters across bare metal and virtual platforms. Network as Code (NetDevOps): Champion automated configuration, deployment, and validation of physical and virtual network infrastructure (leaf-spine fabrics, switches, routers, firewalls, and load balancers) using Ansible, NAPALM, Nornir, and NetBox as a single source of truth. Unified Pipeline Orchestration: Build and manage enterprise GitOps pipelines (ArgoCD, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins) that drive zero-touch provisioning for compute, storage, virtualization, and network layers. Multi-Tier IaC & Configuration: Direct the authoring, testing, and modularization of production-grade Terraform modules, Ansible playbooks, Python automation frameworks, and Kubernetes Helm/Kustomize manifests. Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP): Establish automated PXE/IPXE booting, bare-metal imaging, switch boot-strapping, and dynamic host/hypervisor configuration workflows. Rolling Cluster & Hypervisor Lifecycle: Coordinate and automate rolling non-disruptive upgrades across VMware ESXi, Nutanix AOS/AHV, and OpenShift/Kubernetes worker and control-plane nodes. Configuration Drift & Compliance: Implement continuous drift detection and compliance auditing tools to guarantee that on-prem hardware, network device configurations, and cloud workloads strictly match source-controlled code baselines. Automated Patching & Vulnerability Remediation: Build automated orchestration pipelines for monthly firmware updates, hypervisor security patches, base OS updates, and network OS (NOS) upgrades. L3 Operational Support: Serve as the senior escalation manager for critical automation, networking, hypervisor, and platform outages, leading cross-functional debugging sessions. Knowledge/Skills/Competencies Virtualization & HCI: Extensive, production-level expertise automating and administering VMware vSphere/vCenter and Nutanix (AOS, AHV, Prism Central). Container Orchestration: Hands-on experience configuring, automating, and operating Red Hat OpenShift and native Kubernetes at scale (CNI, CSI, Operators, Helm, Kustomize). NetDevOps & Network Automation: Proven track record automating physical switch and router configurations (Cisco IOS-XE/NX-OS, Arista EOS, Juniper Junos) using NetBox, Ansible, Python (Netmiko, Nornir), or Terraform. Automation & IaC Tooling: Deep proficiency with Terraform, Ansible/Ansible Automation Platform (Tower/AWX), and Git-driven CI/CD systems. Scripting & Development: Advanced scripting abilities in Python, Go, Bash, or PowerShell for custom API integrations and operational tooling. Resiliency & DR: Proven experience automating enterprise backup, snapshotting, and disaster recovery architectures (Veeam, Velero, Zerto, or native storage replication). Observability: Strong working knowledge of telemetry pipelines, SNMP/gNMI collectors, Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK/OpenSearch dashboards. Physical Demands Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment. Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required. Typical Experience 12 to 15 years of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering, systems administration, network operations, and DevOps. 3+ years in a people management or technical lead capacity. Typical Education Bachelor's Degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience. Educational requirements may vary by geography. Notes This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time. Celestica is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on any protected status (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran or disability status or other characteristics protected by law). At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them. COMPANY OVERVIEW: Celestica, Inc. (NYSE: CLS; TSX: CLS) is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica helps its customers achieve competitive advantages. Today, Celestica delivers innovative supply chain solutions globally to customers in strategic two operating and reporting segments: Advanced Technology Solutions (ATS) and Connectivity and Cloud Solutions (CC): ATS: This segment serves customers in complex, regulated and high-reliability markets such as Industrial & Smart Energy, Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor Capital Equipment, and HealthTech. It is engineering led, with deep expertise in design, manufacturing and lifecycle solutions. CCS: This segment focuses on high-performance technology solutions and services for the data center, serving hyperscalers, digital native customers and enterprises. Celestica's Platform Solutions offering provides innovative and customizable computing, storage and networking solutions enabling AI-driven growth. Built on a legacy of trust and performance, Celestica has earned its reputation by delivering results in complex and fast-changing markets. Celestica exceeds customer expectations by identifying trends and staying ahead of the curve. Backed by comprehensive capabilities and a global network across North America, Europe and Asia, Celestica helps customers gain competitive advantage with the quality, flexibility and resiliency they need to respond quickly to shifts in demand. Guided by a bold vision to accelerate market advancements, Celestica delivers innovative solutions and technologies that turn complexity into opportunity. Anchored in teamwork and commitment, Celestica strives to be the most trusted partner to its customers and colleagues worldwide. Strong understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, and modern Lakehouse architectures. (Preferred not mandatory) Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to design scalable data solutions and resolve complex data engineering challenges. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. jobs.description: Senior Security Engineer - IAM About the Role As a Senior Security Engineer, you will lead the architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise Identity and Access Governance systems, authentication, authorization, and single sign-on (SSO) integrations. You will be responsible for defining identity security controls, best practices, and compliance standards for Uber’s workforce and core services. Additionally, you will drive continuous improvement by adopting modern software engineering standards, leveraging emerging AI/ML security capabilities, and mentoring team members. In this role, you will build scalable access governance features, centralized adaptive access management tools, and automated risk models across our hybrid environment. Our team is currently transforming Uber's Identity and Access Management solutions. We are seeking an innovative engineer who can think critically, drive end-to-end technical execution, and incorporate AI/ML technologies to advance our identity infrastructure.
