Authentication & Federation: Engineer and maintain Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), passwordless strategies, and conditional access policies across cloud and hybrid environments. Lifecycle & Governance (JML & NHI): Manage full-lifecycle identity governance (Joiner-Mover-Leaver), access certification campaigns, and segregation-of-duties (SoD) controls. Secure non-human identities (NHIs), including service accounts, API keys, secrets, certificates, and AI/automated agent identities. Automation & Engineering: Build robust APIs, scripts, and automated workflows (using Python, PowerShell, Go, or platform-native tools) to eliminate manual provisioning and reduce operational friction. Collaboration & Consulting: Partner with Cloud, SRE, Application Development, and HR teams to embed identity guardrails into new and existing platforms. Provide technical leadership and mentor junior engineers. Compliance & Audits: Support security frameworks and compliance audits by ensuring identity controls are well-documented and evidenced. What you will need: Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Information Security or Cybersecurity. Experience in at least one of the security domains - Identity & Access Management (IAM/IGA), Application Security, Secret management solutions (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk). Protocol Proficiency: Deep understanding of core identity and authorization standards: SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, LDAP, FIDO2 / WebAuthn. Experience with developing complex software systems scaling to millions of users with production-quality deployment, monitoring, and reliability. Scripting & Coding: Working proficiency in Java, PowerShell, Go, or TypeScript for automation, API integrations, and code/configuration reviews. jobs.description: Job Description About Persistent We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem. Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q2 FY27 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens™ Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026. About Position: We are looking for an experienced Senior Network Security QA Engineer to lead end-to-end quality engineering for a network security platform. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in network protocols, Linux, cloud environments, release validation, API and UI testing, and distributed system testing across physical, virtual, and cloud deployment models. Role: Senior Network Security QA Engineer Location: All Persistent Locations Experience: 5 to 10 Years Job Type: Full-Time Employment What You'll Do: Lead the end-to-end testing lifecycle for a network security platform, ensuring stable, high-quality releases across physical appliances, virtual machines, and cloud instances. Plan and execute release testing, including smoke testing, upgrade and revert validation, feature verification, and regression testing across version compatibility matrices. Analyze network traffic and protocols such as TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, SSL/TLS, and SSH to design realistic, high-fidelity test scenarios for detection and logging accuracy. Build and maintain scalable test environments across on-premises infrastructure, VMware, KVM, AWS, Azure, and GCP. Collaborate with Development, Product Management, and global Quality Engineering teams to triage issues, assess risk areas, and align release goals. Log, track, and drive defect resolution with clear reproduction steps, root cause analysis, and severity assessment. Define test strategies for new features based on requirements, design documents, and acceptance criteria. Validate REST API endpoints, CLI tools, web UI workflows, and system-level behavior across distributed architectures. Design and execute UI/UX test cases for web-based management consoles, dashboards, and configuration interfaces, including cross-browser compatibility, responsiveness, and accessibility. Communicate release readiness, blockers, dependencies, and risk assessments proactively to stakeholders. Expertise You'll Bring: 5 to 10 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Software Testing, or Software Engineering with exposure to network security, cloud, infrastructure, or appliance-based products. Strong knowledge of networking protocols including TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, SSL/TLS, SSH, and Layer 2 through Layer 7 networking concepts. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Strong Linux administration skills across RHEL, AlmaLinux, and Ubuntu environments. Experience with software upgrade, compatibility, rollback, and release validation testing. Hands-on experience testing distributed systems deployed across cloud and on-premises environments. Strong proficiency with REST API testing using Postman, curl, or programmatic approaches. Experience validating web UIs, command-line tools, APIs, logs, and system-level functionality. Experience with Git, GitLab, GitHub, and collaborative source code management workflows. Hands-on experience with Jira, Zephyr Squad, or equivalent test and defect management tools. Experience with Docker containers and Kubernetes (K8s/K3s) environments. Knowledge of network security monitoring technologies including Zeek, Suricata, and YARA. Experience using packet capture and analysis tools such as tcpdump, tshark, and tcpreplay. Familiarity with SIEM and observability platforms including Splunk, Elastic, and Microsoft Sentinel. Experience with CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar platforms. Exposure to pytest, Allure, and automated test reporting frameworks. Understanding of high-availability, fault-tolerant, and distributed architectures. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Analyze collection and index growth. o MongoDB Integrity and Data Reliability: Implement MongoDB database integrity and health-check processes.Use collection validation and MongoDB diagnostic capabilities where appropriate. Monitor WiredTiger storage engine health and database logs. Investigate corruption, checksum, storage, and I/O-related errors. Experience in database upgrade/migrate, patching, backup recovery of large databases. Plan and implement major upgrades, ensuring system integrity and monitoring Analyze, solve, and prepare RCA for production outages. Provide cost/time estimates, capacity planning of database environments. Institute process for continuous improvement, perform other related duties as assigned. Assist on critical production issues, identify root cause and provide mitigation plan. Work with various product/application teams across the company Understand the product architecture and prepare Service Improvement for efficiency. Qualifications & Requirements Minimum years of rich experience on multiple database technologies primarily MongoDB, Oracle and Postgres. Strong knowledge of replication, sharding, indexing, and schema design . Familiarity with monitoring tools (New Relic, CloudWatch, Ops Manager). Experience in implementing and managing database clustering and HA/DR systems. o Ability to diagnose problems and triage/resolve issues across various tiers (application, network, database, server, or storage tiers). o Experience in database upgrade/migrate, patching, backup recovery of large databases. Ability to develop SQL and PL/SQL scripts and Strong Automation mindset/experience. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, Positive attitude and strong commitment to delivering quality work, Ability to multitask under pressure, prioritize work based on criticality. Should be flexible and open to work in 24x7 environment in any shifts, willing to work on holidays, over weekends as per the demand from Project. Key Responsibilities Collaborative partner: Works autonomously and with other engineers and customers to support and maintain monitoring products by ensuring availability of all tools and completing customer requests on-time with quality. Addresses technical challenges and ensures quality through collaborative design and development. Forward Thinker: Applies proactive mindset to continually look for ways to improve performance, quality and efficiency. Designs, develops, analyzes, and automates report on critical metrics that provide insights into overall health ensuring the notifications are delivered effectively and efficiently to meet the enterprise availability, stability and reliability goals. Enforces compliance requirements for documentation’s data integrity, accuracy, and completeness. Helps automate, streamline or rectify workflows required for onboarding or instrumentation of applications, infrastructure, databases, and other middleware tiers to monitoring products. Identifies opportunities, design and build automated tools that help reduce efforts and saves cost on repeatable tasks for cross-platform products. jobs.title: Maconomy Support Analyst
jobs.description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your Role : As a Maconomy Support Analyst, you will provide Level 2 functional and transactional support for the Maconomy ERP platform, ensuring stable and efficient business operations across Finance, Projects, Billing, Purchasing, and related business functions. You will work closely with Finance teams, IT teams, and business stakeholders to resolve issues, improve processes, support system enhancements, and drive operational excellence across the ERP landscape. What Will You Do: Provide Level 2 functional and transactional support for Maconomy ERP, ensuring timely resolution of incidents, service requests, and business-critical issues within SLA commitments. Investigate system issues, collaborate with technology teams to identify defects, perform root-cause analysis, and support timely remediation. Support ERP business processes including Accounting, Purchasing, Production, Distribution, Billing, Customer Order Management, and related operational functions. Create and maintain ERP process documentation, user manuals, operational procedures, knowledge articles, and support guides. Develop incident reports, project status reports, monthly service reports, and analytical insights to support decision-making and continuous improvement. Coordinate with Finance teams, key users, and IT teams to address operational challenges, gather requirements, and improve user experience. Support ERP enhancements, testing activities, special projects, system improvements, and ad-hoc business initiatives. Conduct service review meetings with Finance leads and business stakeholders while promoting governance, best practices, and continuous improvement. Your Future at Kyndryl The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Experience: 3+ years of experience working within complex global organizations in ERP support, ERP operations, or business systems support roles. Proven experience supporting ERP platforms such as Maconomy, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics 365, with Maconomy experience preferred. Strong understanding of ERP business processes including Finance, Accounting, Billing, Purchasing, Project Management, and operational workflows. Experience troubleshooting ERP applications, supporting system installations, investigating incidents, and resolving user issues. Experience documenting business processes, operational procedures, support knowledge bases, and user training materials. Strong reporting, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to identify improvement opportunities. Ability to build trusted relationships with Finance teams, business stakeholders, key users, and technology teams. Excellent communication, organizational, stakeholder management, and time-management skills with the ability to work independently. Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise: Hands-on experience with Deltek Maconomy support, administration, implementation, or enhancement projects. Experience supporting Finance, Project Accounting, Professional Services Automation (PSA), or ERP transformation initiatives. Experience training end users and supporting ERP adoption, change management, and business process improvements. Familiarity with ERP reporting, testing methodologies, governance practices, and service management processes. Experience with ERP/accounting software and relevant ERP certifications is highly desirable. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
